C++网络编程，第1卷：利用ACE和模式掌握复杂性
作者： 道格拉斯·C·施密特、斯蒂芬·D·休斯顿
   
出版商 艾迪生·韦斯利
发布日期 2001年12月10日
ISBN ：0-201-60464-7
页 ：336

 

 

 

 

随着网络、设备和系统的不断发展，软件工程师面临着在频繁变化的环境中创建可靠的分布式应用程序的独特挑战。《C++网络编程，第一卷》提供了使用自适应通信环境（ACE）开发和优化复杂分布式系统的实用解决方案。ACE是一个革命性的开源框架，可在数十种硬件平台和操作系统上运行。

As networks, devices, and systems continue to evolve, software engineers face the unique challenge of creating reliable distributed applications within frequently changing environments. C++ Network Programming, Volume 1, provides practical solutions for developing and optimizing complex distributed systems using the ADAPTIVE Communication Environment (ACE), a revolutionary open-source framework that runs on dozens of hardware platforms and operating systems.

本书旨在指导软件专业人员避开开发高效、可移植且灵活的网络应用程序时可能遇到的陷阱和误区。它探讨了并发网络应用程序固有的设计复杂性，以及在努力掌握这些应用程序时必须权衡的各种因素。

This book guides software professionals through the traps and pitfalls of developing efficient, portable, and flexible networked applications. It explores the inherent design complexities of concurrent networked applications and the tradeoffs that must be considered when working to master them.

《C++网络编程》首先概述了编写分布式并发应用程序所涉及的问题和工具。然后，本书介绍了开发灵活高效的并发网络应用程序所需的基本设计维度、模式和原则。本书的专家作者团队将向您展示如何运用C++和各种模式有效地开发面向对象的网络应用程序，同时提升您的设计技能。

C++ Network Programming begins with an overview of the issues and tools involved in writing distributed concurrent applications. The book then provides the essential design dimensions, patterns, and principles needed to develop flexible and efficient concurrent networked applications. The book's expert author team shows you how to enhance design skills while applying C++ and patterns effectively to develop object-oriented networked applications.

读者将看到以下内容：

Readers will find coverage of:

  • C++网络编程，包括概述和应对常见开发挑战的策略

  • C++ network programming, including an overview and strategies for addressing common development challenges

  • ACE工具包

  • The ACE Toolkit

  • 连接协议、消息交换和消息传递与共享内存

  • Connection protocols, message exchange, and message-passing versus shared memory

  • 可重用网络应用服务的实现方法

  • Implementation methods for reusable networked application services

  • 面向对象网络编程中的并发性

  • Concurrency in object-oriented network programming

  • ACE外立面包装设计原则和模式

  • Design principles and patterns for ACE wrapper facades

本书为 C++ 开发人员提供了最完整的工具包，使他们能够轻松高效地开发成功的、跨平台的、并发的网络应用程序。

With this book, C++ developers have at their disposal the most complete toolkit available for developing successful, multiplatform, concurrent networked applications with ease and efficiency.

      前言

      Foreword

      撰写这篇前言时，我正在欧洲旅行，享受着欧洲完善的公共交通系统。作为一名美国人，我对这套系统感到无比惊叹。无论我降落在哪个机场，都能轻松搭乘快捷、干净、可靠、准时的火车和巴士，而且最重要的是，它们都能直达目的地。出发和到达的广播提供多种语言版本。即使像我这样的非英语母语者，也能轻松理解指示牌和方向。

      As I write this foreword I'm traveling through Europe, relying on the excellent European public transportation infrastructure. Being an American, I'm fascinated and amazed by this infrastructure. Wherever I land at an airport I have easy access to trains and buses that are fast, clean, reliable, on time, and perhaps most importantly, going directly to my destination. Departure and arrival announcements are available in multiple languages. Signs and directions are easy to follow, even for non-native speakers like me.

      我住在波士顿地区，也在那里工作。和大多数美国人一样，我几乎完全依赖汽车出行。除了偶尔乘坐波士顿地铁，我出行都开车，因为公共交通基础设施太过有限，无法满足我的需求。由于波士顿及其他地方数百万人都面临着同样的困境，我们的高速公路基础设施早已不堪重负，无法应对如此庞大的交通流量。如果我知道自己究竟浪费了多少时间在堵车上，我一定会感到震惊。

      I live and work in the Boston area, and like most Americans I rely almost entirely on my automobile to get from one place to the next. Except for an occasional use of the Boston subway system, I use my car to get around because the public transportation infrastructure is too limited to get me to my destination. Since millions of others in Boston and elsewhere are in the same predicament, our highway infrastructure is now well past the point of coping with the traffic volume. I know I'd be appalled if I knew exactly how much of my life I've wasted sitting in traffic jams.

      网络计算系统和交通运输系统之间存在一些有趣的相似之处，其中最显著的一点是，二者的成功都依赖于可扩展的基础设施。可扩展的交通运输系统不仅包含显而易见的基础设施要素，例如火车、铁轨或飞机、机场，还需要调度、路线规划、维护、票务和监控等，所有这些都必须随着物理交通运输系统本身的扩展而扩展。同样，网络计算不仅需要主机和网络——即物理计算和通信基础设施——还需要基于软件的调度、路线规划、调度、配置、版本控制、身份验证、授权和监控等功能，以使网络系统能够根据需要进行扩展。

      There are some interesting similarities between networked computing systems and transportation systems, the most significant of these being that the success of both depends on scalable infrastructure. Scalable transportation systems comprise not just obvious infrastructure elements, such as trains and rails or airplanes and airports. They also require scheduling, routing, maintenance, ticketing, and monitoring, for example, all of which must scale along with the physical transportation system itself. Similarly, networked computing requires not only host machines and networks—the physical computing and communication infrastructure—but also software-based scheduling, routing, dispatching, configuration, versioning, authentication, authorization, and monitoring that allows the networked system to scale as necessary.

      基础设施建设的一个讽刺之处在于，它极难做好，但对用户而言越透明，我们就越认为它成功。例如，尽管瑞士阿尔卑斯山地形崎岖，但一些建筑师、工程师和建造者运用他们的专业知识，打造了一个高效的交通系统，供数百万瑞士人每天轻松使用。事实上，该系统如此可靠便捷，以至于你很快就会习以为常，它对你而言也变得透明。例如，当你登上瑞士火车时，你的注意力只会集中在如何从一个地点到达另一个地点，而不会关注把你送到那里的机械设备。除非你是游客，否则你可能不会注意到你正在穿越一个耗时数年设计和建造的隧道，或者正在攀爬一个陡峭到需要齿轨辅助列车爬坡的山坡。铁路基础设施完美地完成了它的使命，因此，你甚至不会注意到它的存在。

      An ironic fact about infrastructure is that it's extremely difficult to do well, and yet the more transparent to the user it is, the more successful we consider it to be. Despite the rugged terrain of the Swiss Alps, for example, a few architects, engineers, and builders have applied their expertise to provide an efficient transportation system that millions of people in Switzerland use daily with ease. In fact, the system is so reliable and easy to use that you quickly take it for granted, and it becomes transparent to you. For example, when boarding the Swiss railway your focus is simply on getting from one point to another, not on the machinery used to get you there. Unless you're a tourist, you probably miss the fact that you're traversing a tunnel that took years to design and build, or ascending an incline so steep that the railway includes a cog rail to help the train climb. The rail infrastructure does flawlessly what it's supposed to do, and as a result, you don't even notice it.

      本书探讨的是网络计算系统的基础设施软件，通常称为中间件。之所以称之为中间件，是因为它位于操作系统和网络之上、应用程序之下，就像沙漏中的“腰部”。中间件种类繁多，功能各异，从 J2EE 应用服务器、异步消息系统和 CORBA ORB，到用于监控小型嵌入式系统套接字的软件，不一而足。中间件必须支持日益丰富的应用程序、操作系统、网络协议、编程语言和数据格式。如果没有中间件，管理网络计算系统中日益增长的多样性和异构性将变得繁琐、容易出错且成本高昂。

      This book is about infrastructure software, normally called middleware, for networked computing systems. It's called middleware because it's the "waist in the hourglass" that resides above the operating system and networks, but underneath the application. Middleware comes in a wide variety of shapes, sizes, and capabilities, ranging from J2EE application servers, asynchronous messaging systems, and CORBA ORBs to software that monitors sockets for small embedded systems. Middleware must support an ever-wider variety of applications, operating systems, networking protocols, programming languages, and data formats. Without middleware, taming the ever-increasing diversity and heterogeneity in networked computing systems would be tedious, error prone, and expensive.

      尽管中间件种类繁多，解决的问题也各不相同，但不同类型的中间件往往使用相同的模式和通用抽象来应对复杂性。例如，如果您深入了解一个可扩展且灵活的应用服务器、消息系统或 CORBA ORB，您很可能会发现它们在连接管理、并发、同步、事件解复用、事件处理程序分发、错误日志记录和监控等任务中采用了类似的技术。正如瑞士铁路的用户数量远远超过其设计和建造者一样，成功的中间件的用户数量也远远超过其设计和建造者的数量。如果您设计、构建或使用中间件，您的成功取决于您是否了解、理解并应用这些通用模式和抽象。

      Despite the variety of types of middleware, and the variety of issues that middleware addresses, different types of middleware tend to use the same patterns and common abstractions to master complexity. If you were to peek inside a scalable and flexible application server, messaging system, or CORBA ORB, for example, you would likely find that they employ similar techniques for tasks such as connection management, concurrency, synchronization, event demultiplexing, event handler dispatching, error logging, and monitoring. Just as the users of the Swiss railways far outnumber those who designed and built it, the number of users of successful middleware far exceeds the number of people who designed and built it. If you design, build, or use middleware, your success depends on knowing, understanding, and applying these common patterns and abstractions.

      尽管许多人都理解中间件需要可扩展性和灵活性，但很少有中间件能像 Doug Schmidt 和 Steve Huston 在本书中介绍的自适应通信环境 (ACE) 那样高效地提供这些功能。ACE 是一个广泛使用的 C++ 工具包，它捕捉了各种成功的中间件和网络应用程序中使用的常见模式和抽象概念。ACE 已成为许多网络计算系统的基础，其应用范围涵盖实时航空电子应用、CORBA ORB 以及大型机点对点通信支持等。

      While many understand the need for scalability and flexibility in middleware, few can provide it as effectively as the ADAPTIVE Communication Environment (ACE) that Doug Schmidt and Steve Huston describe in this book. ACE is a widely used C++ toolkit that captures common patterns and abstractions used in a variety of highly successful middleware and networked applications. ACE has become the basis for many networked computing systems, ranging from real-time avionics applications to CORBA ORBs to mainframe peer-to-peer communication support.

      和所有优秀的中间件一样，ACE 隐藏了底层各种异构环境的复杂性。然而，ACE 与大多数其他基础设施中间件的不同之处在于，它能在应用程序需要时提供最大的灵活性，同时又不会降低系统的性能或可扩展性。作为一名资深的中间件架构师，我深知在同一个软件包中同时实现性能和灵活性是多么困难。

      Like all good middleware, ACE hides the complexity of the diverse and heterogeneous environments beneath it. What sets ACE apart from most other infrastructure middleware, however, is that even though it allows for maximum flexibility wherever needed by the application, it doesn't degrade the performance or scalability of the system. Being a long-time middleware architect myself, I know all too well that achieving both performance and flexibility in the same package is hard.

      某种程度上，ACE 的灵活性和性能表现并不令我感到意外。由于我与 Doug 长期合作，我深知他是这一领域的先驱。如今种类繁多、可扩展、高性能且灵活的中间件，都明显带有他的印记和影响。他与 Steve 的合作——Steve 是一位才华横溢的 C++ 开发人员和作家，多年来对 ACE 的贡献促成了诸多改进——使得本书成为所有参与中间件设计、构建甚至使用的人员的“必读之作”。随着万维网和互联嵌入式系统的日益普及，网络计算系统的数量、规模和重要性将持续增长。只有理解 Doug 和 Steve 在本书中阐述的关键模式、技术、类和经验教训，我们才能构建出透明、高效且可靠的中间件基础设施。

      In a way, though, the flexibility and performance aspects of ACE don't surprise me. Due to my long-time association with Doug, I'm well aware that he is a pioneer in this area. The wide variety of scalable, high-performing, and flexible middleware that exists today clearly bears his mark and influence. His teaming with Steve, who's a gifted C++ developer and author whose work on ACE has led to many improvements over the years, has yielded a work that's a "must read" for anyone involved in designing, building, or even using middleware. The increasing pervasiveness of the World Wide Web and of interconnected embedded systems means that the number, scale, and importance of networked computing systems will continue to grow. It's only through understanding the key patterns, techniques, classes, and lessons that Doug and Steve describe in this book that we can hope to supply the middleware infrastructure to make it all transparent, efficient, and reliable.

      Steve Vinoski，

        关于本书

        About This Book

        过去十年间，并发面向对象网络编程已成为开发软件应用程序的有效范式，这些应用程序的协作对象可以是并行的、并行的或并行的。

        Over the past decade, concurrent object-oriented network programming has emerged as an effective paradigm for developing software applications whose collaborating objects can either be

        1. 位于同一进程或计算机内

        2. Collocated within one process or computer or

        3. 分布在通过网络连接的一组计算机上，例如嵌入式系统互连、局域网 (LAN)、企业内部网或互联网。

        4. Distributed across a set of computers connected by a network, such as an embedded system interconnect, a local area network (LAN), an enterprise intranet, or the Internet.

        当对象分布在网络上时，构成这些对象的各个实体必须有效地相互通信和协调。此外，随着应用程序在其生命周期内不断变化，它们也必须持续保持这种通信和协调。对象的部署位置、可用的网络基础设施以及平台并发选项赋予了这种强大的自由度，但也带来了挑战。

        When objects are distributed, the various entities that constitute these objects must communicate and coordinate with each other effectively. Moreover, they must continue to do so as applications change over their lifetimes. The placement of objects, the available networking infrastructure, and platform concurrency options allow for a level of freedom that's powerful, yet challenging.

        如果设计得当，并发面向对象网络编程功能可以极大地扩展应用程序的灵活性。例如，您可以根据项目需求和可用资源，使用

        When designed properly, concurrent object-oriented network programming capabilities can add a great deal of flexibility to your application options. For instance, in accordance with the requirements and resources available to your projects, you can use

        • 实时、嵌入式或手持式系统

        • Real-time, embedded, or handheld systems

        • 个人电脑或笔记本电脑

        • Personal or laptop computers

        • 各种规模的UNIX或Linux系统

        • An assortment of various-sized UNIX or Linux systems

        • “大型机”主机，甚至是超级计算机

        • "Big iron" mainframes and even supercomputers

        然而，在多个操作系统 (OS) 平台上开发和移植网络应用程序时，您很可能会遇到复杂的挑战。这些挑战主要体现在网络协议或组件库的兼容性问题上，这些协议或组件库在不同的硬件和软件平台上具有不同的 API 和语义；此外，原生操作系统进程间通信 (IPC) 和并发机制本身的限制也会引入一些意想不到的复杂性。为了缓解这些问题，自适应通信环境(ACE) 提供了一个面向对象的工具包，该工具包可在数十种硬件和操作系统平台上可移植运行，包括大多数版本的 Win32 和 UNIX，以及许多实时和嵌入式操作系统。

        You'll likely encounter complex challenges, however, when developing and porting networked applications on multiple operating system (OS) platforms. These complexities appear in the form of incompatible networking protocols or component libraries that have different APIs and semantics on different hardware and software platforms, as well as accidental complexities introduced by limitations with the native OS interprocess communication (IPC) and concurrency mechanisms themselves. To alleviate these problems, the ADAPTIVE Communication Environment (ACE) provides an object-oriented toolkit that runs portably on dozens of hardware and OS platforms, including most versions of Win32 and UNIX, as well as many real-time and embedded operating systems.

        有些人会让你相信，事实上的或法律上的操作系统标准，例如 POSIX、UNIX98 或 Win32，足以让程序员保护他们的应用程序免受移植性挑战。不幸的是，“标准的好处在于选择众多”这句老话[ Tan96 ]在今天比十年前更加适用。如今，商业、学术和政府项目中使用了数十种不同的操作系统平台，而且随着每个新版本和变体的出现，组合方式的数量还在不断增加。

        Some would have you believe that de facto or de jure OS standards, such as POSIX, UNIX98, or Win32, are all programmers need to shield their applications from portability challenges. Unfortunately, the adage that "the nice thing about standards is that there are so many to choose from" [Tan96] is even more applicable today than it was a decade ago. There are now dozens of different OS platforms used in commercial, academic, and governmental projects, and the number of permutations grows with each new version and variant.

        过去二十年来，我们开发了许多跨平台、并发和联网系统。因此，我们可以向您保证，操作系统厂商通常会在不同时期选择实现不同的标准。此外，标准本身也在不断变化和发展。您很可能需要在多个平台上工作，而这些平台在不同时期以不同的方式实现不同的标准。因此，直接使用操作系统 API 进行编程会带来以下两个问题：

        We've developed many multiplatform, concurrent, and networked systems for the past two decades. We can therefore assure you that OS vendors often choose to implement different standards at different times. Moreover, standards change and evolve. It's likely that you'll work on multiple platforms that implement different standards in different ways at different times. Programming directly to OS APIs therefore yields the following two problems:

        1. 由于用 C 语言编写的原生操作系统 API 通常缺乏类型安全、可移植、可重入和可扩展的系统函数接口和函数库，因此容易出错。例如，广泛使用的 Sockets API（第 2 章讨论过）中的通信端点是通过弱类型的整数或指针 I/O 句柄来标识的，这增加了运行时出现不易察觉的编程错误的可能性。

        2. It's error-prone since native OS APIs written in C often lack type-safe, portable, reentrant, and extensible system function interfaces and function libraries. For example, endpoints of communication in the widely used Sockets API (discussed in Chapter 2) are identified via weakly typed integer or pointer I/O handles, which increase the likelihood of subtle programming errors at run-time.

        3. 这种设计方法助长了不合理的设计技术，因为许多使用操作系统API编写的网络应用程序都基于算法设计而非面向对象设计。算法设计根据特定的功能需求分解应用程序的结构，而这些需求是易变的，并且很可能随时间演变。因此，这种设计范式会产生不可扩展的软件架构，无法快速定制以满足不断变化的应用程序需求[ Boo94 ]。

        4. It encourages inadequate design techniques since many networked applications written using OS APIs are based upon algorithmic design, rather than object-oriented design. Algorithmic design decomposes the structure of an application according to specific functional requirements, which are volatile and likely to evolve over time. This design paradigm therefore yields nonextensible software architectures that can't be customized rapidly to meet changing application requirements [Boo94].

        在当今经济动荡、放松管制和全球竞争激烈的时代，使用原生操作系统 API 和算法设计技术从头开始开发应用程序变得极其昂贵和耗时。

        In this age of economic upheaval, deregulation, and stiff global competition, it's becoming prohibitively expensive and time consuming to develop applications entirely from scratch using native OS APIs and algorithmic design techniques.

        如果您从事网络软件系统开发多年，或许已经习惯了其中一些问题。然而，还有更好的方法。本书将展示 C++ 和 ACE 如何提供面向对象功能，帮助您规避诸多陷阱和误区，同时尽可能地利用标准，甚至某些平台特定的特性。面向对象的设计比算法设计更具长期稳定性，因此是开发多种网络应用程序的首选基础。

        If you've been developing networked software systems for many years, you may have learned to accept some of these problems as a fact of life. There is a better way, however. In this book, we show how C++ and ACE provide object-oriented capabilities that allow you to avoid many traps and pitfalls, while still leveraging standards—and even certain platform-specific features—whenever possible. Object-oriented designs exhibit greater stability over time than algorithmic designs, which makes them the preferred basis for developing many types of networked applications.

        不出所料，这种灵活性也是有代价的：你可能需要学习一些新的概念、方法、模式、工具和开发技巧。根据你的背景，学习曲线可能很平缓，也可能一开始会比较陡峭。但关键在于，面向对象范式可以为你提供一套成熟的技术，从而缓解网络应用程序开发中的诸多挑战。本书提供了一系列具体示例，用以说明用于开发和应用 ACE 工具包中类的面向对象技术。你可以使用相同的技术和 ACE 类来简化你自己的应用程序。

        Not surprisingly, there's a price for all this flexibility: you may need to learn some new concepts, methods, patterns, tools, and development techniques. Depending on your background, this learning curve may be trivial or it may initially seem steep. The bottom line, however, is that the object-oriented paradigm can offer you a mature set of techniques that alleviates many challenges of networked application development. This book presents a series of concrete examples to illustrate the object-oriented techniques used to develop and apply the classes in the ACE toolkit. You can use the same techniques and ACE classes to simplify your own applications.

          Intended Audience

          本书面向希望深入了解使用 C++ 和面向对象设计进行并发网络编程策略和技巧的实践型开发人员或高级学生。我们阐述了快速简便地开发灵活高效的并发网络应用程序所需的关键设计维度、模式和原则。大量的 C++ 代码示例强化了设计概念，并具体展示了如何立即使用 ACE 中的核心类。我​​们还将带您“深入幕后”，了解 ACE 工具包中进程间通信 (IPC) 和并发机制的设计原理。本书内容将有助于提升您的设计技能，并在您自己的面向对象网络应用程序中更有效地应用 C++ 和各种设计模式。

          This book is intended for "hands-on" developers or advanced students interested in understanding the strategies and tactics of concurrent network programming using C++ and object-oriented design. We describe the key design dimensions, patterns, and principles needed to develop flexible and efficient concurrent networked applications quickly and easily. Our numerous C++ code examples reinforce the design concepts and illustrate concretely how to use the core classes in ACE right away. We also take you "behind the scenes" to understand how and why the IPC and concurrency mechanisms in the ACE toolkit are designed the way they are. This material will help to enhance your design skills and to apply C++ and patterns more effectively in your own object-oriented networked applications.

            结构与内容

            Structure and Content

            本书阐述了 C++ 和中间件如何帮助解决开发网络应用程序的关键挑战。我们回顾了主流操作系统平台上可用的核心原生操作系统机制，并展示了如何在 ACE 中应用 C++ 和设计模式，将这些机制封装到类库包装器外观中，从而提高应用程序的可移植性和健壮性。本书的主要应用示例是一个网络日志服务，它通过 TCP/IP 将客户端应用程序的日志记录传输到日志服务器。我们在本书中始终使用该服务作为运行示例。

            This book describes how C++ and middleware help address key challenges associated with developing networked applications. We review the core native OS mechanisms available on popular OS platforms and illustrate how C++ and patterns are applied in ACE to encapsulate these mechanisms in class library wrapper facades that improve application portability and robustness. The book's primary application example is a networked logging service that transfers log records from client applications to a logging server over TCP/IP. We use this service as a running example throughout the book to

            • 具体说明 C++ 和 ACE 如何帮助实现高效、可预测和可扩展的网络应用程序；

            • Show concretely how C++ and ACE can help achieve efficient, predictable, and scalable networked applications and

            • 展示在开发您自己的并发面向对象网络应用程序时将出现的关键设计和实现考虑因素及解决方案。

            • Demonstrate key design and implementation considerations and solutions that will arise when you develop your own concurrent object-oriented networked applications

            本书共分为11章，具体如下：

            The book is organized into 11 chapters as follows:

            • 引言—— 第0章介绍了C++网络编程。首先概述了问题领域，并阐述了当应用程序扩展到单个进程中的单个线程之外时可能出现的挑战。然后，我们介绍了中间件层的分类，并描述了如何应用主机基础设施中间件和ACE工具包来应对常见的网络编程挑战。

            • Introduction— Chapter 0 presents an introduction to C++ network programming. It starts by outlining the problem space and presenting the challenges that can arise when applications extend beyond a single thread in a single process. We then introduce a taxonomy of middleware layers and describe how host infrastructure middleware and the ACE toolkit can be applied to address common network programming challenges.

            • 第一部分—— 第1章至第4章概述了通信设计方案，并描述了ACE中用于有效编写操作系统进程间通信（IPC）机制的面向对象技术。由此产生的类构成了本书运行示例（网络日志服务）的第一个版本的基础。

            • Part I— Chapters 1 through 4 outline communication design alternatives and describe the object-oriented techniques used in ACE to program OS IPC mechanisms effectively. The resulting classes form the basis of the first version of the book's running example, a networked logging service.

            • 第二部分—— 第 5 章至第 10 章概述了并发设计方案，并描述了 ACE 中用于有效编写操作系统并发机制的面向对象技术。

            • Part II— Chapters 5 through 10 outline concurrency design alternatives and describe the object-oriented techniques used in ACE to program OS concurrency mechanisms effectively.

            在第一部分和第二部分中，我们展示了一系列越来越复杂的网络日志服务的实现，以说明 ACE IPC 和并发包装器外观如何在实践中应用。

            Throughout Parts I and II we present a series of increasingly sophisticated implementations of our networked logging service to illustrate how the ACE IPC and concurrency wrapper facades can be applied in practice.

            附录 A总结了 ACE IPC 和并发包装器外观所遵循的类设计和实现原则。附录 B阐述了 ACE 的起源和过去十年来的开源发展历程，并展望了其未来的发展方向。本书最后附有技术术语表（包括本书中斜体字标注的术语）、详尽的参考文献列表以及主题索引。

            Appendix A summarizes the class design and implementation principles that underlie the ACE IPC and concurrency wrapper facades. Appendix B explains the inception and open-source evolution of ACE over the past decade and outlines where it's heading in the future. The book concludes with a glossary of technical terms (including the italicized terms in this book), an extensive list of references for further research, and a general subject index.

              相关材料

              Related Material

              本书着重探讨如何利用特定的 C++ 特性、模式和 ACE 来解决复杂性问题。本系列的第二卷—— 《C++ 网络编程：基于 ACE 和框架的系统化重用》 [ SH ]——扩展了本书的内容，涵盖了 ACE 提供的面向对象的网络编程框架。这些框架具体化了本书中介绍的 ACE 包装器外观类的常用用法，从而支持更广泛、更具扩展性的系统化重用。本书中介绍的 ACE 包装器外观类与第二卷中介绍的 ACE 框架类之间的一个显著区别在于：前者虚方法较少，而后者则包含大量虚方法。

              This book focuses on resolving complexity using specific C++ features, patterns, and ACE. The second volume in this series—C++ Network Programming: Systematic Reuse with ACE and Frameworks [SH]—extends our coverage to include object-oriented network programming frameworks provided by ACE. These frameworks reify common usage patterns of the ACE wrapper facade classes presented in this book to support broader, more extensible levels of systematic reuse. A distinguishing factor between the ACE wrapper facade classes covered in this book and the ACE framework classes covered in Volume 2 is that the ACE wrapper facade classes have few virtual methods, whereas the ACE framework classes have mostly virtual methods.

                  第0章 设计挑战、中间件解决方案和ACE

                  Chapter 0. Design Challenges, Middleware Solutions, and ACE

                  章节概要

                  Chapter Synopsis

                  本章描述了从独立应用架构过渡到网络化应用架构时发生的范式转变。这种转变带来了两类新的挑战：一类是面向软件架构和设计的问题空间挑战，另一类是与实现网络化应用所用的软件工具和技术相关的解决方案空间挑战。本章首先对影响前一类挑战的设计维度进行领域分析，并介绍受后一类挑战启发并应用于该挑战的中间件。然后，本章介绍ACE工具包以及贯穿全书用于阐述解决方案的示例网络化应用。

                  This chapter describes the paradigm shift that occurs when transitioning from stand-alone application architectures to networked application architectures. This shift yields new challenges in two categories: those in the problem space that are oriented to software architecture and design and those in the solution space that are related to software tools and techniques used to implement networked applications. This chapter first presents a domain analysis of design dimensions affecting the former category, and the middleware that is motivated by and applied to the latter category. The chapter then introduces the ACE toolkit and the example networked application that's used to illustrate the solutions throughout this book.

                    0.1 网络化应用的挑战

                    0.1 Challenges of Networked Applications

                    大多数软件开发人员都熟悉独立应用程序架构，在这种架构中，所有与图形用户界面 (GUI)、应用程序服务处理和持久数据资源相关的软件组件都集成在一台计算机上。例如，图 0.1 所示的独立应用程序架构将GUI、服务处理和持久数据资源整合在一台计算机上，所有外围设备都直接连接。独立应用程序中的控制流完全位于应用程序开始执行的计算机上。

                    Most software developers are familiar with stand-alone application architectures, in which a single computer contains all the software components related to the graphical user interface (GUI), application service processing, and persistent data resources. For example, the stand-alone application architecture illustrated in Figure 0.1 consolidates the GUI, service processing, and persistent data resources within a single computer, with all peripherals attached directly. The flow of control in a stand-alone application resides solely on the computer where execution begins.

                    图 0.1. 独立应用程序架构

                    相比之下，网络化应用架构将应用系统划分为多个可由多个应用共享和重用的服务。为了最大限度地提高效率和实用性，这些服务分布在通过网络连接的多个计算设备上，如图0.2所示。在这种环境下，提供给客户端的常见网络服务包括分布式命名、网络文件系统、路由表管理、日志记录、打印、电子邮件、远程登录、文件传输、基于 Web 的电子商务服务、支付处理、客户关系管理、服务台系统、MP3 交换、流媒体、即时通讯和社区聊天室。

                    In contrast, networked application architectures divide the application system into services that can be shared and reused by multiple applications. To maximize effectiveness and usefulness, services are distributed among multiple computing devices connected by a network, as shown in Figure 0.2. Common network services provided to clients in such environments include distributed naming, network file systems, routing table management, logging, printing, e-mail, remote login, file transfer, Web-based e-commerce services, payment processing, customer relationship management, help desk systems, MP3 exchange, streaming media, instant messaging, and community chat rooms.

                    图 0.2. 通用网络应用环境

                    如图 0.2所示的网络化应用架构将交互式 GUI、指令处理和持久数据资源分布在网络中的多个独立主机上。运行时，网络化应用中的控制流位于一个或多个主机上。所有系统组件相互协作通信，根据需要传输数据和执行控制。只要使用兼容的通信协议，即使底层网络、操作系统、硬件和编程语言各不相同，也能实现不同组件之间的互操作性 [ HV99 ]。这种跨多个主机分配网络化应用服务职责的方式可以带来以下好处：

                    The networked application architecture shown in Figure 0.2 partitions the interactive GUI, instruction processing, and persistent data resources among a number of independent hosts in a network. At run time, the flow of control in a networked application resides on one or more of the hosts. All the system components communicate cooperatively, transferring data and execution control between them as needed. Interoperability between separate components can be achieved as long as compatible communication protocols are used, even if the underlying networks, operating systems, hardware, and programming languages are heterogeneous [HV99]. This delegation of networked application service responsibilities across multiple hosts can yield the following benefits:

                    1. 增强的连接性和协作性能够更快地将信息传播给更多潜在用户。这种连接性避免了手动信息传输和重复录入。

                    2. Enhanced connectivity and collaboration disseminates information rapidly to more potential users. This connectivity avoids the need for manual information transfer and duplicate entry.

                    3. 性能和可扩展性的提升使得系统配置能够快速、稳健地进行更改，从而使计算资源与当前和预测的系统需求保持一致。

                    4. Improved performance and scalability allows system configurations to be changed readily and robustly to align computing resources with current and forecasted system demand.

                    5. 通过允许用户和应用程序共享昂贵的外围设备和软件（例如复杂的数据库管理系统）来降低成本。

                    6. Reduced costs by allowing users and applications to share expensive peripherals and software, such as sophisticated database management systems.

                    作为网络应用程序开发人员，你的工作是了解你的应用程序将提供的服务以及提供这些服务的可用环境，然后……

                    Your job as a developer of networked applications is to understand the services that your applications will provide and the environment(s) available to provide them, and then

                    1. 设计服务之间以及服务与客户之间沟通的机制。

                    2. Design mechanisms that services will use to communicate, both between themselves and with clients.

                    3. 确定哪些架构和服务安排能够最有效地利用现有环境。

                    4. Decide which architectures and service arrangements will make the most effective use of available environments.

                    5. 使用能够消除复杂性并产生正确、可扩展、高性能、低维护软件的技术和工具来实施这些解决方案，从而实现您的业务目标。

                    6. Implement these solutions using techniques and tools that eliminate complexity and yield correct, extensible, high-performance, low-maintenance software to achieve your business's goals.

                    本书提供了你完成这些任务所需的信息和工具。

                    This book provides the information and tools you need to excel at these tasks.

                    你的工作并不轻松。与独立应用程序相比，网络应用程序的设计、实现、调试、优化和监控通常要困难得多。你必须学会​​如何解决开发和配置网络应用程序过程中固有的和偶然出现的复杂性[ Bro87 ]。固有的复杂性源于一些关键的领域挑战，这些挑战会使网络应用程序的开发变得复杂，包括

                    Your job will not be easy. Networked applications are often much harder to design, implement, debug, optimize, and monitor than their stand-alone counterparts. You must learn how to resolve the inherent and accidental complexities [Bro87] associated with developing and configuring networked applications. Inherent complexities arise from key domain challenges that complicate networked application development, including

                    • 选择合适的通信机制并设计协议以有效利用它们。

                    • Selecting suitable communication mechanisms and designing protocols to use them effectively

                    • 设计能够高效利用可用计算资源并降低未来维护成本的网络服务

                    • Designing network services that utilize the available computing resources efficiently and reduce future maintenance costs

                    • 利用并发性有效实现系统的可预测、可靠和高性能。

                    • Using concurrency effectively to achieve predictable, reliable, high performance in your system

                    • 安排和配置服务，以最大限度地提高系统可用性和灵活性。

                    • Arranging and configuring services to maximize system availability and flexibility.

                    应对固有的复杂性需要经验和对领域本身的透彻理解。与这些固有复杂性问题相关的许多设计权衡，我们将在第1章和第5章中进行探讨。

                    Dealing with inherent complexity requires experience and a thorough understanding of the domain itself. There are many design tradeoffs related to these inherent complexity issues that we will investigate in Chapters 1 and 5.

                    网络应用软件开发中使用的工具和技术存在局限性，由此会产生一些意外的复杂性，包括：

                    Accidental complexities arise from limitations with tools and techniques used to develop networked application software, including

                    • 缺乏类型安全、可移植且可扩展的原生操作系统API

                    • The lack of type-safe, portable, and extensible native OS APIs

                    • 算法分解的广泛应用使得维护和扩展网络应用程序变得异常困难。

                    • The widespread use of algorithmic decomposition, which makes it unnecessarily hard to maintain and extend networked applications

                    • 对核心网络应用概念和功能的不断重新发现和重新发明，导致软件生命周期成本不必要地居高不下。

                    • The continual rediscovery and reinvention of core networked application concepts and capabilities, which keeps software life-cycle costs unnecessarily high

                    网络应用开发者必须了解这些挑战，并运用相应的技术来有效应对。本书将通过实例阐述 ACE 如何利用面向对象技术和 C++ 语言特性来解决上述各种复杂问题。

                    Networked application developers must understand these challenges and apply techniques to deal with them effectively. Throughout this book we illustrate by example how ACE uses object-oriented techniques and C++ language features to address the accidental complexities outlined above.

                      0.2 网络应用设计维度

                      0.2 Networked Application Design Dimensions

                      即使学习了编程 API 和接口，也可能忽略了领域内的关键设计维度。然而，根据我们的经验，对网络应用领域基础知识有更深入了解的开发人员，能够更有效地解决关键的设计、实现和性能挑战。因此，我们首先探讨网络应用开发的核心架构设计维度。我们重点关注支持多个服务或同一服务的多个实例，并能同时与多个客户端协作的服务器，这与图 0.2所示的网络应用环境类似。

                      It's possible to learn programming APIs and interfaces without appreciating the key design dimensions in a domain. In our experience, however, developers with deeper knowledge of networked application domain fundamentals are much better prepared to solve key design, implementation, and performance challenges effectively. We therefore explore the core architectural design dimensions for networked application development first. We focus on servers that support multiple services, or multiple instances of a service, and that collaborate with many clients simultaneously, similar to the networked application environment shown in Figure 0.2.

                      本书讨论的设计维度是通过对过去十年中数百个生产级网络应用和系统的设计和实现实践经验进行深入的领域 分析而确定的。领域分析是一个归纳式、反馈驱动的过程，它系统地审视应用领域，识别其核心挑战和设计维度，并将其映射到有效的解决方案技术上。该过程具有以下优势：

                      The design dimensions discussed in this book were identified by a thorough domain analysis based on hands-on design and implementation experience with hundreds of production networked applications and systems developed over the past decade. A domain analysis is an inductive, feedback-driven process that examines an application domain systematically to identify its core challenges and design dimensions in order to map them onto effective solution techniques. This process yields the following benefits:

                      它定义了一套通用的领域抽象词汇，使开发人员能够更有效地相互沟通[ Fow97 ]。反过来，明确问题空间的词汇简化了将其映射到解决方案空间中合适的模式和软件抽象集的过程。例如，对网络协议、事件解复用策略和并发架构的共同理解，使我们能够将这些概念应用于我们对包装器外观的讨论，以及我们在[ SH ]中对ACE框架的讨论。

                      • It defines a common vocabulary of domain abstractions, which enables developers to communicate more effectively with each other [Fow97]. In turn, clarifying the vocabulary of the problem space simplifies the mapping onto a suitable set of patterns and software abstractions in the solution space. For example, a common understanding of network protocols, event demultiplexing strategies, and concurrency architectures allows us to apply these concepts to our discussions of wrapper facades, as well as to our discussions of ACE frameworks in [SH].

                      • 它将设计考虑因素分为两类，从而增强了重复利用性：

                      • It enhances reuse by separating design considerations into two categories:

                      1. 那些专门针对特定类型应用程序的和

                      2. Those that are specific to particular types of applications and

                      3. 那些在领域内所有应用程序中通用的功能。

                      4. Those that are common to all applications in the domain.

                      通过关注领域内的常见设计问题，应用程序和中间件开发人员可以发现调整或构建可重用软件类库的机会。当这些类库之间的规范控制流被提取并重新集成时，它们可以形成中间件框架（例如 ACE 中的框架），从而显著减少后续的应用程序开发工作量。在成熟的领域中，可以通过扩展和定制现有的中间件框架，并利用面向对象语言的特性（例如继承、动态绑定、参数化类型和异常处理），系统地解决特定于应用程序的设计问题。

                      By focusing on common design concerns in a domain, application and middleware developers can recognize opportunities for adapting or building reusable software class libraries. When the canonical control flows between these class libraries are factored out and reintegrated, they can form middleware frameworks, such as those in ACE, that can reduce subsequent application development effort significantly. In a mature domain, application-specific design considerations can be addressed systematically by extending and customizing existing middleware frameworks via object-oriented language features, such as inheritance, dynamic binding, parameterized types, and exceptions.

                      在网络应用领域，开发人员需要在图 0.3所示的四个维度上做出设计决策。这些设计维度主要关注如何应对固有的复杂性。因此，它们在很大程度上独立于特定的生命周期流程、设计方法和符号、编程语言、操作系统平台以及网络硬件。每个设计维度都由一组相对独立的备选方案组成。尽管这些方案大多彼此正交，但对网络应用的一个或多个维度进行更改，会相应地改变其“形态”。因此，设计变更并非孤立发生。在考虑以下设计维度时，请牢记这一点：

                      Within the domain of networked applications, developers are faced with design decisions in each of the four dimensions depicted in Figure 0.3. These design dimensions are concerned mainly with managing inherent complexities. They are therefore largely independent of particular life-cycle processes, design methods and notations, programming languages, operating system platforms, and networking hardware. Each of these design dimensions is composed of a set of relatively independent alternatives. Although mostly orthogonal to each other, changes to one or more dimensions of your networked application can change its "shape" accordingly. Design changes therefore don't occur in isolation. Keep this in mind as you consider the following design dimensions:

                      1. 通信维度涉及网络应用程序用于交互的规则、形式和抽象级别。

                      2. Communication dimensions address the rules, form, and level of abstraction that networked applications use to interact.

                      3. 并发维度涉及管理进程和线程的正确使用以表示多个服务实例的策略和机制，以及每个服务实例如何在内部使用多个线程。

                      4. Concurrency dimensions address the policies and mechanisms governing the proper use of processes and threads to represent multiple service instances, as well as how each service instance may use multiple threads internally.

                      5. 服务维度描述了网络化应用程序服务的关键属性，例如每个服务实例的持续时间和结构。

                      6. Service dimensions address key properties of a networked application service, such as the duration and structure of each service instance.

                      7. 配置维度描述了如何识别网络服务以及何时将它们绑定在一起形成完整的应用程序。配置维度通常会影响多个服务，以及服务之间的关系。

                      8. Configuration dimensions address how networked services are identified and the time at which they are bound together to form complete applications. Configuration dimensions often affect more than one service, as well as the relationships between services.
                      图 0.3. 网络化应用设计维度

                      我们将在第 1 章和第5章分别深入探讨前两个维度，而第三个和第四个维度将在 [ SH ] 中讨论。我们首先阐述关键术语、设计权衡和解决方案抽象，然后介绍与每个维度相关的平台功能、其附带的复杂性，以及 ACE 提供的解决方案。ACE 在过去十年中针对这些设计维度不断发展演进。正如您将看到的，ACE 工具包利用久经考验的面向对象分区、接口设计、数据封装模式和 C++ 特性，使您的网络应用程序的设计维度能够尽可能独立且可移植地变化。

                      We examine the first two dimensions in more depth in Chapters 1 and 5, respectively, while the third and fourth are discussed in [SH]. We illustrate the key vocabulary, design trade-offs, and solution abstractions first, followed by the platform capabilities related to each dimension, its associated accidental complexities, and the solutions provided by ACE, which evolved over the past decade in response to these design dimensions. As you'll see, the ACE toolkit uses time-proven object-oriented partitioning, interface design, data encapsulation patterns, and C++ features to enable the design dimensions of your networked applications to vary as independently and portably as possible.

                        0.3 面向对象的中间件解决方案

                        0.3 Object-Oriented Middleware Solutions

                        一些最成功的技术和工具旨在解决网络应用程序中偶然和固有的复杂性，它们都以面向对象的中间件为核心，这有助于管理网络应用程序中的复杂性和异构性。面向对象的中间件提供可重用的服务/协议组件和框架软件，从而在功能上弥合了网络应用程序与客户端之间的差距。

                        Some of the most successful techniques and tools devised to address accidental and inherent complexities of networked applications have centered on object-oriented middleware, which helps manage the complexity and heterogeneity in networked applications. Object-oriented middleware provides reusable service/protocol component and framework software that functionally bridges the gap between

                        1. 端到端应用程序功能需求和

                        2. End-to-end application functional requirements and

                        3. 底层操作系统、网络协议栈和硬件设备。

                        4. The lower-level operating systems, networking protocol stacks, and hardware devices.

                        面向对象的中间件提供了一些功能，这些功能的特性对于简化和协调联网应用程序的连接方式以及它们之间的互操作至关重要。

                        Object-oriented middleware provides capabilities whose qualities are critical to help simplify and coordinate how networked applications are connected and how they interoperate.

                        0.3.1 面向对象的中间件层

                        0.3.1 Object-Oriented Middleware Layers

                        网络协议栈，例如 TCP/IP [ Ste93 ]，可以分解为多个层，例如 OSI 参考模型 [ Bla91 ] 中定义的物理层、数据链路层、网络层、传输层、会话层、表示层和应用层。同样，面向对象的中间件也可以分解为多个层 [ SS01 ]，如图 0.4所示。面向对象中间件的常见层次结构包括以下描述的层：

                        Networking protocol stacks, such as TCP/IP [Ste93], can be decomposed into multiple layers, such as the physical, data-link, network, transport, session, presentation, and application layers defined in the OSI reference model [Bla91]. Likewise, object-oriented middleware can be decomposed into multiple layers [SS01], as shown in Figure 0.4. A common hierarchy of object-oriented middleware includes the layers described below:

                        图 0.4. 上下文中的面向对象中间件层

                        主机基础设施中间件封装了操作系统并发和进程间通信 (IPC) 机制，从而创建面向对象的网络编程能力。这些能力消除了许多与通过原生操作系统 API（例如套接字或 POSIX 线程 (Pthreads)）开发网络应用程序相关的繁琐、易出错且不便携带的操作。主机基础设施中间件的常用示例包括 Java 包 [ AGH00 ] 和 ACE。

                        Host infrastructure middleware encapsulates OS concurrency and interprocess communication (IPC) mechanisms to create object-oriented network programming capabilities. These capabilities eliminate many tedious, error-prone, and nonportable activities associated with developing networked applications via native OS APIs, such as Sockets or POSIX threads (Pthreads). Widely used examples of host infrastructure middleware include Java Packages [AGH00] and ACE.

                        分布式中间件利用并扩展主机基础设施中间件，以实现常见网络编程任务的自动化，例如连接和内存管理、编组和解编组、端点和请求解复用、同步和多线程。使用分布式中间件的开发人员可以像编写独立应用程序一样编写分布式应用程序，即通过调用目标对象上的操作，而无需关心它们的位置、语言、操作系统或硬件 [ HV99 ]。分布式中间件的核心是对象请求代理(ORB)，例如 COM+ [ Box97 ]、Java RMI [ Sun98 ] 和CORBA [ Obj01 ]。

                        Distribution middleware uses and extends host infrastructure middleware in order to automate common network programming tasks, such as connection and memory management, marshaling and demarshaling, end-point and request demultiplexing, synchronization, and multithreading. Developers who use distribution middleware can program distributed applications much like stand-alone applications, that is, by invoking operations on target objects without concern for their location, language, OS, or hardware [HV99]. At the heart of distribution middleware are Object Request Brokers (ORBs), such as COM+ [Box97], Java RMI [Sun98], and CORBA [Obj01].

                        通用中间件服务通过定义更高层级的、与领域无关的服务（例如事件通知、日志记录、持久化、安全性和可恢复事务）来增强分布式中间件的功能。分布式中间件主要侧重于管理终端系统资源以支持面向对象的分布式编程模型，而通用中间件服务则侧重于在整个分布式系统中分配、调度和协调各种资源。如果没有通用中间件服务，每个联网应用程序都必须自行实现这些端到端的功能。

                        Common middleware services augment distribution middleware by defining higher-level domain-independent services, such as event notification, logging, persistence, security, and recoverable transactions. Whereas distribution middleware focuses largely on managing end-system resources in support of an object-oriented distributed programming model, common middleware services focus on allocating, scheduling, and coordinating various resources throughout a distributed system. Without common middleware services, these end-to-end capabilities would have to be implemented ad hoc by each networked application.

                        领域特定中间件服务满足特定领域的特定需求，例如电信、电子商务、医疗保健、流程自动化或航空电子。与其他面向对象的中间件层提供广泛可重用的“横向”机制和服务不同，领域特定服务面向垂直市场。从“商用现成”（COTS）的角度来看，领域特定服务是目前所有中间件层中最不成熟的。这部分是由于历史上缺乏中间件标准，而这些标准是创建领域特定服务所必需的稳定基础。

                        Domain-specific middleware services satisfy specific requirements of particular domains, such as telecommunications, e-commerce, health care, process automation, or avionics. Whereas the other object-oriented middleware layers provide broadly reusable "horizontal" mechanisms and services, domain-specific services target vertical markets. From a "commercial off-the-shelf" (COTS) perspective, domain-specific services are the least mature of the middleware layers today. This is due in part to the historical lack of middleware standards needed to provide a stable base upon which to create domain-specific services.

                        面向对象的中间件是开发网络应用程序的重要工具。它为网络应用程序的开发和演进提供了以下三个方面的改进：

                        Object-oriented middleware is an important tool for developing networked applications. It provides the following three broad areas of improvement for developing and evolving networked applications:

                        1. 战略重点在于提升应用开发者的关注点，使其不再局限于底层操作系统并发性和网络 API。虽然对这些 API 底层概念和功能的透彻理解是所有网络应用开发的基础，但中间件能够将这些细节抽象成更高级、更易于使用的组件。开发者无需过多关注底层细节，便能专注于更具战略意义、以应用为中心的问题。

                        2. Strategic focus, which elevates application developer focus beyond a preoccupation with low-level OS concurrency and networking APIs. A solid grasp of the concepts and capabilities underlying these APIs is foundational to all networked application development. However, middleware helps abstract the details away into higher-level, more easily used artifacts. Without needing to worry as much about low-level details, developers can focus on more strategic, application-centric concerns.

                        3. 有效重用是指利用以往的开发经验，并将关键模式的实现[ SSRB00 , GHJV95 ]具体化为可重用的中间件框架，从而分摊软件生命周期中的工作量。未来，大多数联网应用程序将通过集成和编写特定领域和通用的“可插拔”中间件服务组件来构建，而不是完全从头开始编写[ Joh97 ]。

                        4. Effective reuse, which amortizes software life-cycle effort by leveraging previous development expertise and reifying implementations of key patterns [SSRB00, GHJV95] into reusable middleware frameworks. In the future, most networked applications will be assembled by integrating and scripting domain-specific and common "pluggable" middleware service components, rather than being programmed entirely from scratch [Joh97].

                        5. 开放标准提供了一套可移植且可互操作的软件组件。这些组件有助于引导开发人员将注意力集中在更高层次的软件应用架构和设计问题上，例如互操作安全性、分层分布式资源管理和容错服务。开源和/或标准化的商用现成（COTS）面向对象中间件（例如 CORBA、Java 虚拟机和 ACE）正发挥着越来越重要的作用，这些中间件可以通过开源途径购买或获取。对于面临上市时间压力和软件开发资源有限的组织而言，COTS 中间件尤为重要。

                        6. Open standards, which provide a portable and interoperable set of software artifacts. These artifacts help to direct the focus of developers toward higher-level software application architecture and design concerns, such as interoperable security, layered distributed resource management, and fault tolerance services. An increasingly important role is being played by open and/or standard COTS object-oriented middleware, such as CORBA, Java virtual machines, and ACE, which can be purchased or acquired via open-source means. COTS middleware is particularly important for organizations facing time-to-market pressures and limited software development resources.

                        尽管分布式中间件、通用中间件服务和领域特定中间件服务都是重要的主题，但本书不再赘述，原因我们将在下一节中探讨。如需深入了解这些主题，请参阅http://ace.ece.uci.edu/middleware.html或《C++高级CORBA编程》 [ HV99 ]。

                        Although distribution middleware, common middleware services, and domain-specific middleware services are important topics, they are not treated further in this book for the reasons we explore in the next section. For further coverage of these topics, please see either http://ace.ece.uci.edu/middleware.html or Advanced CORBA Programming with C++ [HV99].

                        0.3.2 主机基础架构中间件的优势

                        0.3.2 The Benefits of Host Infrastructure Middleware

                        当开发人员受到严格的服务质量 (QoS)要求和/或成本控制的驱动时，主机基础设施中间件优于更高层的中间件。它也是推动中间件技术发展的基础领域。这些领域及其原理将在下文讨论。

                        Host infrastructure middleware is preferred over the higher middleware layers when developers are driven by stringent quality of service (QoS) requirements and/or cost containment. It's also a foundational area for advancing the state-of-the-art of middleware. These areas and their rationale are discussed below.

                        满足严格的QoS要求。 某些类型的应用程序需要访问原生操作系统进程间通信（IPC）机制和协议，以满足严格的效率和可预测性QoS要求。例如，需要长时间双向字节流通信服务的多媒体应用程序并不适合某些分布式中间件提供的同步请求/响应模式[ NGSY00 ]。尽管优化技术取得了重大进展[ GS99 , POS + 00 ]，但许多传统的分布式中间件实现仍然会带来显著的吞吐量和延迟开销，并且缺乏足够的接口来操控其他QoS相关属性，例如抖动和可靠性。

                        Meeting stringent QoS requirements. Certain types of applications need access to native OS IPC mechanisms and protocols to meet stringent efficiency and predictability QoS requirements. For example, multimedia applications that require long-duration, bidirectional bytestream communication services are poorly suited to the synchronous request/response paradigm provided by some distribution middleware [NGSY00]. Despite major advances [GS99, POS+00] in optimization technology, many conventional distribution middleware implementations still incur significant throughput and latency overhead and lack sufficient hooks to manipulate other QoS-related properties, such as jitter and dependability.

                        相比之下，主机基础设施中间件通常更适合确保端到端的服务质量 (QoS)，因为它允许应用程序……

                        In contrast, host infrastructure middleware is often better suited to ensure end-to-end QoS because it allows applications to

                        • 省略可能不必要的功能，例如省略同构环境中的序列化和反序列化。

                        • Omit functionality that may not be necessary, such as omitting marshaling and demarshaling in homogeneous environments

                        • 对通信行为进行精细控制，例如支持 IP 组播传输和异步 I/O 等。

                        • Exert fine-grained control over communication behavior, such as supporting IP multicast transmission and asynchronous I/O and

                        • 定制网络协议以优化网络带宽使用，或用共享内存通信替代环回网络通信。

                        • Customize networking protocols to optimize network bandwidth usage or to substitute shared memory communication in place of loop-back network communication

                        到本十年末，我们预计分布式中间件和通用服务的研发将达到一定水平，使其服务质量（QoS）水平能够与手工编写的主机基础设施中间件和网络应用程序相媲美，甚至超越后者。然而，在此之前，仍需编写和部署大量生产软件。正是在此背景下，主机基础设施中间件发挥着至关重要的作用，它提升了网络应用程序开发的抽象层次，同时又不会对其服务质量造成过大的影响。

                        By the end of the decade, we expect research and development (R&D) on distribution middleware and common services will reach a point where its QoS levels rival or exceed that of handwritten host infrastructure middleware and networked applications. In the meantime, however, much production software must be written and deployed. It's within this context that host infrastructure middleware plays such an important role by elevating the level of abstraction at which networked applications are developed without unduly affecting their QoS.

                        成本控制。 为了在全球竞争激烈的环境中生存，许多组织正在向面向对象的开发流程和方法转型。在此背景下，主机基础设施中间件提供了强大且久经考验的解决方案，有助于控制第 0.1 节第 4 页所述的固有复杂性和意外复杂性所带来的成本。

                        Cost containment. To survive in a globally competitive environment, many organizations are transitioning to object-oriented development processes and methods. In this context, host infrastructure middleware offers powerful and time-proven solutions to help contain the costs of the inherent and accidental complexities outlined in Section 0.1, page 4.

                        例如，采用新的编译器、开发环境、调试器和工具包可能成本高昂。由于掌握新技术需要陡峭的学习曲线，培训软件工程师的成本可能更高。在开展评估或采用新技术的软件项目时，控制这些成本至关重要。主机基础设施中间件可以有效地利用现有的操作系​​统和网络经验、知识和技能，同时将开发扩展到新平台，并逐步掌握更先进、更经济的软件技术。

                        For example, adopting new compilers, development environments, debuggers, and toolkits can be expensive. Training software engineers can be even more expensive due to steep learning curves needed to become proficient with new technologies. Containing these costs is important when embarking on software projects in which new technologies are being evaluated or employed. Host infrastructure middleware can be an effective tool for leveraging existing OS and networking experience, knowledge, and skills while expanding development to new platforms and climbing the learning curve toward more advanced, cost-saving software technologies.

                        通过提升核心知识水平来推进实践发展。 对主机基础设施中间件的深入理解有助于开发人员识别更高层次的模式和服务，从而提高他们在各自应用领域的工作效率。除了当前面向方法和消息的中间件技术之外，还有许多新的技术挑战亟待克服。基础设施中间件为未来的研发提供了重要的基础，原因如下：

                        Advancing the state-of-the-practice by improving core knowledge. A solid understanding of host infrastructure middleware helps developers identify higher-level patterns and services so they can become more productive in their own application domains. There are many new technology challenges to be conquered beyond today's method- and message-oriented middleware technologies. Infrastructure middleware provides an important building block for future R&D for the following reasons:

                        • 对主机基础设施中间件的设计挑战和模式有深刻理解的开发人员，能够更快地掌握软件技术的进步。他们进而可以推动团队或组织内部更高级的中间件功能的应用。

                        • Developers with a solid grasp of the design challenges and patterns underlying host infrastructure middleware can become proficient with software technology advances more rapidly. They can then catalyze the adoption of more sophisticated middleware capabilities within a team or organization.

                        • 对中间件“底层”运行机制有透彻了解的开发人员，更有能力找到改进其网络应用程序的新方法。

                        • Developers with a thorough understanding of what happens "under the covers" of middleware are better suited to identify new ways of improving their networked applications.

                          0.4 ACE 工具包概述

                          0.4 An Overview of the ACE Toolkit

                          自适应通信环境(ACE) 是一个广泛使用的主机基础设施中间件示例。ACE 库包含约 24 万行 C++ 代码和约 500 个类。ACE 软件发行版还包含数百个自动化回归测试和示例应用程序。ACE 作为开源软件免费提供，可从http://ace.ece.uci.edu/或http://www.riverace.com下载。

                          The ADAPTIVE Communication Environment (ACE) is a widely used example of host infrastructure middleware. The ACE library contains ~240,000 lines of C++ code and ~500 classes. The ACE software distribution also contains hundreds of automated regression tests and example applications. ACE is freely available as open-source software and can be downloaded from http://ace.ece.uci.edu/ or http://www.riverace.com.

                          为了分离关注点、降低复杂性并允许功能子集化，ACE 采用分层架构设计 [ BMR + 96 ]，如图 0.5所示。ACE 工具包的基础是操作系统适配层和 C++ 封装门面 [ SSRB00 ]的组合，它们封装了操作系统核心的并发网络编程机制。ACE 的更高层在此基础上构建，提供可重用的框架、网络服务组件和基于标准的中间件。这些中间件层共同简化了网络应用程序的创建、组合、配置和移植，而不会造成显著的性能开销。

                          To separate concerns, reduce complexity, and permit functional sub-setting, ACE is designed using a layered architecture [BMR+96], shown in Figure 0.5. The foundation of the ACE toolkit is its combination of OS adaptation layer and C++ wrapper facades [SSRB00], which encapsulate core OS concurrent network programming mechanisms. The higher layers of ACE build upon this foundation to provide reusable frameworks, networked service components, and standards-based middleware. Together, these middleware layers simplify the creation, composition, configuration, and porting of networked applications without incurring significant performance overhead.

                          图 0.5. ACE 的分层架构

                          本书重点介绍用于原生操作系统进程间通信 (IPC) 和并发机制的 ACE 封装外观。框架的其他优势以及 ACE 框架的全面描述将在《C++ 网络编程》第二卷[ SH ] 中阐述。本章剩余部分概述了 ACE 各层的结构和功能。第 263 页的B.1.4 节介绍了基于 ACE 并与其捆绑的标准中间件（TAO [ SLM98 ] 和 JAWS [ HS99 ]）。

                          This book focuses on the ACE wrapper facades for native OS IPC and concurrency mechanisms. The additional benefits of frameworks and a comprehensive description of the ACE frameworks are described in the second volume of C++ Network Programming [SH]. The remainder of this chapter outlines the structure and functionality of the various layers in ACE. Section B.1.4 on page 263 describes the standards-based middleware (TAO [SLM98] and JAWS [HS99]) that's based upon and bundled with ACE.

                          0.4.1 ACE OS 适配层

                          0.4.1 The ACE OS Adaptation Layer

                          ACE 操作系统适配层约占 ACE 总量的 10%（约 27,000 行代码）。它由一个名为ACE_OS 的类组成，该类包含 500 多个 C++ 静态方法。这些方法封装了面向 C 语言的原生操作系统 API，隐藏了平台特定的细节，并为更高层 ACE 使用的操作系统机制提供了统一的接口。ACE_OS适配层简化了ACE的可移植性和可维护性，并确保只有 ACE 开发人员（而非应用程序开发人员）需要了解 ACE 封装器底层晦涩难懂的平台特定知识。ACE_OS 类提供的抽象使得侧边栏 1中所示的所有操作系统平台可以使用单一源代码树。

                          The ACE OS adaptation layer constitutes approximately 10 percent of ACE (about 27,000 lines of code). It consists of a class called ACE_OS that contains over 500 C++ static methods. These methods encapsulate the native, C-oriented OS APIs that hide platform-specific details and expose a uniform interface to OS mechanisms used by higher ACE layers. The ACE_OS adaptation layer simplifies the portability and maintainability of ACE and ensures that only ACE developers—not applications developers—must understand the arcane platform-specific knowledge underlying the ACE wrapper facades. The abstraction provided by the ACE_OS class enables the use of a single source tree for all the OS platforms shown in Sidebar 1.

                          侧边栏 1：ACE 支持的操作系统平台

                          Sidebar 1: OS Platforms Supported by ACE

                          ACE可在多种操作系统上运行，包括：

                          ACE runs on a wide range of operating systems, including:

                          • 例如，PC 操作系统包括 Windows（所有 32/64 位版本）、WinCE；Redhat、Debian 和 SuSE Linux；以及 Macintosh OS X；

                          • PCs, for example, Windows (all 32/64-bit versions), WinCE; Redhat, Debian, and SuSE Linux; and Macintosh OS X;

                          • 大多数 UNIX 版本，例如 SunOS 4.x 和 Solaris、SGI IRIX、HP-UX、Digital UNIX (Compaq Tru64)、AIX、DG/UX、SCO OpenServer、UnixWare、NetBSD 和 FreeBSD；

                          • Most versions of UNIX, for example, SunOS 4.x and Solaris, SGI IRIX, HP-UX, Digital UNIX (Compaq Tru64), AIX, DG/UX, SCO OpenServer, UnixWare, NetBSD, and FreeBSD;

                          • 实时操作系统，例如 VxWorks、OS/9、Chorus、LynxOS、Pharlap TNT、QNX Neutrino 和 RTP RTEMS 以及 pSoS；

                          • Real-time operating systems, for example, VxWorks, OS/9, Chorus, LynxOS, Pharlap TNT, QNX Neutrino and RTP RTEMS, and pSoS;

                          • 大型企业系统，例如 OpenVMS、MVS OpenEdition、Tandem NonStop-UX 和 Cray UNICOS。

                          • Large enterprise systems, for example, OpenVMS, MVS OpenEdition, Tandem NonStop-UX, and Cray UNICOS.

                          ACE 可以与这些平台上所有主流的 C++ 编译器配合使用。ACE 网站（http://ace.ece.uci.edu）包含完整的最新平台列表，以及 ACE 的下载和构建说明。

                          ACE can be used with all of the major C++ compilers on these platforms. The ACE Web site at http://ace.ece.uci.edu contains a complete, up-to-date list of platforms, along with instructions for downloading and building ACE.

                          0.4.2 ACE C++ 封装外观层

                          0.4.2 The ACE C++ Wrapper Facade Layer

                          包装器外观由一个或多个类组成，这些类将函数和数据封装在一个类型安全的面向对象接口中 [ SSRB00 ]。ACE C++ 包装器外观层位于其操作系统适配层之上，并提供基本相同的功能，如图 0.5所示。将此功能打包为 C++ 类，而不是独立的 C 函数，显著降低了学习和正确使用 ACE 所需的工作量。ACE 包装器外观经过精心设计，旨在最大限度地减少或消除因其可用性和安全性的提高而带来的性能开销。ACE 的设计原则在附录 A中进行了讨论。

                          A wrapper facade consists of one or more classes that encapsulate functions and data within a type-safe object-oriented interface [SSRB00]. The ACE C++ wrapper facade layer resides atop its OS adaptation layer and provides largely the same functionality, as shown in Figure 0.5. Packaging this functionality as C++ classes, rather than stand-alone C functions, significantly reduces the effort required to learn and use ACE correctly. The ACE wrapper facades are designed carefully to minimize or eliminate performance overhead resulting from its increased usability and safety. The principles that guide ACE's design are discussed in Appendix A.

                          ACE 提供了一套丰富的封装外观（wrapper facade），几乎占其全部源代码的 50%。应用程序可以通过选择性地继承、聚合和/或实例化这些封装外观来组合和完善它们。本书将展示如何使用套接字、文件、并发和同步封装外观来开发高效、可移植的网络应用程序。

                          ACE provides an extensive set of wrapper facades, constituting nearly 50 percent of its total source base. Applications combine and refine these wrapper facades by selectively inheriting, aggregating, and/or instantiating them. In this book we show how the socket, file, concurrency, and synchronization wrapper facades are used to develop efficient, portable networked applications.

                          0.4.3 ACE框架层

                          0.4.3 The ACE Framework Layer

                          ACE 剩余的约 40% 由面向对象框架构成，这些框架是一组集成的类，它们协同工作，为一系列相关应用程序提供可重用的软件架构 [ FS97 ]。面向对象框架是成功实现系统化重用的关键，因为它们可以补充和增强其他重用技术，例如类库、组件和模式 [ Joh97 ]。例如，ACE 框架通过强调应用程序特定类和应用程序无关类的集成与协作，实现了比重用单个类或独立函数更大规模的软件重用。ACE 中的框架通过应用高级并发和网络编程模式 [ BMR + 96 , SSRB00 ]来集成和增强其 C++ 包装外观类，从而具体化ACE 中相关类族之间的规范控制流和协作。

                          The remaining ~40 percent of ACE consists of object-oriented frameworks, which are integrated sets of classes that collaborate to provide a reusable software architecture for a family of related applications [FS97]. Object-oriented frameworks are a key to successful systematic reuse because they complement and amplify other reuse techniques, such as class libraries, components, and patterns [Joh97]. By emphasizing the integration and collaboration of application-specific and application-independent classes, for example, the ACE frameworks enable larger-scale reuse of software than is possible by reusing individual classes or stand-alone functions. The frameworks in ACE integrate and augment its C++ wrapper facade classes by applying advanced concurrency and network programming patterns [BMR+96, SSRB00] to reify the canonical control flow and collaboration among families of related classes in ACE.

                          以下 ACE 框架支持高效、稳健和灵活的并发网络应用程序和服务开发与配置：

                          The following ACE frameworks support the efficient, robust, and flexible development and configuration of concurrent networked applications and services:

                          事件解复用和分发框架。ACE Reactor 和 Proactor 框架分别实现了 Reactor 和 Proactor 模式 [ SSRB00 ]。Reactor 和 Proactor 框架能够自动解复用和分发特定于应用程序的处理程序，以响应各种类型的基于 I/O、基于定时器、基于信号和基于同步的事件。

                          Event demultiplexing and dispatching frameworks. The ACE Reactor and Proactor frameworks implement the Reactor and Proactor patterns [SSRB00], respectively. The Reactor and Proactor frameworks automate the demultiplexing and dispatching of application-specific handlers in response to various types of I/O-based, timer-based, signal-based, and synchronization-based events.

                          连接建立和服务初始化框架。ACE Acceptor-Connector 框架实现了Acceptor-Connector 模式[ SSRB00 ]。该框架将主动和被动初始化角色与初始化完成后通信对等服务执行的应用处理过程解耦。

                          Connection establishment and service initialization framework. The ACE Acceptor-Connector framework implements the Acceptor-Connector pattern [SSRB00]. This framework decouples the active and passive initialization roles from application processing performed by communicating peer services after initialization is complete.

                          并发框架。ACE 提供了 Task 框架，可用于实现关键的并发模式 [ SSRB00 , Lea99 ]，例如 Active Object 和 Half-Sync/Half-Async，它们分别通过将方法执行与方法调用解耦以及将异步和同步处理解耦来简化并发编程。

                          Concurrency framework. ACE provides the Task framework that can be used to implement key concurrency patterns [SSRB00, Lea99], such as Active Object and Half-Sync/Half-Async, which simplify concurrent programming by decoupling method execution from method invocation and decoupling asynchronous and synchronous processing, respectively.

                          服务配置器框架。 该框架实现了组件配置器模式[ SSRB00 ]，以支持在设计周期后期（例如安装时）动态组装服务的应用程序配置。它还支持在运行时动态重新配置应用程序中的服务。

                          Service configurator framework. This framework implements the Component Configurator pattern [SSRB00] to support the configuration of applications whose services can be assembled dynamically late in their design cycle, for example, at installation time. It also supports the dynamic reconfiguration of services in an application at run time.

                          流框架。 该框架实现了管道和过滤器模式[ BMR + 96 ]，其中每个处理步骤都封装在一个过滤模块中，该模块可以访问和操作流经模块流的数据。ACE Streams 框架简化了分层服务的开发，这些服务可以灵活组合，以创建某些类型的网络应用程序，例如用户级协议栈和网络管理代理[ SS94 ]。

                          Streams framework. This framework implements the Pipes and Filters pattern [BMR+96], wherein each processing step is encapsulated in a filtering module that can access and manipulate data flowing through the stream of modules. The ACE Streams framework simplifies the development of hierarchically layered services that can be composed flexibly to create certain types of networked applications, such as user-level protocol stacks and network management agents [SS94].

                          《C++网络编程：使用ACE和框架进行系统性重用》 [ SH ]一书中对ACE框架的动机、设计和使用进行了深入探讨。此外， 《ACE程序员指南》 [ HJS ]中也提供了关于ACE包装器外观和框架的更多信息。

                          An in-depth discussion of the motivation, design, and use of the frameworks in ACE appears in C++ Network Programming: Systematic Reuse with ACE and Frameworks [SH]. Additional information on the ACE wrapper facades and frameworks is also available in The ACE Programmer's Guide [HJS].

                          0.4.4 ACE 网络服务组件层

                          0.4.4 The ACE Networked Service Components Layer

                          除了之前描述的主机基础设施中间件包装器外观和框架之外，ACE 还提供了一个网络服务库，这些服务被打包成组件。组件是软件系统中封装的部分，用于实现特定的服务或一组服务 [ Szy98 ]。虽然这些组件本身并不包含在 ACE 库中，但它们与 ACE 软件发行版捆绑在一起，以提供以下功能：

                          In addition to its host infrastructure middleware wrapper facades and frameworks previously described, ACE also provides a library of networked services that are packaged as components. A component is an encapsulated part of a software system that implements a specific service or set of services [Szy98]. Although these components aren't included in the ACE library itself, they are bundled with the ACE software distribution to provide the following capabilities:

                          • 展示 ACE 功能的常见用途—— 这些组件展示了如何使用关键的 ACE 框架和类来开发灵活、高效和强大的网络服务。

                          • Demonstrate common uses of ACE capabilities— The components demonstrate how key ACE frameworks and classes can be used to develop flexible, efficient, and robust networked services.

                          • 提取可重用的网络应用程序构建模块—— 这些组件提供了常见网络应用程序服务的可重用实现，例如命名、事件路由[ Sch00 ]、日志记录、时间同步[ SSRB00 ]和网络锁定。

                          • Factor out reusable networked application building blocks— These components provide reusable implementations of common networked application services, such as naming, event routing [Sch00], logging, time synchronization [SSRB00], and network locking.

                            0.5 示例：联网日志服务

                            0.5 Example: A Networked Logging Service

                            本书始终使用一个网络日志服务的示例来帮助说明关键要点和 ACE 的功能。该服务收集并记录来自一个或多个客户端应用程序的诊断信息。这与通常将日志记录到 Windows NT/2000 事件日志的方式不同，后者在 Windows 95 或 98 上不可用。如果您是一位经验丰富的 UNIX 程序员，您可能会认为这是在浪费时间，因为 SYSLOGD 已经提供了这种类型的服务。然而，这恰恰凸显了日志服务的一个关键优势：它具有可移植性，因此应用程序可以在 ACE 支持的所有平台上记录消息。

                            Throughout this book we use a running example of a networked logging service to help illustrate key points and ACE capabilities. This service collects and records diagnostic information sent from one or more client applications. It's a departure from the usual way of logging to a Windows NT/2000 event log, which is not available on Windows 95 or 98. If you're an experienced UNIX programmer, however, you may be thinking this is a waste of time since SYSLOGD provides this type of service already. Yet this underscores a key benefit of the logging service: it's portable, so applications can log messages on all platforms that ACE supports.

                            日志服务示例是 ACE 中实际日志服务的缩影。ACE 的日志服务可以通过组件配置器模式 [ SSRB00 ] 和 ACE 服务配置器框架 [ SH ] 进行动态配置。通过应用适配器模式 [ GHJV95 ]，可以将记录重定向到 UNIX SYSLOGD 或 Windows NT/2000 事件日志，或者同时重定向到两者——即使发起日志服务的应用程序运行在其他类型的操作系统平台上。本书的日志服务示例特意进行了简化，以便我们能够专注于掌握其复杂性。图 0.6展示了我们网络化日志服务中的应用程序进程和服务器。下面，我们将概述图 0.6中显示的关键实体。

                            The logging service example is a microcosm of the actual Logging Service in ACE. ACE's logging service can be configured dynamically via the Component Configurator pattern [SSRB00] and ACE Service Configurator framework [SH]. By applying the Adapter pattern [GHJV95], records can be redirected to a UNIX SYSLOGD or to the Windows NT/2000 event log, or both—even if the initiating application is on another type of OS platform. This book's logging service example is purposely scaled back so we can focus on mastering complexity. Figure 0.6 illustrates the application processes and server in our networked logging service. Below, we outline the key entities shown in Figure 0.6.

                            图 0.6. 网络日志服务的参与者

                            客户端应用程序进程运行在客户端主机上，并生成从调试信息到严重错误信息的各类日志记录。客户端应用程序发送的日志信息表明：

                            Client application processes run on client hosts and generate log records ranging from debugging messages to critical error messages. The logging information sent by a client application indicates the following:

                            1. 日志记录创建时间

                            2. The time the log record was created

                            3. 应用程序的进程标识符

                            4. The process identifier of the application

                            5. 日志记录的优先级和

                            6. The priority level of the log record and

                            7. 包含日志消息文本的字符串，其大小可以从 0 到可配置的最大长度（例如 4K 字节）不等。

                            8. A string containing the logging message text, which can vary in size from 0 to a configurable maximum length, such as 4K bytes.

                            日志服务器收集并输出从客户端应用程序接收的日志记录。日志服务器可以通过从 Socket API 获取的寻址信息来确定每条消息是由哪个客户端主机发送的。通常每个系统配置只有一个日志服务器，但也可以复制多个日志服务器以增强容错能力。

                            Logging servers collect and output log records received from client applications. A logging server can determine which client host sent each message by using addressing information it obtains from the Socket API. There's generally one logging server per system configuration, though they can be replicated to enhance fault tolerance.

                            本书中，我们将多次提及网络日志服务，以便更具体地探讨网络应用领域分析的各个维度。日志服务的架构正是基于这一领域分析而构建的。正如实际产品会随着生命周期的推进而不断变化一样，日志服务的设计、功能、可扩展性和健壮性也会随着本书及[ SH ]的深入而不断演进。我们将持续迭代开发此服务，展示如何利用ACE库中类实现的诸多关键模式，解决常见的设计难题。侧边栏2介绍了如何构建ACE库，以便您能够体验本书中的示例。

                            Throughout the book, we refer to the networked logging service to make our discussion of domain analysis dimensions for networked applications more concrete. The architecture of our logging service is driven by this domain analysis. Just as real products change in scope as they progress through their life cycles, the logging service's design, functionality, scalability, and robustness will evolve as we progress through this book and [SH]. We'll continue developing this service incrementally to show solutions to common design challenges using many key patterns implemented by classes in ACE. Sidebar 2 describes how to build the ACE library so that you can experiment with the examples we present in this book.

                            侧边栏 2：构建 ACE 和使用 ACE 的程序

                              0.6 摘要

                              0.6 Summary

                              本章阐述了在分布式计算环境中高效运行的网络应用程序和中间件所面临的挑战。我们介绍了在开发软件过程中遇到的固有复杂性和偶然复杂性，这些软件涵盖了从严格受限的实时嵌入式系统 [ SLM98 ] 到新兴的中间件抽象 [ MSKS00 ] 以及具有严格服务质量 (QoS) 要求的下一代网络应用程序 [ SKKK00 ]。我们提出了中间件分层分类法，重点强调了主机基础设施中间件的优势，这也是本书的重点。

                              This chapter described the challenges of developing networked applications and middleware that can run effectively in distributed computing environments. We introduced the inherent and accidental complexities encountered when developing software ranging from tightly constrained real-time and embedded systems [SLM98] to newly evolving middleware abstractions [MSKS00] and next-generation networked applications [SKKK00] with stringent QoS requirements. We presented a taxonomy of middleware layering, emphasizing the benefits of host infrastructure middleware, which is the focus of this book.

                              本章还介绍了网络化应用架构关键设计维度的领域分析结果。这些维度被归纳为四类：

                              This chapter also introduced the results of a domain analysis of the key design dimensions for networked application architectures. These were grouped into four categories:

                              1. 通信协议和机制

                              2. Communication protocols and mechanisms

                              3. 并发架构

                              4. Concurrency architectures

                              5. 服务架构和

                              6. Service architectures and

                              7. 服务配置策略。

                              8. Service configuration strategies.

                              过去十年间，我们在开发数百个网络应用程序和中间件组件的过程中不断完善这一领域分析。该分析也指导了 ACE 并发网络编程工具包的开发。ACE 充分展现了将网络应用程序的重复结构和行为重构为主机基础设施中间件的原则和优势[ FBB + 99 ]。ACE 的面向模式软件架构，为工业级应用提供了一个强有力的范例，展示了如何通过合理的面向对象设计和 C++ 使用，显著提升开发进度，并提高网络应用程序和中间件的质量、灵活性和性能。

                              This domain analysis has been refined while developing hundreds of networked applications and middleware components during the past decade. This analysis also guided the development of the ACE concurrent network programming toolkit. ACE exemplifies the principles and benefits gained through refactoring [FBB+99] the recurring structure and behavior of networked applications into host infrastructure middleware. ACE's pattern-oriented software architecture constitutes an industrial-strength example of how proper object-oriented design and C++ usage can yield significant improvements in your development schedules and the quality, flexibility, and performance of your networked applications and middleware.

                              最后，我们介绍了网络日志服务，该服务存储来自一个或多个客户端应用程序的诊断信息。本书通篇使用此示例来说明常见的设计问题以及使用 ACE 实现的有效解决方案。本书接下来的两部分组织如下：

                              Finally, we introduced the networked logging service, which stores diagnostic information sent from one or more client applications. We use this example throughout the book to illustrate common design problems and their effective solutions using ACE. The next two parts of the book are organized as follows:

                              • 第一部分—— 第 1 章至第4章概述了通信设计方案，并描述了 ACE 中用于有效编程 OS IPC 机制的面向对象技术。

                              • Part I— Chapters 1 through 4 outline communication design alternatives and describe the object-oriented techniques used in ACE to programming OS IPC mechanisms effectively.

                              • 第二部分—— 第 5 章至第 10 章概述了并发设计方案，并描述了 ACE 中用于有效编写操作系统并发机制的面向对象技术。

                              • Part II— Chapters 5 through 10 outline concurrency design alternatives and describe the object-oriented techniques used in ACE to program OS concurrency mechanisms effectively.

                              本书两部分都阐述了开发者在设计网络应用程序以及直接使用原生操作系统进程间通信（IPC）和并发API进行编程时遇到的常见问题。我们还展示了ACE如何运用面向对象设计技巧、C++特性和模式来解决这些问题。

                              Throughout both parts of the book, we illustrate common problems that arise when developers design networked applications and when they program them using native OS IPC and concurrency APIs directly. We also show how ACE applies object-oriented design techniques, C++ features, and patterns to resolve these problems.
