                                第一章 沟通设计维度

                                Chapter 1. Communication Design Dimensions

                                章节概要

                                Chapter Synopsis

                                通信是网络应用设计的基础。本章将对通信设计维度进行领域分析，阐述网络应用之间交互所使用的规则、形式和抽象层次。本章涵盖以下设计维度：

                                Communication is fundamental to networked application design. This chapter presents a domain analysis of communication design dimensions, which address the rules, form, and levels of abstraction that networked applications use to interact with each other. We cover the following design dimensions in this chapter:

                                • 无连接协议与面向连接的协议

                                • Connectionless versus connection-oriented protocols

                                • 同步消息交换与异步消息交换

                                • Synchronous versus asynchronous message exchange

                                • 消息传递与共享内存

                                • Message-passing versus shared memory

                                  1.1 无连接协议与面向连接的协议

                                  1.1 Connectionless versus Connection-Oriented Protocols

                                  协议是一组规则，用于规定通信实体（例如在网络计算环境中交互的应用程序进程）之间如何交换控制信息和数据信息。协议通常可以分为无连接协议和面向连接协议。这方面的主要权衡因素包括延迟、可扩展性和可靠性。

                                  A protocol is a set of rules that specify how control and data information is exchanged between communicating entities, such as application processes interacting within a networked computing environment. Protocols can be generally classified as connectionless or connection-oriented. The primary trade-offs in this dimension involve latency, scalability, and reliability.

                                  无连接协议提供面向消息的服务，其中每条消息都可以独立路由和传递。无连接协议通常使用“尽力而为”的传递语义。这种语义并不保证一系列消息会按特定顺序到达目的地，甚至不保证它们最终能够到达！

                                  Connectionless protocols provide a message-oriented service in which each message can be routed and delivered independently. Connectionless protocols often use "best-effort" delivery semantics. These semantics don't guarantee that a series of messages will arrive in a particular order at their destination, or even that they'll ever arrive at all!

                                  无连接协议的常用示例包括用户数据报协议 (UDP) 和互联网协议 (IP)。这些协议可直接用于多媒体应用，例如 VoIP 或流媒体视频 [ MSKS00 ]，这些应用能够容忍一定程度的数据丢失。UDP/IP 还支持不可靠组播 [ DC90 ] 和广播功能，使发送方能够与一组接收方通信。

                                  Widely used examples of connectionless protocols are the User Datagram Protocol (UDP) and Internet Protocol (IP). These protocols can be used directly by multimedia applications, such as voice-over-IP or streaming video [MSKS00], that can tolerate some degree of data loss. UDP/IP also supports unreliable multicast [DC90] and broadcast capabilities that enable a sender to communicate with a group of receivers.

                                  面向连接的协议提供可靠、有序、无重复的数据传输服务，这对于无法容忍数据丢失的应用非常有用。为了提高性能并确保可靠性，面向连接的协议会在发送方和/或接收方交换并维护状态信息。传输控制协议 (TCP) 是一种面向连接的协议，广泛应用于许多面向会话的互联网应用，例如 Web 服务和电子邮件。

                                  Connection-oriented protocols provide a reliable, sequenced, nonduplicated delivery service, which is useful for applications that can't tolerate data loss. To enhance performance and ensure reliability, connection-oriented protocols exchange and maintain state information at the sender and/or receiver(s). The Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) is a connection-oriented protocol used in many session-oriented Internet applications, such as Web services and e-mail.

                                  使用面向连接的协议时，应用程序和中间件开发人员还必须从以下设计方案中进行选择：

                                  When connection-oriented protocols are used, application and middleware developers must also select from the following design alternatives:

                                  • 数据帧策略。面向连接的协议提供不同类型的数据帧策略。例如，某些面向连接的协议（如 TP4 和 XTP）支持面向消息的传输策略。相比之下，TCP 是一种字节流协议，它不保留应用层消息边界。因此，如果应用程序通过 TCP发送四个不同的消息，则接收方将收到一个或多个（可能超过四个）TCP 段。因此，如果应用程序需要面向消息的传输，则发送方和接收方必须执行额外的处理来对通过 TCP 交换的四个消息进行帧封装。如果消息长度始终相等且从未发生网络错误，则帧封装相对简单；否则，它可能是一个相当复杂的问题。

                                  • Data framing strategies. Connection-oriented protocols offer different types of data framing strategies. For example, message-oriented delivery strategies are supported by certain connection-oriented protocols, such as TP4 and XTP. In contrast, TCP is a bytestream protocol that doesn't preserve application message boundaries. Thus, if an application makes four send () calls to transmit four distinct messages over TCP, there will be one or more (and possibly greater than 4) TCP segments transmitted to the receiver. If an application requires message-oriented delivery therefore, the sender and receiver must perform extra processing to frame the four messages exchanged via TCP. If messages are always equal lengths and network errors never occur, framing is relatively simple; otherwise, it can be a nontrivial problem.

                                  • 连接复用策略。图 1.1 展示了通过面向连接的协议传输数据的两种通用策略，具体描述如下：

                                    1. 如图 1.1 (1)所示，多路复用是指来自同一进程内所有线程的客户端请求通过一个 TCP连接发送到服务器进程。连接多路复用的优点在于节省操作系统通信资源，例如套接字句柄和连接控制块。该策略的缺点是编程难度更高 [ AOS + 00 ]、效率更低 [ CB01 ] 且确定性更差 [ SMFGG01 ]。这些问题源于在多路复用连接上将请求与响应关联起来所需的同步和上下文切换机制。

                                    2. 非复用连接是指每个客户端使用不同的连接与对等服务通信，如图 1.1 (2)所示。非复用连接的主要优势在于能够更精细地控制通信优先级。在非复用连接设计中，每个连接的优先级都可以单独设置，因此即使其他线程之间存在大量低优先级通信流量，高优先级通信也能快速传输。这种设计避免了优先级反转，即低优先级线程独占单个复用连接的情况。此外，由于连接不共享，因此该策略的同步开销较低，因为发送和接收双向请求不需要额外的锁。与复用连接策略相比，非复用策略会占用更多操作系统资源，因此在某些环境中（例如高流量的互联网电子商务服务器）可能扩展性较差。

                                  • Connection multiplexing strategies. The two general strategies for transmitting data over a connection-oriented protocol are shown in Figure 1.1 and described below:

                                    1. Multiplexed, wherein all client requests emanating from threads in a single process pass through one TCP connection to a server process, as shown in Figure 1.1 (1). An advantage of connection multiplexing is that it conserves OS communication resources, such as socket handles and connection control blocks. The disadvantages of this strategy are that it's harder to program [AOS+00], less efficient [CB01], and less deterministic [SMFGG01]. These problems stem from the synchronization and context switching mechanisms required to associate requests with responses over a multiplexed connection.

                                    2. Nonmultiplexed, wherein each client uses a different connection to communicate with a peer service, as shown in Figure 1.1 (2). The primary advantage of nonmultiplexed connections is finer control of communication priorities. In the nonmultiplexed connection design, each connection's priority can be set individually, so that high-priority communication will be transmitted quickly, even if there's a large volume of low-priority communications traffic between other threads. This design avoids priority inversion, wherein low-priority threads monopolize a single multiplexed connection. In addition, since connections aren't shared, this strategy incurs low synchronization overhead because additional locks aren't needed to send and receive two-way requests. Compared with multiplexed connection strategies, non-multiplexed strategies use more OS resources, and therefore may not scale well in certain environments, such as high-volume Internet e-commerce servers.

                                  图 1.1. 替代连接复用策略

                                  有关连接复用策略的设计和权衡的更多信息，请参阅 [ SMFGG01 , SSRB00 ]。

                                  Additional information on the design and trade-offs of connection multiplexing strategies is available in [SMFGG01, SSRB00].

                                  日志服务： 我们的网络日志服务实现采用面向连接的 TCP/IP 协议，将客户端应用程序的日志记录传输到日志服务器。连接建立开销通过建立一次连接并在客户端/服务器通信期间缓存该连接来分摊。连接采用非多路复用设计，每个日志客户端应用程序都会与日志服务器建立单独的 TCP 连接。

                                  Logging service Our networked logging service implementations use the connection-oriented TCP/IP protocol to transmit log records from client applications to a logging server. Connection setup overhead is amortized by establishing a connection once and caching it for the duration of the client/server conversations. The connections are nonmultiplexed, with each logging client application opening a separate TCP connection to the logging server.

                                  选择 TCP 协议确实需要我们在 TCP 字节流之上实现数据帧机制（详见第 86 页侧边栏 9）。然而，TCP 的广泛应用使得这项努力物有所值，因为它能够实现跨操作系统平台和数据链路层网络的互操作性和可移植性。此外，传输层（而非应用层）负责流量和拥塞控制、丢失数据包的重传以及确保数据按正确顺序传输。这些功能对于那些无法承受日志记录丢失的网络应用至关重要。

                                  The choice of TCP does require us to implement a data framing mechanism atop TCP bytestreams (which we show in Sidebar 9 on page 86). The ubiquity of TCP makes this effort pay off, however, in terms of interoperability and portability across OS platforms and data link layer networks. Moreover, the transport layer, not the application, is responsible for flow and congestion control, retransmitting lost packets, and ensuring the data is delivered in the proper order. These capabilities are important for networked applications that can't afford to lose log records.

                                    1.2 同步消息交换与异步消息交换

                                    1.2 Synchronous versus Asynchronous Message Exchange

                                    在许多网络应用中，客户端向服务器发送请求，服务器处理请求后返回响应。这些请求/响应协议可以基于无连接协议或面向连接的协议实现。如图1.2所示，请求/响应协议交换的两种可选策略是同步和异步。影响使用同步还是异步消息交换策略的两个因素是：

                                    In many networked applications, a client sends a request to a server, which processes the request and then sends back a response. These request/response protocols can be implemented over either connectionless or connection-oriented protocols. Two alternative strategies for arranging request/response protocol exchanges are synchronous and asynchronous, as shown in Figure 1.2. The two factors that affect whether to use synchronous or asynchronous message exchange strategies are

                                    1. 请求之间的相互关联性

                                    2. The interrelatedness of requests and

                                    3. 底层协议或通信介质的延迟。

                                    4. The latency of the underlying protocol or communication media.
                                    图 1.2. 同步消息传递策略与异步消息传递策略

                                    下面我们将探讨这些因素如何影响策略的选择。

                                    We examine how these factors affect the choice of strategy below.

                                    同步请求/响应协议是最容易实现的形式。在这些协议中，请求和响应以同步顺序交换。每个请求必须同步收到响应后才能发送下一个请求，如图 1.2 (1)所示。同步请求/响应协议适用于以下场景：

                                    Synchronous request/response protocols are the simplest form to implement. In these protocols, requests and responses are exchanged in a lock-step sequence. Each request must receive a response synchronously before the next is sent, as shown in Figure 1.2 (1). Synchronous request/response protocols are appropriate in the following contexts:

                                    • 例如，当请求结果决定后续请求时，需要进行身份验证交换的应用程序，在安全证书交换成功完成之前，不会发送敏感信息请求。

                                    • When the result of a request determines subsequent requests, for example, an application that requires an authentication exchange won't send sensitive information requests until the security certificate exchange completes successfully

                                    • 当应用程序在低延迟网络中交换需要短时间处理的消息时，例如高速局域网中的NFS读取和写入操作

                                    • When applications exchange messages requiring short-duration processing in low-latency networks, such as NFS read() and write () operations in high-speed LANs

                                    • 当实现的简单性或少量协议交换比接下来描述的异步请求/响应协议可能带来的任何性能提升更为重要时。

                                    • When simplicity of implementation or a small number of protocol exchanges overrides any possible performance improvement that may be gained by the asynchronous request/response protocols described next.

                                    异步请求/响应协议无需同步等待响应，即可将请求从客户端直接发送到服务器 [ AOS + 00 ]。如图 1.2 (2)所示，在服务器到达任何响应之前，客户端可以发送多个请求。因此，异步请求/响应协议通常需要一种策略来检测丢失或失败的请求，并在稍后重新发送。异步请求/响应协议适用于以下场景：

                                    Asynchronous request/response protocols stream requests from client to server without waiting for responses synchronously [AOS+00]. Multiple client requests can be transmitted before any responses arrive from a server, as shown in Figure 1.2 (2). Asynchronous request/response protocols therefore often require a strategy for detecting lost or failed requests and resending them later. Asynchronous request/response protocols are appropriate in the following contexts:

                                    • 当不需要等待响应即可决定是否处理后续请求时，例如，Web 浏览器可以使用异步策略从同一服务器获取多个嵌入式图像。由于每个请求都是独立的，因此它们都可以异步发送，而无需等待中间的响应。每个响应都包含浏览器可以用来将其与相应请求匹配的信息，即使响应的顺序与请求的发送顺序不同。

                                    • When a response is not required before deciding on subsequent requests. For example, Web browsers can use asynchronous strategies to fetch multiple embedded images from the same server. Since each request is independent, they can all be sent asynchronously without waiting for the intervening responses. Each response includes information the browser can use to match it to the corresponding request even when the order of responses is different from the order the requests were sent.

                                    • 当通信延迟相对于请求处理所需时间过高时，异步请求策略有助于高效利用网络，降低高延迟的影响。由此带来的性能提升远远超过了将响应与请求关联以及正确实现重试策略所带来的额外复杂性。

                                    • When communication latency is high relative to the processing time required for the request. Asynchronous request strategies help to make efficient use of the network, reducing the effects of high latency. The resulting performance improvement greatly outweighs the extra complexity of associating responses with requests and correctly implementing retry strategies.

                                    日志服务： 我们的网络日志服务器使用一种单向的异步请求/响应协议，无需应用层响应。日志记录直接从客户端应用程序传输到日志服务器；也就是说，服务器无需进行应用层确认。日志服务器在接收到每条日志记录后立即将其写入磁盘，并假设发送的每条日志记录都能可靠地记录下来。只要客户端应用程序不需要网络日志服务采取特殊措施来保证所有日志记录的持久存储（即使发生灾难性故障），这种设计就足够了。如果成为这样的需求，我们就需要开发基于事务的日志服务，这将更加复杂，并带来更高的时间和空间开销。

                                    Logging service Our networked logging server uses a one-way variant of an asynchronous request/response protocol that doesn't require application-level responses. Log records are just transferred from client applications to the logging server; that is, there's no need for application-level acknowledgments from the server. The logging server itself writes each log record to disk immediately after receiving it, with the assumption that each log record sent is recorded reliably. This design suffices as long as client applications don't require the networked logging service to take heroic measures to guarantee that all log records are stored persistently, even when catastrophic failures occur. If this became a requirement, we'd need to develop a transaction-based logging service, which is much more complicated and incurs significantly higher time/space overhead.

                                      1.3 消息传递与共享内存

                                      1.3 Message Passing versus Shared Memory

                                      我们之前对协议的讨论都假设信息是在位于不同计算机上的对等节点之间传输的。这种类型的信息交换称为消息传递。当通信对等节点可以访问共享内存区域时，就会发生另一种类型的信息交换。本节将介绍这两种机制及其优缺点。

                                      Our discussion of protocols has so far assumed information is transferred between peers that reside on different computers. This type of exchange is referred to as message passing. A different type of information exchange can occur when communicating peers have access to a region of shared memory. This section describes these two mechanisms and their tradeoffs.

                                      消息传递通过我们将在第二章探讨的进程间通信（IPC）机制显式地交换字节流和面向记录的数据。应用程序开发人员通常会定义这些消息的格式和内容，以及参与者必须遵循的应用程序协议，以便交换消息。该协议还定义了每次交换中可能的参与者数量（例如，点对点（单播）、多播或广播），以及参与者如何开始、进行和结束消息传递会话。

                                      Message passing exchanges bytestream and record-oriented data explicitly via the IPC mechanisms that we'll explore in Chapter 2. Application developers generally define the format and content of these messages, as well as the application protocol that participants must follow to exchange messages. This protocol also defines the number of possible participants in each exchange (e.g., point-to-point (unicast), multicast, or broadcast) and how participants begin, conduct, and end a message-passing session.

                                      如图 1.3 (1)所示，消息传递进程间通信 (IPC) 机制通过 IPC 通道以消息的形式将数据从一个进程或线程传递到另一个进程或线程。如果传输的数据量很大，则可能会将其分割成多个消息并按顺序发送。如果有多个进程接收数据，则每条消息可能会被多次发送，每个接收者接收一次。许多流行的中间件架构，例如 RPC、CORBA 和面向消息的中间件 (MOM)，其内部都基于消息传递通信模型。

                                      The message-passing IPC mechanisms transfer data from one process or thread to another in messages across an IPC channel, as shown in Figure 1.3 (1). If a large amount of data is transferred, it may be fragmented and sent in a sequence of messages. If there's more than one process receiving the data, each message may be sent multiple times, once for each recipient. Many popular middleware architectures, such as RPC, CORBA, and message-oriented middleware (MOM), are based on a message-passing communication model internally.

                                      图 1.3. 消息传递与共享内存

                                      共享内存允许同一主机或不同主机上的多个进程访问和交换数据，就像数据位于每个进程的本地地址空间一样。当联网应用程序的数据需要被多个进程查看和/或操作时，共享内存机制可能比消息传递更高效。使用操作系统原生共享内存机制的应用程序无需定义实体间的信息传输方法，只需定义如何定位和映射共享内存区域以及放置在共享内存中的数据结构即可。

                                      Shared memory allows multiple processes on the same or different hosts to access and exchange data as though it were local to the address space of each process. When networked applications have data that must be viewed and/or manipulated by multiple processes, shared memory facilities may be a more efficient communication mechanism than message passing. Rather than define the method for transmitting information between entities, applications using native OS shared memory mechanisms must define how to locate and map the shared memory region(s) and the data structures that are placed in shared memory.

                                      共享内存可以分为本地和分布式两种类型，如下所述。

                                      Shared memory can be divided into local and distributed variants, as described next.

                                      本地共享内存允许同一台计算机上的进程拥有一个或多个映射到不同虚拟地址范围的共享内存区域。两种常见的共享内存机制包括：

                                      • Local shared memory allows processes on the same computer to have one or more shared memory regions mapped to different virtual address ranges. Two common shared memory mechanisms include

                                      1. System V UNIX 共享内存，其中shmget()系统函数用于创建新的共享内存区域或返回已存在的共享内存区域。进程可以使用shmat()系统函数将共享内存区域附加到其虚拟地址空间。

                                      2. System V UNIX shared memory, wherein the shmget () system function creates a new region of shared memory or returns an existing one. A process attaches a shared memory region to its virtual address space with the shmat () system function.

                                      3. 内存映射文件是指将文件的全部或部分内容映射到多个进程共享的虚拟内存区域。内存映射文件的内容可以刷新到持久存储，从而为程序执行过程中信息的保存和恢复提供了一种便捷的方式。

                                      4. Memory-mapped files, wherein all or part of a file can be mapped to an area of virtual memory that's shared across multiple processes. The contents of memory-mapped files can be flushed to persistent storage, which provides a convenient way to save and restore information across program execution.

                                      在这两种机制中，操作系统都允许多个进程将共享内存区域映射到它们的地址空间，如图1.3 (2) 所示。所有映射共享内存区域的进程都可以直接读取和写入共享内存的内容。

                                      In both mechanisms, the OS enables multiple processes to map shared memory regions into their address spaces, as shown in Figure 1.3 (2). All processes that map the shared memory region(s) can read from and write to the shared memory's contents directly.

                                      尽管通过共享内存进行多进程通信具有灵活性，但需要精心编程。例如，应用程序开发人员必须确保共享数据不会因竞争条件而损坏。第 10 章中描述的系统级同步机制可以强制将数据序列化到共享内存区域，从而确保共享信息的有序访问。同样，如果应用程序将 C++ 对象存储在共享内存中，则必须进行仔细设计，如侧边栏 3所述。

                                      Despite its flexibility, communicating between multiple processes via shared memory requires careful programming. For example, application developers must ensure that data being shared aren't corrupted by race conditions. The system-scope synchronization mechanisms described in Chapter 10 can enforce serialization to a shared memory region so that shared information is accessed in an orderly manner. Likewise, applications must be designed carefully if they store C++ objects in shared memory, as described in Sidebar 3.

                                      侧边栏 3：C++ 对象和共享内存

                                      Sidebar 3: C++ Objects and Shared Mernory

                                      C++ 的 ` new`运算符可以将 C++ 对象初始化到共享内存中。此功能适用于具体类 [ Bja00 ]，因为每个具体类都包含支持其自身所需的所有操作。具体类中的所有方法都是非虚方法；也就是说，它们是直接调用的，而不是通过函数指针间接调用。许多 ACE 包装器外观都是具体类型，原因详见第 255 页A.6 节。

                                      The C++ placement new operator can initialize C++ objects in shared memory. This feature works for concrete classes [Bja00] because each contains all operations necessary for its support. All methods in a concrete class are nonvirtual; that is, they are called directly rather than indirectly through a pointer-to-function. Many ACE wrapper facades are concrete types, for the reasons described in Section A.6 on page 255.

                                      相比之下，包含虚方法的抽象类型在共享内存中难以实现可移植性。虚方法通常通过位于对象内存中的函数指针表（虚函数表）进行间接调用。共享内存区域在每个映射它的进程中可能位于不同的虚拟内存地址 [ BC94 , Jor91 ]。此外，C++ 编译器/链接器无需将虚函数表放置在不同进程的同一地址。因此，虚函数表及其引用的函数在每个进程中可能映射到不同的虚拟地址，这必然会导致运行时问题。

                                      In contrast, abstract types that contain virtual methods are hard to program portably when placed in shared memory. Virtual methods are usually invoked using an indirect call through a table of function pointers (a vtable) located in the object's memory. A shared memory region may reside at a different virtual memory location in each process that maps it [BC94, Jor91]. Moreover, a C++ compiler/linker needn't locate vtables at the same address in separate processes. The vtable, as well as the functions it refers to, may therefore be mapped at different virtual addresses in each process, which guarantees problems at run time.

                                      分布式共享内存 (DSM)是一种编程抽象，它为应用程序提供了对操作系统虚拟内存机制的扩展 [ JM98 ]。虚拟内存提供了一系列策略，用于按需获取、放置和替换一组页面，从而使程序感觉拥有比实际物理内存更大的地址空间。DSM 将虚拟内存的概念扩展到网络，以实现通过全局/共享内存中的数据进行透明的进程间通信。它代表了两种计算范式的混合：共享内存多处理器和分布式系统 [ PTM97 ]。

                                      • Distributed shared memory (DSM) is a programming abstraction that provides applications with an extension to OS virtual memory mechanisms [JM98]. Virtual memory provides a set of policies for fetching, placing, and replacing a set of pages on demand to give programs the illusion that they have a much larger address space than actually exists in physical memory. DSM extends the virtual memory concept across a network to enable transparent interprocess communication via data in global/shared memory. It represents a hybrid of two computing paradigms: shared memory multiprocessors and distributed systems [PTM97].

                                      例如，有些硬件/软件平台将多台计算机集群到一个逻辑系统中，集群内部共享内存。参与的应用程序通过跨联网计算机管理的分布式共享内存进行通信。分布式共享内存（DSM）系统提供机制来协调跨进程和网络节点的更新。这种通信模型通常在其底层采用消息传递机制来协调数据交换并同步读写操作。

                                      For example, there are hardware/software platforms that cluster multiple computers into one logical system in which memory is shared across the cluster. Participating applications communicate via distributed shared memory managed across the networked computers. DSM systems provide mechanisms for coordinating updates across processes and network nodes. This communication model often employs message-passing mechanisms in its lower layers to coordinate the exchange of data and to synchronize readers and writers.

                                      日志服务： 我们的网络日志服务采用基于 TCP/IP 的消息传递进程间通信 (MPC) 模型。消息传递 IPC 通常比开发分布式空间管理 (DSM) 机制并通过复杂的分布式缓存一致性协议进行管理更为实用。由于 DSM 是一个高级研究课题，在实践中并不常用，因此本书不再赘述。关于 DSM 研究的优秀综述可参见 [ NL91 , PTM97 ]。

                                      Logging service Our networked logging service uses a message-passing IPC model implemented over TCP/IP. Message-passing IPC is usually more practical than developing a DSM mechanism and managing it via complex distributed cache coherency protocols. Since DSM is an advanced research topic that's not commonly used in practice, we don't consider it further in this book. Good overviews of DSM research appear in [NL91, PTM97].

                                        1.4 总结

                                        1.4 Summary

                                        在独立应用程序的单一地址空间内，不同的实体通常通过函数调用传递参数和/或访问全局变量进行交互。然而，在网络应用程序中，位于不同地址空间的实体需要不同的进程间通信机制。本章阐述了进程间通信机制如何带来在设计网络应用程序时需要考虑的诸多通信维度。我们介绍了连接模式、请求/响应协议和信息交换方案，以及指导您做出选择的因素和权衡。

                                        Separate entities within the single address space of a stand-alone application often interact by passing parameters via function calls and/or by accessing global variables. Entities located in different address spaces in networked applications, however, require different interprocess communication mechanisms. This chapter described how IPC mechanisms yield a number of communication dimensions to consider when designing networked applications. We described connection modes, request/response protocols, and information exchange alternatives, as well as factors and tradeoffs to guide your choices.

                                        下一章将讨论 Socket API。它是您在实现设计时最常遇到的进程间通信 (IPC) 机制，因此了解其功能和不足以及 ACE 提供的解决方案至关重要。ACE 工具包提供了一系列类，可帮助您根据本章讨论的设计维度选择合适的通信方式。例如：

                                        The next chapter discusses the Socket API. It's the most common IPC facility you'll encounter when implementing your designs, so it's important to understand its capabilities and shortcomings, as well as ACE's solutions. The ACE toolkit provides a range of classes that help guide your communication choices in accordance with the design dimensions discussed in this chapter. For example,

                                        • 第 3 章介绍了封装面向连接和同步消息传递功能的 ACE 包装器外观。

                                        • The ACE wrapper facades that encapsulate connection-oriented and synchronous message-passing functionality are presented in Chapter 3.

                                        • [ SH ]中说明了异步连接建立和数据传输。

                                        • Asynchronous connection-establishment and data transfer is illustrated in [SH].

                                        • ACE 内存映射文件机制在第 68 页的侧边栏 7中有描述，其共享内存机制在 [ HJS ]中显示。

                                        • The ACE memory-mapped file mechanism is described in Sidebar 7 on page 68 and its shared memory mechanisms are shown in [HJS].

                                        在联网应用程序中使用这些 ACE 功能可以帮助减少固有的和意外的复杂性。

                                        Using these ACE capabilities in your networked applications can help to reduce inherent and accidental complexities.

                                          第二章 Socket API 概述

                                          Chapter 2. An Overview of the Socket API

                                          章节概要

                                          Chapter Synopsis

                                          上一章重点介绍了网络应用通信的设计空间建模，这为解决其固有的复杂性提供了诸多机会。本章将深入探讨解决方案空间，首先介绍最常见的进程间通信 (IPC) 机制：套接字。我们将描述套接字 API 及其在 TCP/IP 中的应用，然后分析开发人员在使用原生操作系统 API 编写网络应用时经常遇到的意外复杂性。

                                          The previous chapter focused on modeling the design space of networked application communication, which provides many opportunities to address inherent complexities. This chapter starts delving into the solution space, beginning with the most common interprocess communication (IPC) mechanism: sockets. We describe the Socket API and its use with TCP/IP, followed by an analysis of common accidental complexities encountered when developers program their networked applications using native OS APIs.

                                            2.1 操作系统进程间通信机制概述

                                            2.1 An Overview of Operating System IPC Mechanisms

                                            网络化应用需要进程间通信（IPC）机制来实现客户端和服务器之间的信息交换。操作系统提供的IPC机制可以分为两大类：

                                            Networked applications require interprocess communication (IPC) mechanisms to enable clients and servers to exchange information. The IPC mechanisms provided by operating systems can be classified into two general categories:

                                            • 本地 IPC—— 某些 IPC 机制，如共享内存、管道、UNIX 域套接字、门或信号，仅允许位于同一台计算机上的实体之间进行通信 [ Ste99 ]。

                                            • Local IPC— Certain IPC mechanisms, such as shared memory, pipes, UNIX-domain sockets, doors, or signals, enable communication only between entities that are collocated on the same computer [Ste99].

                                            • 远程 IPC— 其他 IPC 机制，如 Internet 域套接字 [ Ste98 ​​]、X.25 电路和 Win32 命名管道，支持在网络中位于同一位置或分布的实体之间进行通信。

                                            • Remote IPC— Other IPC mechanisms, such as Internet-domain sockets [Ste98], X.25 circuits, and Win32 Named Pipes, support communication between entities that can be collocated or distributed across a network.

                                            尽管网络应用程序主要关注远程 IPC 机制，但我们提出的模式和 ACE 包装器外观也适用于大多数本地 IPC 机制。

                                            Although networked applications are largely concerned with remote IPC mechanisms, the patterns and ACE wrapper facades we present also apply to most local IPC mechanisms.

                                            本书篇幅有限，无法全面讨论操作系统进程间通信（IPC）机制及其API。如需更全面的内容，建议参考[ Rag93 , MBKQ96 , Ric97 , Sol98 , Ste98 , Ste99 ]。本章重点介绍Socket API和TCP/IP，因为它们分别是目前最常用的IPC API和网络协议。我们将阐述在为异构平台编写可移植且健壮的程序时，依赖Socket API会面临诸多挑战。第3章和第4章将阐述ACE如何使用C++和模式来解决这些问题。

                                            A complete discussion of OS IPC mechanisms and their APIs is beyond the scope of this book. We recommend that you consult [Rag93, MBKQ96, Ric97, Sol98, Ste98, Ste99] for complete coverage. This chapter focuses on the Socket API and TCP/IP since they are the most common IPC API and networking protocol, respectively. We show how hard it is to rely on the Socket API when writing portable and robust programs for heterogeneous platforms. Chapters 3 and 4 then illustrate how ACE uses C++ and patterns to resolve these problems.

                                              2.2 Socket API

                                              2.2 The Socket API

                                              Socket API 最初在 BSD UNIX [ MBKQ96 ] 中开发，旨在为 TCP/IP 协议族提供应用层接口。此后，该 API 已被移植到大多数操作系统，包括所有 ACE 支持的操作系统。如今，它已成为基于 TCP/IP 进行进程间通信编程的事实标准。

                                              The Socket API was developed in BSD UNIX [MBKQ96] to provide an application-level interface to the TCP/IP protocol suite. This API has since been ported to most operating systems, including all those supported by ACE. It's now the de facto standard for programming interprocess communication over TCP/IP.

                                              应用程序可以使用 Socket API 中的 C 函数来创建和管理本地通信端点，这些端点称为套接字。每个套接字都通过句柄访问，句柄在 UNIX 文献中也称为描述符。套接字句柄标识操作系统维护的单个通信端点，同时屏蔽应用程序与底层操作系统内核实现细节之间的差异和依赖关系，例如：

                                              Applications can use the C functions in the Socket API to create and manage local endpoints of communication, which are called sockets. Each socket is accessed via a handle, which is also referred to as a descriptor in the UNIX literature. A socket handle identifies a single communication endpoint maintained by the OS, while shielding applications from differences between, and dependencies on, low-level OS kernel implementation details, such as the following:

                                              • 在 UNIX 系统中，套接字句柄和其他 I/O 句柄（如文件句柄、管道句柄和终端设备句柄）可以互换使用，用于大多数操作。

                                              • In UNIX, socket handles and other I/O handles, such as file, pipe, and terminal device handles, can be used interchangeably for most operations.

                                              • 在 Microsoft Windows 中，套接字句柄和 I/O 句柄虽然用途相似，但不能互换使用以执行大多数操作。

                                              • In Microsoft Windows, socket handles can't be used interchangeably with I/O handles for most operations, though they serve similar purposes.

                                              每个套接字都可以绑定到一个本地地址和一个远程地址。这些地址定义了通过该套接字通信的两个或多个对等方之间的关联。

                                              Each socket can be bound to a local and a remote address. These addresses define the association between two or more peers that communicate via the socket.

                                              Socket API 包含大约二十几个系统函数，可以分为以下五类：

                                              The Socket API contains approximately two dozen system functions that can be classified into the following five categories:

                                              1. 本地上下文管理。Socket API 提供了一些函数来管理本地上下文信息，这些信息通常存储在操作系统内核或系统库中：

                                                功能 描述
                                                插座（） 一个工厂函数，用于分配套接字句柄并将其返回给调用者。
                                                绑定() 将套接字句柄与本地或远程地址关联起来。
                                                getsockname() 返回套接字绑定的本地地址。
                                                获取对等方名称() 返回套接字绑定的远程地址。
                                                关闭（） 释放一个插座手柄，使其可供重复使用。

                                              2. Local context management. The Socket API provides functions to manage local context information, which is normally stored within the OS kernel or in system libraries:

                                                Function Description
                                                Socket() A factory function that allocates a socket handle and returns it to the caller.
                                                bind() Associates a socket handle with a local or remote address.
                                                getsockname() Returns the local address to which a socket is bound.
                                                getpeername() Returns the remote address to which a socket is bound.
                                                close() Deallocates a socket handle, making it available for reuse.

                                              3. 连接建立和连接终止。Socket API 提供用于建立和终止连接的函数：

                                                功能 描述
                                                连接（） 主动建立与插座手柄的连接。
                                                听（） 表示它愿意被动地监听传入的客户端连接请求。
                                                接受（） 一个工厂函数，用于创建新的通信端点以服务客户端请求。
                                                关闭（） 选择性地终止双向连接的读取端和/或写入端数据流。

                                              4. Connection establishment and connection termination. The Socket API provides functions to establish and terminate connections:

                                                Function Description
                                                Connect() Establishes a connection actively on a socket handle.
                                                listen() Indicates its willingness to listen passively for incoming client connection requests.
                                                Accept() A factory function that creates a new communication endpoint to service client requests.
                                                shutdown() Selectively terminates the read-side and/or write-side stream of a bidirectional connection.

                                              5. 数据传输机制。Socket API 提供通过套接字句柄发送和接收数据的函数：

                                                功能 描述 
                                                send()recv()
                                                		 通过特定的 I/O 句柄发送和接收数据缓冲区。 
                                                sendto()recvfrom()
                                                		 交换无连接数据报，其中每次sendto()调用都会提供接收方的网络地址。

                                                在 UNIX 系统中，这些函数也可用于其他类型的单输出句柄，例如文件和终端设备。UNIX 平台还提供以下数据传输机制：

                                                功能 描述 
                                                read()write()
                                                		 通过特定句柄接收和发送数据缓冲区。 
                                                readv()writev()
                                                		 分别支持分散读取和聚集写入语义，以优化模式切换并简化内存管理。 
                                                sendmsg()recvmsg()
                                                		 涵盖其他数据传输函数行为的通用函数。

                                              6. Data transfer mechanisms. The Socket API provides functions to send and receive data via socket handles:

                                                Function Description 
                                                send()recv()
                                                		 Transmit and receive buffers of data via a particular I/O handle. 
                                                sendto()recvfrom()
                                                		 Exchanges connectionless datagrams, where each sendto() call provides the networking address of the recipient.

                                                On UNIX, these functions can also be used for other types of 1/O handles, such as files and terminal devices. UNIX platforms also provide the following data transfer mechanisms:

                                                Function Description 
                                                read()write()
                                                		 Receive and transmit buffers of data via a particular handle. 
                                                readv()writev()
                                                		 Supports scatter-read and gather-write semantics, respectively, to optimize mode switching and simplify memory management. 
                                                sendmsg()recvmsg()
                                                		 General-purpose functions that subsume the behavior of the other data transfer functions.

                                              7. 选项管理。Socket API 定义了一些函数，允许程序员更改默认的套接字行为，以启用多播、广播以及修改/查询传输缓冲区的大小：

                                                功能 描述
                                                setsockopt() 修改协议栈不同层中的选项。
                                                setsockopt() 查询不同协议栈层中的选项。

                                              8. Options management. The Socket API defines functions that allow programmers to alter default socket behavior to enable multicasting, broadcasting, and modifying/querying the size of transport buffers:

                                                Function Description
                                                setsockopt() Modifies options in different protocol stack layers.
                                                setsockopt() Queries options in different protocol stack layers.

                                              9. 网络寻址。 除了上述功能外，联网应用程序通常使用函数将人类可读的名称（例如tango.ece.uci.edu）解析为底层网络地址（例如128.195.174.35）：

                                                功能 描述 
                                                gethostbyname()
gethostbyaddr()
                                                		 处理主机名和 IPv4 地址之间的网络地址映射。 
                                                getipnodebyname()
getipnodebyaddr()
                                                		 处理主机名和 IPv4/IPv6 地址之间的网络地址映射。
                                                获取 servbyname() 通过易于理解的名称来识别服务。

                                              10. Network addressing. In addition to the functions described above, networked applications often use functions to resolve humanly readable names, such as tango.ece.uci.edu, to low-level network addresses, such as 128.195.174.35:

                                                Function Description 
                                                gethostbyname()
gethostbyaddr()
                                                		 Handle network address mapping between hostnames and IPv4 addresses. 
                                                getipnodebyname()
getipnodebyaddr()
                                                		 Handle network address mapping between hostnames and IPv4/IPv6 addresses.
                                                get servbyname() Identifies services by their humanly readable names.

                                              虽然 Socket API 最常用于编写 TCP/IP 应用程序，但它也足够通用，可以支持多种通信域。通信域由协议族和地址族定义，如下所示：

                                              Although the Socket API is most often used to write TCP/IP applications it's broad enough to support multiple communication domains. A communication domain is defined by a protocol family and an address family, as follows:

                                              • 协议族。 当今的网络环境包含大量协议，这些协议可以提供各种通信服务，例如面向连接的可靠传输、不可靠组播等。协议族是指提供一组特定相关服务的协议集合。使用 Socket API 创建套接字时，协议由以下两个参数组合指定：

                                                1. 协议族—— 例如，UNIX 域 (PF_UNIX)、互联网域 IPv4 (PF_INET) 和 IPv6 (PF_INET6)、ATM (PF_ATMSVC)、X.25 (PF_x25)、Appletalk (PF_APPLETALK) 等。

                                                2. 服务类型—— 例如，顺序可靠字节流（SOCK_STREAM）、不可靠数据报（SOCK_DGRAM）等等。

                                                例如，通过将 PF_INET（或 PF_INET6）和 SOCK_STREAM 标志传递给socket()函数来指定 TCP/IP 协议。

                                              • Protocol family. Today's networking environments include a large number of protocols that can offer a variety of communication services, such as connection-oriented reliable delivery, unreliable multicast, etc. A protocol family is a collection of protocols that offers a distinct set of related services. When creating a socket using the Socket API, the protocol is specified by a combination of the following two parameters:

                                                1. Protocol family— for example, UNIX-domain (PF_UNIX), Internet-domain IPv4 (PF_INET) and IPv6 (PF_INET6), ATM (PF_ATMSVC), X.25 (PF_x25), Appletalk (PF_APPLETALK), and so on.

                                                2. Service type— for example, sequenced, reliable bytestream (SOCK_STREAM), unreliable datagram (SOCK_DGRAM), and so on.

                                                For example, the TCP/IP protocol is specified by passing the PF_INET (or PF_INET6) and SOCK_STREAM flags to the socket() function.

                                              • 地址族。 地址族定义了一种地址格式，该格式描述了地址的大小（以字节为单位）以及字段的数量、类型和顺序。此外，地址族还定义了一组用于解释地址格式的函数，例如，确定 IP 数据报的目标子网。地址族与协议族密切对应，例如，IPv4 地址族 AF_INET 只能与 IPv4 协议族 PF_INET 一起使用。

                                              • Address family. An address family defines an address format that characterizes the size of an address in bytes, as well as the number, type, and order of its fields. In addition, an address family defines a set of functions that interpret the address format, for example, to determine the subnet where an IP datagram is destined. Address families correspond closely to protocol families, for example, the IPv4 address family AF_INET works only with the IPv4 protocol family PF_INET.

                                                2.3 Socket API 的局限性

                                                2.3 Limitations of the Socket API

                                                原生 Socket API 存在诸多局限性：容易出错、过于复杂且缺乏可移植性/不统一。虽然以下讨论主要针对 Socket API，但这些批评也适用于其他原生操作系统进程间通信 (IPC) API。

                                                The native Socket API has several limitations: it's error-prone, overly complex, and nonportable/nonuniform. Although the following discussion focuses on the Socket API, the critique also applies to other native OS IPC APIs.

                                                2.3.1 容易出错的 API

                                                2.3.1 Error-Prone APIs

                                                如第 2.2 节所述，Socket API 使用句柄来标识套接字端点。通常，操作系统也使用句柄来标识其他 I/O 设备，例如文件、管道和终端。这些句柄以弱类型整数或指针的形式实现，这会导致运行时出现一些不易察觉的错误。为了说明这些以及其他可能出现的问题，请考虑以下echo_server()函数：

                                                As outlined in Section 2.2, the Socket API uses handles to identify socket endpoints. In general, operating systems use handles to identify other I/O devices, such as files, pipes, and terminals. These handles are implemented as weakly typed integer or pointer types, which allows subtle errors to occur at run time. To illustrate these and other problems that can occur, consider the following echo_server() function:

                                                 0 // This example contains bugs! Do not copy this example!
 1 #include <sys/types.h>
 2 #include <sys/socket.h>
 3
 4 const int PORT_NUM = 10000;
 5
 6 int echo server()
 7 {
 8   struct sockaddr_in addr;
 9   int addr_len;
10   char buf[BUFSIZ];
11   int n_handle;
12   // Create the local endpoint.
13   int s_handle = socket (PF_UNIX, SOCK_DGRAM, 0);
14   if (s_handle == -1) return -1;
15
16   // Set up the address information where the server listens.
17   addr.sin_family = AF_INET;
18   addr.sin_port = PORT_NUM;
19   addr.sin_addr.addr = INADDR_ANY;
20
21   if (bind (s_handle, (struct sockaddr *) &addr,
22             sizeof addr) == -1)
23     return -1;
24
25   // Create a new communication endpoint.
26   if (n_handle = accept (s_handle, (struct sockaddr *) &addr,
27                          &addr_len) != -1) {
28     int n;
29     while ((n = read (s_handle, buf, sizeof buf)) > 0)
30       write (n_handle, buf, n);
31
32     close (n handle);
33   }
34   return 0;
35 }

                                                这个函数至少包含 10 个在使用 Socket API 时常见的、不易察觉的错误。请在阅读上面的代码时尝试找出所有 10 个错误，然后阅读我们下面对这些缺陷的分析。括号中的数字是echo_server()函数中出现错误的行号。

                                                This function contains at least 10 subtle and all-too-common bugs that occur when using the Socket API. See if you can locate all 10 bugs while reading the code above, then read our dissection of these flaws below. The numbers in parentheses are the line numbers where errors occur in the echo_server() function.

                                                1. 忘记初始化一个重要变量。(8–9)必须将addr_len 变量设置为sizeof(addr)。忘记初始化此变量会导致第 26 行的accept()调用在运行时失败。

                                                2. Forgot to initialize an important variable. (8–9) The addr_len variable must be set to sizeof (addr). Forgetting to initialize this variable will cause the accept() call on line 26 to fail at run-time.

                                                3. 使用了不可移植的句柄数据类型。(11–14) 虽然这些代码行看起来似乎无害，但实际上却暗藏玄机。这段代码无法移植到 Windows 套接字 (WinSock) 平台，因为在这些平台上，套接字句柄的类型是 SOCKET，而不是int。此外，WinSock 失败是通过一个名为 INVALID_SOCKET_HANDLE 的非标准宏来指示的，而不是返回-1。上述代码片段中的其他错误只有在检查函数的其余部分后才会显现出来。

                                                  接下来的三个网络寻址错误比较隐蔽，只会在运行时出现。

                                                4. Use of nonportable handle datatype. (11–14) Although these lines look harmless enough, they are also fraught with peril. This code isn't portable to Windows Sockets (WinSock) platforms, where socket handles are type SOCKET, not type int. Moreover, WinSock failures are indicated via a non-standard macro called INVALID_SOCKET_HANDLE rather than by returning –1. The other bugs in the code fragment above aren't obvious until we examine the rest of the function.

                                                  The next three network addressing errors are subtle, and show up only at run time.

                                                5. 未使用的构造函数成员未清除。(17–19)在设置每个地址成员之前，应该将 整个addr结构初始化为 0。Socket API 使用一个基本寻址结构 ( sockaddr )，并根据地址族的不同使用不同的覆盖层，例如IPv4 使用sockaddr_in。如果不将整个结构初始化为 0，则部分字段的内容可能不确定，这可能会导致随机的运行时故障。

                                                6. Unused struct members not cleared. (17–19) The entire addr structure should have been initialized to 0 before setting each address member. The Socket API uses one basic addressing structure (sockaddr) with different overlays, depending on the address family, for example, sockaddr_in for IPv4. Without initializing the entire structure to 0, parts of the fields may have indeterminate contents, which can yield random run-time failures.

                                                7. 地址/协议族不匹配。(17) addr.sin_family 字段被设置为 AF_NET，表示 Internet 地址族。它将与使用 UNIX 协议族创建的套接字 ( s_handle ) 一起使用，这不一致。传递给socket()函数的协议族类型应该是 PF_INET。

                                                8. Address/protocol family mismatch. (17) The addr.sin_family field was set to AF_NET, which designates the Internet addressing family. It will be used with a socket (s_handle) that was created with the UNIX protocol family, which is inconsistent. Instead, the protocol family type passed to the socket() function should have been PF_INET.

                                                9. 字节序错误。(18)赋值给addr.sin_port 的 值不是网络字节序；也就是说，程序员忘记使用htons() 函数将端口号从主机字节序转换为网络字节序。在采用小端字节序的计算机上运行时，这段代码不会报错；但是，客户端将无法通过预期的端口号连接到该服务。

                                                  如果这些网络寻址错误得到纠正，第 21-23 行实际上就能正常工作了！

                                                  第 25-27 行存在一组相互关联的错误。这些错误说明了在直接使用 C Socket API 进行编程时，在运行时之前定位错误是多么困难。

                                                10. Wrong byte order. (18) The value assigned to addr.sin_port is not in network byte order; that is, the programmer forgot to use htons() to convert the port number from host byte order into network byte order. When run on a computer with little-endian byte order, this code will execute without error; however, clients will be unable to connect to it at the expected port number.

                                                  If these network addressing mistakes were corrected, lines 21–23 would actually work!

                                                  There's an interrelated set of errors on lines 25–27. These exemplify how hard it is to locate errors before run-time when programming directly to the C Socket API.

                                                11. 缺少重要的 API 调用。(25)意外地省略了listen() 函数。必须在调用accept()之前调用此函数，才能将套接字句柄设置为所谓的“被动模式”。

                                                12. Missing an important API call. (25) The listen() function was omitted accidentally. This function must be called before accept() to set the socket handle into so-called "passive mode."

                                                13. API 调用使用了错误的套接字类型。(26)对s_handle调用了accept() 函数，这完全正确。但是， s_handle被创建为 SOCK_DGRAM 类型的套接字，而这种套接字类型不能与accept()一起使用。因此，第 13 行的原始socket()调用应该传递 SOCK_STREAM 标志。

                                                14. Wrong socket type for API call. (26) The accept() function was called for s_handle, which is exactly what should be done. The s_handle was created as a SOCK_DGRAM-type socket, however, which is an illegal socket type to use with accept(). The original socket() call on line 13 should therefore have been passed the SOCK_STREAM flag.

                                                15. 运算符优先级错误。(26–27) 还有一个与accept()调用相关的错误。按照目前的写法，如果accept()调用成功， n_handle将被设置为 1 ，如果调用失败，则设置为 0。如果此程序运行在 UNIX 系统上（并且其他错误都已修复），数据将分别写入stdout或stdin，而不是写入连接的套接字。本示例中的大多数错误都可以通过使用 ACE 包装器外观类来避免，但此错误仅仅是运算符优先级错误，无法通过使用 ACE 或任何其他库来避免。这是 C 和 C++ 程序中常见的陷阱 [ Koe88 ]，只有了解运算符优先级才能解决。要修复此问题，请在赋值表达式周围添加一对括号，如下所示：

                                                  if ((n_handle = accept (s_handle, (struct sockaddr *) &addr,
                        &addr_len)) != -1) {

                                                  更好的做法是，遵循我们在 ACE 中使用的约定，将对n_handle的赋值放在单独的一行：

                                                  n_handle = accept   (s_handle,
                     (struct sockaddr *) &addr, &addr_len);
if (n_handle != -1) (  {

                                                  这样，你就不必担心记住晦涩难懂的 C++ 运算符优先级规则了！

                                                  我们的echo_server()函数快要完成了，但还有一些错误尚未解决。

                                                16. Operator precedence error. (26–27) There's one further error related to the accept() call. As written, n_handle will be set to 1 if accept() succeeds and 0 if it fails. If this program runs on UNIX (and the other bugs are fixed), data will be written to either stdout or stdin, respectively, instead of the connected socket. Most of the errors in this example can be avoided by using the ACE wrapper facade classes, but this bug is simply an error in operator precedence, which can't be avoided by using ACE, or any other library. It's a common pitfall [Koe88] with C and C++ programs, remedied only by knowing your operator precedence. To fix this, add a set of parentheses around the assignment expression, as follows:

                                                  if ((n_handle = accept (s_handle, (struct sockaddr *) &addr,
                        &addr_len)) != -1) {

                                                  Better yet, follow the convention we use in ACE and put the assignment to n_handle on a separate line:

                                                  n_handle = accept   (s_handle,
                     (struct sockaddr *) &addr, &addr_len);
if (n_handle != -1) (  {

                                                  This way, you don't have to worry about remembering the arcane C++ operator precedence rules!

                                                  We're almost finished with our echo_server() function, but there are still several remaining errors.

                                                17. API 调用中使用了错误的句柄。(29)调用了read() 函数，试图从被动模式监听套接字s_handle接收最多sizeof buf字节的数据。我们应该对n_handle调用read()函数。由于套接字句柄是弱类型的，这个问题会表现为一个隐蔽的运行时错误，无法在编译时检测到。

                                                18. Wrong handle used in API call. (29) The read() function was called to receive up to sizeof buf bytes from s_handle, which is the passive-mode listening socket. We should have called read() on n_handle instead. This problem would have manifested itself as an obscure run-time error and could not have been detected at compile time since socket handles are weakly typed.

                                                19. 可能存在数据丢失。(30)未检查write() 的返回值是否已写入全部n 个字节（或任何字节），这可能是数据丢失的原因之一。由于套接字缓冲和流控制机制，向字节流模式套接字调用write()可能只会发送请求字节数的一部分，在这种情况下，剩余部分必须稍后发送。

                                                20. Possible data loss. (30) The return value from write() was not checked to see if all n bytes (or any bytes at all) were written, which is a possible source of data loss. Due to socket buffering and flow control, a write() to a bytestream mode socket may only send part of the requested number of bytes, in which case the rest must be sent later.

                                                经验丰富的网络程序员在经历过足够多的挫折后，会对上述大部分问题保持警惕。然而，一个更根本的设计问题是 Socket API 缺乏足够的类型安全和数据抽象。上面的源代码在某些操作系统平台上可以顺利编译，但并非所有平台都能编译。而且，它在任何平台上都无法正常运行！

                                                After being burned enough times, experienced network programmers will be alert for most of the problems outlined above. A more fundamental design problem, however, is the lack of adequate type safety and data abstraction in the Socket API. The source code above will compile cleanly on some OS platforms, but not all. It will not run correctly on any platform, however!

                                                多年来，程序员和库已经实现了许多变通方法来缓解这些问题。一种常见的解决方案是使用typedef来向程序员明确说明涉及的类型。虽然这些解决方案可以缓解一些可移植性问题，但它们并不能解决上述其他问题。特别是，IPC 寻址方案的多样性带来了比简单的typedef所能掩盖的更多差异。

                                                Over the years, programmers and libraries have implemented numerous workarounds to alleviate these problems. A common solution is to use typedefs to clarify to programmers what types are involved. Although these solutions can alleviate some portability concerns, they don't cover the other problems outlined above. In particular, the diversity of IPC addressing schemes presents more variation than a mere typedef can hide.

                                                2.3.2 过于复杂的 API

                                                2.3.2 Overly Complex APIs

                                                Socket API 提供了一个支持多种功能的单一接口：

                                                The Socket API provides a single interface that supports multiple:

                                                • 协议族，例如 TCP/IP、IPX/SPX、X.25、ISO OSI、ATM 和 UNIX 域套接字

                                                • Protocol families, such as TCP/IP, IPX/SPX, X.25, ISO OSI, ATM, and UNIX-domain sockets

                                                • 通信/连接角色，例如主动连接建立、被动连接建立和数据传输。

                                                • Communication/connection roles, such as active connection establishment versus passive connection establishment versus data transfer

                                                • 通信优化，例如 gather-write 函数writev()，它可以在单个系统函数中发送多个缓冲区，

                                                • Communication optimizations, such as the gather-write function, writev(), that sends multiple buffers in a single system function and

                                                • 针对不太常用的功能，例如广播、多播、异步 I/O 和紧急数据传输等，提供相应的选项。

                                                • Options for less common functionality, such as broadcasting, multicasting, asynchronous I/O, and urgent data delivery.

                                                Socket API 将所有这些功能整合到一个单独的 API 中，如第 2.2 节的表格所示。因此，它既复杂又难以掌握。但是，如果您仔细分析 Socket API，就会发现它的接口可以分解为以下几个维度：

                                                The Socket API combines all this functionality into a single API, listed in the tables in Section 2.2. The result is complex and hard to master. If you apply a careful analysis to the Socket API, however, you'll see that its interface can be decomposed into the following dimensions:

                                                1. 通信服务类型，例如流、数据报或连接数据报

                                                2. Type of communication service, such as streams versus datagrams versus connected datagrams

                                                3. 通信/连接角色；例如，客户端通常主动发起连接，而服务器通常被动接受连接。

                                                4. Communication/connection role; for example, clients often initiate connections actively, whereas servers often accept them passively

                                                5. 通信域，例如仅限本地主机与本地或远程主机

                                                6. Communication domain, such as local host only versus local or remote host

                                                图 2.1根据这三个维度对相关的 Socket 函数进行了聚类。然而，这种自然的聚类在 Socket API 中被掩盖了，因为所有这些功能都被塞进了一组函数中。此外，Socket API 无法在编译时针对不同的通信和连接角色（例如主动连接与被动连接建立，或数据报通信与流通信）强制执行函数的正确使用。

                                                Figure 2.1 clusters the related Socket functions according to these three dimensions. This natural clustering is obscured in the Socket API, however, because all this functionality is crammed into a single set of functions. Moreover, the Socket API can't enforce the correct use of its functions at compile time for different communication and connection roles, such as active versus passive connection establishment or datagram versus stream communication.

                                                图 2.1. 插座尺寸分类

                                                2.3.3 非可移植和非统一 API

                                                2.3.3 Nonportable and Nonuniform APIs

                                                尽管 Socket API 应用广泛，但它并不具备可移植性。以下是一些跨平台差异之处：

                                                Despite its ubiquity, the Socket API is not portable. The following are some areas of divergence across platforms:

                                                • 函数名称——第 37 页echo_server()函数中的 read ()、write()和close()函数并非适用于所有操作系统平台。例如，Windows 定义了一组不同的函数（ReadFile()、writeFile()和closesocket()）来实现这些功能。

                                                • Function names— The read(), write(), and close() functions in the echo_server() function on page 37 are not portable to all OS platforms. For example, Windows defines a different set of functions (ReadFile(), writeFile(), and closesocket()) that provide these behaviors.

                                                • 函数语义—— 某些函数在不同平台上的行为有所不同。例如，在 UNIX 和 Win32 系统上，`accept()`函数可以接受客户端地址和客户端长度字段为空指针的情况。但在某些实时平台（例如 VxWorks）上，向`accept()`函数传递空指针可能会导致机器崩溃。

                                                • Function semantics— Certain functions behave differently on different platforms. For example, on UNIX and Win32 the accept() function can be passed NULL pointers for the client address and client length field. On certain real-time platforms, such as VxWorks, passing NULL pointers to accept() can crash the machine.

                                                • 套接字句柄类型—— 不同的平台使用不同的套接字句柄表示方法。例如，在 UNIX 平台上，套接字句柄是整数，而在 Win32 平台上，它们实际上是用指针实现的。

                                                • Socket handle types— Different platforms use different representations for socket handles. For example, on UNIX platforms socket handles are integers, whereas on Win32 they are actually implemented as pointers.

                                                • 头文件—— 不同的操作系统/编译器平台对包含 Socket API 函数原型的头文件使用不同的名称。

                                                • Header files— Different OS/compiler platforms use different names for header files containing Socket API function prototypes.

                                                Socket API 的另一个问题是其数十个函数缺乏统一的命名约定，这使得确定 API 的作用域变得困难。例如，socket()、bind()、accept()和connect()函数是否属于同一个 API 并不显而易见。其他网络 API 通过在每个函数前添加一个通用前缀来解决这个问题。例如，TL​​I API 中的每个函数前都添加了t_ [ Rag93 ]。

                                                Another problem with the Socket API is that its several dozen functions lack a uniform naming convention, which makes it hard to determine the scope of the API. For example, it isn't immediately obvious that socket(), bind(), accept(), and connect() functions belong to the same API. Other networking APIs address this problem by prepending a common prefix before each function. For example, a t_ is prepended before each function in the TLI API [Rag93].

                                                  2.4 总结

                                                  2.4 Summary

                                                  做好任何工作的前提是懂得如何有效使用工具。许多有用的工具如果使用不当也会造成伤害。虽然没有人真的被UNIX管道或套接字砸到过脑袋，但浪费在不必要的开发和调试上的时间和资源无疑会造成巨大的经济损失，导致过早脱发，并影响许多人的社交生活。此外，与扳手和锤子等工具不同，在一个平台上学习使用底层工具可能对将网络应用程序移植到新平台毫无帮助。

                                                  A prerequisite to performing any job well is knowing how to use your tools effectively. Many useful tools can hurt you if misused. Although no one's been hit over the head by a UNIX pipe or socket, the time and resources wasted on unnecessary development and debugging has certainly cost lots of money, caused premature hair loss, and put a damper on many social lives. Moreover, unlike tools such as wrenches and hammers, learning to use low-level tools on one platform may not help when you port your networked applications to a new platform.

                                                  构建联网应用程序的软件开发人员必须掌握进程间通信 (IPC) 的相关概念和工具。本章介绍了 Socket API，讨论了这一广泛应用的 API 提供的各种功能，以及它所带来的一些潜在复杂性。一个简短的程序演示了由这些复杂性导致的常见错误。下一章将展示 ACE 如何应用 C++ 特性和 Wrapper Facade [ SSRB00 ] 模式来解决这些问题。

                                                  Software developers building networked applications must master the concepts and tools associated with interprocess communication (IPC). This chapter presented the Socket API. It discussed the range of capabilities this ubiquitous API provides, as well as its associated set of accidental complexities. One short program illustrated the range of errors commonly made as a result of these complexities. The next chapter shows how ACE applies C++ features and the Wrapper Facade [SSRB00] pattern to resolve them.

                                                    第三章 ACE插座外壳

                                                    Chapter 3. The ACE Socket Wrapper Facades

                                                    章节概要

                                                    Chapter Synopsis

                                                    本章介绍 ACE 提供的模式和包装外观类，以解决第 2 章讨论的 Socket API 中意外出现的复杂性问题。我们将描述使用包装外观模式的 ACE 类，这些类将面向连接的 Socket API 功能封装在可移植的 C++ 类中。此外，我们还将通过简短易懂的 Web 服务器和客户端示例来说明这些类的用法，然后再在第 4 章中展示更大型的网络日志服务。

                                                    This chapter presents the patterns and wrapper facade classes that ACE provides to resolve the accidental complexity problems with the Socket API discussed in Chapter 2. We describe the ACE classes that use the Wrapper Facade pattern to encapsulate connection-oriented Socket API functionality in portable C++ classes. We also illustrate the use of these classes using brief, familiar Web server and client examples before showing the larger networked logging service in Chapter 4.

                                                      3.1 概述

                                                      3.1 Overview

                                                      ACE 定义了一组 C++ 类，用于解决第 2.3 节中描述的 Socket API 的局限性。这些类是根据包装外观模式 [ SSRB00 ] 设计的。[1]因此，它们将现有非面向对象 API 提供的功能和数据封装到更简洁、健壮、可移植、易于维护且内聚的面向对象类接口中。本章介绍的 ACE Socket 包装外观类包括：

                                                      ACE defines a set of C++ classes that address the limitations with the Socket API described in Section 2.3. These classes are designed in accordance with the Wrapper Facade design pattern [SSRB00].[1] They therefore encapsulate the functions and data provided by existing non-object-oriented APIs within more concise, robust, portable, maintainable, and cohesive object-oriented class interfaces. The ACE Socket wrapper facade classes presented in this chapter include:

                                                      [1]在本书的其余部分中，我们使用术语ACE wrapper facade来表示使用 Wrapper Facade 模式设计的 ACE 类。

                                                      [1] In the rest of this book, we use the term ACE wrapper facade to indicate an ACE class designed using the Wrapper Facade pattern.

                                                      ACE 级 描述
                                                      ACE_Addr ACE网络寻址层次结构的根。
                                                      ACE_INET_Addr 封装互联网域名地址族。
                                                      ACE_IPC_SAP ACE IPC 封装外观层次结构的根。
                                                      ACE_SOCK ACE Socket 包装器外观层次结构的根。
                                                      ACE_SOCK_连接器 一个工厂，它连接到对等接收器，然后在ACE_SOCK_Stream对象中初始化一个新的通信端点。
                                                      ACE_SOCK_IO ACE_SOCK_Stream 封装数据模式套接字支持的数据传输机制。
                                                      ACE_SOCK_Acceptor 响应来自对等连接器的连接请求， 在ACE_SOCK_Stream对象中初始化一个新的通信端点的工厂。

                                                      图 3.1展示了这些类之间的关键关系。这些 ACE Socket 包装器外观提供了以下优势：

                                                      Figure 3.1 illustrates the key relationship between these classes. These ACE Socket wrapper facades provide the following benefits:

                                                      • 通过快速检测许多细微的应用程序类型错误来增强类型安全性；例如，被动和主动连接建立工厂没有提供发送或接收数据的方法，因此类型错误是在编译时而不是运行时捕获的。

                                                      • Enhance type-safety by detecting many subtle application type errors quickly; for example, the passive and active connection establishment factories don't provide methods for sending or receiving data, so type errors are caught at compile time rather than at run time.

                                                      • 通过平台无关的 C++ 类确保可移植性。

                                                      • Ensure portability via platform-independent C++ classes.

                                                      • 通过减少应用程序代码量和用于底层网络编程细节的开发工作量，简化常见用例，从而使开发人员能够专注于更高层次的、以应用程序为中心的问题。

                                                      • Simplify common use cases by reducing the amount of application code and development effort expended on lower-level network programming details, which frees developers to focus on higher-level, application-centric concerns.

                                                      本章剩余部分将重点讨论 ACE 面向连接的互联网域包装器外观，因为它们是应用最广泛的 ACE 进程间通信 (IPC) 机制。这些类按照图 3.1所示的层次结构排列。为了避免代码重复，常用方法和状态被提取到抽象类中，这些抽象类不会被直接实例化。子类随后添加相应的方法并强制执行正确的使用模式。例如，面向连接的网络应用程序的典型特征是客户端和服务器之间的连接角色不对称。如图 3.3所示，服务器被动地监听客户端主动发起的连接[ SSRB00 ] 。即使在点对点应用程序中，应用程序同时扮演客户端和服务器的角色，连接也必须由其中一个对等方主动发起，并由另一个对等方被动接受。

                                                      The remainder of our discussion in this chapter focuses on the ACE connection-oriented Internet-domain wrapper facades because they're the most widely used ACE IPC mechanism. The classes are arranged in the hierarchy shown in Figure 3.1. To avoid duplication of code, common methods and state are factored into abstract classes, which aren't instantiated directly. Subclasses then add appropriate methods and enforce proper usage patterns. For example, connection-oriented networked applications are typified by asymmetric connection roles between clients and servers. Servers listen passively for clients to initiate connections actively [SSRB00], as shown in Figure 3.3. Even in peer-to-peer applications, in which applications play the role of both client and server, connections must be initiated actively by one of the peers and accepted passively by the other.

                                                      图 3.3. ACE Socket Wrapper Facade 中的角色

                                                      C Socket API 中的函数可以根据它们在面向连接的协议（例如 TCP）中扮演的三种不同角色来区分：

                                                      The functions in the C Socket API can be distinguished by the three different roles they play for connection-oriented protocols, such as TCP:

                                                      1. 主动连接角色（连接器）由发起与远程对等节点连接的对等应用程序扮演。

                                                      2. The active connection role (connector) is played by a peer application that initiates a connection to a remote peer

                                                      3. 被动连接角色（接受者）由接受来自远程对等节点的连接请求的对等应用程序扮演。

                                                      4. The passive connection role (acceptor) is played by a peer application that accepts a connection from a remote peer and

                                                      5. 通信角色（流）由对等应用程序在连接后交换数据。

                                                      6. The communication role (stream) is played by both peer applications to exchange data after they are connected.

                                                      本章阐述了 ACE Socket 类的功能，并解释了它们如何共同实现上述连接和通信功能。请注意侧边栏 4中关于本书中 UML 图和 C++ 代码的说明。

                                                      This chapter motivates and describes the capabilities of the ACE Socket classes that collectively provide the connection and communication roles outlined above. Keep in mind the points noted in Sidebar 4 regarding UML diagrams and C++ code in this book.

                                                        3.2 ACE_Addr 和 ACE_INET_Addr 类

                                                        3.2 The ACE_Addr and ACE_INET_Addr Classes

                                                        动机

                                                        Motivation

                                                        网络寻址是 Socket API 的一个薄弱环节。Socket API 的网络寻址机制使用 C 结构体和类型转换，这不仅繁琐，而且容易出错。地址族是通用寻址结构体 ` sockaddr`的第一个成员。其他地址结构体，例如用于 Internet 域地址的`sockaddr_in`和用于 UNIX 域地址的`sockaddr_un`，也都有地址族成员，其位置和大小与 ` sockaddr` 结构体相同。应用程序通过以下方式使用这些特定的地址族结构体：

                                                        Network addressing is a trouble spot in the Socket API. Socket API network addressing mechanisms use C structures and typecasts, which are tedious and error-prone to program. The address family is the first member of the generic addressing structure, sockaddr. Other address structures, such as sockaddr_in for Internet-domain addresses and sockaddr_un for UNIX-domain addresses, also have an address family member that occupies the same position and size as in the sockaddr struct. Applications use these specific address family structures by

                                                        1. 为所需的地址族分配一个结构体，例如struct sockaddr_in

                                                        2. Allocating a structure for the desired address family, for example, struct sockaddr_in

                                                        3. 填写地址家族成员信息，以向 Socket API 指示其真实类型。

                                                        4. Filling in the address family member to indicate to the Socket API just what type it really is

                                                        5. 提供地址，例如 IP 地址和端口号，以及

                                                        6. Supplying addresses, such as IP and port numbers, and

                                                        7. 将类型强制转换为sockaddr *以传递给 Socket API 函数。

                                                        8. Casting the type to sockaddr * to pass to Socket API functions.

                                                        The ACE_Addr class also defines a sap_any static data member that both client and server applications can use as a "wildcard" if they don't care what address they're assigned. For example,

                                                        • 客户端应用程序可以使用sap_any创建临时的操作系统分配的端口号，称为“临时端口”，这些端口号在连接关闭后由操作系统回收。

                                                        • Server applications can use sap_any to select their port numbers, as long as they export the assigned numbers to clients via some type of location discovery mechanism, such as a naming or trading service.

There are many other overloaded constructors and set() methods in ACE _INET_Addr that can be used to initialize Internet-domain network address objects using various combinations of host names, IP addresses, and/or TCP/UDP port names and numbers.

                                                          3.3 ACE_IPC_SAP 类

                                                          3.3 The ACE_IPC_SAP Class

                                                          动机

                                                          Motivation

                                                          第 37 页的2.3.1 节概述了原生操作系统 IPC API 中使用的 I/O 句柄所带来的可移植性问题。ACE 通过以下方式解决 I/O 句柄的可移植性问题：

                                                          Section 2.3.1 on page 37 outlined the portability problems incurred by the I/O handles used in native OS IPC APIs. ACE addresses I/O handle portability by:

                                                          • 定义ACE_HANDLE类型定义，该定义指定每个操作系统平台上的适当句柄类型；

                                                          • Defining the ACE_HANDLE type definition, which designates the appropriate type of handle on each OS platform and

                                                          • 定义一个可移植的ACE_INVALID_HANDLE宏，应用程序可以使用它来测试错误。

                                                          • Defining a portable ACE_INVALID_HANDLE macro that applications can use to test for errors

                                                          这些简单的 ACE 定义的类型和值抽象有助于增强应用程序的可移植性。

                                                          These simple ACE-defined type and value abstractions help to enhance application portability.

                                                          然而，熟悉面向对象编程的软件开发人员会注意到，句柄（即使是可移植的句柄）在面向对象的网络应用程序中并不是合适的抽象级别。相反，更合适的编程抽象应该是某种 I/O 句柄类，这就是 ACE 提供ACE_IPC_SAP类的原因。[2]

                                                          Object-savvy software developers will note, however, that a handle—even a portable one—is not the appropriate level of abstraction in an object-oriented networked application. Instead, a more appropriate programming abstraction would be some type of I/O handle class, which is why ACE provides the ACE_IPC_SAP class.[2]

                                                          [2]在网络标准文献[ Bla91 ]中，缩写“SAP”代表“服务接入点”。

                                                          [2] In the networking standards literature [Bla91], the acronym "SAP" stands for "service access point."

                                                          等级能力

                                                          Class Capabilities

                                                          ACE_IPC_SAP类是 ACE IPC 包装器外观层级结构的根类，并为其他 ACE 包装器外观提供基本的 I/O 句柄操作功能。其接口如图 3.5所示（以及3.4 节中描述的ACE SOCK类），其关键方法如下表所示：

                                                          The ACE_IPC_SAP class is the root of the ACE hierarchy of IPC wrapper facades and provides basic I/O handle manipulation capabilities to other ACE wrapper facades. Its interface is shown in Figure 3.5 (along with the ACE SOCK class described in Section 3.4) and its key methods are shown in the table below:

                                                          方法 描述 
                                                          enable()
disable()
                                                          		启用或禁用各种 I/O 句柄选项，例如启用/禁用非阻塞 I/O。 
                                                          set_handle()
get_handle()
                                                          		设置和获取底层 I/O 句柄。

                                                          图 3.5. ACE_IPC_SAP和ACE_SOCK类图

                                                          尽管ACE_IPC_SAP定义了一些有用的方法和数据，但它并非供应用程序直接使用。相反，它被子类使用，例如用于文件、STREAM 管道、命名管道和 System V 传输层接口 (TLI) 的 ACE 包装器外观。为了强制执行此设计约束并防止ACE_IPC_SAP被直接实例化，我们将ACE_IPC_SAP定义为抽象类，并在类的受保护部分声明其构造函数。我们使用这种约定而不是定义纯虚方法，是为了避免在每个子类实例中使用虚指针。

                                                          Although ACE_IPC_SAP defines useful methods and data, it's not intended for direct use by applications. Instead, it's used by subclasses, such as the ACE wrapper facades for files, STREAM pipes, Named Pipes, and the System V Transport Layer Interface (TLI). To enforce this design constraint and to prevent ACE_IPC_SAP from being instantiated directly, we make ACE_IPC_SAP an abstract class by declaring its constructor in the protected part of the class. We use this convention instead of defining a pure virtual method to eliminate the need for a virtual pointer in each subclass instance.

                                                            3.4 ACE_SOCK 类

                                                            3.4 The ACE_SOCK Class

                                                            动机

                                                            Motivation

                                                            如第 2.3 节所述，Socket API 中意外复杂性的一个关键原因在于编译器无法在编译过程中检测到套接字句柄的误用。第 3.3 节中描述的ACE_IPC_SAP类是解决此问题的第一步。本章的其余部分将介绍其他 ACE Socket 包装器外观，以解决第 2.3 节中阐述的其他问题。我们首先沿着图 3.1中的继承层次结构向下分析，并讨论每个层次的合理行为，从ACE_SOCK类开始。

                                                            As discussed in Section 2.3, a key cause of accidental complexity in the Socket API stems from the inability of compilers to detect the misuse of socket handles during compilation. The ACE_IPC_SAP class described in Section 3.3 is the first step toward resolving this problem. The remainder of this chapter describes other ACE Socket wrapper facades that address the other problems illustrated in Section 2.3. We start by moving down the inheritance hierarchy in Figure 3.1 and discussing behavior that makes sense at each level, beginning with the ACE_SOCK class.

                                                            等级能力
