                                                            Class Capabilities

                                                            ACE_SOCK类是 ACE Socket 包装器外观层次结构的根类。除了导出从ACE_IPC_SAP 继承的方法之外，ACE_SOCK还提供其他 ACE Socket 包装器外观（包括本章后面讨论的类）通用的功能。这些功能包括：

                                                            The ACE_SOCK class is the root of the ACE Socket wrapper facade hierarchy. In addition to exporting the methods inherited from ACE_IPC_SAP, ACE_SOCK provides capabilities that are common to other ACE Socket wrapper facades, including the classes discussed later in this chapter. These capabilities include

                                                            • 创建和销毁套接字句柄

                                                            • Creating and destroying socket handles

                                                            • 获取本地和远程对等方的网络地址以及

                                                            • Obtaining the network addresses of local and remote peers and

                                                            • 设置和获取套接字选项，例如套接字队列大小、启用广播/组播通信以及禁用 Nagle 算法（详见第 64 页侧边栏 6）。

                                                            • Setting and getting socket options, such as socket queue sizes, enabling broadcast/multicast communication, and disabling Nagle's algorithm (described in Sidebar 6 on page 64)

                                                            ACE_SOCK的接口及其与ACE_IPC_SAP基类的关系如图 3.5所示，其关键方法如下表所示：

                                                            The interface of ACE_SOCK and its relationship to the ACE_IPC_SAP base class is shown in Figure 3.5 and its key methods are shown in the following table:

                                                            方法 描述 
                                                            open()
close()
                                                            		创建和销毁通信套接字端点。 
                                                            get_local_addr()
get_remote_addr()
                                                            		分别返回本地对等方和远程对等方的地址。 
                                                            set_option()
get_option()
                                                            		设置和获取套接字选项。

                                                            为防止意外误用，ACE_SOCK被定义为抽象类；也就是说，它的构造函数声明在类的受保护访问控制部分。因此，与ACE_IPC_SAP一样， ACE_SOCK的对象不能直接实例化，因为它们只能由子类访问，例如第 3.5 节到第 3.7 节中描述的面向连接的包装器外观。

                                                            To prevent accidental misuse, ACE_SOCK is defined as an abstract class; that is, its constructor is declared in the protected access control section of the class. As with ACE_IPC_SAP therefore, objects of ACE_SOCK can't be instantiated directly since they are accessible only to subclasses, such as the connection-oriented wrapper facades described in Section 3.5 through Section 3.7.

                                                            由于ACE_SOCK类在其析构函数中不会关闭套接字句柄，因此它提供了一个close()方法。如第 255 页A.6.1 节所述，这种设计是有意为之，旨在防止在按值传递ACE_SOCK_Stream或将其复制到不同对象时发生错误。经验丰富的 ACE 开发人员会使用更高级别的类来自动关闭底层套接字句柄。例如，从第 86 页开始的4.4.2 节中描述的Logging_Handler类会在更高级别的处理程序对象关闭时关闭其套接字。 [ SH ]中讨论的ACE_Svc_Handler类也会自动关闭底层套接字句柄。

                                                            The ACE_SOCK class provides a close() method since it doesn't close the socket handle in its destructor. As described in Section A.6.1 on page 255, this design is intentional and prevents errors from occurring when an ACE_SOCK_Stream is passed by value or copied to different objects. Experienced ACE developers use higher-level classes to close the underlying socket handle automatically. For example, the Logging_Handler class described in Section 4.4.2 starting on page 86 closes its socket when the higher-level handler object is closed. The ACE_Svc_Handler class discussed in [SH] also closes the underlying socket handle automatically.

                                                              3.5 ACE_SOCK_Connector 类

                                                              3.5 The ACE_SOCK_Connector Class

                                                              动机

                                                              Motivation

                                                              尽管面向连接的协议有三种不同的角色，但 Socket API 仅支持以下两种套接字模式：

                                                              Although there are three distinct roles for connection-oriented protocols, the Socket API only supports the following two socket modes:

                                                              1. 对等应用程序在其通信角色中使用数据模式套接字，以便在连接的对等方之间交换数据。

                                                              2. A data-mode socket is used by peer applications in their communication roles to exchange data between connected peers and

                                                              3. 被动模式套接字是面向应用程序的被动连接方式，用于返回已连接的数据模式套接字的句柄。

                                                              4. A passive-mode socket is a factory used by a peer application in its passive connection role to return a handle to a connected data-mode socket.

                                                              然而，没有哪种套接字模式专门负责建立连接。实际上，数据模式套接字也按照惯例承担着连接的角色。因此，应用程序不应该在connect()函数成功建立连接之前，对数据模式套接字调用send()或recv()函数。

                                                              No socket mode focuses exclusively on the active connection role, however. Instead, a data-mode socket also plays this role by convention. An application is therefore not supposed to call send() or recv() on a data-mode socket until after the connect() function establishes a connection successfully.

                                                              Socket API 中连接角色和套接字模式之间的不对称性令人困惑且容易出错。例如，应用程序可能会在连接尚未建立之前，意外地对数据模式套接字句柄调用 ` recv()`或`send()`方法。不幸的是，由于套接字句柄是弱类型的，因此这个问题只能在运行时才能检测到。数据模式套接字的双重角色仅通过编程约定来强制执行，而不是通过编译器的类型检查功能。因此，ACE 定义了 ` ACE_SOCK_Connector`类，该类仅公开用于主动建立连接的方法，从而防止意外误用。

                                                              The asymmetry in the Socket API between the connection roles and the socket modes is confusing and error-prone. For example, an application may accidentally call recv() or send() on a data-mode socket handle before it's connected. Unfortunately, this problem can't be detected until run time since socket handles are weakly-typed and thus the dual role of data-mode sockets is only enforced via programming convention, rather than via the compiler's type-checking features. ACE therefore defines the ACE_SOCK_Connector class, which prevents accidental misuse by only exposing methods for actively establishing connections.

                                                              等级能力

                                                              Class Capabilities

                                                              ACE_SOCK_Connector类是一个工厂类，用于主动建立新的通信端点。它提供以下功能：

                                                              The ACE_SOCK_Connector class is a factory that establishes a new end-point of communication actively. It provides the following capabilities:

                                                              • 它与对等接收器建立连接，然后在连接建立后初始化ACE_SOCK_Stream对象。

                                                              • It initiates a connection with a peer acceptor and then initializes an ACE_SOCK_Stream object after the connection is established.

                                                              • 连接可以以阻塞式、非阻塞式或定时式的方式发起，

                                                              • Connections can be initiated in either a blocking, nonblocking, or timed manner and

                                                              • C++ 特性用于支持通用编程技术，从而能够通过 C++ 参数化类型全面替换功能，如第 57 页的侧边栏 5中所述。

                                                              • C++ traits are used to support generic programming techniques that enable the wholesale replacement of functionality via C++ parameterized types, as described in Sidebar 5 on page 57.

                                                              侧边栏 5：使用 Traits 实现 ACE Socket Wrapper Facades

                                                              Sidebar 5: Using Traits for ACE Socket Wrapper Facades

                                                              为了简化 IPC 类及其相关寻址类的全面替换，ACE Socket 包装器外观定义了特性（trait）。特性是 C++ 泛型编程 [Ale01] 的一种惯用法，可用于定义和组合一组特征，从而改变模板类的行为 [ Jos99 ]。ACE Socket 包装器外观使用特性来定义以下类关联：

                                                              To simplify the wholesale replacement of IPC classes and their associated addressing classes, the ACE Socket wrapper facades define traits. Traits are a C++ generic programming [Ale01] idiom that can be used to define and combine a set of characteristics to alter the behavior(s) of a template class [Jos99]. The ACE Socket wrapper facades use traits to define the following class associations:

                                                              • PEER_ADDR — 此特性定义了与 ACE Socket 包装器外观类关联的ACE_INET_Addr寻址类，

                                                              • PEER _ADDR— This trait defines the ACE_INET_Addr addressing class that's associated with ACE Socket wrapper facade classes and

                                                              • PEER _STREAM — 此特性定义了与ACE_SOCK_Acceptor和ACE_SOCK_Connector工厂关联的ACE_SOCK_Stream数据传输类。

                                                              • PEER _STREAM— This trait defines the ACE_SOCK_Stream data transfer class that's associated with the ACE_SOCK_Acceptor and ACE_ SOCK_Connector factories.

                                                              ACE 将这些特性实现为 C++ 类型定义，这些定义在本章的 UML 图中以注释的形式显示。第 253 页的A.5.3 节阐述了如何使用这些特性来编写简洁的通用函数和类。我们将在 (SH) 中探讨 ACE 特性和特性类的其他用途。

                                                              ACE implements these traits as C++ type definitions, which are shown as notes in the UML figures in this chapter. Section A.5.3, page 253, illustrates how to use these traits to write concise generic functions and classes. We explore other uses of ACE traits and traits classes in (SH).

                                                              ACE_SOCK_Connector的接口如图 3.6所示。ACE_SOCK_Connector 中的两个关键方法概述如下表所示：

                                                              The interface of ACE_SOCK_Connector is shown in Figure 3.6. The two key methods in ACE_SOCK_Connector are outlined in the following table:

                                                              方法 描述
                                                              连接（） 使用阻塞模式、非阻塞模式或定时模式，主动连接特定网络地址的 ACE_SOCK_Stream 。
                                                              完全的（） 尝试完成非阻塞连接并初始化ACE_SOCK_Stream。

                                                              图 3.6. ACE_SOCK_Connector类图

                                                              ACE_SOCK_Connector支持阻塞连接、非阻塞连接和定时连接，其中阻塞连接为默认连接方式。非阻塞连接和定时连接适用于在高延迟链路上建立连接、使用单线程应用程序或初始化多个可以按任意顺序连接的对等节点的情况。可以向connect()方法传递三种类型的ACE_Time_Value值来控制其行为：

                                                              ACE_SOCK_Connector supports blocking, nonblocking, and timed connections, where blocking is the default. Nonblocking and timed connections are useful when establishing connections over high-latency links, using single-threaded applications, or initializing many peers that can be connected in an arbitrary order. Three types of ACE_Time_Value values can be passed to the connect() method to control its behavior:

                                                              价值 行为
                                                              空 ACE_Time_Value指针 表示connect()应该无限期地等待，即阻塞直到连接建立或操作系统认为服务器主机不可达。
                                                              指向非空ACE_Time_Value 的指针，其sec()和usec()方法均返回 0。 表示connect()应该执行非阻塞连接，也就是说，如果连接没有立即建立，则返回 -1 并将errno设置为 EWOULDBLOCK。
                                                              一个非空的ACE Time_Value指针，其sec()或usec()方法返回值大于 0。 表示connect()应该只等待一段相对的时间来建立连接，如果到那时仍然无法建立连接， 则返回 -1，并将errno设置为 ETIME。

                                                              ACE_SOCK_Connector的连接超时支持在实践中特别有用，因为 Socket API 实现连接超时的方式在不同的操作系统平台上差异很大。

                                                              The ACE_SOCK_Connector's connection time-out support is particularly useful in practice since the ways in which Socket APIs implement connection time-outs differs widely across OS platforms.

                                                              由于底层套接字 API 不使用工厂套接字来连接数据模式套接字，因此ACE_SOCK_Connector类无需继承3.4 节第54 页所述的ACE_SOCK类。因此，它没有自己的套接字句柄。ACE_SOCK_Connector会从传递给其connect()方法的ACE_SOCK_Stream中借用句柄，并使用该句柄主动建立连接。因此，ACE_SOCK_Connector 实例不存储任何状态，所以可以在多线程程序中以可重入的方式使用，而无需额外的锁。

                                                              Since the underlying socket API doesn't use a factory socket to connect data-mode sockets, the ACE_SOCK_Connector class needn't inherit from the ACE_SOCK class described on page 54 in Section 3.4. It therefore doesn't have its own socket handle. Instead, an ACE_SOCK_Connector borrows the handle from the ACE_SOCK_Stream passed to its connect() method and uses it to establish the connection actively. As a result, instances of ACE_SOCK_Connector don't store any state, so they can be used reentrantly in multithreaded programs without the need for additional locks.

                                                              例子

                                                              Example

                                                              第 19 页的侧边栏 2介绍了如何构建 ACE 库，以便您可以尝试本书中的示例。我们的第一个示例演示了如何使用ACE_SOCK_Connector将客户端应用程序连接到 Web 服务器。首先，我们需要包含必要的 ACE Socket 包装器头文件：

                                                              Sidebar 2 on page 19 describes how to build the ACE library so that you can experiment with the examples we show in the book. Our first example illustrates how the ACE_SOCK_Connector can be used to connect a client application to a Web server. We start by including the necessary ACE Socket wrapper header files:

                                                              #include "ace/INET_Addr.h"
#include "ace/SOCK_Connector.h"
#include "ace/SOCK_Stream.h"

                                                              接下来，我们定义main()函数，该函数会与监听 80 端口的 Web 服务器建立连接。这是支持超文本传输​​协议 (HTTP) 的 Web 服务器使用的标准端口号 [ Ste96 ]。HTTP 是一种基于 TCP 的简单协议，客户端使用它从 Web 服务器下载内容。

                                                              We then define the main() function, which establishes a connection with a Web server listening at port 80. This is the standard port number used by Web servers that support the Hypertext Transport Protocol (HTTP) [Ste96]. HTTP is a simple protocol layered on top of TCP and used by clients to download content from a Web server.

                                                              int main (int argc, char *argv[])
{
  const char *pathname =
    argc > 1 ? argv[1] : "index.html";
  const char *server_hostname =
    argc > 2 ? argv[2] . "ace.ece.uci.edu";

  ACE_SOCK_Connector  connector;
  ACE_SOCK_Stream peer;
  ACE _INET_Addr peer_addr;

  if (peer_addr.set (80, server_hostname) == -1)
    return 1;
  else if (connector.connect (peer, peer_addr) == -1)
    return 1;
  // ...

                                                              在首先描述ACE_SOCK_Stream数据传输类的功能之后，我们将在第 3.5 节的第 63 页完成此示例的其余部分。

                                                              We complete the rest of this example on page 63 in Section 3.5 after first describing the capabilities of the ACE_SOCK_Stream data transfer class.

                                                              请注意，上面的`connector.connect()`调用是同步的；也就是说，它会阻塞，直到连接建立或连接请求失败。如第 58 页的表格所示，ACE Socket 包装器外观可以轻松地实现非阻塞或定时连接，并且具有良好的可移植性。例如，以下代码演示了如何修改客户端应用程序以执行与 Web 服务器的非阻塞 ` connect()`操作：

                                                              Note that the connector.connect() call above is synchronous; that is, it will block until either the connection is established or connect request fails. As shown in the table on page 58, the ACE Socket wrapper facades make it easy to perform nonblocking or timed connections portably. For example, the following code illustrates how to modify our client application to perform a nonblocking connect() to a Web server:

                                                              // Designate a nonblocking connect.
if (connector.connect (peer,
                       peer_addr,
                       &ACE_Time_Value::zero) == -1) {
  if (errno == EWOULDBLOCK) {
    // Do some other work ...

    // Now, try to complete the connection establishment,
    // but don't block if it isn't complete yet.
    if (connector.complete (peer,
                            0,
                            &ACE_Time_Value::zero)   ==   -1)
      // ...

                                                              同样，可以按如下方式执行定时connect() ：

                                                              Likewise, a timed connect() can be performed as follows:

                                                              ACE_Time_Value timeout (10); // Set time-out to 10 seconds

if (connector.connect (peer, peer, addr, &timeout) == -1) {
  if (errno == ETIME)
    // Time-out, do something else...
}

                                                                3.6 ACE_SOCK_IO 和 ACE_SOCK_Stream 类

                                                                3.6 The ACE_SOCK_IO and ACE_SOCK_Stream Classes

                                                                动机

                                                                Motivation

                                                                第 2.3 节指出的一个意外复杂性在于无法在编译时检测套接字误用。如第 3.1 节所述，连接管理涉及三种角色：主动连接角色、被动连接角色和通信角色。然而，套接字 API 仅定义了两种套接字模式：数据模式和被动模式。因此，开发人员可能会以编译时无法检测到的方式误用套接字。ACE_SOCK_Connector类迈出了解决这一复杂性的第一步；ACE_SOCK_Stream类则更进一步。ACE_SOCK_Stream定义了一个数据模式的“仅传输”对象。ACE_SOCK_Stream对象只能用于数据传输，否则就违反了其接口。

                                                                An area of accidental complexity identified in Section 2.3 is the inability to detect socket misuse at compile-time. As described in Section 3.1, connection management involves three roles: active connection role, passive connection role, and communication role. The Socket API, however, defines only two socket modes: data mode and passive mode. Developers can therefore misuse sockets in ways that can't be detected during compilation. The ACE_SOCK_Connector class took the first step toward resolving this area of complexity; the ACE_SOCK_Stream class takes the next step. ACE_SOCK_Stream defines a data-mode "transfer-only" object. An ACE_SOCK_Stream object can't be used in any role other than data transfer without intentionally violating its interface.

                                                                等级能力

                                                                Class Capabilities

                                                                ACE_SOCK_Stream类封装了数据模式套接字支持的数据传输机制。此类提供以下功能：

                                                                The ACE_SOCK_Stream class encapsulates the data transfer mechanisms supported by data-mode sockets. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                • 支持发送和接收最多n字节或正好n字节的数据。

                                                                • Support for sending and receiving up to n bytes or exactly n bytes

                                                                • 支持“分散读取”操作，这种操作会填充多个由调用者提供的缓冲区，而不是单个连续缓冲区。

                                                                • Support for "scatter-read" operations, which populate multiple caller-supplied buffers instead of a single contiguous buffer

                                                                • 支持“收集-写入”操作，该操作可在单个操作中传输多个不连续数据缓冲区的内容。

                                                                • Support for "gather-write" operations, which transmit the contents of multiple noncontiguous data buffers in a single operation

                                                                • 支持阻塞式、非阻塞式和定时 I/O 操作

                                                                • Support for blocking, nonblocking, and timed I/O operations and

                                                                • 支持通用编程技术 [Ale0l]，该技术允许通过 C++ 参数化类型全面替换功能，如第 57 页侧边栏 5所述。

                                                                • Support for generic programming techniques [Ale0l] that enable the wholesale replacement of functionality via C++ parameterized types, as described in Sidebar 5 on page 57

                                                                ACE_SOCK_Stream实例由ACE_SOCK_Acceptor或ACE_SOCK_Connector工厂初始化。ACE_SOCK_Stream和ACE_SOCK_IO类的接口如图 3.7（第 61 页）所示。ACE_SOCK_Stream派生自ACE_SOCK_IO ，而 ACE_SOCK_IO 又派生自ACE_SOCK，并定义了 ACE UDP 封装器外观可重用的基本数据传输方法。

                                                                ACE_SOCK_Stream instances are initialized by the ACE_SOCK_Acceptor or ACE_SOCK_Connector factories. The interface of the ACE_SOCK_Stream and ACE_SOCK_IO classes are shown in Figure 3.7 on page 61. ACE_SOCK_ Stream derives from ACE_SOCK_IO, which itself derives from ACE_SOCK and defines basic data transfer methods that are reused by the ACE UDP wrapper facades.

                                                                图 3.7. ACE_SOCK_Stream和ACE_SOCK_IO类图

                                                                下表列出了通过ACE_SOCK_Stream导出的关键方法：

                                                                The key methods exported through ACE_SOCK_Stream are outlined in the following table:

                                                                方法 描述 
                                                                send()
recv()
                                                                		发送和接收数据缓冲区。由于操作系统中的缓冲机制和传输协议中的流量控制，它们写入或读取的字节数可能少于请求的字节数。 
                                                                send_n()
recv_n()
                                                                		发送和接收大小正好为n字节的数据缓冲区，以简化应用程序对“短写入”和“短读取”的处理。
                                                                recvv_n() 利用操作系统“分散读取”系统功能，高效、完整地接收多个数据缓冲区。
                                                                sendv_n() 使用操作系统“gather-write”系统功能，高效完整地发送多个数据缓冲区。

                                                                ACE_SOCK_Stream类支持阻塞式、定时式和非阻塞式 I/O，其中阻塞式 I/O 为默认设置。定时式 I/O 适用于与可能无限期挂起或阻塞的对等方通信的情况。可以向ACE_SOCK_Stream I/O 方法传递两种类型的ACE_Time_Value值来控制其超时行为：

                                                                The ACE_SOCK_Stream class supports blocking, timed, and nonblocking I/O, where blocking I/O is the default. Timed I/O is useful when communicating with peers that can hang or block indefinitely. Two types of ACE_Time_Value values can be passed to the ACE_SOCK_Stream I/O methods to control their time-out behavior:

                                                                价值 行为
                                                                空 ACE_Time_Value指针 表示 I/O 方法应阻塞，直到数据传输完成或发生错误为止。
                                                                一个非空的ACE Time_ 值指针 指示 I/O 方法应等待一段相对时间以传输数据。如果超时时间在数据发送或接收之前到期，则返回 -1，并将errno设置为 ETIME。

                                                                非阻塞 I/O 适用于那些无法承受数据发送或接收延迟的应用。阻塞式 I/O 与非阻塞式 I/O 可以通过继承自ACE_IPC_SAP的enable()和disable()方法进行控制：

                                                                Nonblocking I/O is useful for applications that can't afford to block when data isn't sent or received immediately. Blocking versus nonblocking I/O can be controlled via the enable() and disable() methods inherited from ACE_IPC_SAP:

                                                                peer.enable (ACE_NONBLOCK); // Enable nonblocking I/O.
peer.disable (ACE_NONBLOCK); // Disable nonblocking I/O.

                                                                如果对处于非阻塞模式的ACE_SOCK_Stream实例调用 I/O 方法，并且该调用会阻塞，则返回 -1，并将errno设置为 EWOULDBLOCK。

                                                                If an I/O method is invoked on an instance of ACE_SOCK_Stream that's in nonblocking mode and the call would block, a –1 is returned and errno is Set to EWOULDBLOCK.

                                                                例子

                                                                Example

                                                                现在我们已经了解了ACE_SOCK_Stream的功能，接下来我们将展示从第 3.5 节第59 页开始的 Web 客户端示例中的数据传输部分。这段代码会向特定的 URL 路径名发送一个 HTTP GET请求，然后打印出从 Web 服务器下载的文件的内容。

                                                                Now that we've examined the capabilities of ACE_SOCK_Stream, we can show the data transfer portion of our Web client example begun on page 59 in Section 3.5. This code sends an HTTP GET request for a particular URL path name and then prints out the contents of the file that's downloaded from the Web server.

                                                                 // ...Connection code from example in Section 3.5 omitted...
 char buf [BUFSIZ];
 iovec iov[3];
 iov[0].iov_base = "GET ";
 iov[0].iov_len = 4; // Length of "GET ".
 iov[1].iov_base = pathname;
 iov[1].iov_len = strlen (pathname);
 iov[2] iov_base = " HTTP/1.0\r\n\r\n" ;
 iov[2].iov_len = 13; // Length of " HTTP/1.0\r\n\r\n";

 if (peer.sendv_n (iov, 3) == -1)
   return 1;

 for (ssize_t n; (n = peer.recv (buf, sizeof buf)) > 0; )
   ACE::write_n (ACE_STDOUT, buf, n);

 return peer, close ();
}

                                                                我们使用iovec结构体数组，通过ACE_SOCK_Stream::sendv_n() 的gather-write 方法高效地将 HTTP GET请求传输到 Web 服务器。这避免了侧边栏 6中描述的Nagle 算法 [ Ste93 ] 的性能问题。在 UNIX/POSIX 平台上，此方法通过writev()实现；在 WinSock2 平台上，则通过WSASend()实现。

                                                                We use an array of iovec structures to transmit the HTTP GET request to the Web server efficiently using the ACE_SOCK_Stream: :sendv_n() gather-write method. This avoids performance issues with Nagle's algorithm [Ste93] described in Sidebar 6. On UNIX/POSIX platforms this method is implemented via writev() and on WinSock2 platforms it's implemented via WSASend().

                                                                client_download_file()函数中的 I/O 方法在遇到 TCP 流控制或 Web 服务器异常时会阻塞。为了防止客户端无限期挂起，我们可以为这些方法调用添加超时。例如，在以下代码中，如果服务器在 10 秒内没有收到数据，则会返回 -1，并将errno设置为 ETIME：

                                                                The I/O methods in the client_download_file() function will block if they encounter TCP flow control or if the Web server misbehaves. To prevent the client from hanging indefinitely, we can add time-outs to these method calls. In the following code, for instance, if the server doesn't receive the data in 10 seconds, a –1 will be returned with errno set to ETIME:

                                                                // Wait no more than 10 seconds to send or receive data.
ACE_Time_Value timeout (10);

peer.sendv_n (iov, 3, &timeout);

while (peer.recv (buf, sizeof buf, &timeout)   >   0)
  // ... process the contents of the downloaded file.

                                                                侧边栏 6：如何运用——以及如何绕过——纳格尔算法

                                                                Sidebar 6: Working With—and Around—Nagle's Algorithm

                                                                默认情况下，大多数 TCP/IP 实现使用 Nagle 算法 [ Ste93 ]，该算法会在发送方的 TCP/IP 协议栈中缓存按顺序发送的小数据包。虽然该算法可以最大限度地减少网络拥塞，但如果您不了解其生效的方式和时间，则可能会增加延迟并降低吞吐量。当连续的单向操作中发送多个小数据包时，可能会出现这些问题；例如，以下代码将触发 Nagle 算法：

                                                                By default, most TCP/IP implementations use Nagle's algorithm [Ste93], which buffers small, sequentially sent packets in the sender's TCP/IP stack. Although this algorithm minimizes network congestion, it can increase latency and decrease throughput if you're unaware of how and when it takes effect. These problems can arise when several small buffers are sent in successive one-way operations; for example, the following code will trigger Nagle's algorithm:

                                                                peer.send_n ("GET ", 4);
peer.send_n (pathname, strlen (pathname));
peer.send_n (" HTTP/1.0\r\n\r\n", 13);

                                                                应用程序开发者可以通过调用`peer.enable()`并传入 `TCP_NODELAY` 标志来禁用 Nagle 算法，这将强制 TCP 尽快发送数据包。第 63 页的 ` client_download_file()`函数展示了一种更高效的解决方案，它使用`sendv_n()`在单个系统函数中传输所有数据缓冲区。该方法接收一个iovec结构体数组作为参数，这些结构体定义如下：

                                                                Application developers can disable Nagle's algorithm by calling peer.enable() with the TCP_NODELAY flag, which forces TCP to send packets out as soon as possible. The client_download_file() function on page 63 shows an even more efficient solution using sendv_n() to transfer all data buffers in a single system function. This method is passed an array of iovec structures, which are defined as follows:

                                                                struct iovec {
  // Pointer to a buffer.
  char *iov_base;

  // Length of buffer pointed to by <iov_base>.
  int iov_len;
};

                                                                某些操作系统平台原生定义了iovec类，而其他平台则通过 ACE 定义。成员名称在所有情况下都相同，但顺序并不总是相同，因此需要显式设置它们，而不是通过结构体初始化。

                                                                Some OS platforms define iovec natively, whereas in other platforms it's defined by ACE. Member names are the same in all cases, but they're not always in the same order, so set them explicitly rather than via struct initialization.

                                                                  3.7 ACE_SOCK_Acceptor 类

                                                                  3.7 The ACE_SOCK_Acceptor Class

                                                                  动机

                                                                  Motivation

                                                                  ACE_SOCK_Connector和ACE_SOCK_Stream类解决了由于通信角色与 Socket API 函数不匹配而导致的复杂性问题。尽管 Socket API 定义了一组函数来履行被动连接建立的职责，但仍然存在一些额外的复杂性。Socket API 中的 C 函数是弱类型的，这使得它们很容易被错误地应用。

                                                                  The ACE_SOCK_Connector and ACE_SOCK_Stream classes resolve complexity issues that arise from the mismatch of communication roles and Socket API functions. Although the Socket API defines a single set of functions to fill the passive connection establishment role, there's an additional set of complexities. The C functions in the Socket API are weakly typed, which makes it easy to apply them incorrectly.

                                                                  例如，可能会对一个数据模式套接字句柄调用`accept()`函数，而该句柄本应通过 ` recv()`和`send() ` I/O 操作来传输数据。同样，也可能对一个被动模式套接字句柄工厂调用 I/O 操作，而该句柄工厂本应只用于接受连接。遗憾的是，这些错误只能在运行时才能检测到。ACE 通过强类型的 ` ACE_SOCK_Acceptor`类解决了这些复杂性。与直接调用 Socket API 不同，编译器可以在编译时轻松检测到对 ` ACE_SOCK_Acceptor`的误用。

                                                                  For example, the accept() function can be called on a data-mode socket handle that's intended to transfer data via the recv() and send() I/O operations. Likewise, the I/O operations can be called on a passive-mode socket handle factory that's intended only to accept connections. Unfortunately, these mistakes can't be detected until run time. ACE resolves these complexities with the strongly typed ACE_SOCK_Acceptor class. As opposed to direct Socket API calls, the compiler can easily detect misuse of an ACE_SOCK_Acceptor at compile time.

                                                                  等级能力

                                                                  Class Capabilities

                                                                  ACE_SOCK_Acceptor类是一个工厂类 [ GHJV95 ]，它被动地建立一个新的通信端点。它提供以下功能：

                                                                  The ACE_SOCK_Acceptor class is a factory [GHJV95] that establishes a new endpoint of communication passively. It provides the following capabilities:

                                                                  • 它接受来自对等连接器的连接，然后在连接建立后初始化ACE_SOCK_Stream对象。

                                                                  • It accepts a connection from a peer connector and then initializes an ACE_SOCK_Stream object after the connection is established.

                                                                  • 连接可以以阻塞式、非阻塞式或定时式的方式接受。

                                                                  • Connections can be accepted in either a blocking, nonblocking, or timed manner.

                                                                  • C++ 特性用于支持通用编程技术，从而能够通过 C++ 参数化类型全面替换功能，如第 57 页的侧边栏 5中所述。

                                                                  • C++ traits are used to support generic programming techniques that enable the wholesale replacement of functionality via C++ parameterized types, as described in Sidebar 5 on page 57.

                                                                  ACE_SOCK_Acceptor类的接口如图 3.8 （第 65 页）所示，其两个关键方法概述如下表所示：

                                                                  The interface of the ACE_SOCK_Acceptor class is shown in Figure 3.8 on page 65 and its two key methods are outlined in the following table:

                                                                  方法 描述
                                                                  打开（） 初始化被动模式工厂套接字，使其被动监听指定的ACE_INET_Addr地址。
                                                                  接受（） 使用新接受的客户端连接 初始化ACE_SOCK 流参数。

                                                                  图 3.8. ACE_SOCK_Acceptor类图

                                                                  ACE_SOCK_Acceptor的 open()和accept()方法使用从ACE_IPC_SAP继承的套接字句柄。这种设计利用 C++ 类型系统来保护应用程序开发人员免受以下意外误用：

                                                                  The ACE_SOCK_Acceptor open() and accept() methods use the socket handle inherited from ACE_IPC_SAP. This design employs the C++ type system to protect application developers from the following sources of accidental misuse:

                                                                  • ACE_SOCK_Acceptor的open()方法总是按正确的顺序调用底层socket()、bind()和listen()函数。

                                                                  • The low-level socket(), bind(), and listen() functions are always called in the right order by the ACE_SOCK_Acceptor's open() method.

                                                                  • 这些函数仅在已初始化为被动模式套接字句柄工厂的套接字句柄上调用。

                                                                  • These functions are called only on a socket handle that's been initialized as a passive-mode socket handle factory.

                                                                  这些以及其他 ACE 外立面设计选择背后的原则在附录 A中进行了描述。

                                                                  The principles that underlie these and other ACE wrapper facade design choices are described in Appendix A.

                                                                  例子

                                                                  Example

                                                                  我们通过展示迭代式 Web 服务器的被动连接建立和内容下载部分来说明ACE_SOCK_Acceptor ，该服务器按如下方式处理客户端请求：

                                                                  We illustrate the ACE_SOCK_Acceptor by showing the passive connection establishment and content downloading portions of an iterative Web server, which processes client requests as follows:

                                                                  1. 接受来自客户端的端口 80 的新连接。

                                                                  2. Accept a new connection from client on port 80.

                                                                  3. 从 GET 请求中读取路径名并下载请求的文件。

                                                                  4. Read path name from GET request and download requested file.

                                                                  5. 关闭连接。

                                                                  6. Close the connection.

                                                                  7. 返回步骤 1。

                                                                  8. Go back to step 1.

                                                                  为了高效地读取文件，我们使用ACE_Mem_Map ，这在第 68 页的侧边栏 7中有详细描述。为了使用ACE_Mem_Map 的功能，我们需要包含ace/Mem_Map.h以及编写 Web 服务器所需的其他 ACE Socket 包装器外观头文件。

                                                                  To read the file efficiently we use an ACE_Mem_Map, which is described in Sidebar 7 on page 68. To use the ACE_Mem_Map capabilities, we include ace/Mem_Map.h along with the other ACE Socket wrapper facade header files needed to write our Web server.

                                                                  #include "ace/Auto_Ptr.h"
#include "ace/INET_Addr.h"
#include "ace/SOCK_Acceptor.h"
#include "ace/SOCK_Stream.h"
#include "ace/Mem_Map.h"

// Return a dynamically allocated path name buffer.
extern char *get_url_pathname (ACE_SOCK_Stream *);

                                                                  我们的 Web 服务器支持 HTTP 1.0 版本，因此每个客户端请求都会建立单独的 TCP 连接。在下面的 Web 服务器代码中，我们首先初始化ACE_SOCK_Acceptor工厂，使其监听 80 端口的连接。然后，我们运行一个事件循环，该循环迭代地接受新的客户端连接，将文件映射到内存，将其下载到客户端，并在文件传输完成后关闭连接。

                                                                  Our Web server supports HTTP version 1.0, so each client request will have a separate TCP connection. In the following Web server code, we first initialize our ACE_SOCK_Acceptor factory to listen for connections on port 80. We then run an event loop that iteratively accepts a new client connection, memory-maps the file, downloads it to the client, and closes the connection when it's finished transmitting the file.

                                                                  int main ()
{
  ACE_INET_Addr server_addr;
  ACE_SOCK_Acceptor acceptor;
  ACE_SOCK_Stream peer;

  if (server_addr.set (80) == -1) return 1;
  if (acceptor.open (server_addr) == -1) return 1;

  for (;;) {
    if (acceptor.accept (peer) == -1) return 1;
    peer->disable (ACE_NONBLOCK); // Ensure blocking <recv>s.

    auto_ptr <char *> pathname = get_url_pathname (peer);
    ACE_Mem_Map mapped_file (pathname.get ());

    if (peer.send_n (mapped_file.addr (),
                     mapped_file.size ()) == -1) return 1;
    peer.close ();
  }

  return acceptor.close () == -1 ? 1 : 0;
}

                                                                  我们迭代式 Web 服务器的主要缺点在于，当大量客户端同时发送请求时，操作系统套接字实现会将少量（例如 5-10 个）连接请求排队，同时 Web 服务器处理当前请求。在生产环境中，操作系统很快就会不堪重负。当这种情况发生时，如果 Web 服务器的操作系统拒绝客户端的连接尝试，客户端可能会遇到错误。第 8 章和第9章将介绍解决此缺点的模式和 ACE 包装器外观。

                                                                  The primary drawback with our iterative Web server will arise when many clients send it requests simultaneously. In this case, the OS Socket implementation will queue a small number (e.g., 5–10) of connection requests while the Web server processes the current one. In a production Web server, the OS can be overwhelmed quickly. When this happens, clients can encounter errors when the Web server's OS refuses their connection attempts. Chapters 8 and 9 describe patterns and ACE wrapper facades that address this drawback.

                                                                  侧边栏 7：ACE_Mem_Map 类

                                                                  Sidebar 7: The ACE_Mem_Map Class

                                                                  ACE_Mem_Map封装器封装了 Win32 和 POSIX 平台上可用的内存映射文件机制。这些调用利用操作系统虚拟内存机制将文件映射到进程的地址空间。映射文件的内容可以直接通过指针访问，这比通过读写系统 I/O 函数访问数据块更加便捷高效。此外，内存映射文件的内容可以在同一台机器上的多个进程之间共享，如第29 页1.3 节所述。

                                                                  The ACE_Mem_Map wrapper facade encapsulates the memory-mapped file mechanisms available on Win32 and POSIX platforms. These calls use OS virtual memory mechanisms to map flies into the address space of a process. Mapped file contents can be accessed directly via a pointer, which Is more convenient and efficient than accessing blocks of data via read and write system I/O functions. In addition, the contents of memory-mapped files can be shared by multiple processes on the same machine, as described in Section 1.3 on page 29.

                                                                  原生的 Win32 和 POSIX 内存映射文件 API 缺乏可移植性且十分复杂。例如，开发人员必须手动执行许多簿记细节，例如显式打开文件、确定其长度以及执行多次映射。相比之下，ACE_Mem_Map封装器提供了一个接口，通过默认值和多个具有多种类型签名变体的构造函数（例如，“从打开的文件句柄映射”或“从文件名映射”）简化了常见的内存映射文件使用。

                                                                  The native Win32 and POSIX memory-mapped file APIs are nonportable and complex. For instance, developers must perform many bookkeeping details manually, such as explicitly opening a file, determining its length, and performing multiple mappings. In contrast, the ACE_Mem_Map wrapper facade offers an interface that simplifies common memory-mapped file usage via default values and multiple constructors with several type signature variants, for example, "map from an open file handle" or "map from a filename."

                                                                    3.8 总结

                                                                    3.8 Summary

                                                                    本章展示了 ACE 如何利用 C++ 特性和包装外观模式，使面向连接的 TCP/IP 机制在网络应用程序中的正确性和可移植性更容易实现。我们重点介绍了 ACE Socket 包装外观，它简化了 TCP/IP 机制的使用。

                                                                    This chapter showed how ACE uses C++ features and the Wrapper Facade pattern to make it easier to program connection-oriented TCP/IP mechanisms correctly and portably in networked applications. We focused on ACE Socket wrapper facades that simplify the use of

                                                                    • 网络地址、I/O句柄和基本套接字操作以及

                                                                    • Network addresses, I/O handles, and basic socket operations and

                                                                    • TCP连接建立和数据传输操作

                                                                    • TCP connection establishment and data transfer operations

                                                                    下一章将展示如何使用这些 Socket 包装器外观来开发我们网络日志服务的第一个迭代版本。

                                                                    The next chapter shows how these Socket wrapper facades are used to develop the first iteration of our networked logging service.

                                                                    ACE Socket 包装器外观解决了第 2.3 节中讨论的 Socket API 的以下问题：

                                                                    The ACE Socket wrapper facades resolve the following problems with the Socket API discussed in Section 2.3:

                                                                    • 易出错的 API—— ACE Socket 封装器确保所有传递给 Socket API 的参数都是类型安全的。同样，ACE 也透明地处理了地址查找函数中必须解决的字节序问题。

                                                                    • Error-prone APIs— The ACE Socket wrapper facades ensure that all arguments to Socket APIs are type-safe. Likewise, byte-ordering issues that must be dealt with during address lookup functions are handled by ACE transparently.

                                                                    • 过于复杂的 API—— 通过将 Socket API 分解为用于主动连接、被动接收和数据传输的独立类，ACE Socket 封装外观降低了网络应用程序开发人员需要面对的复杂性。因此，开发人员无需了解所有 ACE Socket 封装外观即可编写网络应用程序，只需了解他们使用的部分即可。

                                                                    • Overly complex APIs— By clustering the Socket API into separate classes for actively connecting, passively accepting, and transferring data, the ACE Socket wrapper facades reduce the amount of complexity that's exposed to developers of networked applications. Thus, developers needn't understand all of the ACE Socket wrapper facades to write a networked application, only the parts they use.

                                                                    • 不可移植且不统一的 API—— 客户端应用程序和 Web 服务器源代码在 ACE 支持的所有平台上都能正确高效地编译和运行。

                                                                    • Nonportable and nonuniform APIs— The client application and Web server source code compiles and runs correctly and efficiently on all platforms that ACE supports.

                                                                    ACE Socket 封装外观的面向对象设计使得无需修改 API 参数或手动更改寻址结构和函数即可轻松更改应用程序的进程间通信 (IPC) 机制。例如，图 3.2中每种通信服务类型（流、连接数据报或数据报）中的类都公开了一组通用方法，允许使用泛型编程技术轻松互换它们[Ale0l]。如第 57 页侧边栏 5所述，泛型编程和 C++ trait惯用法允许通过参数化类型对功能进行整体替换。这些技术也应用于其他 ACE IPC 封装外观类，这些类在 ACE 网站http://ace.ece.uci.edu上有详细介绍。

                                                                    The object-oriented design of the ACE Socket wrapper facades also makes it easy to change an application's IPC mechanism without having to modify API arguments and manually change addressing structures and functions. For example, the classes within each communication service type (stream, connected datagram, or datagram) in Figure 3.2 expose a common set of methods that allows them to be interchanged easily using generic programming techniques [Ale0l]. As described in Sidebar 5 on page 57, generic programming and the C++ trait idiom enable the wholesale replacement of functionality via parameterized types. These techniques are also applied to other ACE IPC wrapper facade classes, which are described at the ACE Web site at http://ace.ece.uci.edu.

                                                                      第四章 实现网络日志服务

                                                                      Chapter 4. Implementing the Networked Logging Service

                                                                      章节概要

                                                                      Chapter Synopsis

                                                                      本章介绍了我们网络日志服务的第一个实现。我们结合第三章中的 ACE Socket 封装外观和其他处理消息缓冲和（反）序列化的 ACE 类，演示了如何以可移植、正确且高效的方式发送、接收和处理日志记录。本书后续章节将不断完善此示例，以阐明开发面向对象的网络应用程序时需要解决的常见问题。

                                                                      This chapter presents the first implementation of our networked logging service. We illustrate how to send, receive, and process log records in a portable, correct, and efficient manner by combining the ACE Socket wrapper facades from Chapter 3 with other ACE classes that handle message buffering and (de)marshaling. We refine this example throughout the rest of the book to illustrate common issues and problems that need to be resolved when developing object-oriented networked applications.

                                                                        4.1 概述

                                                                        4.1 Overview

                                                                        大多数联网应用程序都会执行以下操作：

                                                                        Most networked applications perform the following activities:

                                                                        • 主动和被动地建立联系

                                                                        • Establish connections actively and passively

                                                                        • 与对等应用程序交换数据

                                                                        • Exchange data with peer applications

                                                                        • 管理数据缓冲区和

                                                                        • Manage buffers of data and

                                                                        • 对数据进行编组和解组，以便能够在异构系统中正确处理数据。

                                                                        • Marshal and demarshal typed data so that it can be processed correctly in heterogeneous systems

                                                                        本章阐述了如何利用 ACE 消息缓冲和（反）序列化类来增强第 3 章中的 ACE Socket 包装器外观，从而简化我们网络日志服务的首次实现。该服务的参与者如图 0.6 （第 18 页）所示。

                                                                        This chapter illustrates how the ACE Socket wrapper facades from Chapter 3 can be augmented with ACE message buffering and (de)marshaling classes to simplify the first implementation of our networked logging service. The participants in this service are shown in Figure 0.6 on page 18.

                                                                          4.2 ACE_Message_Block 类

                                                                          4.2 The ACE_Message_Block Class

                                                                          动机

                                                                          Motivation

                                                                          许多网络应用需要一种高效处理消息的方法[ SS93 ]。标准消息管理操作包括

                                                                          Many networked applications require a means to manipulate messages efficiently [SS93]. Standard message management operations include

                                                                          • 将消息从网络或同一主机上的其他进程接收到时，存储在缓冲区中。

                                                                          • Storing messages in buffers as they are received from the network or from other processes on the same host

                                                                          • 在用户级协议栈中，对消息进行添加和/或删除头部和尾部的操作。

                                                                          • Adding and/or removing headers and trailers from messages as they pass through a user-level protocol stack

                                                                          • 将消息分割并重新组装以适应网络最大传输单元 (MTU)

                                                                          • Fragmenting and reassembling messages to fit into network maximum transmission units (MTUs)

                                                                          • 将消息存储在缓冲区中以便发送或重传

                                                                          • Storing messages in buffers for transmission or retransmission

                                                                          • 重新排序乱序接收到的消息

                                                                          • Reordering messages that were received out-of-sequence

                                                                          为了提高效率，这些操作必须最大限度地减少动态内存管理的开销，避免不必要的数据复制，这就是 ACE 提供ACE_Message_Block类的原因。

                                                                          To improve efficiency, these operations must minimize the overhead of dynamic memory management and avoid unnecessary data copying, which is why ACE provides the ACE_Message_Block class.

                                                                          等级能力

                                                                          Class Capabilities

                                                                          ACE_Message_Block类能够高效地操作固定大小和可变大小的消息。ACE_Message_Block实现了复合模式 [ GHJV95 ] ，并提供以下功能：

                                                                          The ACE_Message_Block class enables efficient manipulation of fixed- and variable-sized messages. ACE_Message_Block implements the Composite pattern [GHJV95] and provides the following capabilities:

                                                                          • 每个ACE_Message_Block都包含一个指向引用计数ACE_Data_Block的指针，而 ACE_Data_Block 又指向与消息关联的实际数据。这种设计实现了灵活高效的数据共享，并最大限度地减少了过多的内存复制开销。

                                                                          • Each ACE_Message_Block contains a pointer to a reference-counted ACE_Data_Block, which in turn points to the actual data associated with a message. This design allows flexible and efficient sharing of data and minimizes excessive memory copying overhead.

                                                                          • 它允许将多个消息链接在一起，形成一个单链表，以支持复合消息，这可用于多态列表和需要高效插入/删除头部/尾部的分层协议栈。

                                                                          • It allows multiple messages to be chained together into a singly linked list to support composite messages, which can be used for polymorphic lists and for layered protocol stacks that require headers/trailers to be inserted/removed efficiently.

                                                                          • 它允许将多个消息连接在一起，形成双向链表，这是第 228 页概述的ACE_Message_Queue类的基础，并在 [ SH ] 中进行了描述。

                                                                          • It allows multiple messages to be joined together in a doubly linked list that forms the basis of the ACE_Message_Queue class outlined on page 228 and described in [SH].

                                                                          • 它将同步和内存管理属性视为应用程序可以在不改变底层ACE_Message_Block实现的情况下进行更改的方面[ Kic97 , CE00 ] 。

                                                                          • It treats synchronization and memory management properties as aspects [Kic97, CE00] that applications can vary without changing the underlying ACE_Message_Block implementation.

                                                                          ACE_Message_Block类的接口如图 4.1所示。它的设计大致模仿了 System V STREAMS [ Rag93 ] 消息缓冲机制，并且支持两种类型的消息：

                                                                          The interface of the ACE_Message_Block class is shown in Figure 4.1. Its design is modeled loosely on the System V STREAMS [Rag93] message buffering mechanism, and it supports two kinds of messages:

                                                                          • 简单消息包含一个ACE_Message_Block ，如图 4.2 (1)所示。

                                                                          • Simple messages contain a single ACE_Message_Block, as shown in Figure 4.2 (1).

                                                                          • 复合消息包含多个按照复合模式 [ GHJV95 ] 链接在一起的ACE_Message_Block，该模式为构建递归聚合提供了一种结构，如图4.2 (2) 所示。复合消息通常由一个包含簿记信息（例如目标地址）的控制消息和一个或多个包含消息实际内容的数据消息组成。

                                                                          • Composite messages contain multiple ACE_Message_Blocks linked together in accordance with the Composite pattern [GHJV95], which provides a structure for building recursive aggregations, as shown in Figure 4.2 (2). Composite messages often consist of a control message that contains bookkeeping information, such as destination addresses, followed by one or more data messages that contain the actual contents of the message.

                                                                          图 4.1. ACE_Message_Block类图

                                                                          图 4.2. 两种ACE_Message_Block

                                                                          ACE_Message_Block的主要方法概述如下表所示：

                                                                          The key methods of ACE_Message_Block are outlined in the following table:

                                                                          方法 描述 
                                                                          ACE Message Block ()
init ()
                                                                          		初始化消息。
                                                                          msg_type() 设置和获取消息类型。
                                                                          msg_priority() 设置和获取消息优先级。
                                                                          克隆（） 返回整条消息的精确“深度副本”。
                                                                          复制（） 返回消息的“浅”副本，该副本的引用计数加 1。
                                                                          发布（） 将引用计数减 1，如果计数降至 0，则释放消息资源。
                                                                          设置标志() 将指定的位与确定消息语义的现有标志集进行按位或运算，例如，在释放消息时是否删除缓冲区等等。
                                                                          clr_flags() 清除指定的标志位。
                                                                          复制（） 将缓冲区中的 n 个字节复制到消息中。
                                                                          rd_ptr() 设置并获取读取指针。
                                                                          wr_ptr() 设置和获取写入指针。
                                                                          cont() 设置和获取消息延续字段，该字段将复合消息链接在一起。
                                                                          下一个() 上一个() 设置和获取指向ACE_Message_Queue中消息双向链表的指针。
                                                                          长度（） 设置和获取消息的当前长度，定义为wr_ptr () – rd_ptr()。
                                                                          total_length() 获取消息的长度，包括所有链式消息块。
                                                                          尺寸（） 设置并获取消息的总容量，其中包括在 [ rd_ptr() , wr_ptr() ] 范围之前和之后分配的存储量。

                                                                          每个ACE_Message_Block都包含一个指向引用计数ACE_Data_Block的指针，而 ACE_Data_Block 又指向实际的数据有效载荷，如图4.2 (1) 所示。请注意，rd_ptr()和wr_ptr()分别指向数据有效载荷活动部分的开头和结尾。图 4.2 (2) 展示了如何使用ACE_Message_Block::duplicate()方法对消息进行“浅拷贝”。这使得它们能够通过最大限度地减少内存分配和复制开销，灵活高效地共享相同的数据。由于消息块本身被复制，因此rd_ptr()和wr_ptr()可以指向同一共享数据有效载荷的不同部分。

                                                                          Each ACE_Message_Block contains a pointer to a reference-counted ACE_Data_Block, which in turn points to the actual data payload, as shown in Figure 4.2 (1). Note how the rd_ptr() and wr_ptr() point to the beginning and end of the active portion of the data payload, respectively. Figure 4.2 (2) shows how the ACE_Message_Block::duplicate() method can be used to make a "shallow copy" of a message. This allows them to share the same data flexibly and efficiently by minimizing memory allocation and copying overhead. Since the message block itself is copied, the rd_ptr() s and wr_ptr() s can point to different parts of the same shared data payload.

                                                                          例子

                                                                          Example

                                                                          以下程序从标准输入读取所有数据，并将数据存储到一个单链表中，该单链表由动态分配的ACE_Message_Block组成，这些消息块通过它们的延续指针链接在一起。然后，它将所有链接的消息块的内容打印到标准输出，并释放它们动态分配的内存。

                                                                          The following program reads all data from standard input into a singly linked list of dynamically allocated ACE_Message_Blocks that are chained together by their continuation pointers. It then prints the contents of all the chained message blocks to the standard output and releases their dynamically allocated memory.

                                                                          #include "ace/OS.h"
#include "ace/Message_Block.h"

int main (int argc, char *argv[])
{
  ACE_Message_Block *head = new ACE_Message_Block (BUFSIZ);
  ACE_Message_Block *mblk = head;

  for (;;) {
    ssize_t nbytes = ACE::read_n (ACE_STDIN,
                                  mblk->wr_ptr (),
                                  mblk->size () ) ;
    if (nbytes <=  0)
      break; // Break out at EOF or error.

    // Advance the write pointer to the end of the buffer.
    mblk->wr_ptr (nbytes);

    // Allocate message block and chain it at the end of list.
    mblk->cont (new ACE_Message_Block (BUFSIZ));
    mblk = mblk->cont ();
  }
  // Print the contents of the list to the standard output.
  for (mblk = head; mblk != 0; mblk = mblk->cont ())
    ACE::write_n (ACE_STDOUT, mblk->rd_ptr (), mblk->length ());

  head->release (); // This releases all the memory in the chain.
  return 0;
}

                                                                          将列表内容打印到标准输出的 for 循环可以替换为对 `ACE::write_n(head)` 的一次调用。此方法使用高效的收集-写入操作，打印出所有通过其`cont() ` 指针链接的消息块。第 90 页的`Logging_Handler::write_log_record()`方法中也使用了类似的优化。

                                                                          The for loop that prints the contents of the list to the standard output can be replaced by a single call to ACE::write_n (head). This method prints out all the message blocks chained through their cont () pointers using a highly efficient gather-write operation. A similar optimization is used in the Logging_Handler::write_log_record() method on page 90.

                                                                          我们使用ACE::read_n()和ACE::write_n()方法，而不是 C++ iostreams 机制，因为并非所有 ACE 运行的操作系统平台都充分支持 C++ iostreams。在充分支持cin和cout 的平台上，可以使用它们进行替换。但是，由于内部缓冲，它们可能会产生额外的数据复制，并且无法利用上一段所述的收集写入优化。

                                                                          We use the ACE::read_n() and ACE::write_n() methods rather than the C++ iostreams mechanism since not all OS platforms that ACE runs on support C++ iostreams adequately. It's possible to substitute cin and cout on platforms that do support them properly. They may incur additional data copying due to internal buffering, however, and can't take advantage of the gather-write optimization described in the preceding paragraph.

                                                                            4.3 ACE_InputCDR 和 ACE_OutputCDR 类

                                                                            4.3 The ACE_InputCDR and ACE_OutputCDR Classes

                                                                            动机

                                                                            Motivation

                                                                            发送和接收消息的网络应用程序通常需要对以下方面提供支持：

                                                                            Networked applications that send and receive messages often require support for

                                                                            • 线性化用于处理丰富类型数据（例如数组、链表或图）与原始内存缓冲区之间的转换。

                                                                            • Linearization to handle the conversion of richly typed data, such as arrays, linked lists, or graphs, to/from raw memory buffers

                                                                            • 为了在具有不同编译器对齐约束和不同字节顺序规则的硬件指令的环境中正确互操作，需要进行序列化/反序列化。

                                                                            • Marshaling/demarshaling to correctly interoperate in environments with heterogeneous compiler alignment constraints and hardware instructions with different byte-ordering rules

                                                                            由于手动执行线性化、编组和反编组操作非常困难，因此这些操作最好封装在可重用的类中，这就是 ACE 提供ACE_OutputCDR和ACE_InputCDR 的原因。

                                                                            Since it's hard to manually perform linearization, marshaling, and de-marshaling correctly and efficiently, these operations are best encapsulated in reusable classes, which is why ACE provides ACE_OutputCDR and ACE_InputCDR.

                                                                            等级能力

                                                                            Class Capabilities

                                                                            ACE_OutputCDR和ACE_InputCDR类提供了一种高度优化、可移植且便捷的方法，可以使用标准的 CORBA 通用数据表示 (CDR) 格式对数据进行编组和解组[ Obj01 ]。ACE_OutputCDR 从数据结构创建 CDR 缓冲区（编组），而 ACE_InputCDR从CDR缓冲区提取数据（解组）。

                                                                            The ACE_OutputCDR and ACE_InputCDR classes provide a highly optimized, portable, and convenient means to marshal and demarshal data using the standard CORBA Common Data Representation (CDR) format [Obj01]. ACE_ OutputCDR creates a CDR buffer from a data structure (marshaling) and ACE_InputCDR extracts data from a CDR buffer (demarshaling).

                                                                            ACE_OutputCDR和ACE_InputCDR类支持以下功能：

                                                                            The ACE_OutputCDR and ACE_InputCDR classes support the following features:

                                                                            • 它们提供对以下类型进行（反）序列化的操作：

                                                                              -基本类型，例如布尔值；16 位、32 位和 64 位整数；8 位字节；单精度和双精度浮点数；字符；以及字符串。

                                                                              -基本类型数组

                                                                            • They provide operations to (de)marshal the following types:

                                                                              - Primitive types, for example, booleans; 16-, 32-, and 64-bit integers; 8-bit octets; single and double precision floating point numbers; characters; and strings

                                                                              - Arrays of primitive types

                                                                            • 可以使用插入（<<）和提取（>>）运算符来封送和解封送原始类型，语法与 C++ iostream 组件相同。

                                                                            • The insertion (<<) and extraction (>>) operators can be used to marshal and demarshal primitive types, using the same syntax as the C++ iostream components.

                                                                            • 它们内部使用ACE_Message_Block链来避免昂贵的内存复制。

                                                                            • They use ACE_Message_Block chains internally to avoid expensive memory copies.

                                                                            • 它们分别利用 CORBA CDR 对齐和字节排序规则来避免昂贵的内存复制和字节交换操作。

                                                                            • They take advantage of CORBA CDR alignment and byte-ordering rules to avoid expensive memory copying and byte-swapping operations, respectively.

                                                                            • 它们提供针对常见硬件平台（如 Intel x86）的优化字节交换代码，该代码使用内联汇编语言指令，而其他平台则使用标准的htons()、htonl()、ntohs()和ntohl()宏/函数。

                                                                            • They provide optimized byte swapping code that uses inline assembly language instructions for common hardware platforms, such as Intel x86, and the standard htons(), htonl(), ntohs(), and ntohl() macros/functions on other platforms.

                                                                            • 它们支持八位字节缓冲区的零拷贝封送和解封送。

                                                                            • They support zero copy marshaling and demarshaling of octet buffers.

                                                                            • 用户可以为不使用 ASCII 或 UNICODE 作为其原生字符集的平台定义自定义字符集转换器。

                                                                            • Users can define custom character set translators for platforms that do not use ASCII or UNICODE as their native character sets.

                                                                            ACE CDR 流类的接口如图 4.3所示。ACE_OutputCDR 类中的关键方法如下表所示：

                                                                            The interfaces for the ACE CDR streaming classes are shown in Figure 4.3. The key methods in ACE_OutputCDR class are shown in the following table:

                                                                            方法 描述
                                                                            ACE_OutputCDR() 创建一个空的 CDR 流以供插入。
                                                                            写_*（） 将原始数据插入流中，例如write_ushort()。
                                                                            write_*_array() 将基本类型数组插入流中，例如write_long_array()。
                                                                            operator<<() 为每种基本类型都定义了一个插入运算符。
                                                                            good_bit() 如果流检测到错误，则返回 0。
                                                                            total_length() 返回流中的字节数。
                                                                            开始（） 返回指向链中第一个消息块的指针。
                                                                            结尾（） 返回指向链中最后一个消息块的指针。

                                                                            图 4.3. ACE_InputCDR和ACE_OutputCDR类图

                                                                            同样， ACE_InputCDR类的关键方法如下表所示：

                                                                            Likewise, the key methods for the ACE_InputCDR class are shown in the following table:

                                                                            方法 描述
                                                                            ACE_InputCDR() 创建一个空的 CDR 流以供提取。
                                                                            读_*（） 从流中提取原始类型，例如读取 char()。
                                                                            读取数组() 从流中提取原始数组，例如读取 octet_array()。
                                                                            运算符>>() 为每种基本类型定义了一个提取运算符。
                                                                            好部分() 如果流检测到错误，则返回 0。
                                                                            窃取内容() 返回包含当前 CDR 流的 底层ACE_Message_Block的副本。

                                                                            ACE_InputCDR和ACE_OutputCDR类负责将类型化数据转换为非类型化缓冲区，反之亦然。因此，程序员在使用这些类时必须格外小心，以避免类型系统冲突。避免这些问题的一种方法是使用分布式中间件进行编程，例如第264 页B.1.4 节中描述的 CORBA [ Obj01 ] 和 ACE ORB (TAO) [ SLM98 ] 。

                                                                            The ACE_InputCDR and ACE_OutputCDR classes transform typed data into untyped buffers and vice versa. As a result, programmers must be careful when using these classes to prevent type system violations. One way to avoid these problems altogether is to program using distribution middleware, such as CORBA [Obj01] and The ACE ORB (TAO) [SLM98] described in Section B.1.4 on page 264.

                                                                            例子

                                                                            Example

                                                                            ACE CDR 流式类预定义了基本类型和数组的运算符 << 和 >>。ACE 应用程序负责为其自身的数据类型定义这些运算符。[1]为了说明这些运算符，我们展示了客户端应用程序和日志服务器都使用的ACE_Log_Record类的 ACE CDR 插入和提取运算符。这个 C++ 类包含多个字段和一个可变大小的消息缓冲区。因此，我们的插入操作会将每个字段编组到一个ACE_OutputCDR对象中，如下所示：

                                                                            The ACE CDR streaming classes predefine operators << and >> for primitive types and arrays. ACE applications are responsible for defining these operators for their own data types.[1] To illustrate these operators, we show the ACE CDR insertion and extraction operators for the ACE_Log_Record class that's used by both the client application and logging server. This C++ class contains several fields and a variable-sized message buffer. Our insertion operation therefore marshals each field into an ACE_OutputCDR object, as shown below:

                                                                            [1]这些运算符也可以通过工具自动生成，例如TAO 提供的CORBA 接口定义语言 (IDL) 编译器 [ AOSK00 ]。

                                                                            [1] These operators can also be generated automatically by tools, such as the CORBA Interface Definition Language (IDL) compiler [AOSK00] provided by TAO.

                                                                            int operator<< (ACE_OutputCDR &cdr,
                const ACE Log Record &log_record)
{
  size_t msglen = log_record.msg_data_len ();

  // Insert each <log_record> field into the output CDR stream.
  cdr << ACE_CDR::Long (log_record.type ());
  cdr << ACE_CDR::Long (log_record.pid ());
  cdr << ACE_CDR::Long (log_record.time_stamp ().sec ());
  cdr << ACE_CDR::Long (log_record.time_stamp ().usec ());
  cdr << ACE_CDR::ULong (msglen);

  cdr.write_char_array (log_record.msg_data (), msglen);

  return cdr.good bit ();
}

                                                                            我们的提取运算符从ACE_InputCDR对象中反序列化每个字段，并相应地填充ACE_Log_Record对象：

                                                                            Our extraction operator demarshals each field from an ACE_InputCDR object and fills in an ACE_Log_Record object accordingly:

                                                                            int operator>> (ACE_InputCDR &cdr,
                ACE_Log_Record &log_record)
{
  ACE_CDR::Long type;
  ACE_CDR::Long pid;
  ACE_CDR::Long sec, usec;
  ACE_CDR::ULong buffer_len;

  // Extract each field from input CDR stream into <log_record>.
  if ((cdr >> type) && (cdr >> pid) && (cdr >> sec)
     && (cdr >> usec) && (cdr >> buffer_len)) {
    ACE_TCHAR log_msg[ACE_Log_Record::MAXLOGMSGLEN+1];
    log_record.type (type);
    log_record.pid (pid);
    log_record.time_stamp (ACE_Time_Value (sec, usec));
    cdr.read_char_array (log_msg, buffer_len);
    log_msg [buffer_len] = '\0';
    log_record.msg_data (log_msg);
  }

  return cdr.good_bit ();
}

                                                                            我们稍后将使用这两个插入和提取运算符来简化我们的网络日志应用程序。

                                                                            We'll use these two insertion and extraction operators to simplify our networked logging application shortly.

                                                                              4.4 初始日志服务器

                                                                              4.4 The Initial Logging Server

                                                                              我们的第一个网络日志服务实现定义了初始设计和核心可重用类的实现。日志服务器监听操作系统网络服务文件中定义为ace_logger的 TCP 端口号，这是许多网络服务器采用的惯例。例如，UNIX /etc/services文件中可能存在以下行：

                                                                              Our first networked logging service implementation defines the initial design and the core reusable class implementations. The logging server listens on a TCP port number defined in the operating system's network services file as ace_logger, which is a practice used by many networked servers. For example, the following line might exist in the UNIX /etc/ services file:

                                                                              ace_logger     9700/tcp     # Connection-oriented Logging Service

                                                                              客户端应用程序可以选择性地指定客户端应用程序和日志服务器进行通信以交换日志记录的 TCP 端口和 IP 地址。如果未指定此信息，则端口号取自服务数据库，主机名默认为 ACE_DEFAULT_SERVER_HOST，在大多数操作系统平台上定义为“ localhost ”。连接建立后，客户端将日志记录发送到日志服务器，服务器将每条记录写入一个文件。本节介绍一组可重用的类，用于处理本书中所有日志服务器的被动连接建立和数据传输。

                                                                              Client applications can optionally specify the TCP port and the IP address where the client application and logging server should rendezvous to exchange log records. If this information is not specified, however, the port number is located in the services database, and the host name is assumed to be the ACE_DEFAULT_SERVER_HOST, which is defined as "localhost" on most OS platforms. Once it's connected, the client sends log records to the logging server, which writes each record to a file. This section presents a set of reusable classes that handle passive connection establishment and data transfer for all the logging servers shown in this book.

                                                                              4.4.1 Logging_Server 基类

                                                                              4.4.1 The Logging_Server Base Class

                                                                              前几节已经介绍了ACE_Message_Block、ACE_Output_CDR和ACE_InputCDR，接下来我们将在一个新的基类中使用这些类，以简化本书中日志服务器的实现。图 4.4展示了我们的抽象基类Logging_Server 、将在4.4.2 节中开发的Logging_Handler类，以及将在后续章节中开发的具体日志服务器类。我们将Logging_Server基类的定义放在名为Logging_Server.h的头文件中：

                                                                              Now that previous sections described ACE_Message_Block, ACE_Output_CDR, and ACE_InputCDR, we'll use these classes in a new base class that will simplify our logging server implementations throughout the book. Figure 4.4 illustrates our Logging_Server abstract base class, the Logging_Handler class we'll develop in Section 4.4.2, and the concrete logging server classes that we'll develop in future chapters. We put the definition of the Logging_Server base class into the following header file called Logging_Server.h:

                                                                              图 4.4. 日志服务器示例类

                                                                              #include "ace/FILE_IO.h"
#include "ace/SOCK_Acceptor.h"

// Forward declaration.
class ACE_SOCK_Stream;

class Logging_Server
{
public:
  // Template Method that runs logging server's event loop.
  virtual int run (int argc, char *argv[]);

protected:
  // The following four methods are ''hooks'' that can be
  // overridden by subclasses.
  virtual int open (u_short port = 0);
  virtual int wait_for_multiple_events () { return 0; }
  virtual int handle_connections () = 0;
  virtual int handle_data (ACE_SOCK_Stream * = 0) = 0;

  // This helper method can be used by the hook methods.
  int make_log_file (ACE_FILE_IO &, ACE_SOCK_Stream * = 0);

  // Close the socket endpoint and shutdown ACE.
  virtual ~Logging_Server () {
    acceptor_.close ();
  }

  // Accessor.
  ACE_SOCK_Acceptor &acceptor () {
    return acceptor_;
  }

private:
  // Socket acceptor endpoint.
  ACE_SOCK_Acceptor acceptor_;
};

                                                                              后续所有联网日志服务示例都将包含此头文件，继承Logging_Server类，并重写和重用其方法，我们将在下文中分别介绍这些方法。实现文件Logging_Server.cpp包含以下 ACE 头文件：

                                                                              All the subsequent networked logging service examples will include this header file, subclass Logging_Server, and override and reuse its methods, each of which we describe below. The implementation file Logging_Server.cpp includes the following ACE header files:

                                                                              #include "ace/FILE_Addr.h"
#include "ace/FILE_Connector.h"
#include "ace/FILE_IO.h"
#include "ace/INET_Addr.h"
#include "ace/SOCK_Stream.h"
#include "Logging_Server.h"
                                                                              Logging_Server::run() 模板方法

                                                                              此公共方法执行本书中大多数日志服务器使用的规范初始化和事件循环步骤。

                                                                              This public method performs the canonical initialization and event loop steps used by most of the logging servers in this book.

                                                                              int Logging_Server::run (int argc, char *argv[])
{
  if (open (argc > 1 ? atoi (argv[1]) : 0) == -1)
    return -1;

  for (;;) {
    if (wait_for_multiple_events () == -1) return -1;
    if (handle_connections () == -1) return -1;
    if (handle data () == -1) return -1;
  }
  return 0;
}

                                                                              上面的代码是模板方法模式 [ GHJV95 ] 的一个示例，它定义了操作中算法的框架，并将一些步骤延迟到可供子类重写的钩子方法中。`run ()`模板方法中对`open()`、`wait_for_multiple_events()`、`handle_data()`和`handle_connections()`的调用都是可供子类重写的钩子方法。
