                                                                              The code above is an example of the Template Method pattern [GHJV95], which defines the skeleton of an algorithm in an operation, deferring some steps to hook methods that can be overridden by subclasses. The calls to open(), wait_for_multiple_events(), handle_data(), and handle_connections() in the run() template method are all hook methods that can be overridden by subclasses.

                                                                              日志服务器钩子方法

                                                                              Logging_Server类中的每个 hook 方法都有一个作用和默认行为，下面简要描述一下。

                                                                              Each hook method in the Logging_Server class has a role and a default behavior that's described briefly below.

                                                                              `Logging_Server::open() ` 方法初始化服务器地址和` Logging_Server`的 acceptor 端点，使其被动监听指定的端口号。虽然子类可以重写此方法，但下面所示的默认实现足以满足本书所有示例的需求：

                                                                              Logging_Server::open(). This method initializes the server address and the Logging_Server's acceptor endpoint to listen passively on a designated port number. Although it can be overridden by subclasses, the default implementation shown below suffices for all the examples in this book:

                                                                              int Logging_Server::open (u_short logger_port)
{
  // Raises the number of available socket handles to
  // the maximum supported by the OS platform.
  ACE::set_handle_limit ();

  ACE_INET_Addr server_addr;
  int result;
  if (logger_port != 0)
    result = server_addr.set (logger_port, INADDR_ANY);
  else
    result = server_addr.set ("ace_logger", INADDR_ANY);
  if (result == -1)
    return -1;

  // Start listening and enable reuse of listen address
  // for quick restarts.
  return acceptor_.open (server_addr, 1);
}

                                                                              虽然ACE_INET_Addr构造函数接受端口号和主机名作为参数，但出于以下原因，我们在这里避免使用它：

                                                                              Although an ACE_INET_Addr constructor accepts the port number and host name as arguments, we avoid it here for the following reasons:

                                                                              1. 我们允许用户传递端口号或使用默认服务名称，这需要不同的调用方式。

                                                                              2. We allow the user to either pass a port number or use the default service name, which requires different calls

                                                                              3. 可能会调用诸如gethostbyname()之类的网络寻址函数，这可能会让程序员感到意外，因为他们不会预料到构造函数会延迟执行，直到服务器主机地址解析完毕。

                                                                              4. Networking addressing functions such as gethostbyname() may be called, which can surprise programmers who don't expect a constructor to delay its execution until the server host address is resolved and

                                                                              5. 如果出现错误，我们需要发出正确的诊断信息。

                                                                              6. We need to issue the proper diagnostic if there was an error.

                                                                              第 256 页的A.6.3 节解释了为什么 ACE 不使用原生 C++ 异常来传播错误。

                                                                              Section A.6.3 on page 256 explains why ACE doesn't use native C++ exceptions to propagate errors.

                                                                              请注意acceptor_.open调用中的第二个参数。它会在 acceptor 套接字上设置 SO-REUSEADDR 套接字选项，从而允许程序在停止后立即重新启动。这避免了与上次运行遗留的处于 TIME_WAIT 状态的套接字发生冲突，否则这些冲突会导致新的日志服务器在几分钟内无法监听日志客户端。

                                                                              Note the second argument on the acceptor_.open call. It causes the SO-REUSEADDR socket option to be set on the acceptor socket, allowing the program to restart soon after it has been stopped. This avoids any clashes with sockets in TIME_WAIT state left from the previous run that would otherwise prevent a new logging server from listening for logging clients for several minutes.

                                                                              `Logging_Server::wait_for_multiple_events() ` 方法的作用是等待多个事件发生。它的默认实现是空操作，即返回 0。使用第 7 章中描述的基于`select()`的同步事件解复用机制的日志服务器实现会覆盖此默认行为。

                                                                              Logging_Server::wait_for_multiple_events(). The role of this method is to wait for multiple events to occur. It's default implementation is a no-op; that is, it simply returns 0. This default behavior is overridden by implementations of the logging server that use the select() -based synchronous event demultiplexing mechanisms described in Chapter 7.

                                                                              `Logging_Server::handle_connections()` 方法的作用是接受来自客户端的一个或多个连接。我们将其定义为纯虚方法，以确保子类实现它。

                                                                              Logging_Server::handle_connections(). The role of this hook method is to accept one or more connections from clients. We define it as a pure virtual method to ensure that subclasses implement it.

                                                                              `Logging_Server::handle_data()` 方法的作用是接收来自客户端的日志记录并将其写入日志文件。我们将其定义为纯虚方法，以确保子类实现它。

                                                                              Logging_Server::handle_data(). The role of this hook method is to receive a log record from a client and write it to a log file. We also define it as a pure virtual method to ensure that subclasses implement it.

                                                                              侧边栏 8：ACE 文件包装器外观

                                                                              Sidebar 8: The ACE File Wrapper Facades

                                                                              ACE 根据包装器外观模式封装了用于无缓冲文件操作的平台机制。与大多数 ACE IPC 包装器外观系列一样，ACE 文件类解耦了……

                                                                              ACE encapsulates platform mechanisms for unbuffered file operations in accordance with the Wrapper Facade pattern. Like most of the ACE IPC wrapper facades families, the ACE File classes decouple the

                                                                              • 初始化工厂，例如ACE_FILE_Connector，用于打开和/或创建文件，来自

                                                                              • Initialization factories, such as ACE_FILE_Connector, which open and/or create files, from

                                                                              • 数据传输类，例如ACE_FILE_IO ，应用程序使用该类来读取和写入由ACE_FILE_Connector打开的文件的数据。

                                                                              • Data transfer classes, such as the ACE_FILE_IO, which applications use to read and write data to a file opened by ACE_FILE_Connector,

                                                                              ACE IPC 和文件包装器外观的对称性表明了 ACE 设计的通用性，并为将 IPC 机制策略化到 [ SH ]中描述的更高级别的 ACE 框架中提供了基础。

                                                                              The symmetry of the ACE IPC and file wrapper facades demonstrates the generality of ACE's design and provides the basis for strategizing IPC mechanisms into the higher-level ACE frameworks described in [SH].

                                                                              Logging_Server::make_log_file() 方法

                                                                              钩子方法可以使用此辅助方法来初始化日志文件，使用侧边栏 8中概述的 ACE 文件包装器外观。

                                                                              This helper method can be used by the hook methods to initialize a log file using the ACE File wrapper facades outlined in Sidebar 8.

                                                                              int Logging_Server::make_log_file (ACE_FILE_IO &logging_file,
                                   ACE_SOCK_Stream *logging_peer)
{
  char filename[MAXHOSTNAMELEN + sizeof (".log")];

  if (logging_peer != 0) { // Use client host name as file name.
    ACE_INET_Addr logging_peer_addr;
    logging_peer->get_remote_addr (logging_peer_addr);
    logging_peer_addr.get_host_name (filename, MAXHOSTNAMELEN);
    strcat (filename, ".log");
  }
  else
    strcpy (filename, "logging_server.log");

  ACE_FILE_Connector connector;
  return connector.connect (logging_file,
                            ACE_FILE_Addr (filename),
                            0, // No time-out.
                            ACE_Addr::sap_any, // Ignored.
                            0, // Don't try to reuse the addr.
                            O_RDWR | O_CREAT | O_APPEND,
                            ACE_DEFAULT_FILE_PERMS);

                                                                              默认情况下，我们将日志文件命名为“ logging_server.log ”。可以通过使用已连接客户端的主机名来覆盖此名称，如第 7.4 节第 156 页所示。

                                                                              We name the log file "logging_server.log" by default. This name can be overridden by using the host name of the connected client, as we show on page 156 in Section 7.4.

                                                                              侧边栏 9：日志服务消息帧协议

                                                                              Sidebar 9: The Logging Service Message Framing Protocol

                                                                              由于 TCP 是字节流协议，我们需要一个应用层消息帧协议来分隔数据流中的日志记录。我们使用一个 8 字节的 CDR 编码头部，其中包含字节顺序指示符和有效载荷长度，后跟日志记录内容，如下所示：

                                                                              Since TCP is a bytestream protocol, we need an application-level message framing protocol to delimit log records In the data stream. We use an 8-byte, CDR-encoded header that contains the byte-order Indication and payload length, followed by the log record contents, as shown below:





                                                                              4.4.2 Logging_Handler 类

                                                                              4.4.2 The Logging_Handler Class

                                                                              此类用于日志服务器中，以封装日志记录的 I/O 和处理，并遵循侧边栏 9中描述的消息帧协议。此协议实现的发送端在第 96 页的Logging_Client::send()方法中显示，接收端在第 88 页的Logging_Handler::recv_log_record()方法中显示。

                                                                              This class is used in logging servers to encapsulate the I/O and processing of log records in accordance with the message framing protocol described in Sidebar 9. The sender side of this protocol implementation is shown in the Logging_Client::send() method on page 96, and the receiver side is shown in the Logging_Handler::recv_log_record() method on page 88.

                                                                              Logging_Handler类的定义位于名为 Logging_Handler.h 的头文件中。

                                                                              The Logging_Handler class definition is placed in a header file called Logging_Handler.h.

                                                                              #include "ace/FILE_IO.h"
#include "ace/SOCK_Stream.h"

class ACE_Message_Block; // Forward declaration.
class Logging_Handler
{
protected:
  // Reference to a log file.
  ACE_FILE_IO &log_file_;
  // Connected to the client.
  ACE_SOCK_Stream logging_peer_;

public:
  // Initialization and termination methods.
  Logging_Handler (ACE_FILE IO &log_file)
    : log_file_ (log_file) {}
  Logging_Handler (ACE_FILE_IO &log_file,
                   ACE_HANDLE handle)
    : log_file_ (log_file) { logging_peer_.set_handle (handle); }
  Logging_Handler (ACE_FILE_IO &log_file,
                   const ACE_SOCK_Stream &logging_peer)
    : log_file_ (log_file), logging_peer_ (logging_peer) {}
  Logging_Handler (const ACE_SOCK_Stream &logging_peer)
    : log_file_ (0), logging_peer_ (logging_peer) {}
  int close () { return logging_peer_.close (); }

  // Receive one log record from a connected client. Returns
  // length of record on success and <mblk> contains the
  // hostname, <mblk->cont()> contains the log record header
  // (the byte order and the length) and the data. Returns -1 on
  // failure or connection close.
  int recv_log_record (ACE_Message_Block *&mblk);

  // Write one record to the log file. The <mblk> contains the
  // hostname and the <mblk->cont> contains the log record.
  // Returns length of record written on success; -1 on failure.
  int write_log_record (ACE_Message_Block *mblk);

  // Log one record by calling <recv_log_record> and
  // <write_log_record>. Returns 0 on success and -1 on failure.
  int log_record ();

  ACE_SOCK_Stream &peer () { return logging_peer_; } // Accessor.
};

                                                                              下面，我们将展示recv_log_record()、write_log_record()和log_record()方法的实现。

                                                                              Below, we show the implementation of the recv_log_record(), write_ log_record(), and log_record() methods.

                                                                              `Logging_Handler::recv_log_record()` 方法实现了网络日志服务消息帧协议的接收端（参见侧边栏 9，第 86 页）。它使用`ACE_SOCK_Stream`、`ACE_Message_Block`和`ACE_InputCDR`类，以及第 79 页定义的提取运算符 `>>` ，从连接的客户端读取一条完整的日志记录。由于我们使用 ` ACE_InputCDR`类对从网络接收的内容进行反序列化，因此该代码具有可移植性和互操作性。

                                                                              Logging_Handler::recv_log_record(). This method implements the receiving side of the networked logging service's message framing protocol (see Sidebar 9, page 86). It uses the ACE_SOCK_Stream, ACE_Message_Block, and ACE_InputCDR classes along with the extraction operator>> defined on page 79 to read one complete log record from a connected client. This code is portable and interoperable since we demarshal the contents received from the network using the ACE_InputCDR class.

                                                                               1 int Logging_Handler::recv_log_record (ACE_Message_Block *&mblk)
 2 {
 3   ACE_INET_Addr peer_addr;
 4   logging_peer_.get_remote_addr (peer_addr);
 5   mblk = new ACE_Message_Block (MAXHOSTNAMELEN + 1);
 6   peer_addr.get_host_name (mblk->wr_ptr (), MAXHOSTNAMELEN);
 7   mblk->wr_ptr (strlen (mblk->wr_ptr ()) + 1); // Go past name.
 8
 9   ACE_Message_Block *payload =
10     new ACE_Message_Block (ACE_DEFAULT_CDR_BUFSIZE);
11   // Align Message Block for a CDR stream.
12   ACE_CDR::mb_align (payload);
13
14   if (logging_peer_.recv_n (payload->wr_ptr (), 8) == 8) {
15     payload->wr_ptr (8);     // Reflect addition of 8 bytes.
16
17     ACE_InputCDR cdr (payload);
18
19     ACE_CDR::Boolean byte_order;
20     // Use helper method to disambiguate booleans from chars.
21     cdr  >> ACE_InputCDR::to_boolean (byte_order);
22     cdr.reset_byte_order (byte_order);
23
24     ACE_CDR::ULong length;
25     cdr  >>  length;
26
27     payload->size (length + 8);
28
29     if (logging_peer_.recv_n (payload->wr_ptr(), length) > 0) {
30       payload->wr_ptr (length);    // Reflect additional bytes.
31       mblk->cont (payload);
32       return length; // Return length of the log record.
33     }
34   }
35   payload->release ();
36   mblk->release ();
37   payload = mblk = 0;
38   return -1;
39 }

                                                                              第 3-7 行 我们分配一个新的ACE_Message_Block来存储logging_peer_的主机名。我们小心地以 NUL 结尾主机名，并确保只有主机名包含在消息块的当前长度中，该长度定义为wr_ptr () – rd_ptr()。

                                                                              Lines 3–7 We allocate a new ACE_Message_Block in which to store the logging_peer_'s host name. We're careful to NUL-terminate the host name and to ensure that only the host name is included in the current length of the message block, which is defined as wr_ptr () – rd_ptr().

                                                                              第 9-12 行： 我们创建一个单独的ACE_Message_Block来保存日志记录。头部的大小已知（8 字节），因此我们首先接收它。由于我们将使用 CDR 机制在接收到头部后对其进行反序列化，因此我们对新的消息块采取一些与 CDR 相关的预防措施。CDR 能够以可移植的方式反序列化数据，这要求序列化后的数据从 8 字节对齐边界开始。ACE_Message_Block不提供任何对齐保证，因此我们在使用payload->wr_ptr()接收头部之前，调用ACE_CDR::mb_align()来强制进行正确的对齐。对齐可能会导致块内部缓冲区开头出现一些未使用的字节，因此我们必须将有效负载的大小设置为大于它将接收的 8 字节（ACE_DEFAULT_CDR_BUFSIZE 的默认值为 512）。

                                                                              Lines 9–12 We create a separate ACE_Message_Block to hold the log record. The size of the header is known (8 bytes), so we receive that first. Since we'll use the CDR facility to demarshal the header after it's received, we take some CDR-related precautions with the new message block. CDR's ability to demarshal data portably requires the marshaled data start on an 8-byte alignment boundary. ACE_Message_Block doesn't provide any alignment guarantees, so we call ACE_CDR::mb_align() to force proper alignment before using payload->wr_ptr() to receive the header. The alignment may result in some unused bytes at the start of the block's internal buffer, so we must initially size payload larger than the 8 bytes it will receive (ACE_DEFAULT_CDR_BUFSIZE has a default value of 512).

                                                                              第 14-15 行 在成功调用recv_n()获取固定大小的标头后，有效载荷的写入指针向前移动，以反映消息块中增加了 8 个字节。

                                                                              Lines 14–15 Following a successful call to recv_n() to obtain the fixed-sized header, payload's write pointer is advanced to reflect the addition of 8 bytes to the message block.

                                                                              第 17-25 行：我们创建一个 CDR 对象，用于反序列化有效载荷消息块 中的 8 字节头部。CDR 对象会复制该头部，从而避免在反序列化头部的过程中对有效载荷消息块进行任何修改。由于字节顺序指示符是ACE_CDR::Boolean类型，因此无论客户端的字节顺序如何，都可以提取该指示符。然后，根据输入指示的顺序设置 CDR 流的字节顺序，并提取可变大小的日志记录有效载荷的长度。

                                                                              Lines 17–25 We create a CDR object to demarshal the 8-byte header located in the payload message block. The CDR object copies the header, avoiding any alteration of the payload message block as the header is de-marshaled. Since the byte order indicator is a ACE_CDR::Boolean, it can be extracted regardless of the client's byte order. The byte order of the CDR stream is then set according to the order indicated by the input, and the length of the variable-sized log record payload is extracted.

                                                                              第 27-32 行： 既然我们知道了日志记录有效载荷的长度，有效载荷消息块的大小就会被调整以容纳完整的记录。第二次调用`recv_n()`会将剩余的日志记录追加到有效载荷消息块中，紧跟在头部之后。如果一切顺利，我们会更新有效载荷中的写入指针以反映添加的数据，通过其延续字段将有效载荷链接到mblk，并返回日志记录的长度。

                                                                              Lines 27–32 Now that we know the length of the log record payload, the payload message block is resized to hold the complete record. The second recv_n() call appends the remainder of the log record to the payload message block, immediately following the header. If all goes well, we update the write pointer in payload to reflect the added data, chain payload to mblk via its continuation field, and return the length of the log record.

                                                                              第 35-38 行 错误情况会在这里结束，因此我们需要释放mblk和payload中的内存以防止泄漏。

                                                                              Lines 35–38 Error cases end up here, so we need to release the memory in mblk and payload to prevent leaks.

                                                                              recv_log_record ()方法有效地利用了 CDR 流和消息块，以可移植且高效的方式接收日志记录。它利用消息块的延续链来存储客户端应用程序的主机名，其后紧跟包含日志记录的消息块。这两个元素彼此独立，但在应用程序中作为一个整体传递，如图4.5所示。

                                                                              The recv_log_record() method makes effective use of a CDR stream and a message block to portably and efficiently receive a log record. It leverages the message block's continuation chain to store the host name of the client application, followed by the message block holding the log record.These two items are kept separate, yet are passed around the application as a single unit, as shown in Figure 4.5.

                                                                              图 4.5. 日志记录信息的消息区块链

                                                                              Logging_Handler::write_log_record()。 此方法使用ACE_FILE_IO、ACE Message_Block和ACE_InputCDR类以及第 79 页定义的提取运算符>>，将从客户端接收的主机名和日志记录数据格式化并写入日志文件。

                                                                              Logging_Handler::write_log_record(). This method uses the ACE_FILE_IO, ACE Message_Block, and ACE_InputCDR classes together with the extraction operator>> defined on page 79 to format and write the host name and log record data received from a client into a log file.

                                                                               1 int Logging Handler::write_log_record (ACE Message Block *mblk)
 2 {
 3   if (log_file_->send_n (mblk) == -1) return -1;
 4
 5   if (ACE::debug ()) {
 6     ACE_InputCDR cdr (mblk->cont ());
 7     ACE_CDR::Boolean byte_order;
 8     ACE_CDR::ULong length;
 9     cdr >> ACE_InputCDR::to_boolean (byte_order);
10     cdr.reset_byte_order (byte_order);
11     cdr >> length;
12     ACE_Log_Record log_record;
13     cdr >> log_record; // Extract the <ACE_log_record>.
14     log_record.print (mblk->rd_ptr (), 1, cerr);
15   }
16
17   return mblk->total_length ();
18 }

                                                                              第 3 行： 对等主机名位于mblk中，日志记录位于mblk的延续链中。我们使用ACE_FILE_IO中的send_n()方法写入所有通过其cont()指针链接的消息块。该方法内部使用操作系统收集写入操作来降低跨域开销。由于日志文件以 CDR 格式写入，我们需要编写一个单独的程序来读取该文件并以易于阅读的格式显示其值。

                                                                              Line 3 The peer host name is in mblk and the log record is in mblk's continuation chain. We use the send_n() method from ACE_FILE_IO to write all the message blocks chained through their cont() pointers. Internally, this method uses an OS gather-write operation to reduce the domain-crossing penalty. Since the log file is written out in CDR format, we'd need to write a separate program to read the file and display its values in a humanly readable format.

                                                                              第 5-18 行： 如果处于调试模式，我们会从日志记录数据构建一个 CDR 流，并将其内容打印到cerr。由于日志记录的头部仍然位于日志记录消息块中，因此必须提取字节顺序，以确保日志记录本身能够正确反序列化。虽然头部长度不会被使用，但我们提取它是为了确保在调用提取运算符反序列化日志记录时，CDR 流能够正确地定位在日志记录的开头。该方法返回写入日志文件的字节数。

                                                                              Lines 5–18 If we're in debugging mode, we build a CDR stream from the log record data and print its contents to cerr. Since the log record's header is still in the log record message block, the byte order must be extracted to ensure that the log record itself is demarshaled correctly. Although the header's length is not used, we extract it to ensure that the CDR stream is positioned correctly at the start of the log record when the extraction operator is called to demarshal the log record. The method returns the number of bytes written to the log file.

                                                                              Logging_Handler::log_record()。 此方法同时使用recv_log_record()和write_log_record()方法从套接字读取日志记录并将其写入日志文件。

                                                                              Logging_Handler::log_record(). This method uses both the recv_log_record() and the write_log_record() methods to read a log record from a socket and write it to a log file, respectively.

                                                                              int Logging_Handler::log_record ()
{
  ACE_Message_Block *mblk = 0;
  if (recv_log_record (mblk) == -1)
    return -1;
  else {
    int result = write_log_record (mblk);
    mblk->release (); // Free up the entire contents.
    return result == -1 ? -1 : 0;
  }
}

                                                                              release ()调用会删除mblk中的客户端主机名和mblk->cont()中的日志记录。

                                                                              The release() call deletes the client host name in mblk and the log record in mblk->cont().

                                                                              4.4.3 Iterative_Logging_Server 类

                                                                              4.4.3 The Iterative_Logging_Server Class

                                                                              以下代码展示了如何使用 ACE Socket 包装器外观实现迭代式日志服务器。此示例继承了Logging_Server基类中的各种钩子方法，以迭代方式处理客户端日志请求，如下所示：

                                                                              The following code shows how to implement an iterative logging server using the ACE Socket wrapper facades. This example subclasses the various hook methods in the Logging_Server base class to process client logging requests iteratively as follows:

                                                                              1. handle_connections () hook 方法接受来自客户端的新连接。

                                                                              2. The handle_connections() hook method accepts a new connection from a client.

                                                                              3. handle_data () hook 方法会读取并处理来自该客户端的日志记录，直到连接关闭或发生故障为止。

                                                                              4. The handle_data() hook method reads and processes log records from that client until the connection is closed or a failure occurs.

                                                                              5. 返回步骤 1。

                                                                              6. Go back to step 1.

                                                                              首先，我们引入本示例所需的头文件。

                                                                              We first include the header files we'll need for this example.

                                                                              #include "ace/FILE_IO.h"
#include "ace/INET_Addr.h"
#include "ace/Log_Msg.h"

#include "Logging_Server.h"
#include "Logging_Handler.h"

                                                                              接下来，我们创建一个名为Iterative_Logging_Server的类，该类继承自Logging_Server 类，并将该类放入名为Iterative_Logging_Server.h的头文件中。我们定义了数据成员，用于接收来自客户端的日志记录并将数据写入日志文件。

                                                                              We next create an Iterative_Logging_Server class that inherits from Logging_Server and put this class into a header file called Iterative_Logging_Server.h. We define data members that receive log records from a client and write the data to a log file.

                                                                              class Iterative_Logging_Server : public Logging_Server
{
protected:
  ACE_FILE_IO log_file_;
  Logging_Handler logging_handler_;

public:
  Iterative_Logging_Server (): logging_handler_ (log_file_) {}

  Logging_Handler &logging_handler () {
    return logging_handler_;{
  }

protected:
  // Other methods shown below...
};

                                                                              open ()钩子方法使用第 85 页定义的make_log_file()辅助方法创建和/或打开日志文件。如果make_log_file()调用失败，我们将使用侧边栏 10中描述的 ACE_ERROR_RETURN 宏来打印失败原因并返回失败值。如果调用成功，我们将调用父类的open()钩子来初始化ACE_INET_Addr网络地址，日志服务器将在该地址监听客户端连接。

                                                                              The open() hook method creates and/or opens a log file using the make_log_file() helper method defined on page 85. If the call to make_ log_file() fails, we use the ACE_ERROR_RETURN macro described in Sidebar 10 to print the reason and return a failure value. If it succeeds, we call our parent's open() hook to initialize the ACE_INET_Addr networking address where the logging server listens for client connections.

                                                                              virtual int open (u_short port) {
  if (make_log_file (log_file_) == -1)
    ACE_ERROR_RETURN ((LM_ERROR, "%p\n", "make_log_file()"),
                      -l) ;
  return Logging_Server::open (port);
}

                                                                              析构函数会关闭日志文件，如下所示：

                                                                              The destructor closes down the log file, as shown below:

                                                                              virtual ~Iterative_Logging_Server () {
  log_file_.close ();
}

                                                                              侧边栏 10：ACE 调试和错误宏

                                                                              Sidebar 10: ACE Debugging and Error Macros

                                                                              ACE 提供了一组宏，用于以类似printf() 的格式集中打印调试和错误消息。最常用的宏是 ACE_DEBUG、ACE_ERROR 和 ACE_ERROR_RETURN，它们封装了ACE_Log_Msg::log()方法。该方法接受可变数量的参数，因此所有这些宏的第一个参数实际上是一个复合参数，用额外的括号括起来，以便 C++ 预处理器将其视为一个参数。

                                                                              ACE provides a set of macros that consolidate the printing of debugging and error messages via a printf() -like format. The most common macros are ACE_DEBUG, ACE_ERROR, and ACE_ERROR_RETURN, which encapsulate the ACE_Log_Msg::log() method. This method takes a variable number of arguments, so the first argument to all these macros is actually a compound argument wrapped in an extra set of parentheses to make it appear as one argument to the C++ preprocessor.

                                                                              ACE_Log_Msg::log()方法的第一个参数是严重性代码，例如，LM_ERROR 表示一般错误，LM_DEBUG 表示诊断信息。下一个参数是格式字符串，可接受大多数printf()转换说明符。ACE 还定义了一些用于跟踪和日志记录操作的附加格式说明符，包括

                                                                              The first argument to the ACE_Log_Msg:: log() method is the severity code, for example, LM_ERROR for general errors and LM_DEBUG for diagnostic information. The next parameter is a format string that accepts most printf() conversion specifiers. ACE defines some additional format specifiers that are useful for tracing and logging operations, including

                                                                              格式 行动
                                                                              1% 显示发生错误的行号
                                                                              %N 显示发生错误的文件名
                                                                              %n 显示程序名称
                                                                              %P 显示当前进程 ID
                                                                              %p 接受一个const char *参数，并显示该参数以及与errno对应的错误字符串（类似于perror()）。
                                                                              %T 显示当前时间
                                                                              %t 显示调用线程的 ID

                                                                              ACE_ERROR_RETURN 宏是记录错误消息并从当前函数返回值的快捷方式，因此它接受两个参数：第一个参数与其他宏相同，第二个参数是记录消息后从函数返回的值。

                                                                              The ACE_ERROR_RETURN macro is a shortcut for logging an error message and returning a value from the current function, Hence, it takes two arguments: the first is the same as the other macros and the second is the value to return from the function after logging the message.

                                                                              由于我们实现的是一个迭代式服务器，因此可以重用继承的wait_for_multiple_events()方法。这样， handle_connections()方法就会阻塞，直到可以接受下一个客户端连接。

                                                                              We can reuse the inherited wait_for_multiple_events() method since we're implementing an iterative server. Thus, the handle_connections() method simply blocks until it can accept the next client connection.

                                                                              virtual int handle_connections () {
  ACE_INET_Addr logging_peer_addr;

  if (acceptor ().accept (logging_handler_.peer (),
                          &logging_peer_addr) == -1)
    ACE_ERROR_RETURN ( (LM_ERROR, "%p\n", "accept ()"), -1);
  ACE_DEBUG ((LM_DEBUG, "Accepted  connection from %s\n",
             logging_peer_addr.get_host_name ()));
  return 0;
}

                                                                              服务器接受来自客户端的新连接后，其handle_data()钩子方法会继续接收来自该客户端的日志记录，直到连接关闭或发生故障为止。

                                                                              After the server accepts a new connection from a client, its handle_data() hook method continues to receive log records from that client until the connection closes or a failure occurs.

                                                                              virtual int handle_data (ACE_SOCK_Stream *) {
  while (logging_handler_.log_record () != -1)
    continue;

  logging_handler_.close () ; // Close the socket handle.
  return 0;
}

                                                                              main ()函数实例化一个Iterative_Logging_Server对象，并调用其run()方法来迭代处理所有客户端请求。这段代码位于Iterative_Logging_Server.cpp文件中。

                                                                              The main() function instantiates an Iterative_Logging_Server object and calls its run() method to process all client requests iteratively. This code is in file Iterative_Logging_Server.cpp.

                                                                              #include "ace/Log_Msg.h"
#include "Iterative_Logging_Server.h"

int main (int argc, char *argv[])
{
  Iterative_Logging_Server server;

  if (server.run (argc, argv) == -1)
    ACE_ERROR_RETURN ((LM_ERROR, "%p\n", "server.run()"), 1);
  return 0;
}

                                                                              本示例展示了使用 ACE 而非原生 C Socket API 调用来编写网络应用程序是多么容易。第 2.3 节中提到的所有 Socket API 的固有复杂性都已通过使用 ACE 包装外观类得到消除。消除这些复杂性后，应用程序开发人员可以专注于核心应用程序逻辑。请注意，我们展示的大部分源代码都与第4.4.1 节中Logging_Handler方法中的应用程序特定（反）序列化和 I/O 代码有关，而没有涉及直接使用 Socket API 编写的应用程序中常见的“传统”套接字操作、缓冲区管理或字节序处理代码。

                                                                              This example illustrates how much easier it is to program networked applications using ACE instead of the native C Socket API calls. All the Socket API's accidental complexities identified in Section 2.3 have been removed via the use of ACE wrapper facade classes. With this complexity removed, application developers are freed to focus on strategic application logic. Note that most of the source code we've shown is concerned with application-specific (de)marshaling and I/O code in the Logging_Handler methods shown in Section 4.4.1, and none of the "traditional" socket manipulation, buffer management, or byte ordering code found in applications programmed directly to the Socket API.

                                                                              尽管我们的第一个日志服务器经过多次改进，但由于其迭代式服务器设计，其实现仍然存在局限性。本书后续示例将阐述并发模式和 ACE 包装器外观如何帮助克服这些问题。由于日志服务器将Logging_Server和Logging_Handler角色解耦，我们可以在不改变其整体设计的情况下修改其实现细节。

                                                                              Despite its many improvements, however, our first logging server's implementation is limited by its iterative server design. Subsequent examples in this book illustrate how concurrency patterns and ACE wrapper facades help to overcome these problems. Since the logging server decouples the Logging_Server and Logging_Handler roles, we can modify its implementation details without changing its overall design.

                                                                                4.5 客户端应用程序

                                                                                4.5 The Client Application

                                                                                以下客户端应用程序演示了如何使用 ACE 包装器外观来建立连接、编组日志记录并将数据发送到我们的日志服务器。此示例从标准输入读取行，将每一行作为单独的日志记录发送到日志服务器，并在从标准输入读取到文件结束符 (EOF) 时停止。首先，我们包含此代码使用的类所需的 ACE 头文件。最好包含所有与所用类对应的 ACE 头文件。例如，ace/OS.h包含 ACE_DEFAULT_SERVER_HOST 的定义，我们将其用作默认主机名。

                                                                                The following client application illustrates how to use the ACE wrapper facades to establish connections, marshal log records, and send the data to our logging server. This example reads lines from standard input, sends each line to the logging server in a separate log record, and stops when it reads EOF from standard input. We first include the ACE header files needed for the classes this code uses. It's a good idea to specifically include all ACE headers corresponding to the classes used. For example, ace/OS .h includes a definition of ACE_DEFAULT_SERVER_HOST, which we use as the default host name.

                                                                                #include "ace/OS.h"
#include "ace/CDR_Stream.h"
#include "ace/INET_Addr.h"
#include "ace/SOCK_Connector.h"
#include "ace/SOCK_Stream.h"
#include "ace/Log_Record.h"
#include "ace/streams.h"
#include <string>

                                                                                我们包含了ace/streams.h 文件，其中包含用于提高 C++ iostream 可移植性的条件代码。根据 ACE 中的配置设置，它会包含正确格式的头文件（例如，<iostream>而不是<iostream.h>）。如果 iostream 位于std命名空间中，ace/streams.h文件会将使用的类引入全局命名空间。

                                                                                We include ace/streams.h, which contains the conditional code to make the use of C++ iostreams more portable. Based on configuration settings in ACE, it includes the proper form of header file (e.g., <iostream> vs. <iostream.h>). If the iostreams are supplied in the std namespace, the ace/streams.h file brings the classes used into the global namespace.

                                                                                我们首先定义一个Logging_Client类，其send()方法通过连接的ACE_SOCK_Stream发送一条ACE_Log_Record。该类还实现了一个辅助方法，该方法返回对其ACE_SOCK_Stream实例的引用，以及一个用于关闭底层套接字句柄的析构函数。

                                                                                We start by defining a Logging_Client class whose send() method transmits one ACE_Log_Record over a connected ACE_SOCK_Stream. This class also implements a helper method that returns a reference to its ACE_SOCK_Stream instance and a destructor that closes the underlying socket handle.

                                                                                class Logging Client
{
public:
  // Send <log_record> to the server.
  int send (const ACE_Log_Record &log_record);

  // Accessor method.
  ACE_SOCK_Stream &peer () { return logging_peer_; }

  // Close the connection to the server.
  ~Logging_Client () { logging_peer_.close (); }

private:
  ACE_SOCK_Stream logging_peer_; // Connected to server.
}

                                                                                Logging_Client ::send()方法实现了第 86 页侧边栏 9中描述的消息帧机制的发送方。该方法具有可移植性和互操作性，因为它使用第 79 页定义的插入运算符 ( operator<< ) 将日志记录的内容编组到ACE_OutputCDR流中。

                                                                                The Logging_Client::send() method implements the sender side of the message framing mechanism described in Sidebar 9 on page 86. This method is portable and interoperable since it uses the insertion operator (operator<<) defined on page 79 to marshal the contents of the log record into an ACE_OutputCDR stream.

                                                                                 1 int Logging_Client::send (const ACE_Log_Record &log_record) {
 2   const size_t max_payload_size =
 3       4 // type()
 4     + 8 // timestamp
 5     + 4 // process id
 6     + 4 // data length
 7     + MAXLOGMSGLEN // data
 8     + ACE_CDR::MAX_ALIGNMENT; // padding;
 9
10   ACE_OutputCDR payload (max_payload_size);
11   payload << log_record;
12   ACE_CDR::ULong length = payload.total_length ();
13
14   ACE_OutputCDR header (ACE_CDR::MAX_ALIGNMENT + 8);
15   header << ACE_OutputCDR::from_boolean (ACE_CDR_BYTE_ORDER);
16   header << ACE_CDR::ULong (length);
17
18   iovec iov[2];
19   iov [0].iov_base = header.begin ()->rd_ptr ();
20   iov[0] .iov_len = 8;
21   iov [1].iov_base = payload.begin ()->rd_ptr ();
22   iov[1] .iov_len = length;
23
24   return logging_peer_.sendv_n (iov, 2);
25 }

                                                                                第 2-12 行我们为完整的ACE_Log_Record 分配足够的空间，将log_record的内容插入到有效载荷CDR 流中，并获取流使用的字节数。

                                                                                Lines 2–12 We allocate enough space for a complete ACE_Log_Record, insert the contents of log_record into the payload CDR stream, and get the number of bytes used by the stream.

                                                                                第 14-16 行 接下来，我们创建一个 CDR 编码的标头，以便接收方可以确定传入 CDR 流的字节顺序和大小。

                                                                                Lines 14–16 We next create a CDR-encoded header so the receiver can determine the byte order and size of the incoming CDR stream.

                                                                                第 18-24 行 我们使用iovec通过单个sendv_n () gather-write 方法调用来高效地发送标头和有效载荷 CDR 流。

                                                                                Lines 18–24 We use an iovec to efficiently send the header and payload CDR streams using a single sendv_n () gather-write method call.

                                                                                最后，我们展示客户端应用程序的main()函数。

                                                                                Finally, we show the client application's main() function.

                                                                                第 3-19 行： 如果 TCP 端口和主机名作为命令行参数传递，我们将使用它们来初始化日志服务器被动监听并接受连接的网络端点。否则，我们将使用默认设置。

                                                                                Lines 3–19 If the TCP port and host name are passed as command-line arguments, we use them to initialize the network endpoint where the logging server listens passively to accept connections. Otherwise, we use the default settings.

                                                                                第 21-29 行：接下来，我们尝试使用上面初始化的ACE_INET_Addr 连接到日志服务器。连接尝试通过ACE_SOCK_Connector进行。如果成功，则logging_client对象的套接字将被连接。

                                                                                Lines 21–29 We next try to connect to the logging server using the ACE_INET_Addr initialized above. The connection is attempted via an ACE_SOCK_Connector. If successful, the logging_client object's socket is connected.

                                                                                第 31-47 行 最后，我们展示了主客户端事件循环，该循环会持续从标准输入读取缓冲区并将其转发到日志服务器，直到遇到文件结束符 (EOF)。ACE_Log_Record类保存记录一条日志所需的信息，并包含用于设置和获取日志记录数据的方法。我们使用第 96 页定义的Logging_Client::send()方法来简化ACE_Log_Record 的编组和传输。

                                                                                Lines 31–47 Finally, we show the main client event loop, which keeps reading buffers from the standard input and forwarding them to the logging server until an EOF occurs. The ACE_Log_Record class holds the information for logging one record and contains methods to set and get log record data. We use the Logging_Client::send() method defined on page 96 to simplify the ACE_Log_Record marshaling and transmission.

                                                                                此客户端日志应用程序是对 ACE 中网络日志服务的简化。实际的 ACE 日志功能基于ACE_Log_Msg类。侧边栏 10中描述的宏使用了ACE_Log_Msg类（特别是其ACE_Log_Msg::log()方法）。在去除一些不必要的复杂性之后，日志客户端代码本身相对简单。因此，随着本书对日志服务的进一步阐述，示例将重点放在服务器端，因为它们能够更好地展现解复用、并发和同步方面的挑战。

                                                                                This client logging application is a simplification of the networked logging service in ACE. The actual ACE logging facility is based on the ACE_Log_Msg class. The macros described in Sidebar 10 use the ACE_Log_Msg class (particularly its ACE_Log_Msg::log() method). The logging client code itself is relatively simple after the accidental complexities have been removed. As we continue to develop the logging service in the book, therefore, the examples will focus on servers since they illustrate the most interesting demultiplexing, concurrency, and synchronization challenges.

                                                                                  4.6 总结

                                                                                  4.6 Summary

                                                                                  在本章中，我们将 ACE Socket 包装器外观以及 ACE 消息缓冲和（反）序列化类应用到了网络日志服务的初始客户端/服务器实现中。在本书后续章节中，我们将继续使用这些 ACE 类，以确保我们的网络日志服务实现具有可移植性、简洁性和高效性。完整的日志服务包含在 ACE 的网络服务组件中，这些组件在第 16 页的0.4.4 节中有详细介绍。

                                                                                  In this chapter, we applied the ACE Socket wrapper facades and the ACE message buffering and (de)marshaling classes to the initial client/server implementation of our networked logging service. We'll continue to use these ACE classes throughout the book to keep our networked logging service implementations portable, concise, and efficient. A complete logging service is available as part of ACE's networked service components, which are outlined in Section 0.4.4 on page 16.

                                                                                    第二部分：并发面向对象网络编程

                                                                                    Part II: Concurrent Object-Oriented Network Programming

                                                                                      第五章 并发设计维度

                                                                                    第五章 并发设计维度

                                                                                    Chapter 5. Concurrency Design Dimensions

                                                                                    章节概要

                                                                                    Chapter Synopsis

                                                                                    并发性对于开发可扩展且健壮的网络应用程序（尤其是服务器）至关重要。本章将对并发设计维度进行领域分析，阐述管理进程、线程和同步器正确使用的策略和机制。本章涵盖以下设计维度：

                                                                                    Concurrency is essential to develop scalable and robust networked applications, particularly servers. This chapter presents a domain analysis of concurrency design dimensions that address the policies and mechanisms governing the proper use of processes, threads, and synchronizers. We cover the following design dimensions in this chapter:

                                                                                    • 迭代式服务器、并发式服务器和响应式服务器

                                                                                    • Iterative versus concurrent versus reactive servers

                                                                                    • 进程与线程

                                                                                    • Processes versus threads

                                                                                    • 进程/线程生成策略

                                                                                    • Process/thread spawning strategies

                                                                                    • 用户线程、内核线程和混合线程模型

                                                                                    • User versus kernel versus hybrid threading models

                                                                                    • 分时课程与实时课程安排

                                                                                    • Time-shared versus real-time scheduling classes

                                                                                    • 基于任务的架构与基于消息的架构

                                                                                    • Task- versus message-based architectures

                                                                                      5.1 迭代式、并发式和响应式服务器

                                                                                      5.1 Iterative, Concurrent, and Reactive Servers

                                                                                      服务器可以分为迭代式、并发式和响应式三种类型。这一维度的主要权衡在于编程的简易性与扩展以应对不断增长的服务产品和主机负载的能力之间的平衡。

                                                                                      Servers can be categorized as either iterative, concurrent, or reactive. The primary trade-offs in this dimension involve simplicity of programming versus the ability to scale to increased service offerings and host loads.

                                                                                      迭代式服务器会完整处理每个客户端请求，然后再处理后续请求。因此，在处理请求的过程中，迭代式服务器会将其他请求排队或忽略。迭代式服务器最适合以下两种情况：

                                                                                      Iterative servers handle each client request in its entirety before servicing subsequent requests. While processing a request, an iterative server therefore either queues or ignores additional requests. Iterative servers are best suited for either

                                                                                      • 持续时间较短的服务，例如标准的 Internet ECHO 和 DAYTIME 服务，其执行时间变化极小。

                                                                                      • Short-duration services, such as the standard Internet ECHO and DAYTIME services, that have minimal execution time variation or

                                                                                      • 运行频率较低的服务，例如在平台负载较低时每晚运行的远程文件系统备份服务。

                                                                                      • Infrequently run services, such as a remote file system backup service that runs nightly when platforms are lightly loaded

                                                                                      迭代式服务器的开发相对简单。图 5.1 (1) 展示了它们通常如何在单个进程地址空间内内部执行服务请求，如下面的伪代码所示：

                                                                                      Iterative servers are relatively straightforward to develop. Figure 5.1 (1) illustrates how they often execute their service requests internally within a single process address space, as shown by the following pseudo-code:

                                                                                      void iterative server()
{
  initialize listener endpoint(s)

  for (each new client request) {
    retrieve next request from an input source
    perform requested service
    if (response required) send response to client
  }
}
                                                                                      图 5.1. 迭代/响应式服务器与并发服务器

                                                                                      由于这种迭代结构，每个请求的处理都是在相对粗粒度的级别上串行化的，例如，在应用程序和操作系统同步事件多路复用器（如select()或WaitForMultipleObjects()）之间的接口处。然而，这种粗粒度的并发级别可能会未能充分利用主机平台上可用的某些处理资源（例如多个 CPU）和操作系统功能（例如对与 I/O 设备进行并行 DMA 传输的支持）。

                                                                                      Due to this iterative structure, the processing of each request is serialized at a relatively coarse-grained level, for example, at the interface between the application and an OS synchronous event demultiplexer, such as select() or WaitForMultipleObjects(). However, this coarse-grained level of concurrency can underutilize certain processing resources (such as multiple CPUs) and OS features (such as support for parallel DMA transfer to/from I/O devices) that are available on a host platform.

                                                                                      迭代式服务器还可能导致客户端在等待服务器处理请求时无法继续执行操作。服务器端延迟过高会使应用程序和中间件级别的重传超时计算变得复杂，从而引发过多的网络流量。此外，根据客户端和服务器之间用于交换请求的协议类型，服务器也可能收到重复的请求。

                                                                                      Iterative servers can also prevent clients from making progress while they are blocked waiting for a server to process their requests. Excessive server-side delays complicate application and middleware-level retransmission time-out calculations, which can trigger excessive network traffic. Depending on the types of protocols used to exchange requests between client and server, duplicate requests may also be received by a server.

                                                                                      如图 5.1 (2)所示，并发服务器可以同时处理来自多个客户端的请求。根据操作系统和硬件平台的不同，并发服务器可以使用多个线程或多个进程来执行其服务。如果服务器是单服务服务器，则可以同时运行同一服务的多个副本。如果服务器是多服务服务器，也可以同时运行不同服务的多个副本。

                                                                                      Concurrent servers handle multiple requests from clients simultaneously, as shown in Figure 5.1 (2). Depending on the OS and hardware platform, a concurrent server either executes its services using multiple threads or multiple processes. If the server is a single-service server, multiple copies of the same service can run simultaneously. If the server is a multiservice server, multiple copies of different services may also run simultaneously.

                                                                                      并发服务器非常适合 I/O 密集型服务和/或执行时间不固定的长时间运行服务。与迭代服务器不同，并发服务器允许使用更细粒度的同步技术，在应用程序定义的级别对请求进行序列化。这种设计需要同步机制，例如信号量或互斥锁[ EKB92 ]，以确保同时运行的进程和线程之间能够进行稳健的协作和数据共享。我们将在第 6 章中探讨这些机制，并在第 10 章中展示它们的使用示例。

                                                                                      Concurrent servers are well-suited for I/O-bound services and/or long-duration services that require variable amounts of time to execute. Unlike iterative servers, concurrent servers allow finer grained synchronization techniques that serialize requests at an application-defined level. This design requires synchronization mechanisms, such as semaphores or mutex locks [EKB92], to ensure robust cooperation and data sharing between processes and threads that run simultaneously. We examine these mechanisms in Chapter 6 and show examples of their use in Chapter 10.

                                                                                      正如我们将在5.2 节中看到的，并发服务器可以采用多种结构，例如，使用多个进程或线程。一种常见的并发服务器设计是每个请求一个线程，其中主线程会生成一个单独的工作线程来并发地处理每个客户端请求：

                                                                                      As we'll see in Section 5.2, concurrent servers can be structured various ways, for example, with multiple processes or threads. A common concurrent server design is thread-per-request, where a master thread spawns a separate worker thread to perform each client request concurrently:

                                                                                      void master thread()
{
  initialize listener endpoint(s)

  for (each new client request) {
    receive the request
    spawn new worker thread and pass request to this thread
  }
}

                                                                                      主线程继续监听新的请求，而工作线程则处理客户端请求，如下所示：

                                                                                      The master thread continues to listen for new requests, while the worker thread processes the client request, as follows:

                                                                                      void worker thread()
{
  perform requested service
  if (response required) send response to client
  terminate thread
}

                                                                                      修改这种每个请求一个线程的模型，使其支持其他并发服务器模型（例如每个连接一个线程）非常简单：

                                                                                      It's straightforward to modify this thread-per-request model to support other concurrent server models, such as thread-per-connection:

                                                                                      void master thread()
{
  initialize listener endpoint(s)

  for (each new client connection) {
    accept connection
    spawn new worker thread and pass connection to this thread
  }
}

                                                                                      在这种设计中，主线程持续监听新的连接，而工作线程则处理来自连接的客户端请求，如下所示：

                                                                                      In this design, the master thread continues to listen for new connections, while the worker thread processes client requests from the connection, as follows:

                                                                                      void worker_thread()
{
  for (each request on the connection) {
    receive the request
    perform requested service
    if (response required) send response to client
  }
}

                                                                                      每个连接对应一个线程的机制为客户端请求的优先级排序提供了良好的支持。例如，来自高优先级客户端的连接可以关联到高优先级线程。由于操作系统可以抢占低优先级线程，因此来自高优先级客户端的请求将优先于来自低优先级客户端的请求得到处理。

                                                                                      Thread-per-connection provides good support for prioritization of client requests. For instance, connections from high-priority clients can be associated with high-priority threads. Requests from higher-priority clients will therefore be served ahead of requests from lower-priority clients since the OS can preempt lower-priority threads.

                                                                                      第 5.3 节阐述了其他几种并发服务器模型，例如线程池和进程池。

                                                                                      Section 5.3 illustrates several other concurrent server models, such as thread pool and process pool.

                                                                                      响应式服务器几乎可以同时处理多个请求，尽管所有处理实际上都在单个线程中完成。在操作系统平台广泛支持多线程之前，并发处理通常通过同步事件多路复用策略来实现，其中多个服务请求由单线程进程按轮询顺序处理。例如，标准的 X Windows 服务器就是以这种方式运行的。

                                                                                      Reactive servers process multiple requests virtually simultaneously, although all processing is actually done in a single thread. Before multithreading was widely available on OS platforms, concurrent processing was often implemented via a synchronous event demultiplexing strategy where multiple service requests were handled in round-robin order by a single-threaded process. For instance, the standard X Windows server operates this way.

                                                                                      响应式服务器可以通过显式地对每个请求进行时间片轮转来实现，这可以通过同步事件多路复用机制来实现，例如第 6 章中描述的select()和WaitForMultipleObjects() 。以下伪代码展示了基于select() 的响应式服务器中常用的编程风格：

                                                                                      A reactive server can be implemented by explicitly time-slicing attention to each request via synchronous event demultiplexing mechanisms, such as select() and WaitForMultipleObjects() described in Chapter 6. The following pseudo-code illustrates the typical style of programming used in a reactive server based on select():

                                                                                      void reactive_server()
{
  initialize listener endpoint(s)

  // Event loop.
  for (;;) {
    select() on multiple endpoints for client requests
    for (each active client request) {
      receive the request
      perform requested service
      if (response is necessary) send response to client
    }
  }
}

                                                                                      虽然该服务器可以在一段时间内服务多个客户端，但从服务器的角度来看，它本质上是迭代式的。因此，与充分利用操作系统对多线程的全面支持相比，使用这种技术开发的应用程序存在以下局限性：

                                                                                      Although this server can service multiple clients over a period of time, it's fundamentally iterative from the server's perspective. Compared with taking advantage of full-fledged OS support for multithreading, therefore, applications developed using this technique possess the following limitations:

                                                                                      • 编程复杂度增加。 某些类型的网络应用程序，例如 I/O 密集型服务器，很难使用响应式服务器模型进行编程。例如，开发人员需要显式地让出事件循环线程，并手动保存和恢复上下文信息。因此，为了让客户端感知到它们的请求是并发处理的而不是迭代处理的，每个请求的执行时间必须相对较短。同样，耗时较长的操作（例如下载大型文件）必须显式地编程为有限状态机，以跟踪对象的处理步骤，同时响应其他对象的事件。随着状态数量的增加，这种设计会变得难以管理。

                                                                                      • Increased programming complexity. Certain types of networked applications, such as I/O-bound servers, are hard to program with a reactive server model. For example, developers are responsible for yielding the event loop thread explicitly and saving and restoring context information manually. For clients to perceive that their requests are being handled concurrently rather than iteratively, therefore, each request must execute for a relatively short duration. Likewise, long-duration operations, such as downloading large files, must be programmed explicitly as finite state machines that keep track of an object's processing steps while reacting to events for other objects. This design can become unwieldy as the number of states increases.

                                                                                      • 可靠性和性能下降。例如，如果某个服务进入无限循环或因死锁 而无限期挂起，则单个操作失败会导致整个服务器进程挂起。此外，即使整个进程没有失败，如果操作系统在某个服务调用系统函数或发生页面错误时阻塞整个进程，其性能也会下降。反之，如果仅使用非阻塞方法，则很难通过诸如 DMA 等利用数据和指令缓存局部性的高级技术来提高性能。如第 6 章所述，操作系统多线程机制可以通过自动执行运行在不同线程中的独立服务的抢占式并行执行来克服这些性能限制。一种无需采用完整的并发服务器解决方案即可解决这些问题的方法是使用异步 I/O，这在侧边栏 11中有详细介绍。

                                                                                      • Decreased dependability and performance. An entire server process can hang if a single operation fails, for example, if a service goes into an infinite loop or hangs indefinitely in a deadlock. Moreover, even if the entire process doesn't fail, its performance will degrade if the OS blocks the whole process whenever one service calls a system function or incurs a page fault. Conversely, if only nonblocking methods are used, it can be hard to improve performance via advanced techniques, such as DMA, that benefit from locality of reference in data and instruction caches. As discussed in Chapter 6, OS multithreading mechanisms can overcome these performance limitations by automating preemptive and parallel execution of independent services running in separate threads. One way to work around these problems without going to a full-blown concurrent server solution is to use asynchronous I/O, which is described in Sidebar 11.

                                                                                      侧边栏 11：异步 I/O 和主动式服务器

                                                                                      Sidebar 11: Asynchronous I/O and Proactive Servers

                                                                                      在单线程服务器中处理多个 I/O 流的另一种机制是异步 I/O。该机制允许服务器通过一个或多个 I/O 句柄发起 I/O 请求，而无需等待请求完成。操作系统会在请求完成后通知调用者，然后服务器可以继续处理已完成的 I/O 句柄。异步 I/O 可在以下操作系统平台上使用：

                                                                                      Yet another mechanism for handling multiple I/O streams in a single-threaded server is asynchronous I/O. This mechanism allows a server to initiate I/O requests via one or more I/O handles without blocking for completion. Instead, the OS notifies the caller when requests are complete, and the server can then continue processing on the completed I/O handles. Asynchronous I/O is available on the following OS platforms:

                                                                                      • Win32 通过重叠 I/O 和 I/O 完成端口支持此功能 [ Ric97 , Sol98 ]。

                                                                                      • It's supported on Win32 via overlapped I/O and I/O completion ports [Ric97, Sol98].

                                                                                      • 一些符合 POSIX 标准的平台实现了aio_*()系列异步 I/O 函数（POS95、Gal95）。

                                                                                      • Some POSIX-compliant platforms implement the aio_*() family of asynchronous I/O functions (POS95, Gal95).

                                                                                      然而，由于异步 I/O 的实现不如多线程或同步事件解复用那样具有可移植性，因此本书不再对其进行深入探讨。

                                                                                      Since asynchronous I/O isn't implemented as portably as multithreading or synchronous event demultiplexing, however, we don't consider it further in this book.

                                                                                      在[ SH ]中，我们讨论了异步I/O，并介绍了ACE Proactor框架，该框架实现了Proactor模式（SSRB00）。这种模式允许事件驱动型应用程序在异步操作完成时高效地解复用和分发服务请求，从而在不承担并发某些缺陷的情况下获得并发的性能优势。ACE Proactor框架可在Win32和支持aio_*()系列异步I/O函数的POSIX兼容平台上运行。

                                                                                      Asynchronous I/O is discussed in [SH] when we present the ACE Proactor framework, which implements the Proactor pattern (SSRB00). This pattern allows event-driven applications to demultiplex and dispatch service requests efficiently when they are triggered by the completion of asynchronous operations, thereby achieving the performance benefits of concurrency without incurring certain of its liabilities. The ACE Proactor framework runs on Win32 and on POSIX-compliant platforms that support the aio_*() family of asynchronous I/O functions.

                                                                                      日志服务为了简化起见，我们在 第 4 章 中对网络日志服务的初始实现采用了迭代式服务器设计。后续章节将扩展日志服务器的功能和可扩展性，具体如下：第 7 章将服务器扩展为响应式设计，第 8 章阐述了使用多进程的并发设计，第 9 章展示了几种使用多线程的并发设计。

                                                                                      Logging service For simplicity, the initial implementation of our networked logging service in Chapter 4 used an iterative server design. Subsequent chapters extend the capabilities and scalability of our logging server as follows: Chapter 7 extends the server to show a reactive style, Chapter 8 illustrates a concurrent style using multiple processes, and Chapter 9 shows several concurrent designs using multiple threads.

                                                                                        5.2 进程与线程

                                                                                        5.2 Processes versus Threads

                                                                                        第 5.1 节描述了并发服务器的优势，并发服务器可以使用多个进程或多个线程来实现。这方面的主要权衡取舍涉及健壮性、效率和可扩展性。

                                                                                        Section 5.1 described the benefits of concurrent servers, which can be implemented using multiple processes or multiple threads. The primary tradeoffs in this dimension involve robustness, efficiency, and scalability.

                                                                                        多进程。 进程是操作系统中为程序指令执行提供上下文的实体。每个进程管理着特定的资源，例如虚拟内存、I/O句柄和信号处理程序，并通过内存管理单元（MMU）硬件与其他操作系统进程隔离。在UNIX系统中，通过fork()函数创建的进程以及在Win32系统中，通过CreateProcess()函数创建的进程，会在与其调用者不同的地址空间中并发执行。这些机制将在第8章中进行详细探讨。

                                                                                        Multiprocessing. A process is the OS entity that provides the context for executing program instructions. Each process manages certain resources, such as virtual memory, I/O handles, and signal handlers, and is protected from other OS processes via memory management unit (MMU) hardware. Processes created by fork() on UNIX and by CreateProcess() on Win32 execute concurrently in different address spaces than their callers. These mechanisms are examined closely in Chapter 8.

                                                                                        早期操作系统，例如 BSD UNIX [ MBKQ96 ]，为每个进程仅提供单线程控制。这种单线程进程模型可以增强系统的健壮性，因为进程之间在没有程序员显式干预的情况下无法相互干扰。例如，进程之间只能通过共享内存或本地进程间通信（IPC）机制进行协作，如图5.2 (1) 所示。

                                                                                        Earlier-generation operating systems, such as BSD UNIX [MBKQ96], provided processes with just one thread of control. This single-threaded process model can enhance robustness since processes can't interfere with one another without explicit programmer intervention. For example, processes can collaborate with each other only via shared memory or local IPC mechanisms, as shown in Figure 5.2 (1).

                                                                                        图 5.2. 多进程与多线程

                                                                                        然而，使用单线程进程开发某些类型的应用程序，特别是高性能或实时服务器，会比较困难。需要相互通信或响应管理请求的服务器必须使用某种形式的进程间通信（IPC），这增加了它们的复杂性。此外，使用多进程也很难对调度和进程优先级进行高效、细粒度的控制。

                                                                                        It's hard to use single-threaded processes, however, to develop certain types of applications, particularly high-performance or real-time servers. Servers that need to communicate with each other or respond to management requests must use some form of IPC, which adds to their complexity. It's also hard to exert efficient, fine-grain control over scheduling and process priority using multiprocessing.

                                                                                        多线程。 为了缓解上述进程问题，大多数操作系统平台现在都支持在进程内执行多个线程。线程是在进程的保护域上下文中执行的一系列指令步骤，如图5.2 (2) 所示。除了指令指针之外，线程还管理某些资源，例如函数激活记录的运行时堆栈、一组寄存器、信号掩码、优先级和线程特定数据。如果有多个 CPU 可用，多线程服务器中的服务可以并行执行 [ EKB + 92 ]。在许多 UNIX 版本中，线程由pthread_create()函数创建；在 Win32 系统中，线程由CreateThread() 函数创建。

                                                                                        Multithreading. To alleviate the problems with processes outlined above, most OS platforms now support multiple threads within a process. A thread is a single sequence of instruction steps executed in the context of a process's protection domain, as shown in Figure 5.2 (2). In addition to an instruction pointer, a thread manages certain resources, such as a runtime stack of function activation records, a set of registers, signal masks, priorities, and thread-specific data. If multiple CPUs are available, services in multithreaded servers can execute in parallel [EKB+92]. On many versions of UNIX, threads are spawned by pthread_create() ; on Win32 they are spawned by CreateThread().

                                                                                        实现并发网络应用程序，将多个操作分别在不同的线程而不是不同的进程中执行，可以减少以下并发开销来源：

                                                                                        Implementing concurrent networked applications that perform multiple operations in separate threads rather than in separate processes can reduce the following sources of concurrency overhead:

                                                                                        • 线程创建和上下文切换。 由于线程维护的状态比进程少，因此线程创建和上下文切换的开销可以低于相应的进程生命周期活动。例如，进程范围内的资源（例如虚拟地址映射和缓存）在进程内切换线程时无需更改。

                                                                                        • Thread creation and context switching. Since threads maintain less state than processes, thread creation and context switching overhead can be lower than the corresponding process lifecycle activities. For example, process-wide resources, such as virtual address mappings and caches, needn't change when switching between threads in a process.

                                                                                        • 同步。 在调度和执行应用程序线程时，可能不需要在内核模式和用户模式之间切换。同样，进程内同步通常比进程间同步开销更小，因为被同步的对象是进程本地的，因此可能不需要内核干预。相比之下，进程间线程同步通常涉及操作系统内核。

                                                                                        • Synchronization. It may not be necessary to switch between kernel mode and user mode when scheduling and executing an application thread. Likewise, intraprocess synchronization is often less expensive than interprocess synchronization because the objects being synchronized are local to a process and may therefore require no kernel intervention. In contrast, interprocess thread synchronization generally involves the OS kernel.

                                                                                        • 数据复制。 线程可以使用进程本地内存共享信息，这具有以下优点：

                                                                                          1. 它通常比使用共享内存或本地 IPC 机制在进程间通信更高效，因为数据不需要通过内核进行复制。

                                                                                          2. 在进程本地内存中使用 C++ 对象更容易，因为不存在类虚函数表布局的问题（参见第 30 页的侧边栏 3）。

                                                                                          例如，对于引用驻留在进程本地内存中的公共数据结构的协作数据库服务，使用多线程实现比使用多进程实现更简单、更高效。

                                                                                          由于这些优化，多线程通常可以显著提升应用程序的性能。例如，I/O 密集型应用程序可以从多线程中受益，因为计算密集型服务可以与磁盘和网络操作重叠执行。然而，操作系统平台支持线程并不意味着所有应用程序都应该使用多线程。特别是，在使用多线程实现并发应用程序时，会出现以下限制：

                                                                                        • Data copying. Threads can share information using process-local memory, which has the following benefits:

                                                                                          1. It's often more efficient than using shared memory or local IPC mechanisms to communicate between processes because data needn't be copied through the kernel.

                                                                                          2. It's easier to use C++ objects in process-local memory since there's no problem with class virtual table layouts (see Sidebar 3 on page 30).

                                                                                          For example, cooperating database services that reference common data structures resident in process-local memory are simpler and more efficient to implement with multiple threads than with multiple processes.

                                                                                          As a result of these optimizations, multithreading can often improve application performance significantly. For example, I/O-bound applications can benefit from multithreading since compute-intensive services can be overlapped with disk and network operations. Just because an OS platform supports threads, however, doesn't imply that all applications should be multithreaded. In particular, the following limitations arise when using multithreading to implement concurrent applications:

                                                                                        • 性能下降。 一个常见的误解是，多线程本质上就能提升应用程序性能。然而，很多时候，由于多种原因，多线程并不能提升性能，其中包括：

                                                                                          1. 单处理器上的计算密集型应用程序无法从多线程中受益，因为计算和通信无法并行运行。

                                                                                          2. 细粒度的锁定策略可能会产生较高的同步开销，从而阻止应用程序充分利用并行处理的优势[ SS95 ]。

                                                                                        • Performance degradation. A common misconception is that threading inherently improves application performance. Many times, however, threading doesn't improve performance for several reasons, including:

                                                                                          1. Compute-bound applications on a uniprocessor won't benefit from multithreading since computations and communication can't run in parallel.

                                                                                          2. Fine-grained locking strategies can yield high synchronization overhead, which prevents applications from fully exploiting the benefits of parallel processing [SS95].

                                                                                        • 鲁棒性降低。 为了减少上下文切换和同步开销，线程之间几乎没有或完全没有内存管理单元 (MMU) 保护。在单个进程地址空间内通过线程执行所有任务会降低应用程序的鲁棒性，原因有以下几点：

                                                                                          1. 同一进程地址空间内的不同线程之间缺乏有效的隔离。因此，进程中一个服务出现故障可能会破坏进程内其他线程上运行的服务所共享的全局数据。这反过来可能导致错误的结果、整个进程崩溃，或者应用程序无限期地挂起。

                                                                                          2. 在一个线程中调用某些操作系统函数可能会对整个进程产生不良副作用；例如，UNIX 的exit()函数和 Win32 的ExitProcess()函数会产生终止进程内所有线程的副作用。

                                                                                        • Reduced robustness. To reduce context switching and synchronization overhead, threads receive little or no MMU protection from each other. Executing all tasks via threads within a single process address space can reduce application robustness for several reasons, including:

                                                                                          1. Separate threads within the same process address space aren't well protected from each other. One faulty service in a process can therefore corrupt global data shared by services running on other threads in the process. This, in turn, may produce incorrect results, crash an entire process, or cause an application to hang indefinitely.

                                                                                          2. Certain OS functions invoked in one thread can have undesirable side effects on an entire process; for example, the UNIX exit() and Win32 ExitProcess() functions have the side effect of terminating all the threads within a process.

                                                                                        • 缺乏细粒度的访问控制。 在大多数操作系统中，进程是访问控制的粒度。因此，多线程的另一个局限性在于，进程内的所有线程共享相同的用户 ID 和对文件及其他受保护资源的访问权限。为了防止意外或故意访问未经授权的资源，基于进程所有权构建安全机制的网络服务（例如 TELNET）通常运行在单独的进程中。

                                                                                        • Lack of fine-grained access control. On most operating systems, a process is the granularity of access control. Another limitation with multithreading, therefore, is that all threads within a process share the same user ID and access privileges to files and other protected resources. To prevent accidental or intentional access to unauthorized resources, network services, such as TELNET, that base their security mechanisms on process ownership often run in separate processes.

                                                                                        日志服务 我们网络化日志服务中的日志服务器并发实现方式多种多样。第 8 章和第9章分别使用多进程和多线程来实现并发日志服务器。

                                                                                        Logging service The concurrent implementations of the logging server in our networked logging service can be implemented in a variety of ways. Chapters 8 and 9 use multiple processes and multiple threads, respectively, to implement concurrent logging servers.

                                                                                          5.3 进程/线程生成策略

                                                                                          5.3 Process/Thread Spawning Strategies

                                                                                          生成进程和线程有多种策略。不同的策略可用于在不同情况下优化服务器并发性能，从而使开发人员能够调整服务器并发级别，以匹配客户端需求和可用的操作系统处理资源。如下所示，不同的策略以降低启动开销为代价，换取更高的资源消耗。

                                                                                          There are various strategies for spawning processes and threads.
