Different strategies can be used to optimize concurrent server performance under different circumstances, thereby enabling developers to tune server concurrency levels to match client demands and available OS processing resources. As shown below, the different strategies trade off decreased startup overhead for increased resource consumption.

                                                                                          预启动策略。 该策略在服务器创建时预先启动一个或多个操作系统进程或线程。这些“热启动”的执行资源形成一个资源池，通过在请求必须被处理之前承担服务启动开销来提高响应速度。该资源池可以根据各种因素（例如可用 CPU 数量、当前机器负载或客户端请求队列长度）进行静态和/或动态扩展或收缩。图 5.3 (1) 展示了一种线程的预启动策略。该设计采用半同步/半异步模式 [ SSRB00 ]，将来自 I/O 层的请求传递给线程池中的工作线程。

                                                                                          Eager spawning. This strategy prespawns one or more OS processes or threads at server creation time. These "warm-started" execution resources form a pool that improves response time by incurring service startup overhead before requests must be serviced. This pool can be expanded or contracted statically and/or dynamically depending on various factors, such as number of available CPUs, current machine load, or the length of a client request queue. Figure 5.3 (1) depicts an eager spawning strategy for threads. This design uses the Half-Sync/Half-Async pattern [SSRB00], which feeds requests from an I/O layer up to a worker in the pool of threads.

                                                                                          图 5.3. 线程池急切产卵策略

                                                                                          另一种快速生成线程的策略是使用领导者/跟随者模式[ SSRB00 ]管理线程池，如图 5.3 (2)所示。该模式定义了一个高效的并发模型，其中多个线程轮流共享一组事件源，以检测、解复用、分发和处理事件源上发生的服务请求。当池化线程处理请求没有同步或顺序约束时，可以使用领导者/跟随者模式代替半同步/半异步模式来提高性能。

                                                                                          An alternative eager spawning strategy is to manage a thread pool using the Leader/Followers pattern [SSRB00], as shown in Figure 5.3 (2). This pattern defines an efficient concurrency model where multiple threads take turns sharing a set of event sources to detect, demultiplex, dispatch, and process service requests that occur on the event sources. The Leader/Followers pattern can be used in lieu of the Half-Sync/Half-Async pattern to improve performance when there are no synchronization or ordering constraints on the processing of requests by pooled threads.

                                                                                          按需生成机制会在客户端连接和/或数据请求到达时创建新的进程或线程，如第 5.1 节所示的每个请求一个线程和每个连接一个线程的模型。图 5.4展示了这种线程策略。按需生成策略的主要优势在于其资源消耗的降低。然而，其缺点在于，由于生成进程/线程和启动服务会产生开销，这些策略可能会降低高负载服务器的性能，并影响实时系统的确定性。

                                                                                          On-demand spawning creates a new process or thread in response to the arrival of client connection and/or data requests, as the thread-per-request and thread-per-connection models shown in Section 5.1. Figure 5.4 illustrates this strategy for threads. The primary benefit of on-demand spawning strategies is their reduced consumption of resources. The drawbacks, however, are that these strategies can degrade performance in heavily loaded servers and determinism in real-time systems due to the costs incurred when spawning processes/threads and starting services.

                                                                                          图 5.4. 基于请求的按需线程生成策略

                                                                                          第 9.2 节（第 191 页）介绍了一种采用每个连接一个线程、按需生成策略实现的日志服务器。[ SH ] 中提供了说明即时生成策略的示例。在该书中，我们展示了如何应用 ACE 框架来实现半同步/半异步和领导者/追随者线程池模型。

                                                                                          Logging service Section 9.2 on page 191 presents a logging server implemented with a thread-per-connection, on-demand spawning strategy. Examples that illustrate eager spawning strategies are presented in [SH]. In that book, we show how ACE frameworks can be applied to implement both half-sync/half-async and leader/followers thread pool models.

                                                                                            5.4 用户线程、内核线程和混合线程模型

                                                                                            5.4 User, Kernel, and Hybrid Threading Models

                                                                                            调度是操作系统确保应用程序合理使用主机 CPU 资源的主要机制。线程是多线程进程中调度和执行的基本单元。现代操作系统平台提供了多种线程调度模型，用于调度应用程序创建的线程。这些模型之间的一个关键区别在于线程竞争系统资源（尤其是 CPU 时间）的争用范围。有两种不同的争用范围：

                                                                                            Scheduling is the primary mechanism an OS provides to ensure that applications use host CPU resources appropriately. Threads are the units of scheduling and execution in multithreaded processes. Modern OS platforms provide various models for scheduling threads created by applications. A key difference between the models is the contention scope in which threads compete for system resources, particularly CPU time. There are two different contention scopes:

                                                                                            • 进程争用范围，即同一进程中的线程相互竞争（但不直接与其他进程中的线程竞争）以争夺已分配的 CPU 时间。

                                                                                            • Process contention scope, where threads in the same process compete with each other (but not directly with threads in other processes) for scheduled CPU time.

                                                                                            • 系统竞争范围，其中线程直接与其他系统范围的线程竞争，而不管它们与哪个进程关联。

                                                                                            • System contention scope, where threads compete directly with other system-scope threads, regardless of what process they are associated with.

                                                                                            目前常用的操作系统中普遍实现了三种线程调度模型：

                                                                                            Three thread scheduling models are implemented in commonly available operating systems today:

                                                                                            • N:1 用户线程模型

                                                                                            • N:1 user-threading model

                                                                                            • 1:1 内核线程模型

                                                                                            • 1:1 kernel-threading model

                                                                                            • N:M混合线程模型

                                                                                            • N:M hybrid-threading model

                                                                                            下面我们将描述这些模型，讨论它们的优缺点，并展示它们如何支持各种竞争范围。

                                                                                            We describe these models below, discuss their trade-offs, and show how they support various contention scopes.

                                                                                            N:1 用户线程模型。 早期的线程实现构建于原生操作系统进程控制机制之上，并由用户空间的库进行处理。因此，操作系统内核完全不了解线程。内核负责调度进程，而库则管理单个进程内的n 个线程，如图5.5 (1)所示。因此，该模型被称为“N:1”用户线程模型，线程被称为“用户空间线程”或简称“用户线程”。在 N:1 线程模型中，所有线程都在进程竞争范围内运行。HP-UX 10.20 和 SunOS 4.x 就是提供 N:1 用户线程模型的平台示例。

                                                                                            The N:1 user-threading model. Early threading implementations were layered atop the native OS process control mechanisms and handled by libraries in user space. The OS kernel therefore had no knowledge of threads at all. The kernel scheduled the processes and the libraries managed n threads within one process, as shown in Figure 5.5 (1). Hence, this model is referred to as "N:1" user-threading model, and the threads are called "user-space threads" or simply "user threads." All threads operate in process contention scope in the N:1 thread model. HP-UX 10.20 and SunOS 4.x are examples of platforms that provide an N:1 user-threading model.

                                                                                            图 5.5. N:1 和 1:1 螺纹模型

                                                                                            在 N:1 线程模型中，内核不参与同一进程内的任何线程生命周期事件或上下文切换。因此，线程的创建、删除和上下文切换可以非常高效。具有讽刺意味的是，N:1 模型的两个主要问题也源于内核对线程的无知：

                                                                                            In the N:1 threading model, the kernel isn't involved in any thread life-cycle events or context switches within the same process. Thread creation, deletion, and context switches can therefore be highly efficient. The two main problems with the N:1 model, ironically, also stem from the kernel's ignorance of threads:

                                                                                            1. 无论主机有多少个 CPU，每个进程都只会被调度到一个 CPU 上。进程中的所有线程都会争用该 CPU，共享内核在进程调度中可能使用的任何时间片分配。

                                                                                            2. Regardless of the number of host CPUs, each process is scheduled onto only one. All threads in a process contend for that CPU, sharing any time-slice allocation the kernel may use in its process scheduling.

                                                                                            3. 如果一个线程发出阻塞操作，例如从文件读取数据或向文件写入数据，则该进程中的所有线程都会阻塞，直到该操作完成。许多 N:1 线程实现，尤其是 DCE Threads，都提供了对操作系统函数的封装来缓解这种限制。然而，这些封装并非完全透明，它们会对程序的行为产生限制。因此，您必须了解这些限制，以免对应用程序造成不利影响。

                                                                                            4. If one thread issues a blocking operation, for example, to read() from or write() to a file, all threads in that process block until the operation completes. Many N:1 implementations, most notably DCE Threads, provide wrappers around OS system functions to alleviate this restriction. These wrappers aren't entirely transparent, however, and they have restrictions on your program's behavior. You must therefore be aware of them to avoid adversely affecting your application.

                                                                                            1:1 内核线程模型。 大多数现代操作系统内核都直接支持线程。在“1:1”内核线程模型中，应用程序创建的每个线程都由一个内核线程直接处理。操作系统内核将每个内核线程调度到系统的 CPU 上，如图5.5 (2) 所示。因此，在“1:1”模型中，所有线程都在系统竞争范围内运行。HP-UX 11、Linux 和 Windows NT/2000 都是提供 1:1 内核线程模型的平台示例。

                                                                                            The 1:1 kernel-threading model. Most modern OS kernels provide direct support for threads. In the "1:1" kernel-threading model, each thread created by an application is handled directly by a kernel thread. The OS kernel schedules each kernel thread onto the system's CPU(s), as shown in Figure 5.5 (2). In the "1:1" model, therefore, all threads operate in system contention scope. HP-UX 11, Linux, and Windows NT/2000 are examples of platforms that provide a 1:1 kernel-threading model.

                                                                                            1:1 模型解决了上述 N:1 模型存在的以下两个问题：

                                                                                            The 1:1 model fixes the following two problems with the N:1 model outlined above:

                                                                                            • 多线程应用程序可以利用多个 CPU（如果有的话）。

                                                                                            • Multithreaded applications can take advantage of multiple CPUs if they are available.

                                                                                            • 如果内核阻塞了系统函数中的一个线程，其他线程仍然可以继续执行。

                                                                                            • If the kernel blocks one thread in a system function, other threads can continue to make progress.

                                                                                            然而，由于操作系统内核参与线程的创建和调度，线程生命周期操作的成本可能比 N:1 模型更高，但通常仍然比进程生命周期操作的成本更低。

                                                                                            Since the OS kernel is involved in thread creation and scheduling, however, thread life-cycle operations can be more costly than with the N:1 model, though generally still cheaper than process life-cycle operations.

                                                                                            N:M 混合线程模型。 一些操作系统，例如 Solaris [ EKB + 92 ]，提供了 N:1 和 1:1 模型的组合，称为“N:M”混合线程模型。该模型支持用户线程和内核线程的混合使用。混合模型如图5.6所示。当应用程序生成一个线程时，它可以指定该线程应在哪个竞争范围内运行（Solaris 的默认设置为进程竞争范围）。操作系统线程库会创建一个用户空间线程，但只有在需要或应用程序明确请求系统竞争范围时才会创建内核线程。与 1:1 模型一样，操作系统内核会将内核线程调度到 CPU 上。然而，与 N:1 模型一样，操作系统线程库会将用户空间线程调度到所谓的“轻量级进程”（LWP）上，而这些轻量级进程本身又与内核线程一一对应。

                                                                                            The N:M hybrid-threading model. Some operating systems, such as Solaris [EKB+92], offer a combination of the N:1 and 1:1 models, referred to as the "N:M" hybrid-threading model. This model supports a mix of user threads and kernel threads. The hybrid model is shown in Figure 5.6. When an application spawns a thread, it can indicate in which contention scope the thread should operate (the default on Solaris is process contention scope). The OS threading library creates a user-space thread, but only creates a kernel thread if needed or if the application explicitly requests the system contention scope. As in the 1:1 model, the OS kernel schedules kernel threads onto CPUs. As in the N:1 model, however, the OS threading library schedules user-space threads onto so-called "lightweight processes" (LWPs), which themselves map 1-to-1 onto kernel threads.

                                                                                            图 5.6. N:M 混合螺纹模型

                                                                                            细心的读者会注意到，在 N:M 模型中，一个问题再次出现：当一个用户空间线程发出阻塞的系统函数时，多个用户空间线程可能会被阻塞。当操作系统内核阻塞一个 LWP 时，线程库调度到该 LWP 上的所有用户线程也会被阻塞，尽管进程中调度到其他 LWP 上的线程可以继续执行。Solaris 内核通过以下基于调度器激活概念的双管齐下的方法解决了这个问题 [ ABLL92 ]：

                                                                                            The astute reader will note that a problem resurfaces in the N:M model, where multiple user-space threads can block when one of them issues a blocking system function. When the OS kernel blocks an LWP, all user threads scheduled onto it by the threads library also block, though threads scheduled onto other LWPs in the process can continue to make progress. The Solaris kernel addresses this problem via the following two-pronged approach based on the concept of scheduler activations [ABLL92]:

                                                                                            1. 操作系统线程库维护着一个轻量级线程池，用于运行所有进程作用域的用户线程。它可以根据需要将这些用户线程重新调度到池中的轻量级线程上。可以通过 Pthreads 库的pthread_setconcurrency()函数调整此线程池的大小。

                                                                                            2. The OS threading library maintains a pool of LWPs that it uses to run all the process-scoped user threads. It can reschedule these user threads onto LWPs in the pool as the need arises. The size of this pool can be adjusted via the Pthreads pthread_setconcurrency() function.

                                                                                            3. 当操作系统内核检测到某个进程中的所有内核线程都被阻塞时，它会向受影响的进程发送 SIGWAITING 信号。线程库捕获到该信号后，可以启动一个新的 LWP（轻量级工作进程）。然后，它可以将进程范围内的线程重新调度到新的 LWP 上，从而使应用程序能够继续执行。

                                                                                            4. When the OS kernel notices that all kernel threads in a process are blocked, it sends the SIGWAITING signal to the affected process. The threading library catches the signal and can start a new LWP. It can then reschedule a process-scope thread onto the new LWP, allowing the application to continue making progress.

                                                                                            并非所有操作系统平台都允许您控制线程如何映射到系统资源以及如何分配系统资源。您应该了解您的平台允许哪些操作以及它们的运行方式，以便充分利用现有资源。有关操作系统并发机制的详细讨论，请参阅 [ Lew95 , But97 , Ric97 , Sol98 , Sch94 ]。与任何功能强大的工具一样，误用线程可能会造成损害。因此，当需要在不同的争用范围之间进行选择时，您应该选择哪一个？答案取决于以下哪个原因最能解释您创建线程的原因，以及该线程与程序中其他线程的独立程度：

                                                                                            Not all OS platforms allow you to influence how threads are mapped to, and how they allocate, system resources. You should know what your platform(s) do allow and how they behave to make the most of what you have to work with. Detailed discussions of OS concurrency mechanisms appear in [Lew95, But97, Ric97, Sol98, Sch94]. As with any powerful, full-featured tool, it's possible to hurt yourself when misusing threads. So, when given a choice between contention scope, which should you choose? The answer lies in which of the following reasons corresponds most closely to why you're spawning a thread, as well as how independent it must be of other threads in your program:

                                                                                            • 创建线程以避免与其他任务的干扰。 某些任务必须在尽可能少的干扰下执行，无论是进程中的其他线程，还是系统中的其他线程。例如：

                                                                                              - 一个必须对某些刺激快速做出反应的线程，例如追踪鼠标移动或关闭发电厂中的阀门。

                                                                                              - 一项 CPU 密集型任务，应与其他任务隔离

                                                                                              - 在多处理器系统上执行 I/O 密集型任务。

                                                                                              在这种情况下，每个线程都应该独立调度，并尽可能减少与其他线程的竞争。为了实现这一目标，请使用系统作用域线程，避免将新线程与同一内核线程上的其他线程竞争，从而使操作系统能够利用多个 CPU。如果您的系统支持 N:M 模型，请显式请求系统作用域线程。如果您的系统支持 1:1 模型，那么您很幸运，因为无论如何您都会获得一个系统作用域线程。但是，在 N:1 系统中，您可能就无法做到这一点了。

                                                                                            • Spawn threads to avoid interference from other tasks. Some tasks must execute with minimal interference from other threads in your process, or even other threads in the system. Some examples are

                                                                                              - A thread that must react quickly to some stimulus, such as tracking mouse movement or closing a valve in a power plant

                                                                                              - A CPU-intensive task that should be isolated from other tasks

                                                                                              - An I/O-intensive task on a multiprocessor system.

                                                                                              In these cases, each thread should be scheduled on its own and have minimal contention from the other threads in your application. To achieve this aim, use a system-scoped thread to avoid scheduling the new thread against other threads on the same kernel thread and enable the OS to utilize multiple CPUs. If your system supports the N:M model, request system contention scope explicitly. If your system offers the 1:1 model, you're in luck because you get a system-scoped thread anyway. On N:1 systems, however, you may be out of luck.

                                                                                            • 创建线程可以简化应用程序设计。 通常，将操作系统资源保留给高负载场景是明智之举。创建线程的主要动机可能是通过将应用程序分解为独立的逻辑任务来简化其设计，例如处理数据并将其传递给下一阶段的处理阶段。在这种情况下，如果可以使用进程作用域线程，则无需承担内核线程的开销。进程作用域线程在 N:1 系统中始终使用，在 N:M 模型中则按需使用。进程作用域线程具有以下优势：

                                                                                              - 它们避免内核额外参与线程创建、调度和同步，同时还能分离应用程序中的关注点。

                                                                                              只要进程作用域线程的等待状态是由同步引起的，例如等待互斥锁，而不是阻塞系统功能，那么整个进程或内核线程就不会意外阻塞。

                                                                                            • Spawn threads to simplify application design. It's often wise to conserve your available OS resources for demanding situations. Your primary motivation for creating threads may be to simplify your application design by decomposing it into separate logical tasks, such as processing stages that operate on data and pass it to the next stage. In this case, you needn't incur the cost of a kernel-thread if you can employ process-scoped threads, which are always used in N:1 systems or by request in the N:M model. Process-scoped threads have the following consequences:

                                                                                              - They avoid extra kernel involvement in thread creation, scheduling, and synchronization, while still separating concerns in your application.

                                                                                              - As long as the wait states of process-scoped threads are induced by synchronization, such as waiting on a mutex, rather than blocking system functions, your entire process or kernel thread won't block inadvertently.

                                                                                            虽然多线程乍看之下可能令人生畏，但一旦掌握了同步模式 [ SSRB00 ] 和操作系统并发机制，线程就能帮助简化应用程序设计。例如，您可以从一个或多个线程执行同步 I/O操作，与 Reactor 或 Proactor 等同步或异步事件处理模式相比，这可以带来更简洁的设计。我们将在第 6 章讨论操作系统并发机制，并在第 9 章和第10章讨论封装这些机制的 ACE 线程和同步包装器外观。

                                                                                            Although multithreading may seem intimidating at first, threads can help to simplify your application designs once you've mastered synchronization patterns [SSRB00] and OS concurrency mechanisms. For example, you can perform synchronous I/O from one or more threads, which can yield more straightforward designs compared with synchronous or asynchronous event handling patterns, such as Reactor or Proactor, respectively. We discuss OS concurrency mechanisms in Chapter 6 and the ACE threading and synchronization wrapper facades that encapsulate these mechanisms in Chapters 9 and 10.

                                                                                            日志服务 本书其余部分中的日志服务器实现展示了各种 ACE 并发包装器外观。这些示例使用系统竞争范围的线程，即 1:1 内核线程，用于执行 I/O 操作，例如从客户端接收日志记录。这种设计确保了阻塞式从套接字接收数据的调用不会意外阻塞任何其他线程或整个进程！

                                                                                            Logging service Our logging server implementations in the rest of this book illustrate various ACE concurrency wrapper facades. These examples use threads with system contention scope, that is, 1:1 kernel threads, when the thread's purpose is to perform I/O, such as receiving log records from clients. This design ensures that a blocking call to receive data from a socket doesn't inadvertently block any other thread or the whole process!

                                                                                              5.5 时间共享和实时排课课程

                                                                                              5.5 Time-Shared and Real-Time Scheduling Classes

                                                                                              除了第 5.4 节中描述的争用范围和线程模型之外，操作系统平台通常还会定义策略和优先级，这些策略和优先级会进一步影响调度行为 [ But97 ]。这些功能使现代操作系统能够运行各种应用程序，满足其通用和实时调度的各种需求。操作系统内核可以将线程分配到不同的调度类，并使用优先级和资源使用情况等多种标准来调度这些线程。下文描述的不同调度类策略在公平性与可预测性和控制性之间进行了权衡。

                                                                                              In addition to the contention scopes and threading models described in Section 5.4, OS platforms often define policies and priority levels that further influence scheduling behavior [But97]. These capabilities enable modern operating systems to run a mix of applications with a range of general-purpose and real-time scheduling needs. OS kernels can assign threads to different scheduling classes and schedule these threads using several criteria, such as their priority and their resource usage. The different scheduling class strategies described below trade off fairness for increased predictability and control.

                                                                                              分时调度类。 通用操作系统调度器面向传统的分时交互式环境。这些操作系统的调度器通常是

                                                                                              Time-shared scheduling class. General-purpose OS schedulers target traditional time-sharing, interactive environments. Schedulers for these operating systems are typically

                                                                                              • 基于优先级—— 优先级最高的可运行线程将被安排执行。

                                                                                              • Priority-based— the highest-priority runnable thread is the next one scheduled for execution.

                                                                                              • 公平起见—— 分时调度器中线程的优先级可以根据其 CPU 使用率进行调整。例如，当一个长时间运行的计算密集型线程占用更多 CPU 时间时，分时调度器可以逐步降低其优先级，直到达到一个下限。

                                                                                              • Fair— the priority of threads in a time-shared scheduler can be varied as a function of their CPU usage. For example, as a long-running compute-bound thread uses more CPU time, a time-shared scheduler can decrease its priority progressively until a lower limit is reached.

                                                                                              • 抢占式—— 如果低优先级线程在高优先级线程可运行时正在执行，调度器应抢占低优先级线程，并允许高优先级线程运行。

                                                                                              • Preemptive— if a lower-priority thread is executing when a higher-priority thread becomes runnable, the scheduler should preempt the lower-priority thread and allow the higher-priority thread to run.

                                                                                              • 时间片轮转技术用于在优先级相同的线程之间循环执行任务。在这种技术中，每个线程最多运行一段有限的时间（例如 10 毫秒）。当前运行线程的时间片结束后，调度器会选择另一个可用的线程，执行上下文切换，并将被抢占的线程放入队列。

                                                                                              • Time-sliced, which is used to cycle among threads with the same priority. With this technique, each thread runs for up to a finite period of time (e.g., 10 milliseconds). After the time slice of the currently running thread has elapsed, the scheduler selects another available thread, performs a context switch, and places the preempted thread onto a queue.

                                                                                              实时调度类。 虽然分时调度器适用于传统的网络应用，但它们很少能满足具有实时性要求的应用的需求。例如，分时调度器通常没有固定的线程执行顺序，因为调度器会随时间改变线程优先级。此外，分时调度器不会限制高优先级线程准备运行时抢占低优先级线程所需的时间。

                                                                                              Real-time scheduling class. Although time-shared schedulers are suitable for conventional networked applications, they rarely satisfy the needs of applications with real-time requirements. For example, there's usually no fixed order of execution for threads in a time-shared scheduler class since the scheduler can vary thread priorities over time. Moreover, time-shared schedulers don't try to bound the amount of time needed to preempt a lower-priority thread when a higher-priority thread becomes ready to run.

                                                                                              因此，实时操作系统（例如 VxWorks 或 LynxOS）和一些通用操作系统（例如 Solaris 和 Windows NT）提供了一个实时调度类 [ Kha92 ]，用于限制调度用户线程或内核线程所需的最坏情况时间。具有实时调度类的操作系统通常支持以下一种或两种调度策略 [ Gal95 ]：

                                                                                              Therefore, real-time operating systems (such as VxWorks or LynxOS) and some general-purpose operating systems (such as Solaris and Windows NT) provide a real-time scheduling class [Kha92] that bounds the worst-case time required to dispatch user threads or kernel threads. An OS with a real-time scheduling class often supports one or both of the following scheduling policies [Gal95]:

                                                                                              • 轮询调度中，时间片指定一个线程在被另一个具有相同优先级的实时线程抢占之前可以运行的最大时间。

                                                                                              • Round-robin, where a time quantum specifies the maximum time a thread can run before it's preempted by another real-time thread with the same priority.

                                                                                              • 先进先出（FIFO），其中优先级最高的线程可以一直运行，直到它主动放弃控制权或被优先级更高的实时线程抢占为止。

                                                                                              • First-in, first-out (FIFO), where the highest-priority thread can run for as long as it chooses, until it voluntarily yields control or is preempted by a real-time thread with an even higher priority.

                                                                                              当操作系统同时支持分时调度和实时调度时，实时线程的优先级始终高于任何分时线程。

                                                                                              When an OS supports both time-shared and real-time scheduling classes, the real-time threads always run at a higher priority than any time-shared threads.

                                                                                              CPU密集型实时程序可能会接管系统资源，导致其他系统活动无法正常运行。因此，大多数通用操作系统通过限制实时调度类的使用权限，仅允许以超级用户权限运行的应用程序使用，来防止这种情况的发生。

                                                                                              A CPU-bound real-time program can take over the system and starve all other system activities. Most general-purpose operating systems therefore regulate this undesirable situation by restricting the use of the real-time scheduling class to applications running with superuser privileges.

                                                                                              日志服务： 由于日志服务通常对时间要求不高，本书中的大多数示例都直接使用操作系统默认的分时调度类。但为了完整起见，第 9.3 节第 200 页的网络日志服务器示例展示了如何使用 ACE 编写一个可在实时调度类中运行的可移植日志服务器。

                                                                                              Logging service Since a logging service isn't usually time critical, most of our examples in this book simply use the default OS time-shared scheduling class. For completeness, however, the networked logging server example on page 200 in Section 9.3 shows how to use ACE to write a portable logging server that runs in the real-time scheduling class.

                                                                                                5.6 基于任务的架构与基于消息的架构

                                                                                                5.6 Task- versus Message-Based Architectures

                                                                                                并发架构是以下两者之间的绑定：

                                                                                                A concurrency architecture is a binding between:

                                                                                                1. CPU为应用程序代码提供执行上下文。

                                                                                                2. CPUs, which provide the execution context for application code

                                                                                                3. 从一个或多个应用程序和网络设备发送和接收的数据和控制消息

                                                                                                4. Data and control messages, which are sent and received from one or more applications and network devices

                                                                                                5. 服务处理任务，即对到达和离开的消息执行服务。

                                                                                                6. Service processing tasks, which perform services upon messages as they arrive and depart.

                                                                                                网络应用程序的并发架构是影响其性能的几个主要因素之一[1]，它会影响上下文切换、同步、调度和数据移动的成本。并发架构主要有两种类型：基于任务的架构和基于消息的架构[ SS93 ]。这一维度的主要权衡在于编程的简易性与性能之间的平衡。

                                                                                                A networked application's concurrency architecture is one of several factors[1] that most impact its performance by affecting context switching, synchronization, scheduling, and data movement costs. There are two canonical types of concurrency architectures: task-based and message-based [SS93]. The primary trade-offs in this dimension involve simplicity of programming versus performance.

                                                                                                [1]影响性能的其他关键因素包括协议、总线、内存和网络硬件设备特性。

                                                                                                [1] Other key factors that affect performance include protocol, bus, memory, and network hardware device characteristics.

                                                                                                基于任务的并发架构根据应用程序中的服务功能单元来组织多个 CPU。在这种架构中，任务是活动的，而任务处理的消息是被动的，如图5.7 (1) 所示。并发性是通过在不同的 CPU 中执行服务任务，并在任务/​​CPU 之间传递数据消息和控制消息来实现的。基于任务的并发架构可以使用生产者/消费者模式来实现，例如管道和过滤器 [ BMR + 96 ] 以及活动对象 [ SSRB00 ]，我们在 [ SH ] 中对此进行了说明。

                                                                                                Task-based concurrency architectures structure multiple CPUs according to units of service functionality in an application. In this architecture, tasks are active and messages processed by the tasks are passive, as shown in Figure 5.7 (1). Concurrency is achieved by executing service tasks in separate CPUs and passing data messages and control messages between the tasks/CPUs. Task-based concurrency architectures can be implemented using producer/consumer patterns, such as Pipes and Filters [BMR+96] and Active Object [SSRB00], which we illustrate in [SH].

                                                                                                图 5.7. 基于任务的并发架构与基于消息的并发架构

                                                                                                基于消息的并发架构根据从应用程序和网络设备接收的消息来组织 CPU。在这种架构中，消息是主动的，而任务是被动的，如图5.7 (2) 所示。并发性是通过将多个消息同时引导到不同的 CPU 上，并经由服务任务栈来实现的。每个请求一个线程、每个连接一个线程以及线程池模型均可用于实现基于消息的并发架构。第 9 章阐述了每个连接一个线程的用法，线程池的实现参见 [ SH ]。

                                                                                                Message-based concurrency architectures structure the CPUs according to the messages received from applications and network devices. In this architecture, messages are active and tasks are passive, as shown in Figure 5.7 (2). Concurrency is achieved by shepherding multiple messages on separate CPUs through a stack of service tasks simultaneously. Thread-per-request, thread-per-connection, and thread pool models can be used to implement message-based concurrency architectures. Chapter 9 illustrates the use of thread-per-connection, and thread pools are shown in [SH].

                                                                                                日志服务： 本书中，我们使用基于消息的并发架构（特别是每个连接一个线程）来构建网络日志服务的线程设计，这种架构通常比基于任务的架构更高效[ HP91 , SS95 ]。然而，基于任务的架构通常更容易编程，因为任务或层内的同步通常是不必要的，并发是在任务访问点（例如协议栈中的层之间）进行串行化的。相比之下，基于消息的架构由于需要更复杂的并发控制，实现起来可能更困难。

                                                                                                Logging service We structure the networked logging service threading designs in this book using message-based concurrency architectures, in particular thread-per-connection, which are often more efficient than task-based architectures [HP91, SS95]. Task-based architectures are often easier to program, however, since synchronization within a task or layer is often unnecessary since concurrency is serialized at the task access points, such as between layers in a prostocol stack. In contrast, message-based architectures can be harder to implement due to the need for more sophisticated concurrency control.

                                                                                                  5.7 总结

                                                                                                  5.7 Summary

                                                                                                  网络服务器可以将一个或多个操作系统进程或线程与一个或多个应用程序服务关联起来。这些因素需要在多个维度上做出设计决策，从而影响线程和进程的使用、CPU 资源的使用、调度行为以及应用程序性能。本章对可用于设计网络应用程序的丰富并发维度集进行了领域分析。本书的其余章节将描述基于此领域分析而产生的 ACE 封装外观。在这些章节中，我们将重点讨论封装和使用当今操作系统中可用的同步事件解复用、多处理、线程和同步机制的优缺点。

                                                                                                  Networked servers may associate one or more OS processes or threads with one or more application services. These factors require design decisions in a number of dimensions that affect thread and process usage, CPU resource usage, scheduling behavior, and application performance. This chapter provided a domain analysis of the rich set of concurrency dimensions that can be used to design networked applications. The remaining chapters in this book describe the ACE wrapper facades that resulted from this domain analysis. There we focus on the pros and cons of encapsulating and using synchronous event demultiplexing, multiprocessing, threading, and synchronization mechanisms available on today's operating systems.

                                                                                                    第六章 操作系统并发机制概述

                                                                                                    Chapter 6. An Overview of Operating System Concurrency Mechanisms

                                                                                                    章节概要

                                                                                                    Chapter Synopsis

                                                                                                    网络应用程序，尤其是服务器，通常需要并发处理请求以满足其服务质​​量要求。第 5 章描述了与并发方案相关的通用设计权衡。本章概述了可用于实现这些设计的同步事件解复用、多进程、多线程和同步机制。我们还将讨论使用原生 C 级并发 API 开发网络应用程序时常见的可移植性和编程问题。

                                                                                                    Networked applications, particularly servers, must often process requests concurrently to meet their quality of service requirements. Chapter 5 describes general design tradeoffs related to concurrency alternatives. This chapter presents an overview of the synchronous event demultiplexing, multiprocessing, multithreading, and synchronization mechanisms available to implement those designs. We also discuss common portability and programming problems that arise when networked applications are developed using native C-level concurrency APIs.

                                                                                                      6.1 同步事件解复用

                                                                                                      6.1 Synchronous Event Demultiplexing

                                                                                                      同步事件解复用器是操作系统提供的一种函数，它等待一组事件源上发生的指定事件。当一个或多个事件源变为活动状态时，该函数返回给调用者。调用者随后可以处理来自多个事件源的事件。同步事件解复用器通常用作响应式服务器事件循环的基础，这些循环以连续有序的方式检查并响应来自客户端的事件。

                                                                                                      A synchronous event demultiplexer is a function supplied by an OS that waits for specified events to occur on a set of event sources. When one or more of the event sources become active, the function returns to its caller. The caller can then process the events originating from many sources. Synchronous event demultiplexers are often used as the basis of reactive server event loops that examine and react to events from clients in a continuous and orderly way.

                                                                                                      大多数操作系统都支持一种或多种同步事件解复用功能，例如

                                                                                                      Most operating systems support one or more synchronous event demultiplexing functions, such as

                                                                                                      • poll ()函数 [ Rag93 ] 源自 System V UNIX

                                                                                                      • The poll() function [Rag93], which stems from System V UNIX

                                                                                                      • WaitForMultipleObjects()函数[ Sol98 ] 由 Win32 提供，

                                                                                                      • The WaitForMultipleObjects() function [Sol98], which is provided by Win32 and

                                                                                                      • select ()函数 [ Ste98 ​​] 对 I/O 句柄上的事件源进行解复用[1]

                                                                                                        [1] Win32 版本的select()仅对套接字句柄有效。

                                                                                                      • The select() function [Ste98], which demultiplexes event sources on I/O handles[1]

                                                                                                        [1] The Win32 version of select() works only on socket handles.

                                                                                                      我们重点介绍select() 函数，因为它最常用。事件驱动型网络应用程序可以使用select()函数来确定哪些句柄可以同步执行 I/O 操作，而不会阻塞调用它们的应用程序线程。select ()函数的 C API概述如下：

                                                                                                      We focus on select() because it's the most common. Event-driven networked applications can use select() to determine which handles can have I/O operations invoked on them synchronously without blocking the application thread that calls them. The C API for the select() function is outlined below:

                                                                                                      int select (int width,               // Maximum handle plus 1
            fd_set *read_fds,        // Set of "read" handles
            fd_set *write_fds,       // Set of "write" handles
            fd_set *except_fds,      // Set of "exception" handles
            struct timeval *timeout);// Time to wait for events

                                                                                                      fd_set是一个结构体，表示一组用于检查 I/O 事件的句柄（句柄集）。select() 函数会检查 fd_set 中的三个参数（read_fds、write_fds 和 except_fds），分别用于判断是否存在处于活动状态的句柄，例如用于读取、写入或处理异常情况（如带外数据）。select() 函数会通过修改其fd_set参数来告知调用者哪些句柄处于活动状态，哪些句柄处于非活动状态，具体修改方式如下：

                                                                                                      An fd_set is a structure representing a set of handles to check for I/O events (a handle set). The three fd_set parameters whose addresses are passed in read_fds, write_fds, and except_fds are examined by select() to see if any of their handles are active for reading, writing, or exceptional conditions (such as out-of-band data), respectively. The select() function informs its caller about active and inactive handles by modifying its fd_set arguments as outlined below:

                                                                                                      • 如果句柄值在fd_set中未激活，则该句柄将被忽略，并且其值在select()返回的fd_set中将不会激活。

                                                                                                      • If a handle value is not active in the fd_set, that handle is ignored and its value won't be active in the fd_set returned from select().

                                                                                                      • 如果fd_set中的某个句柄值处于活动状态，则会检查该句柄是否存在待处理的事件。如果该句柄存在待处理的事件，则其对应的值在select()返回的fd_set中将处于活动状态。如果该句柄不存在待处理的事件，则其对应的值在返回的fd_set中将处于非活动状态。

                                                                                                      • If a handle value is active in the fd_set, the corresponding handle is examined for pending events. If the handle has an event pending, its corresponding value will be active in the fd_set returned from select(). If the handle does not have a pending event, its value will be inactive in the returned fd_set.

                                                                                                      每个操作系统平台都提供了一组基本操作，允许应用程序查询和操作fd_set。虽然这些操作在某些平台上是宏，而在其他平台上是函数，但它们具有一组一致的名称和行为：

                                                                                                      Each OS platform supplies a basic set of operations that allows applications to query and manipulate fd_sets. Although these operations are macros on some platforms and functions on others, they have a consistent set of names and behaviors:

                                                                                                      功能 描述
                                                                                                      FD_ZERO() 在fd_set中将所有句柄值标记为非活动状态。
                                                                                                      FD_CLR() 在fd_set中将句柄设置为非活动状态。
                                                                                                      FD_SET() 在fd_set中设置要激活的句柄。
                                                                                                      FD_ISSET() 测试指定的句柄在fd_set中是否处于活动状态。

                                                                                                      select()的最后一个参数是指向struct timeval 的指针，该结构体包含以下两个字段：

                                                                                                      The final parameter to select() is a pointer to struct timeval, which contains the following two fields:

                                                                                                      struct timeval
{
  long tv_sec;  /* seconds */
  long tv_usec; /* microseconds */
};

                                                                                                      以下三种类型的timeval值可以传递给select()来控制其超时行为：

                                                                                                      The following three types of timeval values can be passed to select() to control its time-out behavior:

                                                                                                      价值 行为
                                                                                                      空时间值指针 表示select()应该无限期地等待，直到至少发生一次 I/O 事件或信号中断调用为止。
                                                                                                      tv_sec和tv_usec字段均为 0 的 非空时间值指针 表示select()应该执行“轮询”，即检查所有句柄并立即返回任何结果。
                                                                                                      timeval中tv_sec或tv_usec字段大于0 的 变量 表示select()应该等待最多指定时间以发生 I/O 事件。

                                                                                                        6.2 多处理机制

                                                                                                        6.2 Multiprocessing Mechanisms

                                                                                                        所有现代通用操作系统都提供了创建和管理多个进程执行的机制。进程是资源管理和保护的基本单元。一些嵌入式操作系统，例如许多版本的 VxWorks 和 pSoS，仅支持单个地址空间，这类似于单个进程。这种限制通常是合理的；例如，手机的计算机可能不需要运行多个进程。然而，大多数此类嵌入式系统都支持多线程，我们将在6.3 节中对此进行探讨。

                                                                                                        All modern, general-purpose operating systems provide mechanisms to create and manage the execution of multiple processes. A process is a unit of resource management and protection. Some embedded operating systems, such as many versions of VxWorks and pSoS, support only a single address space, which is akin to a single process. This limitation is often reasonable; for example, your cell phone's computer may not need to run multiple processes. Most of these embedded-type systems do facilitate multithreading, however, which we'll examine in Section 6.3.

                                                                                                        不同操作系统提供的进程控制功能差异很大。然而，在多进程操作系统中，以下功能领域是常见的：

                                                                                                        The process control functionality offered by different operating systems varies greatly. On multiprocessing operating systems, however, the following areas of capability are common:

                                                                                                        进程生命周期操作。 进程在操作系统或应用程序调用进程创建和执行函数时创建，例如fork()和exec*()系列函数（POSIX）或CreateProcess()（Win32）。这些函数会创建一个新的地址空间来运行特定的程序。启动进程还可以设置新程序的命令行参数和环境变量，以便将命令、参数以及文件或目录位置等信息传递给新进程。进程会一直运行，直到它终止为止。

                                                                                                        Process lifetime operations. Processes come into existence when either the OS or application programs call process creation and execution functions, such as fork() and the exec*() family of functions (POSIX) or CreateProcess() (Win32). These functions create a new address space to run a particular program. The initiating process can also set the new program's command-line arguments and environment variables to pass information, such as commands, parameters, and file or directory locations, to a new process. A process runs until it terminates either

                                                                                                        • 例如，进程主动退出，通过执行完其main()函数，或者调用进程退出 API，例如ExitProcess() (Win32) 或exit() (POSIX)，这允许进程将其退出状态设置为指定值；

                                                                                                        • Voluntarily, for example, by reaching the end of its main() function or by calling a process exit API, such as ExitProcess() (Win32) or exit() (POSIX), which allows a process to set its exit status to a specified value, or

                                                                                                        • 例如，非自愿地通过信号（POSIX）或外部取消操作（如TerminateProcess()（Win32））终止进程。

                                                                                                        • Involuntarily, for example, by being killed via a signal (POSIX) or by an external cancelation operation, such as TerminateProcess() (Win32).

                                                                                                        进程同步操作。 大多数操作系统会在进程退出时保留其身份和退出状态，这使得其父进程可以与其同步并获取其退出状态。常见的进程同步函数包括：

                                                                                                        Process synchronization operations. Most operating systems retain the identity and exit status of a process when it exits, which allows its parent process to synchronize with it and obtain its exit status. Common examples of process synchronization functions include:

                                                                                                        • POSIX wait()和waitpid()函数以及

                                                                                                        • The POSIX wait() and waitpid() functions and

                                                                                                        • Win32 函数WaitForSingleObject()和WaitForMultipleObjects()

                                                                                                        • The Win32 functions WaitForSingleObject() and WaitForMultipleObjects()

                                                                                                        许多操作系统也维护着创建进程和被创建进程之间固有的父子关系。一些操作系统利用这种关系来通知可能感兴趣的父进程，其某个子进程已经退出。例如，在 POSIX 系统中，当某个子进程退出时，操作系统会向父进程发送 SIGCHLD 信号。

                                                                                                        Many operating systems also maintain the inherent parent/child relationship between creator and created processes. This relationship is used by some operating systems to help notify a possibly-interested parent process that one of its child processes has exited. On POSIX systems, for instance, the OS sends a SIGCHLD signal to a parent process when one of its child processes exits.

                                                                                                        进程属性操作。 大多数操作系统都提供用于获取和设置各种进程属性的函数。可在进程级别设置的属性包括默认文件访问权限、用户标识、资源限制、调度优先级和当前工作目录。一些操作系统还允许进程锁定其虚拟内存的某些区域，以避免页面错误或启用与 I/O 设备的基于内存的交换。

                                                                                                        Process property operations. Most operating systems provide functions to get and set various process properties. Properties that can be set at the process level include default file access permissions, user identification, resource limits, scheduling priority, and the current working directory. Some operating systems also allow a process to lock down regions of its virtual memory to avoid page faulting or to enable memory-based exchanges with I/O devices.

                                                                                                          6.3 多线程机制

                                                                                                          6.3 Multithreading Mechanisms

                                                                                                          线程是进程内的一个执行单元。大多数现代操作系统都提供了处理线程生命周期、同步以及其他各种线程相关属性（例如优先级和线程专用存储）的机制。下面我们将详细介绍这些机制。

                                                                                                          A thread is a unit of execution within a process. Most modern operating systems provide mechanisms that handle thread lifetime, synchronization, and various other thread-related properties, such as priorities and thread-specific storage. We outline each of these mechanisms below.

                                                                                                          线程生命周期操作。 程序中的主线程在进程开始执行时隐式创建。大多数其他线程是通过显式调用线程创建函数而创建的，例如pthread_create()（Pthreads 库）或CreateThread()（Win32 库）。这些函数会创建并启动一个新线程，运行调用者指定的特定入口点函数。与进程一样，线程会一直运行直到终止。

                                                                                                          Thread lifetime operations. The main thread in a program is created implicitly when a process begins its execution. Most other threads come into existence via explicit calls to thread creation functions, such as pthread_create() (Pthreads) or CreateThread() (Win32). These functions create and start a new thread running a particular entry-point function specified by the caller. As with processes, threads run until they terminate either

                                                                                                          • 例如，线程主动退出，可以通过到达入口点函数的末尾或调用线程退出函数来实现，例如pthread_exit() (Pthreads) 或ExitThread() (Win32)，这允许线程将其退出状态设置为指定值。

                                                                                                          • Voluntarily, for example, by reaching the end of their entry-point functions or calling a thread exit function, such as pthread_exit() (Pthreads) or ExitThread() (Win32), which allows a thread to set its exit status to a specified value or

                                                                                                          • 例如，通过信号或异步线程取消操作（如pthread_cancel() (Pthreads) 或TerminateThread() (Win32)）被非自愿地终止。

                                                                                                          • Involuntarily, for example, by being killed via a signal or by an asynchronous thread cancelation operation, such as pthread_cancel() (Pthreads) or TerminateThread() (Win32).

                                                                                                          线程同步操作。 许多操作系统线程机制允许以以下两种方式创建线程：

                                                                                                          Thread synchronization operations. Many OS threading mechanisms allow threads to be created as either:

                                                                                                          • 分离式线程—— 当分离式线程退出时，操作系统会自动回收用于存储线程状态和退出状态的存储空间，或者

                                                                                                          • Detached— When a detached thread exits, the OS reclaims storage used for the thread's state and exit status automatically, or

                                                                                                          • 可加入—— 当一个可加入的线程退出时，操作系统会保留它的身份和退出状态，以便另一个线程随后可以与其同步以获取其退出状态。

                                                                                                          • Joinable— When a joinable thread exits, the OS retains its identity and exit status so that another thread can subsequently synchronize with it to obtain its exit status.

                                                                                                          常见的线程同步机制示例包括

                                                                                                          Examples of common thread synchronization mechanisms include

                                                                                                          • Pthreads 中的pthread_join()函数

                                                                                                          • The pthread_join() function in Pthreads

                                                                                                          • Win32 函数WaitForSingleObject()和WaitForMultipleObjects()

                                                                                                          • The Win32 functions WaitForSingleObject() and WaitForMultipleObjects()

                                                                                                          某些操作系统平台提供同步功能，允许线程相互挂起和恢复。有些平台还允许线程向同一进程中的其他线程发送信号。然而，这些操作通常不具备可移植性，且难以正确使用[ But97 ]；因此，本书不再赘述，尽管ACE在支持这些操作的平台上对其进行了封装。

                                                                                                          Some OS platforms provide synchronization functions that allow threads to suspend and resume each other. Some allow threads to send signals to other threads in the same process. However, these operations are generally nonportable and hard to use correctly [But97]; therefore, we don't consider them further in this book, although ACE does encapsulate them on platforms where they exist.

                                                                                                          线程属性操作。 大多数操作系统都提供了获取和设置各种线程属性的函数。例如，可以使用Pthreads 库中的pthread_getschedparam()和pthread_setschedparam()函数以及Win32 库中的Get-ThreadPriority()和SetThreadPriority()函数来检查和更改线程的优先级。同样，许多操作系统允许应用程序选择更基本的属性，例如线程的调度类。例如，Solaris 同时支持第 5.5 节中描述的实时调度类和分时调度类 [ Kha92 ] 。

                                                                                                          Thread property operations. Most operating systems provide functions to get and set various thread properties. For example, a thread's priority can be examined and changed using the pthread_getschedparam() and pthread_setschedparam() functions in Pthreads as well as the Get-ThreadPriority() and SetThreadPriority() functions in Win32. Likewise, many operating systems allow applications to select more fundamental properties, such as the thread's scheduling class. For instance, Solaris supports both the real-time and time-shared scheduling classes [Kha92] described in Section 5.5.

                                                                                                          线程特定存储。 线程特定存储 (TSS) 的作用域与全局数据类似；也就是说，它并非任何特定函数或对象的局部数据。然而，与全局数据不同的是，每个线程实际上都拥有一个独立的 TSS 数据副本。应用程序可以使用 TSS 来维护许多函数或对象需要访问但对特定线程私有的数据。一个常见的例子是errno ，它用于传递系统函数的错误状态。在多线程程序中，每个线程都包含一个独立的errno副本。

                                                                                                          Thread-specific storage. Thread-specific storage (TSS) is similar in scope to global data; that is, it isn't local to any specific function or object. Unlike global data, however, each thread actually has a separate copy of TSS data. TSS can be used by applications to maintain data that many functions or objects need to access, but that's private to a given thread. A common example is errno, which conveys the error status of system functions. In a multithreaded program, each thread contains a separate copy of errno.

                                                                                                          每个 TSS 项都关联一个全局键，该键对进程内的所有线程都有效。这些键由工厂函数创建，例如Pthreads 库中的pthread_key_create()函数或Win32 库中的TlsAlloc() 函数。任何线程都可以使用该键通过指针访问其存储副本。键/指针关系由 TSS 函数管理，例如Pthreads 库中的pthread_setspecific()和pthread_getspecific()函数，或Win32 库中的TlsGetvalue()和TlsSetValue() 函数。

                                                                                                          Each TSS item is associated with a key that's global to all threads within a process. These keys are created by a factory function, such as pthread_key_create() (Pthreads) or TlsAlloc() (Win32). Any thread can use the key to access its copy of the storage via a pointer. The key/pointer relationship is managed by TSS functions, such as pthread_setspecific() and pthread_getspecific() in Pthreads or TlsGetvalue() and Tls-SetValue() in Win32.

                                                                                                            6.4 同步机制

                                                                                                            6.4 Synchronization Mechanisms

                                                                                                            如第 6.2 节和6.3节所述，操作系统平台提供了基本的同步机制，允许进程和线程等待其他进程和线程完成。这些机制足以满足同时执行多个独立执行路径的相对粗粒度应用程序的需求。然而，许多并发应用程序需要更细粒度的同步机制，以便进程和线程协调它们的执行顺序以及访问共享资源（例如文件、数据库记录、网络设备、对象成员和共享内存）的顺序。对这些资源的访问必须同步，以防止出现竞态条件。

                                                                                                            As described in Sections 6.2 and 6.3, OS platforms provide rudimentary synchronization mechanisms that allow processes and threads to wait for other processes and threads to finish. These mechanisms are sufficient for relatively coarse-grained applications that execute multiple independent execution paths concurrently. Many concurrent applications require more fine-grained synchronization mechanisms, however, to allow processes and threads to coordinate their execution order and the order that they access shared resources, such as files, database records, network devices, object members, and shared memory. Access to these resources must be synchronized to prevent race conditions.

                                                                                                            当两个或多个并发线程的执行顺序导致不可预测的错误结果时，就会发生竞态条件。防止竞态条件的一种方法是使用同步机制，将访问共享资源的关键代码段的访问串行化。常见的操作系统同步机制包括互斥锁、读写锁、信号量和条件变量。

                                                                                                            A race condition can occur when the execution order of two or more concurrent threads yields unpredictable and erroneous results. One way to prevent race conditions is to use synchronization mechanisms that serialize access to critical sections of code that access shared resources. Common OS synchronization mechanisms include mutexes, readers/writer locks, semaphores, and condition variables.

                                                                                                            为了说明这些机制的必要性，请考虑在第 94 页第 4.4.3 节中定义的Iterative_Logging_Server::handle_data()方法中添加以下内容。

                                                                                                            To illustrate the need for these mechanisms, consider the following addition to the Iterative_Logging_Server::handle_data() method defined in Section 4.4.3 on page 94.

                                                                                                            typedef u_long COUNTER;

// File scope global variable.
static COUNTER request count;

// ...

  virtual int handle_data (ACE_SOCK_Stream *) {
    while (logging_handler_.log_record () != -1)
      // Keep track of number of requests.
      ++request_count;

    ACE_DEBUG ((LM_DEBUG,
               "request_count = %d\n", request_count));
    logging_handler_.close ();
    return 0;
}

                                                                                                            ` handle_data ()`方法等待客户端发送日志记录。当收到记录时，该方法会将其移除并进行处理。`request_count`变量用于跟踪收到的客户端日志记录的数量。

                                                                                                            The handle_data() method waits for log records to arrive from a client. When a record arrives, it's removed and processed. The request_count variable keeps track of the number of incoming client log records.

                                                                                                            只要`handle_data()`函数在进程中的单个线程中执行，上面的代码就能正常工作。然而，当多个线程在同一进程中同时执行`handle_data()`函数时，在许多平台上可能会出现错误的结果。问题在于，由于全局变量 ` request_count`存在竞争条件，代码并非线程安全。特别是，在某些平台上，不同的线程可能会递增并打印 ` request_count`变量的“过期”版本。

                                                                                                            The code above works fine as long as handle_data() executes in just one thread in a process. Incorrect results can occur on many platforms, however, when multiple threads execute handle_data() simultaneously in the same process. The problem is that the code's not thread-safe due to race conditions on the global variable request_count. In particular, different threads can increment and print "stale" versions of the request_count variable on platforms where

                                                                                                            • 自增操作编译成多个汇编语言加载、添加和存储赋值和/或

                                                                                                            • Auto-increment operations compile into multiple assembly language load, add, and store assignments and/or

                                                                                                            • 硬件并不强制执行内存总顺序。

                                                                                                            • Total memory ordering is not enforced by the hardware.

                                                                                                            操作系统提供了一系列同步机制，以确保在类似情况下获得正确的结果。以下是几种最常见的同步机制。

                                                                                                            Operating systems offer a range of synchronization mechanisms to ensure correct results in this and similar situations. The following are the most common synchronization mechanisms.

                                                                                                            6.4.1 互斥锁

                                                                                                            6.4.1 Mutual Exclusion (Mutex) Locks

                                                                                                            互斥锁（mutex）可用于保护多个线程并发访问的共享资源的完整性。互斥锁通过定义一个每次只能由一个线程执行的临界区代码，来串行化多个线程的执行。互斥锁的语义是“括号式”的；也就是说，持有互斥锁的线程负责释放它。这种语义上的简洁性有助于确保高效的互斥锁实现，例如通过硬件自旋锁。[2]

                                                                                                            Mutual exclusion (mutex) locks can be used to protect the integrity of a shared resource that's accessed concurrently by multiple threads. A mutex serializes the execution of multiple threads by defining a critical section of code that can be executed by only one thread at a time. Mutex semantics are "bracketed"; that is, the thread owning a mutex is responsible for releasing it. This semantic simplicity helps ensure efficient mutex implementations, for example, via hardware spin locks.[2]

                                                                                                            [2]虽然自旋锁的单个开销很低，但如果线程必须长时间忙于等待特定条件的发生，则自旋锁可能会消耗过多的 CPU 资源。

                                                                                                            [2] Although spin locks have low individual overhead they can consume excessive CPU resources if a thread must busy wait a long period of time for a particular condition to occur.

                                                                                                            互斥锁一般分为两种类型：

                                                                                                            There are two general types of mutexes:

                                                                                                            • 非递归互斥锁，如果当前拥有该互斥锁的线程在未先释放它的情况下尝试重新获取它，则会导致死锁或其他故障。

                                                                                                            • Nonrecursive mutex that will deadlock or otherwise fail if the thread currently owning the mutex tries to reacquire it without first releasing it and

                                                                                                            • 递归互斥锁允许拥有该互斥锁的线程多次获取它而不会发生自我死锁，只要该线程最终释放互斥锁的次数相同即可。

                                                                                                            • Recursive mutex that will allow the thread owning the mutex to acquire it multiple times without self-deadlock, as long as the thread ultimately releases the mutex the same number of times.

                                                                                                            6.4.2 读写锁

                                                                                                            6.4.2 Readers/Writer Locks

                                                                                                            读写锁允许通过任一方式访问共享资源。

                                                                                                            A readers/writer lock allows access to a shared resource by either

                                                                                                            • 多个线程并发读取资源而不修改它，或者

                                                                                                            • Multiple threads reading a resource concurrently without modifying it or

                                                                                                            • 一次只能有一个线程修改资源，并且禁止所有其他线程进行读写访问。

                                                                                                            • Only one thread at a time modifying the resource and excluding all other threads from both read and write access.

                                                                                                            这种类型的锁可以提高并发应用程序的性能，因为在这些应用程序中，受读写锁保护的资源的读取频率远高于写入频率。读写锁可以实现为优先考虑读取者或写入者 [ BA90 ]。

                                                                                                            This type of lock can improve the performance of concurrent applications in which resources protected by a readers/writer lock are read from much more frequently than they are written to. Readers/writer locks can be implemented to give preference either to readers or to writers [BA90].

                                                                                                            读写锁与互斥锁有一些共同的特性；例如，获取锁的线程也必须释放该锁。当写入线程想要获取锁时，它会等待所有其他锁持有者释放锁，然后写入线程才能独占该锁。然而，与互斥锁不同的是，多个线程可以同时获取读写锁进行读取操作。

                                                                                                            Readers/writer locks share some properties with mutexes; for example, the thread that acquires a lock must also release it. When a writer wishes to acquire the lock, the thread waits for all other lock holders to release the lock, then the writer thread gains an exclusive hold on the lock. Unlike mutexes, however, multiple threads may acquire a readers/writer lock for reading simultaneously.

                                                                                                            6.4.3 信号锁

                                                                                                            6.4.3 Semaphore Locks

                                                                                                            信号量在概念上是一个非负整数，可以原子地进行递增和递减操作。当线程尝试递减值为 0 的信号量时，该线程会被阻塞。只有当另一个线程“发布”该信号量，使其计数大于 0 时，被阻塞的线程才会被释放。

                                                                                                            A semaphore is conceptually a non-negative integer that can be incremented and decremented atomically. A thread blocks when it tries to decrement a semaphore whose value equals 0. A blocked thread will be released only after another thread "posts" the semaphore, causing its count to become greater than 0.

                                                                                                            信号量通过保存状态来跟踪阻塞线程的数量和顺序。它们通常使用睡眠锁来实现，睡眠锁会触发上下文切换，从而允许其他线程执行。与互斥锁不同，信号量不需要由最初获取它们的线程释放。这种特性使得信号量可以在更广泛的执行上下文中使用，例如信号处理程序或中断处理程序。

                                                                                                            Semaphores retain state to keep track of the count and the number of blocked threads. They are often implemented using sleep locks, which trigger a context switch that allows other threads to execute. Unlike mutexes, they need not be released by the same thread that acquired them initially. This capability allows semaphores to be used in a broader range of execution contexts, such as signal handlers or interrupt handlers.

                                                                                                            6.4.4 条件变量

                                                                                                            6.4.4 Condition Variables

                                                                                                            条件变量提供的同步方式与互斥锁、读写锁或信号量锁有所不同。后三种机制会让其他线程等待，直到持有锁的线程执行临界区中的代码。相比之下，线程可以使用条件变量来协调和调度自身的处理过程。

                                                                                                            A condition variable provides a different flavor of synchronization than a mutex, readers/writer, or semaphore lock. The latter three mechanisms make other threads wait while the thread holding the lock executes code in a critical section. In contrast, a thread can use a condition variable to coordinate and schedule its own processing.

                                                                                                            例如，条件变量可以使其自身等待，直到涉及其他线程共享数据的条件表达式达到特定状态。当协作线程指示共享数据状态已改变时，阻塞在条件变量上的线程将被唤醒。新唤醒的线程随后重新评估其条件表达式，如果共享数据已达到所需状态，则可以恢复其处理。由于条件变量可以等待任意复杂的条件表达式，因此与上述其他同步机制相比，它们允许更复杂的调度决策。

                                                                                                            For example, a condition variable can make itself wait until a condition expression involving data shared by other threads attains a particular state. When a cooperating thread indicates that the shared data state has changed, a thread that's blocked on a condition variable is awakened. The newly awakened thread then reevaluates its condition expression and can resume its processing if the shared data has attained the desired state. Since arbitrarily complex condition expressions can be waited for using a condition variable, they permit more complex scheduling decisions than the other synchronization mechanisms outlined above.

                                                                                                            条件变量为高级并发模式（例如活动对象和监视器对象[ SSRB00 ]）以及进程内通信机制（例如同步消息队列）提供了核心同步机制。Pthreads 和 UNIX 国际（UI）线程（在 Solaris 上实现）原生支持条件变量，但其他平台（例如 Win32 和许多实时操作系统）则不支持。

                                                                                                            Condition variables provide the core synchronization mechanisms for advanced concurrency patterns, such as Active Object and Monitor Object [SSRB00], and intraprocess communication mechanisms, such as synchronized message queues. Pthreads and UNIX International (UI) threads (implemented on Solaris) support condition variables natively, but other platforms, such as Win32 and many real-time operating systems, do not.

                                                                                                            侧边栏 12评估了上述操作系统同步机制的相对性能特征。通常情况下，您应该尽量使用能够提供所需语义的最高效同步机制。当效率至关重要时，请查阅应用程序目标平台的参考信息。您可以通过更改 ACE 同步类来调整应用程序，以利用平台差异。此外，通过使用策略性锁定模式[ SSRB00 ] 并遵循第 10.1 节第209 页所述的ACE_LOCK*伪类的方法签名，您的代码可以保持可移植性。

                                                                                                            Sidebar 12 evaluates the relative performance characteristics of the OS synchronization mechanisms outlined above. You should generally try to use the most efficient synchronization mechanism that provides the semantics you require. When efficiency is important, look up the reference information for platforms targeted by your application. You can tune your application to take advantage of platform differences by varying the ACE synchronization classes. Moreover, your code can remain portable by using the Strategized Locking pattern [SSRB00] and conforming to the method signature of the ACE_LOCK* pseudo-class described on page 209 in Section 10.1.

                                                                                                            侧边栏 12：评估同步机制性能

                                                                                                            Sidebar 12: Evaluating Synchronization Mechanism Performance

                                                                                                            操作系统提供了一系列同步机制来满足不同应用程序的需求。尽管本章讨论的同步机制的性能会因操作系统实现和硬件的不同而有所差异，但以下是一些需要考虑的一般性问题：

                                                                                                            Operating systems provide a range of synchronization mechanisms to handle the needs of different applications. Although the performance of the synchronization mechanisms discussed in this chapter varies according to OS implementations and hardware, the following are general issues to consider:

                                                                                                            • 条件变量和信号量通常比互斥锁开销更高，因为它们的实现更复杂。然而，原生操作系统机制几乎总是比用户创建的替代方案性能更好，因为它们可以利用操作系统内部特性和硬件特定的调优。

                                                                                                            • Condition variables and semaphores often have higher overhead than mutexes since their Implementations are more complicated. Native OS mechanisms nearly always perform better than user-created substitutes, however, since they can take advantage of internal OS characteristics and hardware-specific tuning.

                                                                                                            • 互斥锁通常比读写锁开销更低，因为它们不需要管理多个写入集。然而，多个读取线程可以并行执行，因此，当用于访问读取频率远高于更新频率的数据时，读写锁在多处理器上的扩展性更好。

                                                                                                            • Mutexes generally have lower overhead than readers/writer locks because they don't need to manage multiple walter sets.
