Multiple reader threads can proceed in parallel, however, so readers/writer locks can scale better on multiprocessors when they are used to access data that are read much more than they are updated.

                                                                                                            • 非递归互斥锁比递归互斥锁效率更高。此外，如果程序员忘记释放递归互斥锁，它们可能会导致一些不易察觉的错误[ But97 ]，而非递归互斥锁则会立即通过死锁暴露这些问题。

                                                                                                            • Nonrecursive mutexes are more efficient than recursive mutexes. Moreover, recursive mutexes can cause subtle bugs if programmers forget to release them [But97], whereas nonrecursive mutexes reveal these problems by deadlocking immediately.

                                                                                                              6.5 操作系统并发机制的局限性

                                                                                                              6.5 Limitations with OS Concurrency Mechanisms

                                                                                                              使用上述原生操作系统并发机制开发网络应用程序可能会导致可移植性和可靠性问题。为了说明其中一些问题，请考虑一个使用 UI 线程互斥锁来解决我们在第 6.4 节第 131 页针对request_count观察到的自增序列化问题的函数：

                                                                                                              Developing networked applications using the native OS concurrency mechanisms outlined above can cause portability and reliability problems. To illustrate some of these problems, consider a function that uses a UI threads mutex to solve the auto-increment serialization problem we observed with request_count on page 131 in Section 6.4:

                                                                                                              typedef u_long COUNTER;

static COUNTER request_count; // File scope  global variable.

static mutex_t m; // Protects request count (initialized to zero).
// ...

  virtual int handle_data (ACE_SOCK_Stream *) {
    while (logging_handler_.log_record () != -1) {
      // Keep track of number of requests.
      mutex_lock (&m);   // Acquire lock
      ++request_count;   // Count # of requests
      mutex unlock (&m); // Release lock
    }

    mutex_lock (&m);
    int count = request_count;
    mutex_unlock (&m);
    ACE_DEBUG ((LM_DEBUG, "request_count = %d\n", count));
    logging_handler_.close ();
    return 0;
  }

                                                                                                              在上面的代码中，m是一个mutex_t类型的变量，它被自动初始化为 0。在 UI 线程中，任何被设置为零的同步变量都会被隐式地初始化为其默认语义 [ EKB + 92 ]。例如，mutex_t变量m是一个静态变量，默认情况下被初始化为未锁定状态。因此，当第一次调用mutex_lock()函数时，它将获得该锁的所有权。任何其他尝试获取该锁的线程都必须等待持有锁m 的线程释放它。

                                                                                                              In the code above, m is a variable of type mutex_t, which is automatically initialized to 0. In UI threads, any synchronization variable that's set to zero is initialized implicitly with its default semantics [EKB+92]. For example, the mutex_t variable m is a static variable that's initialized by default in the unlocked state. The first time the mutex_lock() function is called, it will therefore acquire ownership of the lock. Any other thread that attempts to acquire the lock must wait until the thread owning lock m releases it.

                                                                                                              虽然上面的代码解决了原有的同步问题，但它存在以下缺点：

                                                                                                              Although the code above solves the original synchronization problem, it suffers from the following drawbacks:

                                                                                                              • 这种方法过于繁琐。 解决方案需要修改源代码，添加互斥锁及其相关的 C 函数。在开发大型软件系统时，如果不能持续地进行此类手动修改，将会导致维护问题。

                                                                                                              • Obtrusive. The solution requires changing the source code to add the mutex and its associated C functions. When developing a large software system, making these types of modifications manually will cause maintenance problems if changes aren't made consistently.

                                                                                                              • 容易出错。 虽然`handle_data()`方法相对简单，但程序员很容易在更复杂的方法中忘记调用`mutex_unlock()` 。省略此调用会导致其他线程因尝试获取互斥锁而被阻塞，从而造成资源饥饿。此外，由于 ` mutex_t`是非递归的，如果拥有互斥锁 ` m`的线程在释放它之前尝试重新获取它，则会发生死锁。另外，我们忽略了检查`mutex_lock() ` 的返回值以确保其成功，这可能会在生产应用程序中造成一些不易察觉的问题。

                                                                                                              • Error-prone. Although the handle_data() method is relatively simple, it's easy for programmers to forget to call mutex_unlock() in more complex methods. Omitting this call will cause starvation for other threads that are blocked trying to acquire the mutex. Moreover, since a mutex_t is nonrecursive, deadlock will occur if the thread that owns mutex m tries to reacquire it before releasing it. In addition, we neglected to check the return value of mutex_lock() to make sure it succeeded, which can yield subtle problems in production applications.

                                                                                                              • 未知的副作用。 程序员也可能忘记初始化互斥锁变量。如上所述，静态的mutex_t变量在 UI 线程上会被隐式初始化。但是，对于动态分配的对象中的mutex_t字段，则没有这样的保证。此外，其他操作系统线程实现，例如 Pthreads 和 Win32 线程，不支持这种隐式初始化语义；也就是说，所有同步对象都必须显式初始化。

                                                                                                              • Unseen side-effects. It's also possible that a programmer will forget to initialize the mutex variable. As mentioned above, a static mutex_t variable is implicitly initialized on UI threads. No such guarantees are made, however, for mutex_t fields in objects allocated dynamically. Moreover, other OS thread implementations, such as Pthreads and Win32 threads, don't support these implicit initialization semantics; that is, all synchronization objects must be initialized explicitly.

                                                                                                              • 此代码不具备可移植性。 它仅适用于 UI 线程的同步机制。因此，若要将handle_data()方法移植到 Pthreads 和 Win32 线程，则需要修改锁定代码，使其使用完全不同的同步 API。

                                                                                                              • Non-portable. This code will work only with the UI threads synchronization mechanisms. Porting the handle_data() method to use Pthreads and Win32 threads will therefore require changing the locking code to use different synchronization APIs altogether.

                                                                                                              总的来说，原生操作系统并发 API 存在许多与2.3 节中 Socket API 类似的问题。此外，不同操作系统平台上的并发 API 标准化程度更低。即使 API 本身相似，不同实现之间也常常存在细微的语法和语义差异。例如，不同操作系统提供商实现的 Pthreads 标准不同草案中的函数，其参数列表和返回的错误指示器都可能不同。

                                                                                                              In general, native OS concurrency APIs exhibit many of the same types of problems associated with the Socket API in Section 2.3. In addition, concurrency APIs are even less standardized across OS platforms. Even where the APIs are similar, there are often subtle syntactic and semantic variations from one implementation to another. For example, functions in different drafts of the Pthreads standard implemented by different operating system providers have different parameter lists and return different error indicators.

                                                                                                              侧边栏 13概述了不同并发 API 的错误传播策略之间的一些差异。这种缺乏可移植性会增加并发网络应用程序的复杂性。因此，设计更高层次的编程抽象（例如 ACE 中的抽象）至关重要，这有助于开发人员避免因 API 不可移植和不统一而导致的问题。

                                                                                                              Sidebar 13 outlines some of the differences between error propagation strategies for different concurrency APIs. This lack of portability increases the accidental complexity of concurrent networked applications. Therefore, it's important to design higher-level programming abstractions, such as those in ACE, to help developers avoid problems with nonportable and nonuniform APIs.

                                                                                                              侧边栏 13：并发 API 错误传播策略

                                                                                                              Sidebar 13: Concurrency API Error Propagation Strategies

                                                                                                              不同的并发 API 向调用者报告错误的方式各不相同。例如，某些 API（如 UI 线程和 Pthreads）在成功时返回 0，失败时返回一个非零的错误值。而其他 API（如 Win32 线程）在失败时返回 0，并通过线程特定的存储来指示错误值。这种行为上的差异令人困惑且不便于移植。相比之下，ACE 并发包装器外观定义并强制执行一种统一的方法：如果发生失败，则始终返回-1，并设置一个线程特定的errno值来指示失败的原因。

                                                                                                              Different concurrency APIs report errors to callers differently, For example, some APIs, such as UI threads and Pthreads, return 0 on success and a non-0 error value on failure. Other APIs, such as Win32 threads, return 0 on failure and indicate the error value via thread-specific storage. This diversity of behaviors is confusing and nonportable. In contrast, the ACE concurrency wrapper facades define and enforce a uniform approach that always returns -1 if a failure occurs and sets a thread-specific errno value to indicate the cause of the failure.

                                                                                                                6.6 总结

                                                                                                                6.6 Summary

                                                                                                                操作系统提供并发机制，用于管理终端系统上的多个进程以及进程内的多个线程。任何优秀的通用操作系统都允许多个进程并发运行。现代通用操作系统和实时操作系统也允许多个线程并发运行。当与适当的模式和应用程序配置结合使用时，并发有助于提高性能并简化程序结构。

                                                                                                                Operating systems provide concurrency mechanisms that manage multiple processes on an end system and manage multiple threads within a process. Any decent general-purpose OS allows multiple processes to run concurrently. Modern general-purpose and real-time operating systems also allow multiple threads to run concurrently. When used in conjunction with the appropriate patterns and application configurations, concurrency helps to improve performance and simplify program structure.

                                                                                                                ACE提供的并发包装器外观类将在以下四章中进行描述：

                                                                                                                The concurrency wrapper facade classes provided by ACE are described in the following four chapters:

                                                                                                                • 第 7 章描述了同步事件解复用的 ACE 类。

                                                                                                                • Chapter 7 describes ACE classes for synchronous event demultiplexing.

                                                                                                                • 第 8 章描述了操作系统进程机制的 ACE 类。

                                                                                                                • Chapter 8 describes ACE classes for OS process mechanisms.

                                                                                                                • 第 9 章描述了操作系统线程机制的 ACE 类。

                                                                                                                • Chapter 9 describes ACE classes for OS threading mechanisms.

                                                                                                                • 第 10 章描述了操作系统同步机制的 ACE 类。

                                                                                                                • Chapter 10 describes ACE classes for OS synchronization mechanisms.

                                                                                                                在接下来的四章中，我们将探讨 ACE 如何利用 C++ 特性和包装外观模式来克服原生操作系统并发 API 的问题，从而提升并发网络应用程序的功能性、可移植性和健壮性。在适当的情况下，我们将展示 ACE 并发包装外观的实现，以说明它们如何映射到底层操作系统并发机制。我们还会指出不同操作系统平台的特性差异，以及 ACE 如何保护开发者免受这些差异的影响。

                                                                                                                Throughout these four chapters we'll examine how ACE uses C++ features and the Wrapper Facade pattern to overcome problems with native OS concurrency APIs and improve the functionality, portability, and robustness of concurrent networked applications. Where appropriate, we'll show ACE concurrency wrapper facade implementations to illustrate how they are mapped onto underlying OS concurrency mechanisms. We also point out where the features of OS platforms differ and how ACE shields developers from these differences.

                                                                                                                  第七章 ACE同步事件解复用封装外观

                                                                                                                  Chapter 7. The ACE Synchronous Event Demultiplexing Wrapper Facades

                                                                                                                  章节概要

                                                                                                                  Chapter Synopsis

                                                                                                                  本章介绍了 ACE 封装器外观，它使用可移植的 C++ 类封装了操作系统同步事件解复用机制。我们还展示了几个应用了这些 ACE 封装器外观的全新和改进版网络日志服务器。

                                                                                                                  This chapter describes the ACE wrapper facades that encapsulate OS synchronous event demultiplexing mechanisms with portable C++ classes. We also present several new and improved versions of our networked logging server that apply these ACE wrapper facades.

                                                                                                                    7.1 概述

                                                                                                                    7.1 Overview

                                                                                                                    第 5.1 节讨论了服务器并发维度，其中第 106 页的响应式服务器是设计选择之一。响应式服务器模型可以被视为“轻量级多任务处理”，它使用单线程服务器以轮询方式与多个客户端通信，而无需引入线程和同步机制带来的开销和复杂性。这种服务器并发策略使用事件循环，持续检查并响应来自客户端的事件。事件循环将来自不同事件源的输入进行解复用，以便按顺序处理它们。

                                                                                                                    Section 5.1 discussed server concurrency dimensions, with the reactive server on page 106 being one of the design choices. The reactive server model can be thought of as "lightweight multitasking," where a single-threaded server communicates with multiple clients in a round-robin manner without introducing the overhead and complexity of threading and synchronization mechanisms. This server concurrency strategy uses an event loop that examines and reacts to events from its clients continuously. An event loop demultiplexes input from various event sources so they can be processed in an orderly way.

                                                                                                                    网络应用程序中的事件源主要是套接字句柄。最便于移植的套接字句柄同步事件解复用器是select()函数及其句柄集，详见第 6.1 节第125 页。本章将介绍以下类，这些类可用于简化和优化响应式服务器中这些功能的使用：

                                                                                                                    Event sources in networked applications are primarily socket handles. The most portable synchronous event demultiplexer for socket handles is the select() function and its handle sets, discussed on page 125 in Section 6.1. This chapter describes the following classes that can be applied to simplify and optimize the use of these facilities in reactive servers:

                                                                                                                    ACE 类/方法 描述
                                                                                                                    ACE_Handle_Set 封装fd_set及其常用操作。
                                                                                                                    ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator 提供了一种可移植且高效的机制，用于遍历ACE_Handle_Set对象中的活动句柄集。
                                                                                                                    ACE::select() 简化select()的最常用用法，并增强其可移植性。

                                                                                                                    ACE_Handle_Set和ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator类的接口如图 7.1所示。这些包装器外观提供了以下优点：

                                                                                                                    The interfaces of the ACE_Handle_Set and ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator classes are shown in Figure 7.1. These wrapper facades provide the following benefits:

                                                                                                                    图 7.1. ACE_Handle_Set和ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator类图

                                                                                                                    • 确保跨操作系统平台的可移植性。ACE_Handle_Set和 ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator类可用于所有支持select()和fd_set的操作系统平台。这些类简化了 I/O 句柄的正确使用，从而可以同步地解复用网络事件。

                                                                                                                    • Ensure portability across OS platforms. The ACE_Handle_Set and ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator classes can be used on all OS platforms that support select() and fd_set. These classes simplify the correct use of I/O handles to demultiplex network events synchronously.

                                                                                                                    • 在不影响可移植性的前提下，高效地遍历活动句柄集合。 高效地遍历活动句柄集合是提升响应式服务器事件循环性能的重要因素。为了优化事件循环性能，程序员常常会深入研究fd_set的内部结构，以寻找更高效的扫描方法。ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator经过高度优化，可以减轻网络应用程序对内部fd_set表示的依赖。

                                                                                                                    • Iterate through the set of active handles efficiently without compromising portability. Iterating through the set of active handles efficiently is an important factor in enhancing the performance of reactive server event loops. The need to optimize event loop performance often tempts programmers to examine the internals of fd_set to find ways to scan them more efficiently. The ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator is highly optimized to alleviate the need for networked applications to rely on internal fd_set representations.

                                                                                                                    ACE ::select()包装方法封装了select()系统函数，并使用ACE_Handle_Set类来简化句柄传递。本文使用响应式日志服务器来演示这些 ACE 包装方法如何简化网络应用程序编程。

                                                                                                                    The ACE::select() wrapper methods encapsulate the select() system function and use the ACE_Handle_Set class to simplify handle passing. A reactive version of the logging server is used to illustrate how these ACE wrappers can simplify networked application programming.

                                                                                                                      7.2 ACE_Handle_Set 类

                                                                                                                      7.2 The ACE_Handle_Set Class

                                                                                                                      动机

                                                                                                                      Motivation

                                                                                                                      第37页的2.3 节描述了直接使用 I/O 句柄所带来的复杂性。fd_set在以下几个方面带来了额外的复杂性：

                                                                                                                      Section 2.3 on page 37 described the complexities associated with direct use of I/O handles. The fd_set represents another source of accidental complexity in the following areas:

                                                                                                                      • 平台提供的用于操作和扫描fd_set 的宏或函数必须谨慎使用，以避免处理未激活的句柄，并避免无意中损坏fd_set 。

                                                                                                                      • The macros or functions that platforms supply to manipulate and scan an fd_set must be used carefully to avoid processing handles that aren't active and to avoid corrupting an fd_set inadvertently.

                                                                                                                      • 扫描活动句柄的代码通常是性能瓶颈，因为它在一个紧密的循环中持续执行。因此，它是提升性能的明显优化目标。

                                                                                                                      • The code to scan for active handles is often a hot spot because it executes continually in a tight loop. It's therefore an obvious candidate for optimization to improve performance.

                                                                                                                      • fd_set定义在系统提供的头文件中，因此其表示形式对程序员是公开的。自然而然地，人们会忍不住以“创造性”的方式利用这种平台内部信息。然而，这样做会导致可移植性问题，因为不同平台上的表示形式差异很大。

                                                                                                                      • The fd_set is defined in system-supplied header files, so its representation is exposed to programmers. Naturally, it's tempting to make use of this platform-internal knowledge in "creative" ways. However, doing so causes portability problems because representations vary widely across platforms.

                                                                                                                      • 当fd_set与select()函数一起使用时，存在一些不易移植的细微方面。

                                                                                                                      • There are subtle nonportable aspects of fd_set when used in conjunction with the select() function.

                                                                                                                      为了说明后一点，让我们再回顾一下select()函数的函数签名：

                                                                                                                      To illustrate the latter point, let's revisit the function signature for the select() function:

                                                                                                                      int select (int width,               // Maximum handle plus 1
            fd_set *read_fds,        // Set of "read" handles
            fd_set *write_fds,       // Set of "write" handles
            fd_set *except_fds,      // Set of "exception" handles
            struct timeval *timeout);// Time to wait for events

                                                                                                                      三个fd_set参数指定在选择每种事件类型时要使用的句柄。timeout参数用于指定等待事件发生的时间限制。这些参数的具体细节在不同平台上只有细微差别。然而，由于 I/O 句柄（以及 fd_set）在不同平台上的特性不同，第一个参数（width）的含义在不同的操作系统中差异很大：

                                                                                                                      The three fd_set arguments specify the handles to use when selecting for each event type. The timeout argument is used to specify a time limit to wait for events to occur. The particular details concerning these parameters vary in only minor ways across platforms. Due to the changing nature of I/O handles (and, thus, fd_set) across platforms, however, the meaning of the first argument (width) varies widely across operating systems:

                                                                                                                      • 在 UNIX 系统中，I/O 句柄的起始值从 0 开始，并递增到操作系统定义的最大值。因此，UNIX 系统中width参数的含义是“在fd_set中扫描句柄的深度”；也就是说，它被定义为三个fd_set参数中编号最大的句柄加 1。

                                                                                                                      • On UNIX, I/O handles start at the value 0 and increase to an OS-defined maximum limit. The meaning of the width parameter on UNIX is therefore "how far into the fd_set to scan for handles"; that is, it's defined as the highest numbered handle in any of the three fd_set parameters, plus 1.

                                                                                                                      • 在 Win32 系统中，套接字句柄被实现为指针，而不是低位整数。因此，`select()` 函数的宽度参数会被完全忽略。每个`fd_set`都包含其自身的句柄计数。

                                                                                                                      • On Win32, socket handles are implemented as pointers rather than as low-numbered integers. The width argument to select() is therefore ignored completely. Instead, each fd_set contains its own handle count.

                                                                                                                      • 在其他平台上，句柄可能是不从 0 开始的整数，其定义可能又有所不同。

                                                                                                                      • On other platforms, where handles may be integers that don't start at 0, the definition may differ yet again.

                                                                                                                      fd_set中与大小相关的值也会根据平台表示的特性及其select()语义而有所不同。因此，任何直接使用原生操作系统 API 编写的应用程序都必须适应所有这些细微差别，每个项目最终可能都需要重新设计和实现用于管理宽度值的正确代码。在每个应用程序中处理这些可移植性差异既繁琐又容易出错，这就是 ACE 提供ACE_Handle_Set类的原因。

                                                                                                                      The size-related values in an fd_set are also computed differently depending on the characteristics of the platform's representation and its select() semantics. Any applications written directly to native OS APIs must therefore adapt to all these subtle differences, and each project may end up redesigning and reimplementing code that manages the proper value to supply for width. Addressing these portability differences in each application is tedious and error prone, which is why ACE provides the ACE_Handle_Set class.

                                                                                                                      等级能力

                                                                                                                      Class Capabilities

                                                                                                                      ACE_Handle_Set类使用包装外观模式 [ SSRB00 ] 来指导fd_set的封装。此类提供以下功能：

                                                                                                                      The ACE_Handle_Set class uses the Wrapper Facade pattern [SSRB00] to guide the encapsulation of fd_sets. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                                                      • 它通过简化跨操作系统平台对fd_set和select()的使用，增强了事件驱动应用程序的可移植性、易用性和类型安全性。

                                                                                                                      • It enhances the portability, ease of use, and type safety of event-driven applications by simplifying the use of fd_set and select() across OS platforms

                                                                                                                      • 它会在添加和删除句柄时自动跟踪和调整fd_set 的大小相关值。

                                                                                                                      • It tracks and adjusts the fd_set size-related values automatically as handles are added and removed

                                                                                                                      由于fd_set表示形式的差异隐藏在ACE_Handle_Set的实现中，因此应用程序代码可以编写一次，然后在移植到新平台时只需重新编译即可。

                                                                                                                      Since differences in fd_set representations are hidden in the implementation of ACE_Handle_Set, application code can be written once and then simply recompiled when it's ported to a new platform.

                                                                                                                      ACE_Handle_Set的接口如图 7.1所示，其主要方法如下表所示：

                                                                                                                      The interface for ACE_Handle_Set is shown in Figure 7.1 and its key methods are shown in the following table:

                                                                                                                      方法 描述 
                                                                                                                      ACE_Handle_Set()
reset()
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             		将句柄集初始化为其默认值。
                                                                                                                      clr_bit() 清除套装中的一个把手。
                                                                                                                      设置位() 为套装添加一个把手。
                                                                                                                      is_set() 测试指定的句柄在集合中是否处于活动状态。
                                                                                                                      num_set() 返回集合中活动句柄的数量。
                                                                                                                      最大设置() 返回集合中最大句柄的值。
                                                                                                                      fdset() 返回指向底层fd_set()的指针，如果集合中没有活动句柄，则返回 NULL 指针。
                                                                                                                      同步() 重新同步句柄集，以找到新的最高活动句柄和活动句柄的数量，这在句柄集因外部操作（例如调用 select ()）而改变后非常有用。

                                                                                                                      例子

                                                                                                                      Example

                                                                                                                      第 4.4.3 节和5.1节概述了迭代服务器的一些问题。使用同步事件解复用来实现响应式服务器模型是避免这些问题的一种策略。现在，我们展示一个示例，该示例通过使用select() 函数和ACE_Handle_Set类来增强第 4 章中的迭代日志服务器实现。该服务器对以下两种类型的事件进行解复用：

                                                                                                                      Sections 4.4.3 and 5.1 outlined some of the problems associated with iterative servers. Using synchronous event demultiplexing to implement the reactive server model is one strategy to avoid these problems. We now show an example that enhances the iterative logging server implementation from Chapter 4 by using select() together with the ACE_Handle_Set class. This server demultiplexes the following two types of events:

                                                                                                                      1. 客户新联系的到来

                                                                                                                      2. Arrival of new connections from clients

                                                                                                                      3. 客户端连接上的日志记录到达

                                                                                                                      4. Arrival of log records on client connections

                                                                                                                      我们将实现放在名为Reactive_Logging_Server.h的头文件中，该文件首先包含了 ACE 的Handle_Set.h文件和Iterative_Logging_Server.h文件。我们从第 92 页定义的Iterative_Logging_Server类派生出一个新的类Reactive_Logging_Server。我们重用了它的数据成员，并定义了两个用于管理多个客户端的新成员。

                                                                                                                      We put our implementation in a header file named Reactive_Logging_Server.h, which starts by including ACE's Handle_Set.h file and the Iterative_Logging_Server.h file. We derive a new class, Reactive_Logging_Server, from the Iterative_Logging_Server class defined on page 92. We reuse its data members and define two more that are used to manage multiple clients.

                                                                                                                      #include "ace/Handle_Set.h"
#include "Iterative_Logging_Server.h"

class Reactive_Logging_Server : public Iterative_Logging_Server
{
protected:
  // Keeps track of the acceptor socket handle and all the
  // connected stream socket handles.
  ACE_Handle_Set master_handle_set_;

  // Keep track of handles marked as active by <select>.
  ACE_Handle_Set active_handles_;

  // Other methods shown below...
};

                                                                                                                      为了实现响应式服务器语义，我们重写了Iterative_Logging_Server中的 hook 方法，首先是open()：[1]

                                                                                                                      To implement reactive server semantics, we override the hook methods in Iterative_Logging_Server, starting with open():[1]

                                                                                                                      [1]为了节省空间，我们省略了比我们早期迭代日志服务器实现中更多的错误处理。

                                                                                                                      [1] To save space, we omit more of the error handling than in our earlier iterative logging server implementation.

                                                                                                                      virtual int open (u_short logger_port) {
  Iterative_Logging_Server::open (logger_port);
  master_handle_set_.set_bit (acceptor () .get_handle ());
  acceptor ().enable (ACE_NONBLOCK);
  return 0;
}

                                                                                                                      在调用其父类的open()方法初始化 acceptor 之后，我们调用master_handle_set_的set_bit()方法来跟踪 acceptor 的套接字句柄。此外，我们还将acceptor设置为非阻塞模式，原因详见侧边栏 14。

                                                                                                                      After calling down to its parent class's open() method to initialize the acceptor, we call the set_bit() method on the master_handle_set_ to keep track of the acceptor's socket handle. We also set the acceptor into non-blocking mode for the reasons described in Sidebar 14.

                                                                                                                      接下来，我们为响应式服务器实现 ` wait_for_multiple_events()`方法。我们将`master_handle_set_`复制到`active_handles_`中，后者将被`select()`修改。我们需要使用类型转换来计算`select()`的宽度参数，以便在 Win32 平台上编译（在该平台上传递给`select()` 的实际值会被忽略）。`select ()`的第二个参数是指向`active_handles_`中底层`fd_set`的指针，该`fd_set` 可通过`ACE_Handle_Set::fdset()`方法访问。

                                                                                                                      Next, we implement the wait_for_multiple_events() method for the reactive server. We copy master_handle_set_ into active_handles_, which will be modified by select(). We need to calculate the width argument for select() using a cast to compile on Win32 (the actual value passed to select() is ignored on that platform). The second parameter to select() is a pointer to the underlying fd_set in active_handles_accessed via the ACE_Handle_Set: : fdset() method.

                                                                                                                      virtual int wait_for_multiple_events () {
  active_handles_ = master_handle_set_;
  int width = (int) active_handles_.max_set () + 1;
  if (select (width,
              active_handles_.fdset (),
              0,  // no write_fds
              0,  // no except_fds
              0)) // no timeout
    return -1;
  active_handles_.sync
    ((ACE_HANDLE) active_handles_.max_set () + 1);
  return 0;
}

                                                                                                                      侧边栏 14：非阻塞接受者的动机

                                                                                                                      Sidebar 14: Motivation for Nonblocking Acceptors

                                                                                                                      当接收套接字被传递给`select()`时，一旦收到连接，它就会被标记为“活动”。许多服务器利用此事件来指示可以不阻塞地调用`accept()`。然而，由于 TCP/IP 的异步特性，这里存在一个竞态条件。具体来说，在`select()`指示接收套接字处于活动状态之后（但在调用`accept()`之前），客户端可以关闭其连接，此时`accept()`可能会阻塞，并可能导致整个应用程序进程挂起。为了避免这个问题，在使用`select()`时，应始终将接收套接字设置为非阻塞模式。在 ACE 中，可以通过将 `ACE_NONBLOCK` 标志传递给`ACE_IPC_SAP`导出的`enable()`方法来方便地处理这个问题，从而也为`ACE_SOCK_Acceptor`提供了支持。

                                                                                                                      When an acceptor socket is passed to select(), it's marked as "active" when a connection is received. Many servers use this event to indicate that it's okay to call accept() without blocking. Unfortunately, there's a race condition that stems from the asynchronous behavior of TCP/IP In particular, after select() indicates an acceptor socket is active (but before accept() is called) a client can close its connection, whereupon accept() can block and potentially hang the entire application process. To avoid this problem, acceptor sockets should always be set into non-blocking mode when used with select(). In ACE, this is handled portably and conveniently by passing the ACE_NONBLOCK flag to the enable() method exported by ACE_IPC_SAP and, thus, by ACE_SOCK_Acceptor.

                                                                                                                      如果发生错误，`select()`返回-1，我们将其作为方法的值返回。如果成功，则返回活动句柄的数量，并修改 ` active_handles_fd_set`以指示每个当前活动的句柄。调用`ACE_Handle_Set::sync()`会重置`active_handles_`中的句柄计数和大小相关值，以反映`select()`所做的更改。

                                                                                                                      If an error occurs, select() returns –1, which we return as the value of the method. If it succeeds, the number of active handles is returned and the active_handles_fd_set is modified to indicate each handle that's now active. The call to ACE_Handle_Set::sync() resets the handle count and size-related values in active_handles_ to reflect the changes made by select().

                                                                                                                      现在我们展示 ` handle_connections()`钩子方法的实现。如果 acceptor 的句柄处于活动状态，我们会接受所有到达的连接，并将它们添加到 ` master_handle_set_`中。由于我们将 acceptor 设置为非阻塞模式，因此当所有待处理的连接都被接受后，它会返回-1并将`errno`设置为 `EWOULDBLOCK`，如侧边栏 14中所述。因此，我们无需担心进程会无限期地挂起。

                                                                                                                      We now show the implementation of the handle_connections() hook method. If the acceptor's handle is active, we accept all the connections that have arrived and add them to the master_handle_set_. Since we set the acceptor into non-blocking mode, it returns -1 and sets errno to EWOULDBLOCK when all pending connections have been accepted, as described in Sidebar 14. We therefore needn't worry about the process hanging indefinitely.

                                                                                                                      virtual int handle_connections() {
  if (active_handles_.is_set (acceptor ().get_handle ())) {
    while (acceptor ().accept (logging_handler ().peer ()) == 0)
      master_handle_set_.set_bit
        (logging_handler ().peer ().get_handle ());
        // Remove acceptor handle from further consideration.
        active_handles_.clr_bit (acceptor().get_handle());
  }
  return 0;
}

                                                                                                                      请注意我们在此处使用了`get_handle()`方法，以及在下面的 ` handle_data()`方法中使用了`set_handle()`方法。这种直接使用底层套接字句柄的做法符合第 237 页A.2.2 节中解释的“允许受控违反类型安全”设计原则。

                                                                                                                      Note our use of the get_handle() method here, as well as the use of set_handle() in the handle_data() method below. This direct use of a low-level socket handle is permitted by the Allow Controlled Violations of Type Safety design principle explained in Section A.2.2 on page 237.

                                                                                                                      handle_data () hook 方法会遍历所有可能处于活动状态的句柄；对于每个活动句柄，它会调用第 91 页定义的log_record()方法。此方法会处理每个活动连接中的一个日志记录。

                                                                                                                      The handle_data() hook method loops over the set of handles that may be active; for each active handle it calls the log_record() method defined on page 91. This method processes one log record from each active connection.

                                                                                                                      // This method has problems. Do not copy this example!
virtual int handle_data (ACE_SOCK_Stream *) {
  for (ACE_HANDLE handle = acceptor ().get_handle () + 1;
       handle < active_handles_.max_set () + 1;
       handle++) {
    if (active_handles_.is_set (handle)) {
      logging_handler ().peer ().set_handle (handle);

      if (logging_handler ().log_record () == -1) {
        // Handle connection shutdown or comm failure.
        master_handle_set_.clr_bit (handle);
        logging_handler ().close ();
      }
    }
  }

  return 0;
}

                                                                                                                      在handle_data() 函数中，我们使用ACE_Handle_Set方法来处理数据。

                                                                                                                      In handle_data() we use ACE_Handle_Set methods to

                                                                                                                      • 检查句柄是否处于活动状态

                                                                                                                      • Check if a handle is active

                                                                                                                      • 当客户端关闭连接时，清除master_handle_set_中的句柄。

                                                                                                                      • Clear the handle in the master_handle_set_ when a client closes its connection

                                                                                                                      虽然这种方法相当简洁，但以上述方式使用ACE_Handle_Set存在一些缺点。下一节将介绍ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator如何解决这些问题，因此请务必在将上述解决方案应用到您自己的代码之前阅读该部分！

                                                                                                                      Although this method is fairly concise, there are several drawbacks with using ACE_Handle_Set in the manner shown above. The next section describes how the ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator addresses these problems, so make sure to read it before applying the solution above in your own code!

                                                                                                                      我们的main()函数与4.4.3 节中的迭代服务器几乎完全相同。唯一的区别是我们定义了Reactive_Logging_Server的实例，而不是Iterative_Logging_Server的实例。

                                                                                                                      Our main() function is almost identical to the iterative server in Section 4.4.3. The only difference is we define an instance of Reactive_ Logging_Server rather than Iterative_Logging_Server.

                                                                                                                      #include "ace/Log_Msg.h"
#include "Reactive_Logging_Server.h"

int main (int argc, char *argv[])
{
  Reactive_Logging_Server server;

  if (server.run (argc, argv) == -1)
    ACE_ERROR_RETURN ((LM_ERROR, "%p\n", "server.run()"), 1);
  return 0;
}

                                                                                                                        7.3 ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator 类

                                                                                                                        7.3 The ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator Class

                                                                                                                        动机

                                                                                                                        Motivation

                                                                                                                        前面的例子展示了响应式服务器如何通过以下步骤将事件拆分为多个事件处理程序：

                                                                                                                        The preceding example showed how reactive servers demultiplex events to event handlers via the following steps:

                                                                                                                        1. select ()函数返回其修改后的句柄集中处于活动状态的句柄数量。

                                                                                                                        2. The select() function returns the number of handles whose values are active in its modified handle set(s).

                                                                                                                        3. 服务器的事件循环随后扫描句柄集，识别活动句柄，并为每个句柄运行事件处理代码。

                                                                                                                        4. The server's event loop then scans through the handle sets, identifies the active handles, and runs the event handling code for each handle.

                                                                                                                        尽管这些步骤看似简单，但在实践中却会遇到一些问题，因为select()返回的是活动句柄值的总数，但并不指明它们位于哪个句柄集中。因此，应用程序必须扫描每个句柄集的内容才能找到活动句柄。扫描句柄集的一种方法是，对每个可能处于活动状态的句柄调用ACE_Handle_Set::is_set()，就像我们在第 146 页的handle_data()方法中所做的那样。然而，这种方法存在两个问题：

                                                                                                                        Although these steps seem simple, complications arise in practice since select() returns the total number of active handle values, but doesn't indicate in which handle set(s) they reside. Applications must therefore scan through the contents of each handle set to find the active handles. One way to scan a handle set is to call ACE_Handle_Set::is_set() on each handle that may be active, as we did in the handle_data() method on page 146. There are two problems with this approach, however:

                                                                                                                        • 用于遍历句柄的 for循环技术仅适用于将套接字句柄表示为连续无符号整数范围的操作系统平台。虽然 POSIX/UNIX 平台支持此技术，但它在 Win32 上不起作用，因此代码不具备可移植性。此外，该循环假定接收方套接字拥有最小的句柄。在复杂的应用程序中，如果句柄在接收方套接字之前打开，之后又被关闭，则此假设可能不成立，此时它们的句柄值将被回收利用。

                                                                                                                        • The for loop technique used to iterate through the handles works only on OS platforms that represent socket handles as a contiguous range of unsigned integers. While POSIX/UNIX platforms support this technique, it doesn't work on Win32, so the code is non-portable. Moreover, the loop assumes that the acceptor socket has the lowest socket handle. In complex applications this property may not be true if handles were opened before the acceptor socket and later closed, in which case their handle values will be recycled.

                                                                                                                        • 即使在支持连续句柄值的平台上，每次 ` is_set()`操作也会按顺序对所有可能的句柄值调用。然而，在网络应用程序中，通常情况下，任何时候都只有部分套接字句柄处于活动状态。按顺序搜索稀疏填充的句柄集效率低下，尤其是在句柄数量较大的情况下；例如，许多 UNIX 平台默认每个`fd_set`包含 1024 个句柄。虽然可以使用`ACE_Handle_Set` 的 `max_set()`和`num_set()`方法来限制搜索范围，但按顺序扫描句柄集仍然存在不必要的效率损失。

                                                                                                                        • Even on platforms that do support contiguous handle values, each is_set() operation is called sequentially on all possible handle values. In networked applications it's often the case, however, that only some of the many possible socket handles are active at any point. Searching the sparsely populated handle sets sequentially is inefficient, particularly if the potential number of handles is large; for example, many UNIX platforms default to 1,024 handles per fd_set. Although the ACE_Handle_Set max_set() and num_set() methods can be used to limit the scope of a search, there are still unnecessary inefficiencies associated with scanning handle sets sequentially.

                                                                                                                        解决这些可移植性问题并优化每个应用程序中的这些瓶颈既繁琐又容易出错，因此 ACE 提供了ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator类。

                                                                                                                        Addressing these portability concerns and optimizing these bottlenecks in each application is tedious and error prone, which is why ACE provides the ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator class.

                                                                                                                        等级能力

                                                                                                                        Class Capabilities

                                                                                                                        ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator基于迭代器模式 [ GHJV95 ] ，它提供了一种在不暴露对象底层结构的情况下按顺序访问聚合对象元素的方法。此类高效地扫描ACE_Handle_Set中的句柄，并通过其operator()方法一次返回一个活动句柄。ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator的接口及其与ACE_Handle_Set类的关系如图 7.1 （第 140 页）所示。其关键方法如下表所示：

                                                                                                                        The ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator is based on the Iterator pattern [GHJV95] that provides ways to access elements of an aggregate object sequentially without exposing the underlying structure of the object. This class scans efficiently through the handles in an ACE_Handle_Set, returning only the active handles one at a time through its operator() method. The interface of ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator and its relationship with the ACE_Handle_Set class is shown in Figure 7.1 on page 140. Its key methods are shown in the following table:

                                                                                                                        方法 描述
                                                                                                                        ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator() 初始化句柄集迭代器以迭代ACE_Handle_Set。
                                                                                                                        操作员（） 返回句柄集中下一个未见过的句柄，如果所有句柄都已见过，则返回 ACE_INVALID_HANDLE。

                                                                                                                        由于ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator并非设计为“健壮的迭代器”[ Kof93 ]，因此重要的是不要从正在迭代的ACE_Handle_Set中清除句柄。

                                                                                                                        Since the ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator is not designed as a "robust iterator" [Kof93] it's important to not clear handles from an ACE_Handle_Set that's being iterated over.

                                                                                                                        尽管ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator 的接口很简单，但它的实现比第 3 章中描述的 ACE Socket 包装器外观更强大。特别是，ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator封装了所有平台特定的fd_set表示细节，这有助于以可移植且高效的方式遍历ACE_Handle_Set中的所有活动句柄，如下所示：

                                                                                                                        Although ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator has a simple interface, it's implementation is more powerful than the ACE Socket wrapper facades described in Chapter 3. In particular, ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator encapsulates all the platform-specific fd_set representation details that help to iterate through all active handles in an ACE_Handle_Set portably and efficiently, as follows:

                                                                                                                        • Winsock 的fd_set包含一个字段，用于存储集合中句柄值的数量。句柄本身存储在句柄值数组的相邻位置。ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator利用这一信息，无需搜索下一个句柄，也无需搜索所有可能的句柄值来查找活动句柄，即可访问每个句柄。

                                                                                                                        • Winsock's fd_set has a field containing the number of handle values in the set. The handles themselves are stored in adjacent locations in an array of handle values. ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator uses this knowledge to access each handle without having to search for the next handle, and without having to search all possible handle values for active handles.

                                                                                                                        • 大多数 UNIX fd_set表示法利用了句柄值0到n 的范围，将每个可能的句柄值分配给一个单独的位。因此， fd_set包含一个足够大的整数数组，可以覆盖整个位值范围。ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator类旨在通过跳过值为零的整数数组元素来快速扫描大量非活动句柄值序列。非零数组元素可以通过移位和掩码位来快速扫描，使用私有类成员来记住数组元素，并在operator()调用之间移动位置。

                                                                                                                        • Most UNIX fd_set representations take advantage of the 0-n range of possible handle values by assigning each possible handle value to a single bit. An fd_set thus contains an array of integers that's large enough to cover the entire range of bit values. The ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator class is designed to scan past large sequences of inactive handle values rapidly by skipping integer array elements that have zero values. Nonzero array elements can be scanned quickly by shifting and masking bits, using private class members to remember the array element and shift position between operator() invocations.

                                                                                                                        • 通过使用更合适的移位和数组元素访问策略，可以适应底层fd_set的不同大小和位顺序。例如，ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator可以配置为使用基于以下两个假设的高度优化的位操作算法：

                                                                                                                          - fd_set由单词数组表示（在大多数 UNIX 平台上都是如此）。

                                                                                                                          - 如果n是一个字，表达式n &~( n - 1) 访问 n 的最低有效位 (1sb) 。

                                                                                                                          该算法的关键优化在于， fd_set中每个字测试的位数恰好是当前激活的位数，而不是字中的总位数。当激活句柄较少时，该算法可以显著提升服务器性能。

                                                                                                                          在这个算法中，ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator首先在fd_set中找到第一个具有有效位的字。由于表达式word &~( word- 1) 测试字中第 1 位是否有效，我们需要找到n使得 1sb = 2n 。对于fd_set中的每个字，其运行时间复杂度为 O(字中有效位的数量)。因此，如果一个字由 64 位组成，并且只有一个位有效，则运行时间复杂度为 1，而不是 64。

                                                                                                                        • Different sizes and bit orders of underlying fd_set are adapted to by using more appropriate shifting and array element access strategies. For example, the ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator can be configured to use a highly optimized bit manipulation algorithm based on the following two assumptions:

                                                                                                                          - The fd_set is represented by an array of words(this is the case on most UNIX platforms).

                                                                                                                          - If n is a word, the expression n &~(n - 1) accesses the least-significant bit (1sb) of n.

                                                                                                                          The key optimization in this algorithm is that the number of bits tested in each word in an fd_set is exactly the number of bits active, rather than the total number of bits in the word. When there are few active handles, this algorithm can improve server performance significantly.

                                                                                                                          In this algorithm, the ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator starts by finding the first word with an active bit in fd_set. Since the expression word &~(word–1) tests the 1sb active in a word, we must find n such that 1sb = 2n. For each word in fd_set we have a cost of O(number of bits active in word). Thus, if a word consists of 64 bits and there's only one bit active, the run-time cost is 1, rather than 64.

                                                                                                                        • ACE_Handle_Set可以配置为使用另一种快速算法，该算法在select()设置句柄后生成活动句柄的计数。它维护一个包含 256 个字符的数组，每个元素包含生成索引值所需的活动位数量。例如，元素 5 的值为 2（二进制数 5 需要设置 2 位，即 0 和 2）。通过快速遍历fd_set元素并对相应的数组值求和，可以快速计算fd_set中的活动位数量，而无需顺序扫描所有元素。

                                                                                                                        • ACE_Handle_Set can be configured to use another fast algorithm that generates a count of active handles after select() sets them. It maintains a 256 element array of characters, with each element containing the number of active bits required to produce the index value. For example, element 5 contains the value of 2 (2 bits, 0 and 2, are set for the binary number 5). By skimming through the fd_set elements and summing the corresponding array values, the number of active bits in the fd_set can be calculated quickly without scanning them all sequentially.

                                                                                                                        • 由于ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator是ACE_Handle_Set的友元函数，它可以利用计算出的活动句柄数量和最大句柄值来限制其搜索空间。这种设计使得ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator能够扫描所有可能处于活动状态的句柄值的最小必要子集。

                                                                                                                        • Since ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator is a friend of ACE_Handle_Set, it can use the calculated number of active handles and the maximum handle value to limit its search space. This design allows an ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator to scan the smallest necessary subset of handle values that may be active.

                                                                                                                        通过将所有这些优化细节隐藏在ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator中，ACE 可以在不影响应用程序可移植性的前提下，显著提升关键同步事件解复用操作的性能。此类展示了适当的抽象级别如何显著提升应用程序性能。

                                                                                                                        By hiding all these optimization details in ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator, ACE can greatly improve the performance of key synchronous event demultiplexing operations without compromising application portability. This class illustrates how the appropriate levels of abstraction can improve application performance significantly.

                                                                                                                        例子

                                                                                                                        Example

                                                                                                                        本示例说明了如何使用ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator来解决第 7.2 节末尾（第 146 页）提到的响应式日志服务器的缺点。我们将重点放在第146 页所示的handle_data()方法上，并将其大部分代码替换为ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator ，该 ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator 会遍历active_handles_，如下所示：

                                                                                                                        This example illustrates how we can use the ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator to solve the drawbacks with the reactive logging server alluded to near the end of Section 7.2 on page 146. We focus our attention on the handle_data() method shown on page 146, replacing much of its code with an ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator that iterates over the active_handles_ as follows:

                                                                                                                        virtual int handle_data (ACE_SOCK_Stream *) {
  ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator peer_iterator (active_handles_);
    for (ACE_HANDLE handle;
         (handle = peer_iterator ()) != ACE_INVALID_HANDLE;
         ) {
      logging handler ().peer ().set_handle (handle);

      if (logging_handler ().log_record () == -1) {
        // Handle connection shutdown or comm failure.
        master_handle_set_.clr_bit (handle);
        logging_handler ().close ();
      }
    }
}

                                                                                                                        这段代码不仅更简洁、更易于移植，而且由于采用了ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator优化，效率也更高。

                                                                                                                        Not only is this code more concise and portable, but it's also more efficient due to the ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator optimizations.

                                                                                                                          7.4 ACE::select() 方法

                                                                                                                          7.4 The ACE::select() Methods

                                                                                                                          动机

                                                                                                                          Motivation

                                                                                                                          select ()函数在大多数操作系统平台上都可用。然而，即使是这个常用的函数也存在一些微妙之处，使其使用起来比实际需要的要复杂。例如，请看第 144 页中select()的用法。尽管select()在响应式服务器中最常见的用途是无限期地等待一组套接字句柄的输入，但程序员必须为写入和异常的fd_set以及超时指针提供 NULL 指针。此外，程序员还必须记住调用active_handles_的sync()方法来反映select()所做的更改。在每个应用程序中处理这些问题既繁琐又容易出错，因此 ACE 提供了ACE::select()包装方法。

                                                                                                                          The select() function is available on most OS platforms. Yet even this common function has subtleties that make it harder to use than necessary. For example, consider how select() is used on page 144. Even though the most common use case for select() in a reactive server is to wait indefinitely for input on a set of socket handles, programmers must provide NULL pointers for the write and exception fd_sets and for the timeout pointer. Moreover, programmers must remember to call the sync() method on active_handles_ to reflect changes made by select(). Addressing these issues in each application can be tedious and error prone, which is why ACE provides the ACE::select() wrapper methods.

                                                                                                                          方法能力

                                                                                                                          Method Capabilities

                                                                                                                          ACE 为原生select()函数定义了重载的静态包装方法，简化了其在最常见情况下的使用。这些方法在工具类ACE中定义如下：

                                                                                                                          ACE defines overloaded static wrapper methods for the native select() function that simplify its use for the most common cases. These methods are defined in the utility class ACE as follows:

                                                                                                                          class ACE  {
public:
  static int select (int width,
                     ACE_Handle_Set &rfds,
                     const ACE_Time_Value *tv = 0);
  static int select (int width,
                     ACE_Handle_Set *rfds,
                     ACE_Handle_Set *wfds = 0,
                     ACE_Handle_Set *efds = 0,
                     const ACE_Time_Value *tv = 0);
  // ... Other methods omitted ....
};

                                                                                                                          ACE类中的第一个重载`select()`方法省略了某些参数，并指定了默认值为无超时值，即无限期等待。第二个方法为不常用的写入和异常` ACE_Handle_Set`提供了默认值 0。当底层`select()`方法返回时，这两个方法都会自动调用`ACE_Handle_Set::sync()`，以重置句柄集中的句柄计数和大小相关值，从而反映`select()`所做的任何更改。

                                                                                                                          The first overloaded select() method in class ACE omits certain parameters and specifies a default value of no time-out value, that is, wait indefinitely. The second method supplies default values of 0 for the infrequently used write and exception ACE_Handle_Sets. They both automatically call ACE_Handle_Set::sync() when the underlying select() method returns to reset the handle count and size-related values in the handle set to reflect any changes made by select().

                                                                                                                          我们设计这些包装函数时，充分考虑了设计细节和常见用法，旨在简化编程工作量并降低应用程序代码出错的概率。该设计基于以下因素：

                                                                                                                          We devised these wrapper functions by paying attention to design details and common usages to simplify programming effort and reduce the chance for errors in application code. The design was motivated by the following factors:

                                                                                                                          • 针对常见情况进行简化。 如上所述，在响应式服务器中， `select()`最常见的用例是无限期地等待一组套接字句柄上的输入。`ACE ::select()`方法简化了这种常见用例。我们将在A.3 节中进一步讨论这一设计原则。

                                                                                                                          • Simplify for the common case. As mentioned above, the most common use case for select() in a reactive server is to wait indefinitely for input on a set of socket handles. The ACE::select() methods simplify this common use case. We discuss this design principle further in Section A.3.

                                                                                                                          • 封装平台差异。 所有版本的select()函数都接受一个超时参数；但是，只有 Linux 版本会在返回时修改超时值，以反映选择句柄时剩余的超时时间。ACE ::select()包装函数将超时值声明为常量，以明确其行为，并包含内部代码来规避 Linux 上非标准的超时修改扩展。我们将在A.5 节中进一步讨论此设计原则。

                                                                                                                          • Encapsulate platform variation. All versions of select() accept a timeout argument; however, only Linux's version modifies the timeout value on return to reflect how much time was left in the time-out period when one of the handles was selected. The ACE::select() wrapper functions declare the timeout const to unambiguously state its behavior, and include internal code to work around the nonstandard time-out-modifying extensions on Linux. We discuss this design principle further in Section A.5.

                                                                                                                          • 提供类型可移植性。由于不同平台上的计时器类型不一致，因此使用ACE_Time_Value 类代替平台原生计时器类型。

                                                                                                                          • Provide type portability. The ACE_Time_Value class is used instead of the native timer type for the platform since timer types aren't consistent across all platforms.

                                                                                                                          例子

                                                                                                                          Example

                                                                                                                          日志服务器越实用、越便携，就会有越多的客户端应用程序想要使用它，其负载也会越大。因此，我们需要提前规划，设计后续的日志服务器，避免成为性能瓶颈。在接下来的几章中，我们将探讨操作系统并发机制及其相关的ACE包装器外观。然而，随着并发使用范围的扩大，目前使用的单个日志记录文件将会成为瓶颈，因为所有日志记录最终都会汇聚到该文件中。

                                                                                                                          The more useful and portable we make our logging server, the more client applications will want to use it and the greater its load will become. We therefore want to think ahead and design our subsequent logging servers to avoid becoming a bottleneck. In the next few chapters, we'll explore OS concurrency mechanisms and their associated ACE wrapper facades. As our use of concurrency expands, however, the single log record file we've been using thus far will become a bottleneck since all log records converge to that file.

                                                                                                                          为了应对不同形式的并发，我们扩展了最新的响应式服务器示例，使其能够将来自不同客户端的日志记录写入不同的日志文件，每个连接的客户端对应一个日志文件。图 7.2展示了更具可扩展性的响应式日志服务器架构，该架构基于并增强了本章前面的两个示例。如图所示，此响应式服务器实现维护了一个映射容器，允许日志服务器为每个客户端保留单独的日志文件。该图还展示了我们如何使用ACE::select()包装方法和ACE_Handle_Set类，通过响应式服务器模型为多个客户端提供服务。

                                                                                                                          In preparation for adding different forms of concurrency therefore, we extend our latest reactive server example to write log records from different clients to different log files, one for each connected client. Figure 7.2 illustrates the potentially more scalable reactive logging server architecture that builds upon and enhances the two earlier examples in this chapter. As shown in the figure, this reactive server implementation maintains a map container that allows a logging server to keep separate log files for each of its clients. The figure also shows how we use the ACE::select() wrapper method and the ACE_Handle_Set class to service multiple clients via a reactive server model.

                                                                                                                          图 7.2. 响应式日志服务器的架构

                                                                                                                          我们的实现首先包含几个新的头文件，这些头文件提供了我们将在日志服务器中使用的各种新功能。

                                                                                                                          Our implementation starts by including several new header files that provide various new capabilities we'll use in our logging server.

                                                                                                                          #include "ace/ACE.h"
#include "ace/Handle_Set.h"
#include "ace/Hash_Map_Manager.h"
#include "ace/Synch.h"
#include "Logging_Server.h"
#include "Logging_Handler.h"

                                                                                                                          接下来，我们定义ACE_Hash_Map_Manager模板的类型定义，这将在侧边栏 15中进行解释。

                                                                                                                          We next define a type definition of the ACE_Hash_Map_Manager template, which is explained in Sidebar 15.

                                                                                                                          typedef ACE_Hash_Map_Manager<ACE_HANDLE,
                             ACE_ FILE IO *,
                             ACE_Null_Mutex> LOG_MAP;

                                                                                                                          我们将使用此模板的一个实例，将活动的ACE_HANDLE套接字连接高效地映射到与其日志文件对应的ACE_FILE_IO对象。通过使用ACE_HANDLE作为映射键，我们解决了一个重要的可移植性问题：UNIX 上的套接字句柄是小的无符号整数，而 Win32 上的套接字句柄是指针。

                                                                                                                          We'll use an instance of this template to map an active ACE_HANDLE socket connection efficiently onto the ACE_FILE_IO object that corresponds to its log file. By using ACE_HANDLE as the map key, we address an important portability issue: socket handles on UNIX are small unsigned integers, whereas on Win32 they are pointers.

                                                                                                                          我们创建了一个名为Reactive_Logging_Server_Ex.h的新头文件，其中包含一个名为Reactive_Logging_Server_Ex的子类，该子类继承自Logging_Server 。此实现与7.2 节中的实现的主要区别在于，我们构建了一个log_map，以便高效地将活动句柄与其对应的ACE_FILE_IO指针关联起来。为了避免将活动句柄误认为是流套接字，我们没有将ACE_SOCK_Acceptor添加到log_map中。

                                                                                                                          We create a new header file named Reactive_Logging_Server_Ex.h that contains a subclass called Reactive_Logging_Server_Ex, which inherits from Logging_Server. The main difference between this implementation and the one in Section 7.2 is that we construct a log_map to associate active handles to their corresponding ACE_FILE_IO pointers efficiently. To prevent any doubt that an active handle is a stream socket the ACE_SOCK_Acceptor isn't added to the log_map.

                                                                                                                          class Reactive_Logging_Server_Ex : public Logging_Server
{
protected:
  // Associate an active handle to an <ACE_FILE_IO> pointer.
  LOG_MAP log_map_;

  // Keep track of acceptor socket and all the connected
  // stream socket handles.
  ACE_Handle_Set master_handle_set_;

  // Keep track of read handles marked as active by <select>.
  ACE_Handle_Set active_read_handles_;

  // Other methods shown below...
};

                                                                                                                          侧边栏 15：ACE 容器类

                                                                                                                          Sidebar 15: The ACE Container Classes

                                                                                                                          ACE 提供了一系列容器类，包括

                                                                                                                          ACE provides a suite of containers classes, Including

                                                                                                                          • 单链表和双链表

                                                                                                                          • Singly and doubly linked lists

                                                                                                                          • 集合和多重集合

                                                                                                                          • Sets and multisets

                                                                                                                          • 栈和队列

                                                                                                                          • Stacks and queues

                                                                                                                          • 动态数组

                                                                                                                          • Dynamic arrays

                                                                                                                          • 字符串操作类

                                                                                                                          • String manipulation classes

                                                                                                                          这些类尽可能地模仿 C++ 标准库类，以便随着 C++ 编译器的成熟，可以轻松地在它们之间切换。

                                                                                                                          Where possible, these classes are modeled after the C++ standard library classes so that it's easy to switch between them as C++ compilers mature,

                                                                                                                          ACE_Hash_Map_Manager定义了一个集合抽象，可以高效地将键与值关联起来。我们使用此类而不是“标准”的std::map [ Aus98 ]的原因有几个：

                                                                                                                          The ACE_Hash_Map_Manager defines a set abstraction that associates keys to values efficiently. We use this class instead of the "standard" std::map [Aus98] for several reasons:

                                                                                                                          1. std ::map并不那么标准——并非所有 ACE 支持的编译器都实现了它，即使实现了，它们的接口实现方式也不尽相同。

                                                                                                                          2. The std::map isn't so standard—not all compilers that ACE works with Implement it, and those that do don't all implement its interface the same way.

                                                                                                                          3. ACE_Hash_Map_Manager基于哈希执行高效的查找，而std::map目前还不支持此功能。

                                                                                                                          4. The ACE_Hash_Map_Manager performs efficient lookups based on hashing, something std::map doesn't yet support.

                                                                                                                          [ HJS ]中有更多关于 ACE 容器类的介绍。

                                                                                                                          More coverage of the ACE container classes appears in [HJS].

                                                                                                                          open () hook 方法只是简单地执行初始化响应式服务器所需的步骤。

                                                                                                                          The open() hook method simply performs the steps necessary to initialize the reactive server.

                                                                                                                          virtual int open (u_short port) {
