  Logging_Server::open (port);
  master_handle_set_.set_bit (acceptor ().get_handle ());
  acceptor ().enable (ACE_NONBLOCK);
  return 0;
}

                                                                                                                          此响应式服务器中的wait_for_multiple_events() hook方法与第 7.2 节中的方法类似。不过，在此方法中，我们调用了ACE::select() ，它是 ACE 中的一个静态包装方法，为select()函数中不常用的参数提供默认参数。

                                                                                                                          The wait_for_multiple_events() hook method in this reactive server is similar to the one in Section 7.2. In this method, though, we call ACE::select(), which is a static wrapper method in ACE that provides default arguments for the less frequently used parameters to the select() function.

                                                                                                                          virtual int wait_for_multiple_events () {
  active_read_handles_ = master_handle_set_;
  int width = (int) active_read_handles_.max_set () + 1;

  return ACE::select (width, active_read_handles_);
}

                                                                                                                          handle_connections () hook 方法的实现与Reactive_Logging_Server中的实现类似。我们接受新的连接并更新log_map_和master_handle_set_。

                                                                                                                          The handle_connections() hook method implementation is similar to the one in Reactive_Logging_Server. We accept new connections and update the log_map_ and master_handle_set_.

                                                                                                                          virtual int handle_connections () {
  ACE_SOCK_Stream logging_peer;

  while (acceptor ().accept (logging_peer) != -1) {
    master_handle_set_.set_bit (logging_peer.get_handle ());

    ACE_FILE_IO *log_file = new ACE_FILE_IO;

    // Use the client' s hostname as the logfile name.
    make_log_file (*log_file, &logging_peer);

    // Add the new <logging_peer>'s handle to the map and
    // to the set of handles we <select> for input.
    log_map_.bind (logging_peer.get_handle (), log_file);
    master_handle_set_.set_bit (logging_peer.get_handle ());
  }
  return 0;
}

                                                                                                                          请注意，我们使用从第 4.4.1 节中描述的Logging_Server基类继承的make_log_file()方法（参见第 85 页）。

                                                                                                                          Note that we use the make_log_file() method (see page 85) inherited from the Logging_Server base class described in Section 4.4.1.

                                                                                                                          handle_data () hook 方法仅遍历活动连接，从每个连接接收日志记录，并将记录写入与客户端连接关联的日志文件。

                                                                                                                          The handle_data() hook method iterates over only the active connections, receives a log record from each, and writes the record to the log file associated with the client connection.

                                                                                                                          virtual int handle_data (ACE_SOCK_Stream *) {
  ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator peer_iterator (active_read_handles_);

  for (ACE_HANDLE handle;
       (handle = peer_iterator ()) != ACE_INVALID_HANDLE;
       ) {
    ACE_FILE_IO *log_file;

    log_map_.find (handle, log_file);
    Logging_Handler logging_handler (*log_file, handle);
    if (logging_handler.log_record () == -1) {
      logging_handler.close ();
      master_handle_set_.clr_bit (handle);
      log_map_.unbind (handle);
      log_file->close ();
      delete log file; }
    }
  }
  return 0; }
}

                                                                                                                          当客户端关闭连接时，我们会关闭相应的日志处理程序，从主句柄集（master_handle_set_）中清除句柄，从日志映射（log_map_）中移除句柄到文件的关联，并删除动态分配的ACE_FILE_IO对象。虽然本示例中没有展示太多错误处理代码，但生产环境中的实现应在发生故障时采取适当的纠正措施。

                                                                                                                          When a client closes its connection, we close the corresponding Logging_ Handler, clear the handle from the master_handle_set_, remove the handle-to-file association from the log_map_, and delete the dynamically allocated ACE_FILE_IO object. Although we don't show much error handling code in this example, a production implementation should take appropriate corrective action if failures occur.

                                                                                                                          最后，我们展示main()程序，它与我们之前展示的程序基本相同，只是这次我们定义了Reactive_Logging_Server_Ex的一个实例。

                                                                                                                          Finally, we show the main() program, which is essentially identical to the ones we showed earlier, except that this time we define an instance of Reactive_Logging_Server_Ex.

                                                                                                                          int main (int argc, char *argv[])
{
  Reactive_Logging_Server_Ex server;

  if (server.run (argc, argv) == -1)
    ACE_ERROR_RETURN ((LM_ERROR, "%p\n", "server.run()"), 1);
  return 0;
}

                                                                                                                            7.5 总结

                                                                                                                            7.5 Summary

                                                                                                                            本章探讨了在使用响应式服务器模型设计网络应用程序时，会遇到的各种意外复杂性、性能下降的根源以及可移植性问题。文中介绍了ACE_Handle_Set和ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator包装器外观，它们提供了一种解决这些问题的方法。这些类有助于确保服务器程序的可移植性和健壮性，同时又不影响网络应用程序的性能。

                                                                                                                            This chapter examined the accidental complexities, sources of performance degradation, and portability problems that arise when designing a networked application using a reactive server model. The ACE_Handle_Set and ACE_Handle_Set_Iterator wrapper facades were described as one way to resolve these problems. These classes help ensure portable and robust server programming without compromising the performance of networked applications.

                                                                                                                            响应式服务器是一种常见的编程模型，它允许一台服务器同时处理与多个对等节点或客户端的交互。虽然本章中新版本的网络日志服务器展示了实现这种模型的可移植性，但仍有改进的空间。7.4节中的示例根据ACE_Handle_Set中套接字句柄是否处于活动状态来决定是否接受新连接或接收日志记录。虽然这种设计可行，但它将事件解复用和连接管理代码紧密耦合在一起。因此，应用程序开发人员需要重写这段代码，而这段代码实际上是通用的，因此应该重构为一个可重用的框架。

                                                                                                                            Reactive servers are a common programming model that allows one server to handle interactions with multiple peers or clients concurrently. Although the new versions of the networked logging server in this chapter showed how easy it is to do so portably, there's still room for further improvement. The example in Section 7.4 decides whether to accept a new connection or receive log records based on whether or not a socket handle is active in an ACE_Handle_Set. Although this design works, it tightly couples the event demultiplexing and connection management code. Application developers are therefore required to rewrite this code, which is actually general purpose and should therefore be refactored into a reusable framework.

                                                                                                                            这里根本的问题在于，`select()`和`fd_set`构成了强大的事件解复用和事件处理功能的基础，而这些功能很难封装在一个简单的包装器外观中。因此，ACE 提供了一个基于Reactor 模式[ SSRB00 ] 的框架，以便更灵活地重构和重用通用的事件解复用和分发行为。我们在 [ SH ]中详细介绍了 ACE Reactor 框架。

                                                                                                                            The fundamental issue here is that select() and fd_set form the basis for powerful event demultiplexing and event handling capabilities that are hard to encapsulate within a simple wrapper facade. ACE therefore provides a framework based on the Reactor pattern [SSRB00] to refactor and reuse the generic event demultiplexing and dispatching behavior more flexibly. We cover the ACE Reactor framework thoroughly in [SH].

                                                                                                                              第八章 ACE流程包装器外观

                                                                                                                              Chapter 8. The ACE Process Wrapper Facades

                                                                                                                              章节概要

                                                                                                                              Chapter Synopsis

                                                                                                                              本章介绍 ACE 封装器外观，它使用可移植的 C++ 类封装操作系统多进程机制。本章阐述了常用操作系统多进程机制的巨大差异，以及 ACE 如何将可移植概念抽象成实用的类。最后，本章展示了如何在我们网络日志服务的多进程版本中应用这些类。

                                                                                                                              This chapter describes the ACE wrapper facades that encapsulate OS multiprocessing mechanisms with portable C++ classes. It illustrates the wide variation in multiprocessing facilities among popular operating systems and the techniques ACE uses to abstract portable concepts into useful classes. Finally, it shows how to apply these classes in a multiprocess version of our networked logging service.

                                                                                                                                8.1 概述

                                                                                                                                8.1 Overview

                                                                                                                                操作系统对多进程的支持对于网络应用程序至关重要，因为它有助于……

                                                                                                                                OS support for multiprocessing is important for networked applications because it helps to

                                                                                                                                • 通过允许操作系统在不同的 CPU 上调度和运行不同的进程来启用并发性。

                                                                                                                                • Enable concurrency by allowing the OS to schedule and run separate processes on different CPUs

                                                                                                                                • 通过使用 MMU 硬件来提高系统的健壮性，从而保护独立的进程地址空间免受系统中其他活动进程的意外或恶意破坏。

                                                                                                                                • Increase robustness by using MMU hardware to protect separate process address spaces from accidental or malicious corruption by other active processes in the system

                                                                                                                                • 通过允许每个进程验证或控制浏览者或会话级别的安全和身份验证信息来增强安全性。

                                                                                                                                • Enhance security by allowing each process to verify or control peruser or per-session security and authentication information

                                                                                                                                本章介绍网络应用程序可以用来生成和管理一个或多个进程的以下 ACE 类：

                                                                                                                                This chapter describes the following ACE classes that networked applications can use to spawn and manage one or more processes:

                                                                                                                                ACE 级 描述
                                                                                                                                ACE流程 以可移植的方式创建和同步进程。
                                                                                                                                ACE_Process_Options 既包含平台无关选项，也包含平台特定选项。
                                                                                                                                ACE_Process_Manager 以可移植的方式创建和同步完成一组进程。

                                                                                                                                图 8.1展示了这些类之间的关系。这些包装器外观提供了以下优点：

                                                                                                                                Figure 8.1 shows the relationships among these classes. These wrapper facades provide the following benefits:

                                                                                                                                • 增强跨异构操作系统平台的可移植性。 进程管理功能在不同操作系统平台之间差异很大。ACE 的多进程封装器外观提供了对这些功能通用子集的可移植访问。例如，ACE_Process和ACE_Process_Options类可以一致地生成、管理和同步进程，而无需考虑底层操作系统的多进程机制。

                                                                                                                                • Enhance portability across heterogeneous OS platforms. Process management capabilities vary widely among OS platforms. ACE's multiprocessing wrapper facades offer portable access to a common subset of these capabilities. For example, the ACE_Process and ACE_Process_Options classes can spawn, manage, and synchronize processes consistently, regardless of the underlying OS multiprocessing mechanisms.

                                                                                                                                • 轻松访问操作系统特定机制。 某些平台提供强大的进程创建机制，例如 POSIX fork()。本章介绍的 ACE 包装器外观允许开发人员在不更改应用程序代码的情况下，针对不同的项目访问这些机制。

                                                                                                                                • Easy-to-use access to OS-specific mechanisms. Certain platforms offer powerful process creation mechanisms, such as POSIX fork(). The ACE wrapper facades described in this chapter allow developers to access these mechanisms without changing their application code for different projects.

                                                                                                                                • 将一组进程作为一个整体进行管理。 使用多进程的网络应用程序通常需要多个进程作为一个整体启动和结束。ACE_Process_Manager类为ACE_Process提供的单个进程管理功能添加了此功能。

                                                                                                                                • Manage a group of processes as a cohesive collection. Networked applications that make use of multiprocessing often require multiple processes to begin and end as a group. The ACE_Process_Manager class adds this capability to the individual process management offered by ACE_Process.

                                                                                                                                图 8.1. ACE 流程管理类关系

                                                                                                                                本章阐述了ACE多进程类的功能及其背后的原因。我们提供了每个类的示例，以说明它们如何简化和增强我们网络日志服务的各个方面。

                                                                                                                                This chapter motivates and describes the capabilities of the ACE multiprocessing classes. We present examples of each class to illustrate how they can simplify and ruggedize various aspects of our networked logging service.

                                                                                                                                  8.2 ACE_Process 类

                                                                                                                                  8.2 The ACE_Process Class

                                                                                                                                  动机

                                                                                                                                  Motivation

                                                                                                                                  进程创建和管理是大多数通用操作系统的核心组成部分（尽管第 6.2 节描述了为什么一些嵌入式操作系统不提供进程功能）。支持多进程的操作系统提供以下功能：

                                                                                                                                  Process creation and management is a core part of most general-purpose operating systems (though Section 6.2 describes why some embedded operating systems don't provide process capabilities). Operating systems that do support multiple processes provide functionality to

                                                                                                                                  • 创建一个进程来运行特定的程序映像

                                                                                                                                  • Create a process to run a particular program image

                                                                                                                                  • 自愿或非自愿地结束一个过程

                                                                                                                                  • End a process voluntarily or involuntarily

                                                                                                                                  • 与另一个进程的退出同步

                                                                                                                                  • Synchronize with the exit of another process

                                                                                                                                  鉴于操作系统进程管理功能的成熟度，你可能会期望有一个统一的标准来规范这一领域。但遗憾的是，由于种种原因，事实并非如此。例如，下表概述了 POSIX/UNIX 和 Win32 进程管理之间的主要区别：

                                                                                                                                  Given the maturity of these OS process management capabilities, you might expect a unified standard to govern this area. For a variety of factors, unfortunately, that's not the case. For instance, the following table outlines the key differences between POSIX/UNIX and Win32 process management:

                                                                                                                                  POSIX/UNIX Win32
                                                                                                                                  fork()会复制调用进程，包括打开的 I/O 句柄；随后（可选）调用exec*()函数会将当前程序映像替换为新的程序映像。 CreateProcess()函数在一个系统函数调用中既生成一个新进程，又运行一个指定的程序映像。
                                                                                                                                  kill ()函数会向进程发送信号以停止它。进程可以拦截某些信号，并将其解释为优雅关闭和退出的请求。 TerminateProcess()强制进程退出，不给进程任何清理自身的机会。
                                                                                                                                  waitpid ()函数可用于等待子进程退出。父进程还可以捕获SIGCHLD信号，该信号是操作系统在子进程退出时传递给父进程的。 WaitForMultipleObjects ()或WaitForSingleObject()函数均可用于等待进程句柄，该句柄会在进程退出时发出信号。

                                                                                                                                  尽管对操作系统多进程机制的全面讨论超出了本书的范围（更多信息请参见[ Sch94 , Ste92 , Ric97 ]），但此比较展示了两种常用操作系统环境之间的关键差异。正如您所见，操作系统进程管理机制在语法和语义上均有所不同。在每个应用程序中处理这些平台差异既困难又繁琐，容易出错，而且没有必要，因为ACE提供了ACE_Process类。

                                                                                                                                  Although a complete discussion of OS multiprocessing mechanisms is beyond the scope of this book (see [Sch94, Ste92, Ric97] for more information), this comparison shows key differences between two popular operating environments. As you can see, OS process management mechanisms differ syntactically and semantically. Addressing these platform variations in each application is difficult, tedious, error prone, and unnecessary because ACE provides the ACE_Process class.

                                                                                                                                  等级能力

                                                                                                                                  Class Capabilities

                                                                                                                                  ACE_Process类根据包装器外观模式封装了不同操作系统多进程 API 之间的差异。此类定义了统一且可移植的方法，这些方法的功能使应用程序能够：

                                                                                                                                  The ACE_Process class encapsulates the variation among different OS multiprocessing APIs in accordance with the Wrapper Facade pattern. This class defines uniform and portable methods whose capabilities enable applications to

                                                                                                                                  • 生成和终止进程

                                                                                                                                  • Spawn and terminate processes

                                                                                                                                  • 进程退出时同步

                                                                                                                                  • Synchronize on process exit

                                                                                                                                  • 访问进程属性，例如进程 ID

                                                                                                                                  • Access process properties, such as process ID

                                                                                                                                  ACE_Process类的接口如图 8.2所示；其关键的平台无关方法概述如下表所示：

                                                                                                                                  The interface of the ACE_Process class is shown in Figure 8.2; its key platform-independent methods are outlined in the following table:

                                                                                                                                  方法 描述
                                                                                                                                  准备（） 在子进程生成之前，由spawn()函数调用。它允许检查和/或修改新进程要使用的选项，并且是设置平台特定选项的便捷位置。
                                                                                                                                  spawn() 创建一个新的进程地址空间并运行指定的程序映像。
                                                                                                                                  取消管理() 由ACE_Process_Manager在其管理的进程退出时 调用。
                                                                                                                                  getpid() 返回新子进程的进程 ID。
                                                                                                                                  退出代码() 返回子进程的退出代码。
                                                                                                                                  等待（） 等待我们创建的进程退出。
                                                                                                                                  终止() 突然终止进程，不给进程清理的机会（因此请谨慎使用）。

                                                                                                                                  图 8.2. ACE_Process类图

                                                                                                                                  ACE_Process类提供了对创建新进程并在新进程中执行新程序映像这一通用功能的可移植访问。然而，进程管理是少数几个功能领域之一，在这个领域中，包装器外观无法将所有操作系统差异封装到一个统一的类中，从而无法在 ACE 支持的所有操作系统平台上提供可移植性。例如，侧边栏 16描述了与使用某些 POSIX fork()机制独特语义的服务器相关的一些关键可移植性挑战。

                                                                                                                                  The ACE_Process class provides portable access to the common capability of spawning a new process and executing a new program image in the new process. Process management is one of the few functional areas, however, where wrapper facades can't encapsulate all the OS differences into one unified class that offers portability across the full range of OS platforms supported by ACE. For example, Sidebar 16 describes some key portability challenges associated with servers that use certain unique semantics of the POSIX fork() mechanism.

                                                                                                                                  由于 UNIX 是网络应用程序的关键平台，ACE_Process类提供了一些仅在 POSIX/UNIX 环境下才能运行的方法。这些方法在许多设计场景中非常有用（实际上是必要的）。为了避免混淆，下表列出了这些方法，并将其与ACE_Process提供的可移植方法分开列出。

                                                                                                                                  Since UNIX is a key platform for networked applications, the ACE_Process class offers a number of methods that only work in a POSIX/UNIX environment. These methods are useful (indeed, necessary) in many design situations. To avoid confusion, they are listed in the table below, separate from the portable methods that ACE_Process offers.

                                                                                                                                  方法 描述
                                                                                                                                  parent() 可以重写以提供特定于应用程序的行为；如果子进程成功 fork， 则在fork()调用之后在父进程上下文中调用。
                                                                                                                                  孩子（） 可以重写以提供应用程序特定的行为；在子进程上下文中，在fork()之后和exec()之前调用。
                                                                                                                                  杀（） 向进程发送信号。此功能仅适用于能够向指定进程发送信号的 UNIX/POSIX 操作系统。

                                                                                                                                  侧边栏 16：POSIX 可移植性挑战

                                                                                                                                  Sidebar 16: POSIX Portability Challenges

                                                                                                                                  许多 UNIX 应用程序使用 POSIX 的fork()系统函数来创建并发的基于进程的服务器。如果这些服务器依赖于fork()函数同时具备这两种能力，那么移植它们可能会很困难。

                                                                                                                                  Many UNIX applications use the POSIX fork() system function to create concurrent process-based servers. It can be hard to port these servers if they rely on the ability of fork() to both

                                                                                                                                  1. 让父进程使用fork() 函数创建一个子进程，该子进程拥有与其父进程地址空间相同的副本以及所有父进程 I/O 句柄（包括套接字）的副本。

                                                                                                                                  2. Have a parent process fork() a child process with a duplicate of its parent's address space and copies of all the parent's I/O handles (Including sockets) and

                                                                                                                                  3. 父进程和子进程都从fork() 函数返回到同一位置，但返回值不同，然后它们在同一程序映像中运行服务器处理的不同部分。

                                                                                                                                  4. Have both parent and child process return from fork() at the same location but with different return values, which then run different parts of the server processing within the same program Image.

                                                                                                                                  在没有fork()函数的平台上，无法复制地址空间。然而，大多数主流操作系统平台（包括 Win32）都支持在子进程中获取所需 I/O 句柄这一更重要的功能。ACE_Process_Options类提供了一种可移植的方式来使用此功能，如第 8.4 节的日志服务器示例所示。

                                                                                                                                  There's no facility for duplicating an address space on platforms without the fork() function, However, most popular OS platforms, Including WIn32, support the more important capability of obtaining the needed I/O handles in the child process. The ACE_Process_Options class provides a portable way to use this capability, as shown in logging server example in Section 8.4.

                                                                                                                                  例子

                                                                                                                                  Example

                                                                                                                                  本示例演示如何使用ACE_Process以可移植的方式生成一个运行指定程序映像的新进程。我们实现的程序通过以下方式“递归”计算阶乘：

                                                                                                                                  This example illustrates how to use ACE_Process to portably spawn a new process that runs a specified program image. The program we implement computes factorials "recursively" by

                                                                                                                                  1. 让父进程生成一个子进程，该子进程运行程序映像本身来计算通过 FACTORIAL 环境变量传递的数字的阶乘，如果没有设置环境变量，则默认计算 10 的阶乘 (10!)。

                                                                                                                                  2. Having a parent process spawn a child process that runs the program image itself to compute the factorial of a number passed in the FACTORIAL environment variable, defaulting to factorial of 10 (10!) if no environment variable is set.

                                                                                                                                  3. 每个父进程都会等待其子进程完成，使用其子进程的退出代码来计算 n 的阶乘，并将此值作为该进程的退出代码返回。

                                                                                                                                  4. Each parent process then waits for its child process to finish, uses its child's exit code to compute the factorial for n, and returns this as the exit code for the process.

                                                                                                                                  虽然这显然不是计算阶乘的有效方法，但它简洁地说明了ACE_Process 的功能，如下所示。

                                                                                                                                  Although this is clearly not an efficient way to compute factorials, it illustrates the ACE_Process features concisely, as shown below.

                                                                                                                                  #include "ace/OS.h"
#include "ace/Process.h"
int main (int argc, char *argv[])
{
  ACE_Process_Options options;
  char *n_env = 0;
  int n;

  if (argc == 1) { // Top-level process.
    n_env = ACE_OS::getenv ("FACTORIAL");
    n = n_env == 0 ? 0 : atoi (n_env);
    options.command_line ("%s %d", argv[0], n == 0 ? 10 : n);
  }
  else if (atoi (argv[l]) == 1) return 1; // Base case.
  else {
    n = atoi (argv[1]);
    options.command_line ("%s %d", argv[0], n - 1);
  }

  ACE_Process child;
  child.spawn (options); // Make the ''recursive'' call.
  child.wait ();
  return n * child.exit_code (); // Compute n factorial.
}

                                                                                                                                  无论子进程在调用之前是否已结束，对`ACE_Process::wait()`的调用都会生效。如果子进程已结束，则调用立即完成；否则，该方法会等待子进程退出。此方法可移植到所有支持多进程的操作系统。

                                                                                                                                  The call to ACE_Process::wait() will work regardless of whether the spawned process has finished before the call or not. If it has finished, the call completes immediately; if not, the method waits until the child process exits. This method is portable to all operating systems that support multiple processes.

                                                                                                                                  上面的示例展示了ACE_Process_Options最基本且最通用的用法：为新生成的程序指定命令行参数。下一节将讨论为什么我们需要一个单独的选项类，并展示其功能范围。

                                                                                                                                  The example above presents the most basic and portable use of ACE_Process_Options: to specify the command line for a spawned program. The next section discusses why we need a separate options class and shows its range of capabilities.

                                                                                                                                    8.3 ACE_Process_Options 类

                                                                                                                                    8.3 The ACE_Process_Options Class

                                                                                                                                    动机

                                                                                                                                    Motivation

                                                                                                                                    操作系统提供了多种方法来设置新创建进程的属性。新进程的属性会影响其与其他进程的关系以及其执行环境。一些常见的属性包括：

                                                                                                                                    Operating systems provide a variety of methods for setting the properties of newly-created processes. A new process's properties affect its relationship to other processes and its execution environment. Some of the common properties include

                                                                                                                                    • 程序映像。 新进程应该执行哪个程序？

                                                                                                                                    • Program image. Which program should the new process execute?

                                                                                                                                    • 打开的 I/O 句柄。 子进程是否应该继承打开的 I/O 句柄或其他操作系统对象？它是否应该关闭部分或全部继承的打开句柄？

                                                                                                                                    • Open I/O handles. Should the child process inherit open I/O handles or other OS objects? Should it close some or all of its inherited open handles?

                                                                                                                                    • 显示访问权限。 子进程是否应该有权访问终端或用户显示器？

                                                                                                                                    • Access to display. Should the child process have access to a terminal or to the user's display?

                                                                                                                                    • 工作目录。 子进程应该与其父进程运行在同一目录下，还是运行在不同的目录下？

                                                                                                                                    • Working directory. Should the child process run in the same directory as its parent or in a different directory?

                                                                                                                                    • 进程关系。子进程应该作为独立的守护进程 在后台运行，还是作为相关进程组的一部分运行？

                                                                                                                                    • Process relationship. Should the child process run in the background as an independent daemon or as part of a related group?

                                                                                                                                    • 安全属性。 是否应该更改子进程的安全属性或默认文件保护设置，以扩展或限制其权限？

                                                                                                                                    • Security attributes. Should the child process's security attributes or default file protection settings be changed to expand or restrict its abilities?

                                                                                                                                    这些替代方案涉及的功能和 API 通常不具备可移植性，即使在类似的平台上也是如此。要确保每个应用程序的进程属性都能正确表达，需要大量的经验和平台特定的知识。ACE_Process_Options类能够以可移植的方式捕获这些知识。

                                                                                                                                    These alternatives involve capabilities and APIs that are often unportable, even across similar platforms. A great deal of experience and platform-specific knowledge is needed to assure that each application's process properties are expressed correctly. The ACE_Process_Options class captures this knowledge portably.

                                                                                                                                    等级能力

                                                                                                                                    Class Capabilities

                                                                                                                                    ACE_Process_Options类统一了进程属性向ACE_Process和ACE_Process_Manager类传递的方式，这两个类使用这些属性来选择和影响底层操作系统进程的创建和环境机制。ACE_Process_Options提供以下功能：

                                                                                                                                    The ACE_Process_Options class unifies how process properties are communicated to the ACE_Process and ACE_Process_Manager classes, which use these properties to select and influence the underlying OS process creation and environment mechanisms. ACE_Process_Options provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                                                                    • 它允许应用程序指定所需的过程控制信息。

                                                                                                                                    • It enables an application to specify desired process control information.

                                                                                                                                    • 它允许随着平台的变化而扩展过程控制项。

                                                                                                                                    • It allows process control items to be expanded as platforms change.

                                                                                                                                    • 它提供了一种解耦机制，使 ACE 能够在不改变流程创建界面的情况下提供这些功能。

                                                                                                                                    • It provides a decoupling mechanism that enables ACE to offer these capabilities without varying the process creation interface.

                                                                                                                                    ACE_Process_Options类的接口如图 8.3所示，其关键的平台无关方法概述如下表所示：

                                                                                                                                    The interface of the ACE_Process_Options class is shown in Figure 8.3 and its key platform-independent methods are outlined in the following table:

                                                                                                                                    方法 描述
                                                                                                                                    命令行() 使用 printf 风格的格式字符串来指定在生成的进程中启动新程序时要使用的命令及其参数。
                                                                                                                                    setenv() 指定要添加到新生成进程环境中的环境变量。
                                                                                                                                    工作目录() 指定一个新目录，生成的进程在启动新的程序映像之前将切换到该目录。
                                                                                                                                    设置句柄() 设置生成的进程将用于其 STDIN、STDOUT 和 STDERR 的特定文件句柄。
                                                                                                                                    pass_handle() 表示应传递给已生成进程的句柄。

                                                                                                                                    图 8.3. ACE_Process_Options类图

                                                                                                                                    第 161 页的8.2 节解释了ACE_Process提供的原因

                                                                                                                                    Section 8.2 on page 161 explained why ACE_Process offers

                                                                                                                                    1. 适用于所有支持进程的操作系统的方法

                                                                                                                                    2. Methods that are portable to all operating systems that support processes

                                                                                                                                    3. 仅适用于特定平台的方法

                                                                                                                                    4. Methods that work only on certain platforms

                                                                                                                                    ACE_Process_Options类也采用了这种方法。上面列出的方法提供了一组适用于所有多进程平台的可移植属性。下面列出的方法则访问特定于平台的属性：

                                                                                                                                    The ACE_Process_Options class also uses this approach. Its methods listed above offer a portable set of properties for all multiprocess platforms. The methods listed below access platform-specific properties:

                                                                                                                                    方法 描述
                                                                                                                                    creation_flags() 指定是否在生成的进程中运行新的程序映像（POSIX）。
                                                                                                                                    避免僵尸() 允许ACE_Process采取措施，确保生成的进程在退出时 不会变成僵尸（已失效）进程（POSIX）。 
                                                                                                                                    setruid()
seteuid()
                                                                                                                                    		为生成的进程分别设置真实用户 ID 和有效用户 ID（POSIX）。
                                                                                                                                    设置处理属性() 允许访问已生成进程的进程属性设置（Win32）。

                                                                                                                                    这些方法允许多进程应用程序利用非可移植功能，而无需为每个平台重写进程属性管理代码。

                                                                                                                                    These methods allow multiprocessing applications to take advantage of nonportable capabilities, without having to rewrite process property management code for each platform.

                                                                                                                                    例子

                                                                                                                                    Example

                                                                                                                                    本节对第 8.2 节中的示例代码进行如下概括：

                                                                                                                                    This section generalizes the example code from Section 8.2 as follows:

                                                                                                                                    • 它使用 WORKING_DIR 环境变量来设置程序的工作目录，也就是factorial.log文件所在的目录。

                                                                                                                                    • It uses the WORKING_DIR environment variable to set the program's working directory, which is where the factorial.log file resides.

                                                                                                                                    • 它通过环境变量将程序名称传递给子进程。

                                                                                                                                    • It passes the program name to child processes via an environment variable.

                                                                                                                                    • 它会将诊断信息打印到factorial.log文件中，其中包含程序名称和进程 ID。

                                                                                                                                    • It prints diagnostic messages to the factorial.log file that contain the program name and process ID.

                                                                                                                                    #include "ace/OS.h"
#include "ace/ACE.h"
#include "ace/Process.h"

int main (int argc, char *argv[])
{
  ACE_Process_Options options;
  FILE *fp = 0;
  char *n_env = 0;
  int n;

  if (argc == 1) { // Top-level process.
    n_env = ACE _OS::getenv ("FACTORIAL");
    n = n_env == 0 ? 0 : atoi (n_env);
    options.command_line ("%s %d", argv[0], n == 0 ? 10 : n);
    const char *working_dir = ACE_OS::getenv ("WORKING_DIR");
    if (working_dir) options.working_directory (working_dir);
    fp = fopen ("factorial.log", "a");
    options.setenv ("PROGRAM=%s", ACE::basename (argv[0]));
  }
  else {
    fp = fopen ("factorial.log", "a");
    if (atoi (argv[l]) == 1) {
      fprintf (fp, "[%s|%d]: base case\n",
               ACE_OS::getenv ("PROGRAM"), ACE_OS::getpid ());
      fclose (fp);
      return 1; // Base case.
    } else {
      n = atoi (argv[1]);
      options.command_line ("%s %d", argv[0], n - 1);
    }
  }

  ACE_Process child;
  child.spawn (options); // Make the ''recursive'' call.
  child.wait ();
  int factorial = n * child.exit_code (); // Compute n factorial.
  fprintf (fp, "[%s | %d] : %d! == %d\n",
           ACE_OS::getenv ("PROGRAM"), ACE_OS::getpid (),
           n, factorial);
  fclose (fp);
  return factorial;
}

                                                                                                                                    尽管ACE_Process_Options和ACE_Process代码调用的系统函数在不同的操作系统平台（例如 Win32 和 POSIX）上差异很大，但上面的代码可以在所有这些平台上编译和运行，并且具有良好的可移植性和正确性。

                                                                                                                                    Although the system functions called by the ACE_Process_Options and ACE_Process code vary considerably for different OS platforms, such as Win32 and POSIX, the code above will compile and run portably and correctly on all of them.

                                                                                                                                      8.4 ACE_Process_Manager 类

                                                                                                                                      8.4 The ACE_Process_Manager Class

                                                                                                                                      动机

                                                                                                                                      Motivation

                                                                                                                                      复杂的网络应用程序通常需要多个进程协同工作才能提供特定服务。例如，一个多阶段工作流自动化应用程序可能会生成多个进程来处理大型问题的不同部分。一个主进程可能需要等待所有工作进程退出后才能继续执行工作流的下一阶段。这种模式非常常见，因此 ACE 提供了ACE_Process_Manager类。

                                                                                                                                      Complex networked applications often require groups of processes to coordinate to provide a particular service. For example, a multistage workflow automation application may spawn multiple processes to work on different parts of a large problem. One master process may wait for the entire group of worker processes to exit before proceeding with the next stage in the workflow. This is such a common paradigm that ACE provides the ACE_Process_Manager class.

                                                                                                                                      等级能力

                                                                                                                                      Class Capabilities

                                                                                                                                      ACE_Process_Manager类使用包装器外观模式，将ACE_Process的可移植性和强大功能与将进程组作为一个整体进行管理的能力相结合。此类具有以下功能：

                                                                                                                                      The ACE_Process_Manager class uses the Wrapper Facade pattern to combine the portability and power of ACE_Process with the ability to manage groups of processes as a unit. This class has the following capabilities:

                                                                                                                                      • 它提供内部记录保存功能，用于管理和监控由ACE_Process类生成的进程组。

                                                                                                                                      • It provides internal record keeping to manage and monitor groups of processes that are spawned by the ACE_Process class.

                                                                                                                                      • 它允许一个进程生成一组进程，并等待这些进程退出后再继续执行自己的处理。

                                                                                                                                      • It allows one process to spawn a group of process and wait for them to exit before proceeding with its own processing.

                                                                                                                                      ACE_Process_Manager类的接口如图 8.4所示，其主要方法概述如下表所示：

                                                                                                                                      The interface of the ACE_Process_Manager class is shown in Figure 8.4 and its key methods are outlined in the following table:

                                                                                                                                      方法 描述
                                                                                                                                      打开（） 初始化ACE_Process_Manager。
                                                                                                                                      关闭（） 释放所有资源（无需等待进程退出）。
                                                                                                                                      spawn() 生成一个进程并将其添加到要管理的进程组中。
                                                                                                                                      spawn_n() 生成n 个新进程，所有这些进程都属于同一个进程组。
                                                                                                                                      等待（） 等待进程组中的部分或全部进程退出。
                                                                                                                                      实例（） 一个静态方法，返回指向ACE_Process Manager单例的指针。

                                                                                                                                      图 8.4. ACE_Process_Manager类图

                                                                                                                                      ACE_Process_Manager可以通过两种方式使用：

                                                                                                                                      The ACE_Process_Manager can be used in two ways:

                                                                                                                                      • 作为单例[ GHJV95 ] 通过其instance()方法。

                                                                                                                                      • As a singleton [GHJV95] via its instance() method.

                                                                                                                                      • 通过实例化一个或多个实例。此功能可用于支持流程中的多个流程组。

                                                                                                                                      • By instantiating one or more instances. This capability can be used to support multiple process groups within a process.

                                                                                                                                      例子

                                                                                                                                      Example

                                                                                                                                      第 7.4 节中的示例展示了响应式日志服务器的设计和实现，该服务器缓解了纯迭代式服务器设计的缺点。另一种处理客户端请求的服务器模型是为每个客户端创建一个新进程。当多线程解决方案满足以下任一条件时，基于进程的并发模型通常很有用：

                                                                                                                                      The example in Section 7.4 illustrated the design and implementation of a reactive logging server that alleviated the drawbacks of a purely iterative server design. Yet another server model for handling client requests is to spawn a new process to handle each client. Process-based concurrency models are often useful when multithreaded solutions are either:

                                                                                                                                      • 例如，在缺乏高效线程实现或完全缺乏线程支持的旧版 UNIX 系统上，这是不可能实现的。

                                                                                                                                      • Not possible, for example, on older UNIX systems that lack efficient thread implementations or that lack threading support altogether, or

                                                                                                                                      • 例如，由于不可重入的第三方库的限制，或者由于硬件支持的时间和空间分区的可靠性要求，因此不希望这样做。

                                                                                                                                      • Not desired, for example, due to nonreentrant third-party library restrictions or due to reliability requirements for hardware-supported time and space partitioning.

                                                                                                                                      第 5.2 节描述了使用多进程而不是多线程来实现服务器的其他优点和缺点。

                                                                                                                                      Section 5.2 describes other pros and cons of implementing servers with multiple processes rather than multiple threads.

                                                                                                                                      图 8.5展示了我们基于多进程的日志服务器的结构。此版本的日志服务器采用每个连接对应一个进程的并发模型。它在很多方面与4.4.3 节中采用迭代服务器设计的第一个版本类似。主要区别在于，主进程会为每个已接受的日志服务端口连接生成一个新的工作进程。然后，主进程继续接受新的连接。每个工作进程处理客户端通过一个连接发送的所有日志请求；当该连接关闭时，该进程退出。

                                                                                                                                      The structure of our multiprocess-based logging server is shown in Figure 8.5. This revision of the logging server uses a process-per-connection concurrency model. It's similar in many ways to the first version in Section 4.4.3 that used an iterative server design. The main difference here is that a master process spawns a new worker process for each accepted connection to the logging service port. The master process then continues to accept new connections. Each worker process handles all logging requests sent by a client across one connection; the process exits when this connection closes.

                                                                                                                                      图 8.5. 多进程日志服务器的架构

                                                                                                                                      按连接处理数据的方法有两个主要优点：

                                                                                                                                      A process-per-connection approach has two primary benefits:

                                                                                                                                      1. 它能增强日志服务器的稳定性，防止一个服务实例干扰其他实例而导致的问题。例如，这种情况可能是由于内部漏洞，或者恶意客户端利用缓冲区溢出漏洞所致。

                                                                                                                                      2. It "ruggedizes" the logging server against problems where one service instance corrupts others. This could happen, for example, because of internal bugs or by a malicious client finding a way to exploit a buffer overrun vulnerability.

                                                                                                                                      3. 下一步很简单，只需扩展日志服务器，允许每个进程验证或控制每个用户或每个会话的安全和身份验证信息即可。例如，每个用户特定的日志会话开始时可以包含用户名/密码交换。通过使用基于进程的服务器，而不是响应式或多线程服务器，每个进程中对用户特定信息的处理就不会意外（或恶意地！）与其他用户的信息混淆，因为每个进程都有自己的地址空间和访问权限。

                                                                                                                                      4. It's a straightforward next step to extend the logging server to allow each process to verify or control per-user or per-session security and authentication information. For example, the start of each user-specific logging session could include a user/password exchange. By using a process-based server, rather than a reactive or multithreaded server, handling of user-specific information in each process would not be accidentally (or maliciously!) confused with another user's since each process has its own address space and access privileges.

                                                                                                                                      下面所示的每个连接一个进程的服务器在 POSIX 和 Win32 平台上都能正常工作。考虑到第 8.2 节和第 164 页侧边栏 16中解释的平台差异，这确实是一项了不起的成就。由于示例日志服务器设计中清晰的关注点分离以及 ACE 对包装器外观的巧妙运用，服务器代码所需的改动极少且控制得很好。尤其值得一提的是，代码中明显缺少条件编译的应用程序代码。

                                                                                                                                      The process-per-connection server shown below works correctly on both POSIX and Win32 platforms. Given the platform differences explained in Section 8.2 and Sidebar 16 on page 164, this is an impressive achievement. Due to the clean separation of concerns in our example logging server's design and ACE's intelligent use of wrapper facades, the differences required for the server code are minimal and well contained. In particular, there's a conspicuous lack of conditionally compiled application code.

                                                                                                                                      然而，由于进程创建模型不同，我们首先必须决定如何运行 POSIX 进程。Win32 强制程序映像在新进程中运行，而 POSIX 则没有此限制。在 Win32 上，我们将所有服务器逻辑都放在一个程序中，并使用不同的命令行参数在工作进程和主进程中执行此程序映像。在 POSIX 平台上，我们可以：

                                                                                                                                      Due to differing process creation models, however, we must first decide how to run the POSIX process. Win32 forces a program image to run in a new process, where as POSIX does not. On Win32, we keep all of the server logic localized in one program and execute this program image in both the worker and master processes using different command-line arguments. On POSIX platforms, we can either:

                                                                                                                                      • 使用与 Win32 相同的模型并运行新的程序映像，或者

                                                                                                                                      • Use the same model as Win32 and run a new program image or

                                                                                                                                      • fork()返回后不调用exec*()函数，从而提高性能。

                                                                                                                                      • Enhance performance by not invoking an exec*() function call after fork() returns.

                                                                                                                                      为了获得性能优势，并展示 ACE 如何轻松地正确地执行这两种方法，我们不会在 POSIX 上的工作进程中运行新的程序映像。

                                                                                                                                      To gain a performance advantage and to show how easy ACE makes it to do both ways correctly, we won't run a new program image in the worker processes on POSIX.

                                                                                                                                      尽管每个连接的进程日志服务器代码在 POSIX 和 Win32 上的运行方式有所不同，但它本身并不复杂。然而，事件序列的解释以及 ACE 包装器外观中体现的细节（正是这些细节促成了这种简洁性）却相当微妙。为了便于理解，我们将Process_Per_Connection_Logging_Server类、示例中的进程管理以及Logging_Process类的解释分开进行。

                                                                                                                                      The process-per-connection logging server code is not particularly involved even though it operates differently on POSIX and Win32. However, the explanations of the event sequences and the details embodied in the ACE wrapper facades that facilitate this simplicity are rather subtle. To make it easier to absorb, we separate the explanation of the Process_Per_Connection_Logging_Server class, the example's process management, and the Logging_Process class.

                                                                                                                                      Process_Per_Connection_Logging_Server 类。与4.4.3 节 中的迭代日志服务器类似，我们定义一个代表服务器的类。首先，我们需要包含必要的 ACE 头文件：

                                                                                                                                      The Process_Per_Connection_Logging_Server class. As with the iterative logging server in Section 4.4.3, we define a class representing our server. We start by including the necessary ACE header files:

                                                                                                                                      #include "ace/Log_Record.h"
#include "ace/Process.h"
#include "ace/Process_Manager.h"
#include "ace/Signal.h"
#include "Logging_Server.h"

                                                                                                                                      我们从4.4.1 节中定义的Logging_Server类派生出Process_Per_Connection_Logging_Server类。我们重写了run()方法，以适应程序在 Win32 上的两种不同执行方式：作为主进程接受连接并生成工作进程，以及作为工作进程为日志客户端提供服务。这两种方式的区别通过命令行参数来体现：

                                                                                                                                      We derive the Process_Per_Connection_Logging_Server class from the Logging_Server class defined in Section 4.4.1. We override the run() method to accommodate the two different ways the program can be executed on Win32: as the master process to accept connections and spawn worker processes and as a worker process to service a logging client. The difference is expressed via command-line arguments:

                                                                                                                                      • 主进程可以通过命令行上的可选端口号启动，就像我们其他的网络日志服务器实现一样。

                                                                                                                                      • The master process is started with an optional port number on the command line, just like our other implementations of the networked logging server.

                                                                                                                                      • 工作进程启动时有两个参数：（1）+H（ACE 为传递的句柄添加的“句柄”选项）和（2）从主进程继承的套接字句柄的数值。

                                                                                                                                      • The worker process is started with two arguments: (1) +H (the "handle" option that ACE adds for a passed handle) and (2) the numeric value of the socket handle inherited from the master process.

                                                                                                                                      图 8.6和8.7分别描绘了 POSIX 和 Win32 的主进程和工作进程的交互。

                                                                                                                                      Figures 8.6 and 8.7 depict the master and worker process interactions for POSIX and Win32, respectively.

                                                                                                                                      图 8.6. POSIX 主/从进程创建顺序

                                                                                                                                      图 8.7. Win32 的主进程/工作进程创建顺序

                                                                                                                                      我们将从第 180 页开始学习Logging_Process类，届时就会看到命令行参数的实际传递方式。但首先，我们来看一下服务器的类定义：

                                                                                                                                      We'll see how command-line parameters are actually passed when we study the Logging_Process class, beginning on page 180. But first, we examine our server's class definition:

                                                                                                                                      class Process_Per_Connection_Logging_Server
  : public Logging_Server
{
protected:
  char prog_name_[MAXPATHLEN + 1];

                                                                                                                                      `prog_name_`数据成员从命令行参数`argv[0]`接收服务器程序的名称。我们使用此名称来生成处理新连接的工作进程。`run ()`方法会检查命令行参数的数量，以确定服务器应作为主进程还是工作进程运行。如果参数数量为 2，则运行工作进程；否则，运行主进程。

                                                                                                                                      The prog_name_data member receives the server program's name from its argv[0] command-line argument. We use this name to spawn worker processes that handle new connections. The run() method examines the command line's argument count to decide if the server should run as the master or a worker. If there are two arguments, this is a worker process; otherwise, it's the master process.

                                                                                                                                      virtual int run (int argc, char *argv[]) {
  strncpy (prog_name_, argv[0], MAXPATHLEN);
  prog_name_[MAXPATHLEN] = '\0'; // Ensure NUL-termination.
  if (argc == 3)
    return run_worker (argc, argv); // Only on Win32.
  else
    return run_master (argc, argv) ;
}

                                                                                                                                      `run_master ()`方法与 ` Logging_Server::run()`方法类似；例如，它会打开日志服务器的监听端口并调用`handle_connections()`来接受新的客户端连接。但是，它不会调用 ` handle_data() ` 钩子方法，该方法始终在工作进程中调用。主服务器会生成一个新的工作进程来处理每个客户端的日志记录，如图 8.5所示。

                                                                                                                                      The run_master() method is similar to the Logging_Server::run() method; for example, it opens the logging server's listen port and calls handle_connections() to accept new client connections. It does not, however, call the handle_data() hook method, which is always called in the worker process. The master server spawns a new worker process to handle each client's log records, as shown in Figure 8.5.

                                                                                                                                      int run_master (int argc, char *argv[]) {
  u_short logger_port = 0;
  if (argc == 2) logger_port = atoi (argv[1]);
  if (open (logger_port) == -1) return -1;

  for (;;)
    if (handle_connections () == -1) return -1;

  return 0;
}

                                                                                                                                      我们从Logging_Server基类继承了open()方法的实现，该方法初始化 acceptor 端点以被动监听指定端口。由于wait_for_multiple_events()方法的实现是空操作，因此我们在此处省略它，直接调用handle_connections()来运行主事件循环。

                                                                                                                                      We inherit the open() method implementation from the Logging_Server base class, which initializes the acceptor endpoint to listen passively on a designated port. Since the wait_for_multiple_events() implementation is a no-op, we simply omit it here and call handle_connections() directly to run the master event loop.

                                                                                                                                      `run_worker ()`方法仅在 Win32 平台上执行。当工作进程启动时，主进程会通过命令行请求将套接字句柄传递给工作进程。`run_worker ()`方法会将命令行参数转换回句柄，使用该句柄构建一个`ACE_SOCK_Stream`对象，并调用`handle_data()`来处理客户端的日志记录。由于传入的数据类型是固定的，因此必须使用类型转换进行转换。为了在平台 C++ 编译器允许的范围内尽可能安全地进行转换，ACE 提供了一组可移植的类型转换宏（包括下文使用的`ACE_static_cast` ），这些宏在侧边栏 17中有详细介绍。

                                                                                                                                      The run_worker() method is only executed on Win32. When the worker process is spawned, the master process requests the socket handle be passed to the worker process on the command line. The run_worker() method converts the command-line argument back to a handle, builds an ACE_SOCK_Stream object with the handle, and calls handle_data() to process the client's log records. Since the incoming data type is fixed, it must be converted using a cast. To do so as safely as a platform's C++ compiler allows, ACE provides a set of portable casting macros (including ACE_static_cast used below), that is discussed in Sidebar 17.

                                                                                                                                      侧边栏 17：所有 C++ 编译器上的可移植类型转换

                                                                                                                                      Sidebar 17: Portable Casting on All C+ Compilers

                                                                                                                                      大多数先学 C 后学 C++ 的程序员都熟悉类型转换运算符（类型表达式）。它功能强大，但也容易被滥用，因为它违反了类型安全，并可能引入错误，尤其是在将软件移植到新平台时。尽​​管 C++ 标准引入了几个关键字来允许在不丢失类型含义的情况下进行类型转换，但这些关键字在早于该特性的编译器中并未实现。因此，ACE 提供了一组宏，使代码能够更好地移植。这些宏会尽可能利用新的类型转换，并在需要时使用旧的 C 风格类型转换。ACE 提供的最常用类型转换如下表所示：

                                                                                                                                      Most programmers who learned C before C++ are familiar with the cast operator, (type) expression. It's a powerful feature, but is easily misused because it violates type safety and can introduce errors, especially when porting software to new platforms. Although the C++ standard introduced several keywords to allow casting without losing all type meaning, they're not implemented in compilers that predate this feature. ACE therefore supplies a set of macros that allow code to be written portably. They take advantage of the new casts where available and use old C-style casts where needed. The most commonly used casts supplied with ACE are listed in the table below:

                                                                                                                                      ACE施法宏 如果可用，则使用 C++ 类型转换
                                                                                                                                      ACE_const_cast(TYPE, EXPR) const_cast<TYPE>(EXPR)
                                                                                                                                      ACE_static_cast(TYPE, EXPR) static_cast<TYPE>(EXPR)
                                                                                                                                      ACE_dynamic_cast(TYPE, EXPR) dynamic_cast<TYPE>(EXPR)
                                                                                                                                      ACE_reinterpret_cast(TYPE, EXPR) reinterpret_cast<TYPE>(EXPR) 

                                                                                                                                      int run_worker (int argc, char *argv[]){
  ACE_HANDLE socket_handle =
    ACE_static_cast (ACE_HANDLE, atoi (argv[2]));
  ACE_SOCK_Stream logging_peer (socket_handle);

  handle_data (&logging_peer);
  logging_peer.close ();
  return 0;
}

                                                                                                                                      主服务器进程被动地监听新的客户端日志连接。与我们之前的日志服务器一样，` handle_connections()`方法接受新的连接。然而，在基于进程的日志服务器中，` handle_connections()`会生成一个新的工作进程来处理每个新的客户端连接。第 174 页的图 8.6展示了在 POSIX 系统上， `handle_connections()`接受新连接并生成工作进程时发生的事件序列。第 175 页的图 8.7展示了在 Win32 系统上的相同序列（在两幅图中，为了节省空间，名称 ` Process_Per_Connection_Logging_Server`都缩短为 ` Logging Server` ）。图中的图形和说明都引用了 ` Logging_Process`类，该类在第 180 页有详细描述。第 178 页的侧边栏 18描述了这些图中的步骤，以下 C++ 代码片段展示了如何使用`ACE_Process_Manager`来实现这些步骤。

                                                                                                                                      The master server process listens passively for new client logging connections. As in our previous logging servers, the handle_connections() method accepts new connections. In the process-per-connection logging server, however, handle_connections() spawns a new worker process to handle each new client connection. Figure 8.6 on page 174 illustrates the sequence of events that occur when handle_connections() accepts a new connection and spawns a worker process on POSIX. Figure 8.7 on page 175 shows the same sequence on Win32 (in both figures, the name Process_Per_Connection_Logging_Server has been shortened to Logging Server to fit in the available space). The figures and explanation both refer to the Logging_Process class, which is described on page 180. Sidebar 18 on page 178 describes the steps in these figures and the following C++ code segments illustrate how these steps are programmed using ACE_Process_Manager.

                                                                                                                                      下面展示了Process_Per_Connection_Logging_Server类中handle_connections()方法的实现：

                                                                                                                                      The implementation of the handle_connections() method of Process_Per_Connection_Logging_Server is shown below:

                                                                                                                                       1 virtual int handle_connections () {
 2   ACE_SOCK_Stream logging_peer;
 3   if (acceptor ().accept (logging_peer) == -1)
 4     return -1;
 5
 6   Logging_Process *logger =
 7     new Logging_Process (prog_name_, logging_peer);
 8   ACE_Process_Options options;
 9   pid_t pid = ACE_Process_Manager::instance ()->spawn
10     (logger, options);
11   if (pid == 0) {
12     acceptor() .close ();
13     handle_data (&logging_peer);
14     delete logger;
15     ACE_OS::exit (0);
16   }
17   logging_peer.close ();
18   if (pid == -1)
19     ACE_ERROR_RETURN ((LM_ERROR, "%p\n", "spawn ()"), -1);
20
21   return ACE_Process_Manager::instance ()->wait
22     (0, ACE_Time_Value::zero);
23 }

                                                                                                                                      下面我们将剖析handle_connections()方法的实现，参考第 174 页图 8.6和图8.7中的步骤，这些步骤在侧边栏 18中有解释。

                                                                                                                                      We dissect the handle_connections() method implementation below, referring to the steps in Figures 8.6 and 8.7 on page 174 that are explained in Sidebar 18.

                                                                                                                                      第 2-4 行 （步骤 1）调用acceptor().accept()；该调用会阻塞，直到客户端连接。

                                                                                                                                      Lines 2–4 (Step 1) Call acceptor().accept(); the call blocks until a client connects.
