                                                                                                                                      第 6-10 行 （步骤 2-4）生成一个新进程来处理已接受的客户端连接。为每个平台正确设置选项的工作在第 180 页所示的Logging_Process::prepare()方法中完成。ACE_Process ::spawn()调用相应的平台机制来创建新进程。

                                                                                                                                      Lines 6–10 (Steps 2–4) Spawn a new process to handle the accepted client connection. The work to set the options properly for each platform is done in the Logging_Process::prepare() method shown on page 180. ACE_Process::spawn() calls the proper platform mechanism to create the new process.

                                                                                                                                      侧边栏 18：工作进程是如何生成的

                                                                                                                                      Sidebar 18: How Worker Processes Are Spawned

                                                                                                                                      图 8.6和图8.7中所示的编号步骤类似。这些步骤出现在handle_connections()方法中，具体如下：

                                                                                                                                      The numbered steps depicted in Figures 8.6 and 8.7 are similar. They occur in the handle_connections() method and are outlined below:

                                                                                                                                      1. 接受新的日志客户端连接。

                                                                                                                                      2. Accept a new logging client connection.

                                                                                                                                      3. 调用ACE_Process_Manager::spawn()开始生成新的工作进程。它将调用ACE_Process::spawn()。

                                                                                                                                      4. Call ACE_Process_Manager::spawn() to begin spawning the new worker process. It will call ACE_Process::spawn().

                                                                                                                                      5. ACE_Process::spawn()会回调Logging_Server::prepare()方法来设置新进程的属性。

                                                                                                                                      6. ACE_Process::spawn() calls back to the Logging_Server::prepare() method to set up the new process's attributes.

                                                                                                                                      7. ACE_Process ::spawn()方法调用平台的进程创建机制。例如，在 POSIX 系统中，fork()函数会创建一个与主进程完全相同的子进程。新进程从handle_connections()方法开始执行，该方法位于fork()返回的位置。然而，在 Win32 系统中，CreateProcess()函数会创建一个新的进程，该进程并非主进程的副本。新进程会继承新客户端的套接字句柄，如第 180 页的Logging_Process::prepare()方法所示。新进程运行与主进程相同的程序映像，但会通过命令行传递新的句柄值。

                                                                                                                                      8. The ACE_Process::spawn() method calls the platform's process creation mechanism. For example, on POSIX the fork() function creates the worker process as an exact duplicate of the master process. The new process begins executing in the handle_connections() method, at the point where fork() returned. On Win32, however, the CreateProcess() function creates a new process that's not duplicated from the master process. The new process inherits the socket handle for the new client as shown in the Logging_Process::prepare() method on page 180. The new process runs the same program image as the master process, but with the new handle's value passed on the command line.

                                                                                                                                      9. 主节点上的日志记录对等节点的套接字句柄已关闭，而工作节点的副本仍保持打开状态，为日志记录客户端提供服务。

                                                                                                                                        5.在工作进程中，会调用handle_data()钩子方法。在 POSIX 系统中，它直接由handle_connections()方法调用。在 Win32 系统中，Process_Per_Connection_Logging_Server::run()方法会检测到命令行上的句柄，并调用run_worker()方法，该方法会调用handle_data()。当客户端连接关闭时，工作进程退出。

                                                                                                                                      10. The logging peer's socket handle is closed in the master, whereas the worker's copy remains open to service the logging client.

                                                                                                                                        5w. In the worker process, the handle_data() hook method is called. On POSIX, it's called directly from the handle_connections() method. On Win32, the Process_Per_Connection_Logging_Server::run() method notices the handle on the command-line and calls the run_worker() method, which calls handle_data().The worker process exits when the client's connection is closed.

                                                                                                                                      11. 主进程会定期调用ACE_Process_Manager::wait()来查看工作进程是否已退出。

                                                                                                                                      12. The master process periodically calls ACE_Process_Manager::wait() to see if the worker process has exited.

                                                                                                                                      13. 当工作进程退出时，ACE_Process_Manager::wait()会调用Logging_Process::unmanage()。这使得主进程有机会释放与工作进程关联的所有资源。之后， Logging_Process对象会自行删除。

                                                                                                                                      14. When the worker process exits, ACE_Process_Manager::wait() calls Logging_Process::unmanage(). This gives the master process an opportunity to release any resources associated with the worker process. The Logging_Process object then deletes itself.

                                                                                                                                      第 11-15 行 （POSIX 步骤 5w [1] ）在 Win32 系统上， spawn()函数不可能返回 0，因为它要么返回新进程的 PID，要么在出错时返回 -1。因此，这些代码始终在fork()创建的 POSIX 进程的上下文中执行。由于工作进程仅使用客户端已建立的连接，不接受新连接，因此它会关闭其继承的acceptor对象。调用 handle_data()方法来处理客户端的所有日志记录，然后释放Logging_Process对象，工作进程退出。主进程在下次调用第 21 行的ACE_Process_Manager::wait()时会注意到工作进程已退出。

                                                                                                                                      Lines 11–15 (POSIX Step 5w[1]) A 0 return value from spawn() is impossible on Win32 since it will either return the new process's PID or –1 on error. These lines are therefore always executed in the context of a fork() 'd POSIX process. The worker process closes its inherited acceptor object since the worker uses only the client's established connection and doesn't accept new connections. The handle_data() method is called to process all of the client's log records, then the Logging_Process object is freed, and the worker process exits. The master process will notice a worker process has exited when it next calls ACE_Process_Manager::wait() on line 21.

                                                                                                                                      [1] Win32 上的步骤 5w 由第 176 页所示的run_worker()方法执行

                                                                                                                                      [1] Step 5w on Win32 is executed by the run_worker() method shown on page 176.

                                                                                                                                      第 17 行： 如果spawn()调用在父进程中返回（对于 Win32 平台总是如此），则不再需要logging_peer对象，因此将其关闭。实际的 TCP 连接不会关闭，因为以下平台特定的行为封装在 ACE 进程包装器外观中：

                                                                                                                                      Line 17 If the spawn() call returned in the parent (which is always the case for Win32) the logging_peer object is no longer needed, so it's closed. The actual TCP connection is not closed because the following platform-specific behavior is encapsulated in the ACE process wrapper facades:

                                                                                                                                      • 在 POSIX 系统中，工作进程会继承整个对象的副本，包括已打开的句柄。操作系统会对句柄进行计数，因此只有当父进程和工作进程都关闭各自的句柄副本时，连接才会真正断开。

                                                                                                                                      • On POSIX, the worker process inherited a copy of the entire object, including the open handle. The OS reference counts the handles, so the connection won't actually be torn down until both the parent and worker processes close their respective copies of the handle.

                                                                                                                                      • 在 Windows NT/2000 中，句柄的管理方式与 POSIX 类似；也就是说，只有在两个进程都关闭句柄后，连接才会断开。

                                                                                                                                      • On Windows NT/2000, the handles are managed similarly to POSIX; that is, the connection is torn down only after both processes close the handle.

                                                                                                                                      • 在 Windows 95/98 系统中，句柄不会自动进行引用计数。但是，从Logging_Process::prepare()方法调用的ACE_Process_Options::pass_handle()函数会复制logging_peer中包含的套接字句柄。因此，父进程可以安全地关闭其句柄，而不会影响连接。

                                                                                                                                      • On Windows 95/98, handles are not reference counted automatically. However, ACE_Process_Options::pass_handle(), called from the Logging_Process::prepare() method, duplicated the socket handle contained in logging_peer. The parent can therefore close its handle safely without affecting the connection.

                                                                                                                                      与往常一样，ACE 封装外观使应用程序开发人员无需了解每个操作系统平台的这些细微差别！

                                                                                                                                      As usual, the ACE wrapper facades shield application developers from needing to understand these subtle nuances for each OS platform!

                                                                                                                                      第 21-22 行 （步骤 6 和 7）ACE_Process_Manager::wait()方法检查是否有任何工作进程已退出，回收它们的状态并清理它们打开的任何句柄。

                                                                                                                                      Lines 21–22 (Steps 6 and 7) The ACE_Process_Manager::wait() method checks to see if any worker processes have exited, reaping their status and cleaning up any handles they'd opened.

                                                                                                                                      下面所示的 ` handle_data ()`方法在所有平台上都相同。它会将客户端套接字置于阻塞模式，打开日志文件来保存日志记录，并处理日志记录，直到日志客户端关闭套接字或发生错误为止。最后，日志文件会被关闭。

                                                                                                                                      The handle_data() method shown below is identical for all platforms. It puts the client socket into blocking mode, opens the log file to hold the log records, and processes logging records until the logging client closes the socket or an error occurs. Lastly, the log file is closed.

                                                                                                                                      virtual int handle_data (ACE_SOCK_Stream *logging_peer) {
  // Ensure blocking <recv>s.
  logging_peer->disable (ACE_NONBLOCK);
  ACE_FILE_IO log_file;
  make_log_file (log_file, logging_peer);
  Logging_Handler logging_handler (log_file,
                                   *logging_peer);

  while (logging_handler.log_record () != -1)
    continue;

  log_file.close ();
  return  0;
}

                                                                                                                                      Logging_Process 类。 为了正确设置新的工作进程，我们定义了一个Logging_Process类，该类继承自8.2 节中描述的ACE_Process类。由于不同平台和应用程序的设置要求通常有所不同，ACE_Process提供了prepare()和unmanage()钩子方法。我们的Logging_Process类使用prepare()方法将新的日志客户端的套接字句柄传递给工作进程。此外，如果需要重新考虑是否在 POSIX 系统上运行新的程序映像，我们也会在此处记录任何更改。

                                                                                                                                      The Logging_Process class. To set up the new worker process properly, we define a Logging_Process class that's derived from the ACE_Process class described in Section 8.2. Since setup requirements often vary between platforms and applications, ACE_Process provides the prepare() and unmanage() hook methods. Our Logging_Process class uses the prepare() method to pass the new logging client's socket handle to the worker process. It's also the location where we localize any changes if we need to revisit the decision not to run a new program image on POSIX.

                                                                                                                                      class Logging_Process : public ACE_Process
{
private:
  Logging_Process (); // Force desired constructor to be used.

  char prog_name_[MAXPATHLEN + 1];
  ACE_SOCK_Stream logging_peer_;

public:
  Logging_Process (const char *prog_name,
                   const ACE_SOCK_Stream &logging_peer)
    : logging_peer_ (logging_peer.get_handle ())
  { strcpy (prog_name_, prog_name); }

                                                                                                                                      创建新工作进程所需的参数会传递给 ` Logging_Process`类的构造函数。这些参数包括用于启动新进程的命令名称以及工作进程要使用的日志客户端的`ACE_SOCK_Stream` 。这两个参数都会在后续的`prepare()`钩子方法中使用，该方法由`ACE_Process::spawn()`在启动新进程之前调用。

                                                                                                                                      The parameters needed to set up the new worker process are passed to the Logging_Process class's constructor. These include the command name used to spawn the new process and the logging client's ACE_SOCK_Stream to be used by the worker process. Both these parameters are used in the following prepare() hook method, which is called by ACE_Process::spawn() before the new process is spawned.

                                                                                                                                      virtual int prepare (ACE_Process_Options &options) {
  if (options.pass_handle (logging_peer_.get_handle ()) == -1)
    ACE_ERROR_RETURN ((LM_ERROR, "%p\n", "pass_handle()"), -1);
  options.command_line ("%s", prog_name_);
  options.avoid_zombies (1);
  options.creation_flags (ACE_Process_Options::NO_EXEC);
  return 0;
}

                                                                                                                                      prepare ()方法在第 174 页的图 8.6和图8.7中以步骤 3 的形式进行了说明。它唯一的参数是对ACE_Process::spawn()用于生成新进程的ACE_Process_Options对象的引用。这使得prepare()可以根据需要修改或添加选项。我们使用prepare()来设置选项，如下所示：

                                                                                                                                      The prepare() method is illustrated as Step 3 in Figures 8.6 and 8.7 on page 174. Its only argument is a reference to the ACE_Process_Options object that ACE_Process::spawn() is using to spawn the new process. This gives prepare() an opportunity to modify or add to the options as needed. We use prepare() to set the options as follows:

                                                                                                                                      • 传递日志客户端的套接字句柄。ACE_Process和ACE_Process_Options 内部会处理所有与平台相关的细节，以确保正确获取工作进程的套接字句柄，包括在 Windows 95/98 上复制句柄，以及在进程退出时记得关闭复制的句柄。我们使用pass_handle()方法将句柄值传递给工作进程的命令行，这表明日志客户端需要服务。

                                                                                                                                      • Pass the logging client's socket handle. The internals of ACE_Process and ACE_Process_Options perform all platform-specific details of getting the socket handle to the worker process correctly, including duplicating it on Windows 95/98 and remembering to close the duplicated handle when the process exits. We use the pass_handle() method to pass the handle value to the worker process command line, which indicates that a logging client needs service.

                                                                                                                                      • 设置程序名称。这对于 POSIX fork()调用以及在需要时运行新程序映像 都至关重要。

                                                                                                                                      • Set the program name. This is needed both for a POSIX fork() call and to run the new program image when needed.

                                                                                                                                      • 避免僵尸进程。 此标志仅适用于 POSIX 系统，Win32 系统会忽略它。

                                                                                                                                      • Avoid zombie processes. This flag is needed only for POSIX and is ignored for Win32.

                                                                                                                                      • 设置NO-EXEC标志，使 POSIX 系统仅fork() 创建一个新的工作进程，而不exec() 创建一个新的程序映像。此标志在 Win32 系统上也会被忽略。

                                                                                                                                      • Set the NO-EXEC flag so that POSIX systems simply fork() a new worker process and do not exec() a new program image. This flag is also ignored on Win32.

                                                                                                                                      尽管某些方法对 Win32 没有影响，但我们仍然调用它们，以便设置工作进程的过程可以移植到所有支持多进程的 ACE 平台。有关为什么这是正确的设计（以及何时不正确）的讨论，请参阅第 248 页的A.5 节。

                                                                                                                                      Although some methods have no affect on Win32, we call them anyway so the procedure for setting up the worker process is portable to all ACE platforms that support multiple processes. For a discussion of why this is the correct design (and when it isn't), see Section A.5 on page 248.

                                                                                                                                      ACE_Process_Manager封装了平台特定的知识，用于判断进程何时退出，并对任何底层进程已退出的进程对象调用unmanage()钩子方法。Logging_Process ::unmanage()方法在第 174 页的图 8.6和图8.7中以步骤 7 的形式进行了说明，如下所示：

                                                                                                                                      ACE_Process_Manager encapsulates platform-specific knowledge that determines when a process exits and calls the unmanage() hook method on any process object whose underlying process has exited. The Logging_Process::unmanage() is illustrated as Step 7 in Figures 8.6 and 8.7 on page 174 and is shown below:

                                                                                                                                      virtual void unmanage () {
  delete this;
}

                                                                                                                                      它只是清理在日志客户端连接被接受时动态分配的Logging_Process对象。然而，在 Windows 95/98 上，当日志对等套接字句柄传递给工作进程时，可能会出现重复的情况。通过将行为和状态封装在ACE_Process类中，该句柄将在ACE_Process析构函数中关闭，因此我们的清理代码也适用于 ACE 支持的所有平台。

                                                                                                                                      It simply cleans up the Logging_Process object that was allocated dynamically when the logging client connection was accepted. The logging peer socket handle may have been duplicated, however, when passed to the worker process on Windows 95/98. By encapsulating behavior and state in the ACE_Process class, that handle will be closed in the ACE_Process destructor, so our cleanup code is also portable to all platforms that ACE supports.

                                                                                                                                      最后，我们展示main()程序，它是我们早期服务器的略微扩展。

                                                                                                                                      Finally, we show the main() program, which is a slight extension of our earlier servers.

                                                                                                                                      static void sigterm_handler (int /* signum */) { /* No-op. */ }

int main (int argc, char *argv[])
{
  // Register to receive the <SIGTERM> signal.
  ACE_Sig_Action sa (sigterm_handler, SIGTERM);

  Process_Per_Connection_Logging_Server server;

  if (server.run (argc, argv) == -1 && errno != EINTR)
    ACE_ERROR_RETURN ((LM_ERROR, "%p\n", "server.run()"), 1);

  // Barrier synchronization.
  return ACE_Process_Manager::instance ()->wait ();
}

                                                                                                                                      ACE_Sig_Action类注册一个进程来处理 SIGTERM 信号，管理员可以使用该信号关闭父服务器进程。父进程在退出前会调用ACE_Process_Manager::wait()来同步所有工作日志进程的退出时间，然后再关闭自身。如果父进程需要将最终时间戳写入日志输出设备或文件，这种屏障同步功能就非常有用。

                                                                                                                                      The ACE_Sig_Action class registers the process to handle the SIGTERM signal, which administrators can use to shutdown the parent server process. Before exiting, the parent calls ACE_Process_Manager::wait() to synchronize on the exits of all worker logging processes before shutting itself down. This barrier synchronization capability could be useful if the parent process needed to write a final time stamp to the logging output device or file.

                                                                                                                                        8.5 总结

                                                                                                                                        8.5 Summary

                                                                                                                                        许多多进程操作系统是在专有系统盛行时期开发的，因此每个操作系统都开发了自己特定的进程管理机制。由于保持操作系统版本间的兼容性至关重要，许多此类专有进程机制和 API 至今仍然保留。本章展示了如何使用 ACE 进程管理功能，该功能允许在各种平台上进行可移植的编程。我们将 ACE_Process_Manager 应用于一个新的日志服务器实现，该实现将一组生成的进程分组在一起。这种分组方式使得主进程可以在所有工作进程退出后再关闭自身。

                                                                                                                                        Many multiprocessing operating systems were developed when proprietary systems were in vogue, so each developed its own specific mechanisms for process management. Since maintaining version-to-version OS compatibility is important, many of these proprietary process mechanisms and APIs remain to this day. This chapter showed how to use the ACE process management capabilities, which allow multiprocessing servers to be programmed portably across a range of platforms. We applied the ACE_Process_Manager to a new logging server implementation that grouped a set of spawned processes together. The grouping allowed the master process to wait for all the worker processes to exit before shutting itself down.

                                                                                                                                        由于操作系统进程管理语义的固有差异，网络应用程序的开发者必须仔细评估系统的并发需求。前几章主要侧重于缓解底层 API 引入的意外复杂性，而本章则进一步探讨了多平台软件开发的挑战。本章展示了可移植的 ACE 封装外观如何使多进程应用程序的编写更加便捷，同时也明确指出，在评估多进程并发设计时，必须仔细考虑应用程序当前和未来平台的功能。例如，ACE 进程封装外观可以使应用程序免受许多操作系统细节的影响，但它们无法在完全缺乏进程抽象的平台上提供进程抽象。

                                                                                                                                        Due to inherent differences in OS process management semantics, developers of networked applications must evaluate their system's concurrency requirements carefully. Whereas previous chapters focused largely on alleviating accidental complexities introduced by low-level APIs, this chapter expanded on the challenges of multiplatform software development. It showed how the portable ACE wrapper facades make multiprocessing applications much easier to write, while also making it clear that the capabilities of an application's current and future platforms must be considered carefully when evaluating multiprocessing concurrency designs. For example, the ACE process wrapper facades can shield applications from many OS details, but they cannot provide process abstractions on platforms that lack them altogether.

                                                                                                                                          第九章 ACE 穿线包装器外观

                                                                                                                                          Chapter 9. The ACE Threading Wrapper Facades

                                                                                                                                          章节概要

                                                                                                                                          Chapter Synopsis

                                                                                                                                          本章介绍 ACE 封装器外观，它使用可移植的 C++ 类封装操作系统多线程机制。我们将这些 ACE 线程封装器外观应用于我们的网络日志服务，以展示一系列日益灵活高效的增强功能。

                                                                                                                                          This chapter describes the ACE wrapper facades that encapsulate OS multithreading mechanisms with portable C++ classes. We apply these ACE threading wrapper facades to illustrate a series of increasingly flexible and efficient enhancements to our networked logging service.

                                                                                                                                            9.1 概述

                                                                                                                                            9.1 Overview

                                                                                                                                            许多网络应用程序天然适合多线程，因为处理任务可以与 I/O 任务分离。多线程在同时为多个客户端管理面向连接或无连接网络关联的服务器中尤为方便。如今操作系统对多线程的支持日益强大，这有助于网络应用程序：

                                                                                                                                            Many networked applications lend themselves naturally to multithreading because processing tasks can be separated from I/O tasks. Multithreading is particularly convenient in servers that manage connection-oriented or connectionless network associations for many clients simultaneously. Today's increasingly powerful OS support for multithreading helps networked applications to:

                                                                                                                                            • 利用硬件进步，例如能够实现真正执行并行性的对称多处理技术，

                                                                                                                                            • Leverage hardware advances, such as symmetric multiprocessing that enables true execution parallelism,

                                                                                                                                            • 通过重叠计算和通信来提高性能，

                                                                                                                                            • Increase performance by overlapping computation and communication,

                                                                                                                                            • 提高图形用户界面和网络服务器的响应速度，确保按需安排对时间要求严格的任务；

                                                                                                                                            • Improve response time for GUIs and network servers to ensure that time-sensitive tasks are scheduled as needed, and

                                                                                                                                            • 通过使应用程序能够使用直观的同步编程机制，而不是更复杂的异步编程机制，来简化程序结构。

                                                                                                                                            • Simplify program structure by enabling applications to use intuitive synchronous programming mechanisms, rather than more complex asynchronous programming mechanisms.

                                                                                                                                            本章介绍网络应用程序可用于在进程内生成和管理一个或多个控制线程的以下 ACE 类：

                                                                                                                                            This chapter describes the following ACE classes that networked applications can use to spawn and manage one or more threads of control within a process:

                                                                                                                                            ACE 级 描述
                                                                                                                                            ACE线程管理器 允许应用程序以可移植的方式创建和管理线程的生命周期、同步和属性。
                                                                                                                                            ACE_Sched_Params 对操作系统调度类功能进行可移植封装，与ACE_OS::sched_pa​​rams ()包装方法结合使用，以控制实时线程的各种属性。
                                                                                                                                            ACE_TSS 封装线程特定的存储机制，允许像访问程序的全局对象一样访问对线程“物理”私有的对象。

                                                                                                                                            这些外立面包装器具有以下优点：

                                                                                                                                            These wrapper facades provide the following benefits:

                                                                                                                                            • 确保跨异构操作系统平台的可移植性。 操作系统具有不同的多线程语法和语义，ACE 通过其包装器外观将其隐藏起来。例如，ACE_Thread_Manager类确保分离/可合并线程的行为与底层操作系统线程机制无关。

                                                                                                                                            • Ensure portability across heterogeneous OS platforms. Operating systems have diverse multithreading syntax and semantics, which ACE hides via its wrapper facades. For example, the ACE_Thread_Manager class ensures detached/joinable threads behave the same regardless of the underlying OS threading mechanisms.

                                                                                                                                            • 将一组线程作为一个整体进行管理。 并发网络应用程序通常需要多个线程作为一个整体启动和结束。ACE_Thread_Manager类提供线程组功能，允许其他线程等待整个线程组退出后再继续执行其自身的处理。

                                                                                                                                            • Manage a group of threads as a cohesive collection. Concurrent networked applications often require multiple threads to start and end as a unit. The ACE_Thread_Manager class provides a thread group capability that allows other threads to wait for an entire group of threads to exit before proceeding with their processing.

                                                                                                                                            • 影响线程调度策略和优先级。 许多网络应用程序需要严格控制线程的优先级。实时操作系统和通用操作系统在调度能力上通常存在差异，因此跨平台网络应用程序需要一种方法来可移植地管理这些不同的调度属性。ACE_Sched_Params类旨在以统一、可移植且易于使用的方式提供对运行时调度信息的访问。

                                                                                                                                            • Influence thread scheduling policies and priorities. Many networked applications require tight control over the priorities of their threads. Real-time and general-purpose operating systems often differ in their scheduling capabilities, and multiplatform networked applications need a way to manage the disparate scheduling properties portably. The ACE_Sched_Params class is designed to offer access to run-time scheduling information in a uniform, portable, and easy-to-use manner.

                                                                                                                                            • 高效使用和管理线程特定存储 (TSS)。TSS 是一种机制，它允许多个对象和方法管理特定于每个线程的信息。ACE 的 TSS 包装外观类克服了不同平台之间的语法差异和功能差异。

                                                                                                                                            • Efficiently use and manage thread-specific storage (TSS). TSS is a mechanism that enables multiple objects and methods to manage information that's specific to each thread. ACE's TSS wrapper facade class overcomes syntax differences, as well as capability differences, between platforms.

                                                                                                                                            本章阐述了 ACE 多线程类的功能及其背后的原因。我们提供了每个类的示例，以说明它们如何简化和优化我们网络日志服务的各个方面。

                                                                                                                                            This chapter motivates and describes the capabilities of the ACE multithreading classes. We present examples of each class to illustrate how they can simplify and optimize various aspects of our networked logging service.

                                                                                                                                              9.2 ACE_Thread_Manager 类

                                                                                                                                              9.2 The ACE_Thread_Manager Class

                                                                                                                                              动机

                                                                                                                                              Motivation

                                                                                                                                              不同的操作系统使用不同的 API 来创建、管理和同步线程的完成。如今的多线程机制存在一些与前几章讨论的类似的意外复杂性。它们还引入了以下两种类型的可变性，使得编写可移植的应用程序变得困难：

                                                                                                                                              Different operating systems use different APIs to create, manage, and synchronize the completion of threads. Today's multithreading mechanisms suffer from accidental complexities similar to those discussed in previous chapters. They also introduce the following two types of variability that make writing portable applications hard:

                                                                                                                                              • 语法—— 由于语法差异，即使提供相同的功能，原生操作系统线程 API 通常也不具有可移植性。例如，Win32 CreateThread()和 Pthreads pthread_create()函数提供了类似的线程创建功能，尽管它们的 API 在语法上有所不同。

                                                                                                                                              • Syntactic— Native OS threading APIs are often non-portable due to syntactic differences, even if they provide the same capabilities, for example, the Win32 CreateThread () and the Pthreads pthread_create () functions provide similar thread creation capabilities, even though their APIs differ syntactically.

                                                                                                                                              • 语义—— 导出语法统一的 C++ 编程接口的包装器外观并不一定能解决操作系统多线程机制之间的语义差异，例如，Pthreads 和 UI 线程都支持分离线程，而 Win32 不支持，VxWorks 只支持分离线程。

                                                                                                                                              • Semantic— Wrapper facades that export a syntactically uniform C++ programming interface don't necessarily address semantic variations across OS multithreading mechanisms, for example, both Pthreads and UI threads support detached threads, whereas Win32 does not, and VxWorks supports only detached threads.

                                                                                                                                              多线程应用程序的一个特别棘手的问题是如何以可移植的方式取消线程。一些操作系统平台提供了取消线程的原生支持，例如：

                                                                                                                                              One particularly vexing aspect of multithreaded applications is determining how to cancel threads portably. Some OS platforms provide native support for canceling threads, for example:

                                                                                                                                              • Pthreads 定义了一组强大的 API，允许通过pthread_cancel ()和pthread_testcancel ()函数异步或协作地取消线程。

                                                                                                                                              • Pthreads defines a powerful set of APIs that allow threads to be canceled asynchronously or cooperatively via the pthread_cancel () and pthread_testcancel () functions.

                                                                                                                                              • 在某些 UNIX 平台上，也可以通过信号取消线程，例如通过 Pthreads 的pthread_kill()函数和 UI 线程的thr_kill()函数。

                                                                                                                                              • It's also possible to cancel threads on some UNIX platforms via signals, for example, via the Pthreads pthread_kill () and UI threads thr_kill () functions.

                                                                                                                                              • Win32 TerminateThread()函数提供异步取消功能。

                                                                                                                                              • The Win32 TerminateThread () function offers asynchronous cancelation.

                                                                                                                                              遗憾的是，上述原生操作系统线程取消机制缺乏可移植性且容易出错。例如，UNIX 信号和 Win32 的TerminateThread()函数可能会彻底终止线程，使其无法释放所持有的任何资源。Pthreads 的异步线程取消机制虽然能更好地支持清理线程持有的资源，但仍然难以理解和正确编程，并且无法移植到非 Pthreads 平台。

                                                                                                                                              Unfortunately, the native OS thread cancelation mechanisms outlined above are nonportable and error prone. For example, UNIX signals and the Win32 TerminateThread () function can stop a thread dead in its tracks, preventing it from releasing any resources it's holding. The Pthreads asynchronous thread cancelation mechanisms provide better support for cleaning up resources held by a thread, but they are still hard to understand and program correctly, and aren't portable to non-Pthreads platforms.

                                                                                                                                              由于在每个应用程序中处理所有这些可移植性问题既繁琐又容易出错，因此 ACE 提供了ACE_Thread_Manager类。

                                                                                                                                              Since it's tedious and error prone to address all of these portability issues in each application, ACE provides the ACE_Thread_Manager class.

                                                                                                                                              等级能力

                                                                                                                                              Class Capabilities

                                                                                                                                              ACE_Thread_Manager类采用包装器外观模式来封装不同操作系统多线程 API 之间的语法和语义差异。此类提供以下可移植功能：

                                                                                                                                              The ACE_Thread_Manager class uses the Wrapper Facade pattern to guide the encapsulation of the syntactic and semantic variation among different OS multithreading APIs. This class provides the following portable capabilities:

                                                                                                                                              • 生成一个或多个线程，每个线程并发运行应用程序指定的函数。

                                                                                                                                              • Spawns one thread, or multiple threads at once, each running an application-designated function concurrently

                                                                                                                                              • 修改每个已生成线程最常用的线程属性，例如调度优先级和堆栈大小。

                                                                                                                                              • Alters the most common thread attributes, for example, scheduling priority and stack size, for each of the spawned threads

                                                                                                                                              • 生成并管理一组线程，将它们作为一个整体集合，称为线程组。

                                                                                                                                              • Spawns and manages a set of threads as a cohesive collection, called a thread group

                                                                                                                                              • 管理ACE_Task中的线程，我们在 [ SH ]中介绍它。

                                                                                                                                              • Manages the threads in an ACE_Task, which we present in [SH]

                                                                                                                                              • 促进线程的协作取消，以及

                                                                                                                                              • Facilitates cooperative cancelation of threads, and

                                                                                                                                              • 等待一个或多个线程退出。

                                                                                                                                              • Waits for one or more threads to exit.

                                                                                                                                              ACE_Thread_Manager类的接口如图 9.1所示，其关键的平台无关方法概述如下表所示：

                                                                                                                                              The interface of the ACE_Thread_Manager class is shown in Figure 9.1 and its key platform-independent methods are outlined in the following table:

                                                                                                                                              方法 描述
                                                                                                                                              spawn() 创建一个新的控制线程，并将要运行的函数和函数参数传递给它作为线程的入口点。
                                                                                                                                              spawn_n() 创建n 个属于同一线程组的新线程。其他线程可以等待整个线程组退出。
                                                                                                                                              等待 （） 阻塞直到线程管理器中的所有线程都已退出，并回收任何可加入线程的退出状态。
                                                                                                                                              加入（） 等待特定线程退出并回收其退出状态。
                                                                                                                                              cancel_all() 请求停止 由ACE_Thread_Manager对象管理的所有线程。
                                                                                                                                              testcancel() 询问是否已请求停止指定的线程。
                                                                                                                                              出口 （） 退出线程并释放线程的资源。
                                                                                                                                              关闭 （） 关闭并释放所有托管线程的资源。
                                                                                                                                              实例 （） 一个静态方法，返回指向ACE_Thread_Manager单例的指针。

                                                                                                                                              图 9.1. ACE_Thread_Manager类图

                                                                                                                                              ACE_Thread_Manager ::spawn()方法可以接收一组标志位，用于指定所创建线程的属性。该值是下表所示标志位的按位“或”运算结果：

                                                                                                                                              The ACE_Thread_Manager:: spawn () method can be passed a set of flags to specify the properties of the created thread. This value is a bit-wise inclusive "or" of the flags shown in the following table:

                                                                                                                                              旗帜 描述
                                                                                                                                              THR_SCOPE_SYSTEM 新线程以系统调度竞争范围创建，永久绑定到新创建的内核线程。
                                                                                                                                              THR_SCOPE_PROCESS 新线程以进程调度竞争范围创建，也就是说，它作为用户线程运行。
                                                                                                                                              THR_NEW_LWP 此标志会影响进程的并发属性。未绑定线程的期望并发级别会加一，这通常会向可用于运行用户线程的线程池中添加一个新的内核线程。在不支持 N:M 用户/内核线程模型的操作系统平台上，此标志将被忽略。
                                                                                                                                              THR_分离 新线程以分离状态创建，这意味着其他线程无法访问其退出状态。线程终止后，操作系统会立即回收其线程 ID 和其他资源。此标志与 THR_JOINABLE 相反。
                                                                                                                                              THR_JOINABLE 新创建的线程是可加入的，这意味着其他线程可以通过 ` ACE_Thread_Manager::join()`方法获取其退出状态。在其他线程加入之前，操作系统不会回收其线程 ID 和其他资源。此标志与 `THR_DETACHED` 相反。所有 ACE 线程创建方法的默认行为均为 `THR_JOINABLE`。

                                                                                                                                              ACE_Thread_Manager不仅能够创建具有各种属性的线程，还提供了一种安全、易用且可移植的协作式线程取消机制。要使用此机制，取消线程通过调用ACE_Thread_Manager::cancel()来设置一个标志，指示指定的线程应该取消自身。被取消的线程负责配合此机制，定期调用ACE_Thread_Manager::testcancel()来检查是否收到了取消请求。

                                                                                                                                              The ACE_Thread_Manager not only spawns threads with various properties, it also provides a cooperative thread cancelation mechanism that's safe, easy to use, and portable. To use this mechanism, the canceling thread uses ACE_Thread_Manager:: cancel () to set a flag indicating that a designated thread should cancel itself. The canceled thread is responsible for cooperating in this scheme by periodically calling ACE_Thread_Manager::testcancel () to see if it's been requested to cancel itself.

                                                                                                                                              由于线程不会立即取消，ACE 协作线程取消功能类似于使用 Pthreads延迟取消策略，取消点是调用ACE_Thread_Manager::testcancel()。 ACE 协作线程取消与 Pthreads 延迟取消的区别如下：

                                                                                                                                              Since threads are not canceled immediately, the ACE cooperative thread cancelation feature is analogous to using the Pthreads deferred cancelation policy with the cancelation point being the call to ACE_Thread_Manager:: testcancel () ACE cooperative thread cancelation differs from Pthreads deferred cancelation in the following ways:

                                                                                                                                              • 在 ACE 中，线程清理必须在取消点之后显式地编写。

                                                                                                                                              • Thread cleanup in ACE must be programmed explicitly after the cancelation point

                                                                                                                                              • 在 ACE 中，线程被取消后，可以选择完成任何正在进行的工作，甚至完全忽略取消请求。

                                                                                                                                              • After a thread has been canceled in ACE, it can elect to finish any in-progress work or even ignore the cancelation request altogether.

                                                                                                                                              因此，ACE 线程取消完全是自愿的，这是唯一一种既便携又安全地取消线程的方法。

                                                                                                                                              Thus, ACE thread cancelation is strictly voluntary, which is the only way to cancel a thread both portably and safely.

                                                                                                                                              与第 8.4 节中描述的ACE_Process_Manager一样，ACE_Thread_Manager可以通过两种方式使用：

                                                                                                                                              As with the ACE_Process_Manager described in Section 8.4, the ACE_Thread_Manager can be used in two ways:

                                                                                                                                              • 作为单例[ GHJV95 ]，可通过其instance()方法访问。此方法使用双重检查锁定优化模式实现，如侧边栏 19中所述。

                                                                                                                                              • As a singleton [GHJV95] accessed via its instance () method. This method is implemented using the Double-Checked Locking Optimization pattern, as is described in Sidebar 19.

                                                                                                                                              • 通过实例化一个或多个实例，可以实现此功能，从而支持进程内的多组线程组。虽然在任何时候都可以合法使用此功能，但建议在开发使用ACE_Thread_Manager类的共享库(DLL)时使用。这种做法可以避免干扰调用应用程序可能正在使用的单例实例。

                                                                                                                                              • By instantiating one or more instances. This capability can be used to support multiple sets of thread groups within a process. Although this is a legitimate use at any time, it's recommended when developing a shared library (DLL) that uses the ACE_Thread_Manager class. This practice avoids interfering with the singleton instance that the calling application may be using.

                                                                                                                                              例子

                                                                                                                                              Example

                                                                                                                                              在那些线程开销小于进程开销的操作系统中，多线程服务器很常见。以下示例使用ACE_Thread_Manager来实现我们第一个基于每个连接一个线程并发模型的多线程日志服务器。如图9.2所示，主线程持续运行，并扮演着工厂的角色。

                                                                                                                                              Multithreaded servers are common on operating systems where spawning threads incurs less overhead than spawning processes. The following example uses the ACE_Thread_Manager to implement our first multithreaded logging server based on a thread-per-connection concurrency model. As shown in Figure 9.2, the master thread runs continuously and plays the role of a factory that

                                                                                                                                              1. 接受连接并动态创建ACE_SOCK_Stream对象，

                                                                                                                                              2. Accepts a connection and creates a ACE_SOCK_Stream object dynamically and

                                                                                                                                              3. 生成一个工作线程，该线程使用此对象来处理客户端的日志记录会话。

                                                                                                                                              4. Spawns a worker thread that uses this object to handle the client's logging session.
                                                                                                                                              图 9.2. 每个连接一个线程的日志服务器架构

                                                                                                                                              工作线程负责对ACE_SOCK_Stream执行所有后续的日志记录处理，并在连接关闭时销毁该流。这种并发设计类似于8.4 节中为每个客户端连接生成一个新进程的示例。然而，这种每个连接一个线程的日志服务器与每个连接一个进程的实现方式在以下几个方面有所不同：

                                                                                                                                              The worker thread performs all subsequent log record processing on the ACE_SOCK_Stream and destroys it when the connection is closed. This concurrency design is similar to the example in Section 8.4 that spawned a new process for each client connection. This thread-per-connection logging server differs from the process-per-connection implementation in the following ways, however:

                                                                                                                                              侧边栏 19：ACE 中的单例序列化

                                                                                                                                              Sidebar 19: Serializing Singletons in ACE

                                                                                                                                              单例模式 [ GHJV95 ] 确保一个类只有一个实例，并提供一个全局访问点。ACE 中定义的单例使用双重检查锁定优化模式 [ SSRB00 ] 来减少争用和同步开销，确保关键代码段在程序执行期间只需以线程安全的方式获取一次锁。以下代码展示了静态方法ACE_Thread_Manager::instance()如何使用此模式：

                                                                                                                                              The Singleton pattern [GHJV95] ensures that a class has only one Instance and provides a global point of access to it. Singletons defined In ACE use the Double-Checked Locking Optimization pattern [SSRB00] to reduce contention and synchronization overhead when critical sections of code must acquire locks in a thread-safe manner just once during program execution. The following code shows how the static ACE_Thread_Manager::instance () method uses this pattern:

                                                                                                                                              ACE_Thread_Manager *ACE_Thread_Manager::instance () {
  if (ACE_Thread_Manager::thr_mgr_ == 0) {
    ACE_GUARD_RETURN (ACE_Recursive_Thread_Mutex, ace_mon,
                      *ACE_Static_Object_Lock::instance(),
                      0));
    if (ACE_Thread_Manager: ; thr_mgr_ == 0)
      ACE_Thread Manager::thr_mgr_ = new ACE_Thread_Manager;
  }
  return ACE Thread Manager::thr_mgr_;
}

                                                                                                                                              ACE_Static_Object_Lock ::instance()返回一个预初始化的锁，该锁在main()函数运行之前创建，如第 218 页的侧边栏 23中所述。

                                                                                                                                              The ACE_Static_Object_Lock::instance () returns a preinltialized lock that Is created before the main () function runs, as described in Sidebar 23 on page 218.

                                                                                                                                              • 它为每个连接创建一个新线程，而不是创建一个新进程，因此效率应该更高。

                                                                                                                                              • It spawns a new thread for each connection instead of a new process, so it should be more efficient.

                                                                                                                                              • 它更具便携性，因为它可以在任何支持线程的平台上运行。

                                                                                                                                              • It's more portable because it works on any platform that supports threads.

                                                                                                                                              • 由于可移植多线程服务器比多进程服务器更容易编程，因此实现起来要简单得多。

                                                                                                                                              • It's considerably simpler because portable multithreaded servers are easier to program than multiprocessed servers.

                                                                                                                                              第 5.2 节更全面地描述了使用多线程而不是多进程来实现服务器的优点和缺点。

                                                                                                                                              Section 5.2 provides a more general description of the pros and cons of implementing servers with multiple threads rather than with multiple processes.

                                                                                                                                              首先，我们照例包含必要的ACE头文件：

                                                                                                                                              We start, as usual, by including the necessary ACE header files:

                                                                                                                                              #include "ace/SOCK_Stream.h"
#include "ace/Thread_Manager.h"
#include "Logging_Server.h"
#include "Logging_Handler.h"

                                                                                                                                              我们定义了一个继承自Logging_Server 的Thread_Per_Connection_Logging_Server类。

                                                                                                                                              We define a Thread_Per_Connection_Logging_Server class that inherits from Logging_Server.

                                                                                                                                              class Thread Per Connection Logging_Server : public Logging Server
{
private:
  class Thread_Args {
  public:
    Thread_Args (Thread_ Per_Conenction_Logging_Server *lsp)
      : this_ (lsp) {}

    Thread_Per_Connection_Logging_Server *this_;
    ACE_SOCK Stream logging peer_;
  };

  // Passed as a parameter to <ACE_Thread_Manager::spawn>.
  static void *run_svc (void *arg);

protected:
  // Other methods shown below...
};

                                                                                                                                              与第 8.4 节中的Process_Per_Connection_Logging_Server一样，我们继承并重用open()和wait_for_multiple_events ()方法。

                                                                                                                                              As with Process_Per_Connection_Logging_Server in Section 8.4, we inherit and reuse the open() and wait_for_multiple_events () methods.

                                                                                                                                              侧边栏 20：混用线材和物品的陷阱和误区

                                                                                                                                              Sidebar 20: Traps and Pitfalls of Mixing Threads and Objects

                                                                                                                                              必须谨慎管理作为参数传递给线程入口点函数的对象的生命周期。许多程序员会混淆线程和对象，例如说“这个对象在线程中运行”。区分以下概念至关重要：

                                                                                                                                              The life cycle of objects passed as parameters to thread entry point functions must be managed carefully. Many programmers confuse a thread and an object by saying things like "this object runs in a thread." It's critical to make the following distinction:

                                                                                                                                              • 线程是执行单元。

                                                                                                                                              • A thread is a unit of execution.

                                                                                                                                              • 对象是一块内存及其相关方法。

                                                                                                                                              • An object is a chunk of memory and associated methods.

                                                                                                                                              因此，线程与其在执行期间访问的任何对象之间不存在隐式关联。所以，必须确保任何线程都无法在对象被删除后访问它。

                                                                                                                                              Thus, there's no implicit connection between a thread and any object that the thread accesses during execution. It's essential therefore to make sure that no thread can access an object after it's been deleted.

                                                                                                                                              例如，如果在for循环的作用域内创建/销毁了Thread_Args对象，则该线程的后续客户端连接会覆盖该对象。为了避免这些问题，我们动态分配Thread_Args对象，并让run_svc()函数在返回前将其删除。

                                                                                                                                              For example, if the Thread_Args object was constructed/destroyed in the scope of the for loop, the thread would have this object overwritten by a subsequent client connection. To avoid these problems, we therefore allocate Thread_Args objects dynamically and let the run_svc () function delete them before returning.

                                                                                                                                              ` handle_connections()`方法接受一个连接，并将该连接传递给`thread_args`对象的`ACE_SOCK_Stream`数据成员。（侧边栏 20解释了为什么我们要动态分配`thread_args`对象。）然后，我们使用单例`ACE_Thread_Manager`来创建一个新线程，该线程负责处理新连接的客户端。

                                                                                                                                              The handle_connections () method accepts a connection into the ACE_ SOCK_Stream data member of the thread_args object. (Sidebar 20 explains why we allocate thread_args dynamically). We then use the singleton ACE_Thread_Manager to spawn a new thread that handles the newly connected client.

                                                                                                                                              virtual int handle_connections () {
  Thread_Args *thread_args = new Thread_Args (this);

  if (acceptor ().accept (thread_args->logging_peer_) == -1)
    return -1;
  else if (ACE_Thread_Manager:: instance ()->spawn (
      // Pointer-to-function entry point.
      Thread_Per_Connection_Logging_Server::run_svc,
      // <run_svc> parameter.
      ACE_static_cast (void *, thread_ args),
      THR_DETACHED | THR_SCOPE_SYSTEM) == -1)
    return -1;
  else
    return 0;
}

                                                                                                                                              静态方法`run_svc()`是每个新线程的入口点函数。底层操作系统线程创建函数会将 ` thread_args`指针传递给`run_svc()`，后者负责管理` logging_peer`的生命周期。由于我们不会与线程交互来获取其退出状态，因此我们传递`THR_DETACHED`标志，该标志指示`ACE_Thread_Manager`和底层操作系统线程实现，在线程退出后立即释放资源。所有由`ACE_Thread_Manager`单例实例创建的线程都可以作为一个整体进行管理。因此，即使它们在创建时没有通过 `THR_JOINABLE` 标志指定为可加入线程，我们也可以等待它们完成。侧边栏 21展示了如何使用这些标志创建线程。

                                                                                                                                              The static run_svc () method is the entry point function of each new thread. The underlying OS thread creation function will pass the thread_args pointer to run_svc (), which assumes control of the logging_peer's lifetime. Since we don't rendezvous with the thread to collect its exit status, we pass the THR_DETACHED flag, which instructs the ACE_Thread_Manager and underlying OS threading implementation to free up resources as soon as a thread exits. All threads spawned by the ACE_Thread_Manager singleton can be managed as a whole. We can therefore wait for them to finish even though they weren't designated as joinable via the THR_JOINABLE flag when they were spawned. Sidebar 21 illustrates how threads are spawned using these flags.

                                                                                                                                              侧边栏 21：ACE 中线程的生成方式

                                                                                                                                              Sidebar 21: How Threads are Spawned in ACE

                                                                                                                                              下图展示了在使用 UI Threads thr_create ()系统函数的平台配置上调用ACE__Thread_Manager::spawn ()时发生的调用序列：

                                                                                                                                              The figure below illustrates the sequence of calls that occur when ACE__Thread_Manager:: spawn () is invoked on a platform configuration that uses the UI Threads thr_create () system function:





                                                                                                                                              无论操作系统如何，创建线程都会执行以下步骤：

                                                                                                                                              Regardless of OS, the following steps occur to spawn a thread:

                                                                                                                                              1. 操作系统创建线程执行上下文

                                                                                                                                              2. The OS creates a thread execution context

                                                                                                                                              3. 操作系统会为线程栈分配内存。

                                                                                                                                              4. The OS allocates memory for the thread's stack

                                                                                                                                              5. 新线程的寄存器集已准备就绪，以便在调度执行时，它将调用作为参数提供给spawn() 的线程入口点函数。

                                                                                                                                              6. The new thread's register set is prepared so that when it's scheduled into execution, it will call the thread entry point function supplied as a parameter to spawn () and

                                                                                                                                              7. 该线程被标记为可运行，因此操作系统可以开始执行它。

                                                                                                                                              8. The thread is marked runnable so the OS can start executing it

                                                                                                                                              下面显示的run_svc ()方法作为创建的每个新线程处理客户端日志记录的入口点。

                                                                                                                                              The run_svc () method shown below serves as the entry point for each new thread created to process a client log records.

                                                                                                                                              void *Thread_Per_Connection_Logging_Server::run_svc (void *arg)
{
  Thread_Args *thread_args = ACE_static_cast (Thread_Args *, arg);

  thread_args->this_->handle_data (&thread_args->logging_peer_);
  thread_args->logging_peer_.close ();
  delete thread_args;

  return 0; // Return value is ignored.
}

                                                                                                                                              如第 195 页侧边栏 21所示， ACE_Thread_Manager::spawn()方法接收run_svc()函数使用的Thread_Args指针。为了符合 ACE 线程 API 的要求（该 API 具有跨操作系统的可移植性），此指针必须强制转换为void*类型。操作系统线程库调用run_svc()函数后，会将该指针强制转换回Thread_Args*类型。ACE 的ACE_static_cast()宏（参见第 176 页侧边栏 17 ）使得在编译器允许的范围内安全地转换指针变得容易。请注意，由于run_svc()是在一个分离线程中启动的，因此其返回值将被忽略。

                                                                                                                                              As shown in Sidebar 21 on page 195, the ACE_Thread_Manager ::spawn () method is passed the Thread_Args pointer used by run_svc (). This pointer must be cast to a void * to conform to the ACE threading API, which is portable across operating systems. After the run_svc () function is invoked by the OS thread library, it casts the pointer back to a Thread_Args *. The ACE ACE_static_cast () macro (see Sidebar 17 on page 176) makes it easy to cast the pointer as safely as the compiler allows. Note that since we spawned run_svc () in a detached thread it's return value is ignored.

                                                                                                                                              静态run_svc()方法使用Thread_Args参数中的数据成员将控制权转发回以下handle_data()方法，以便继续进行日志记录处理。

                                                                                                                                              The static run_svc () method uses the data members in the Thread_ Args parameter to forward control back to the following handle_data () method so that log record processing can continue.

                                                                                                                                              protected:
  virtual int handle_data (ACE_SOCK_Stream *logging_peer) {
    ACE_FILE_IO log_file;
    // Client's hostname is used as the logfile name.
    make_log_file (log_file, logging_peer);

    // Place the connection into blocking mode.
    client->disable (ACE_NONBLOCK);

    Logging_Handler logging_handler (log_file, *logging_peer);
    ACE_Thread_Manager *tm = ACE_Thread_Manager:: instance ();
    ACE_thread_t me = ACE_OS::thr_self ();

    // Keep handling log records until client closes connection
    // or this thread is asked to cancel itself.
    while (!tm->testcancel (me)
           && logging_handler.log_record () != -1)
      continue;

    log_file.close ();
    return 0;
}

                                                                                                                                              此版本的`handle_data()`与第 179 页的“每个连接一个进程”示例类似。但是，在此版本中，处理客户端日志记录的`handle_data()`线程可以被请求取消自身，这是一个协作式取消的示例。为了实现协作，每个`handle_data() ` 线程在处理日志记录之前都会调用`ACE_Thread_Manager::testcancel()`来检查主线程是否已请求取消。

                                                                                                                                              This version of handle_data () is similar to the process-per-connection example on page 179. In this version, however, the handle_data () thread that's processing client log records can be asked to cancel itself, which is an example of cooperative cancelation. To cooperate, each handle_data () thread calls ACE_Thread_Manager:: testcancel () before handling a log record to see if the main thread has requested a cancelation.

                                                                                                                                              testcancel()调用位置和Logging_Handler::log_record()方法的设计存在一个缺陷：线程要等到收到下一条日志记录后才会注意到取消请求。如果客户端发送日志记录的频率相当高，这可能不会造成问题。[ SH ]中描述的 ACE Reactor 和 Task 框架可以用来避免这个缺陷。

                                                                                                                                              One shortcoming of the placement of the testcancel () call and the design of the Logging_Handler:: log_record () method is that the thread won't notice the cancel request until after the next log record is received. If clients send log records fairly often this may not be a problem. The ACE Reactor and Task frameworks described in [SH] can be used to avoid this shortcoming.

                                                                                                                                              最后，主程序在其run()模板方法中执行日志服务器的事件循环。

                                                                                                                                              Finally, the main () program executes the logging server's event loop within its run () template method.

                                                                                                                                              int main (int argc, char *argv[])
{
  // Register to receive the <SIGTERM> signal.
  ACE_Sig_Action sa (sigterm_handler, SIGTERM);

  Thread_Per_Connection_Logging_Server server;

  if (server.run (argc, argv) == -1}
    ACE_ERROR_RETURN ((LM_ERROR, "%p\n", "server.run()"), 1);

  // Cooperative thread cancelation.
  ACE_Thread_Manager::instance ()->cancel_all ();

  // Barrier synchronization, wait no more than a minute.
  ACE_Time_Value timeout (60);
  return ACE Thread Manager::instance ()->wait (&timeout);
}

                                                                                                                                              日志服务器采用线程/连接模式，通过捕获 SIGTERM 信号来允许系统管理员将其关闭。然而，主线程并非无限期地等待所有日志客户端终止会话，而是使用ACE_Thread_Manager协作取消机制，请求由ACE_Thread_Manager单例实例创建的所有服务线程关闭。

                                                                                                                                              The thread-per-connection implementation of the logging server catches the SIGTERM signal to allow a system administrator to shut it down. Rather than wait an unlimited time for all logging clients to terminate their sessions, however, the main thread uses the ACE_Thread_Manager cooperative cancelation mechanism to request all service threads spawned by the ACE_Thread_Manager singleton to shut down.

                                                                                                                                              main()函数末尾的 wait() 调用允许日志服务器等待最多一分钟，以便在所有已取消的线程完成后进行同步。这是一个屏障同步的例子，它可以防止在某些操作系统平台上出现问题，例如当主线程在其他线程仍在运行时退出，导致出现异常行为。通过timeout参数限制等待时间，我们可以确保日志服务器不会无限期地挂起。

                                                                                                                                              The wait () call at the end of main () allows the logging server to wait up to a minute to synchronize on the completion of all the canceled threads. This is an example of barrier synchronization and it prevents problems from occurring on OS platforms where undesirable behavior occurs if the main thread exits while other threads are still running. By bounding our waiting time via the timeout argument, however, we ensure that the logging server doesn't hang indefinitely.

                                                                                                                                                9.3 ACE_Sched_Params 类

                                                                                                                                                9.3 The ACE_Sched_Params Class

                                                                                                                                                动机

                                                                                                                                                Motivation

                                                                                                                                                由Thread_Per_Connection_Logging_Server类创建的所有线程都以相同的优先级运行，默认值为预定义宏 ACE_DEFAULT_THREAD_PRIORITY 的值。某些类型的网络应用程序，特别是那些具有实时性要求的应用程序，需要对其线程优先级进行更精细的控制。在 ACE 中，可以通过向 ACE_Thread_Manager ::spawn()或spawn_n()方法传递参数来指定新创建线程的优先级。然而，这种方法存在两个问题：
