                                                                                                                                                All threads spawned by the Thread_Per_Connection _Logging_Server class run at the same priority, which by default is the value of the predefined macro ACE_DEFAULT_THREAD_PRIORITY. Certain types of networked applications, particularly those with real-time requirements, need more control over their thread priorities. It's possible to specify the priority of a newly create thread in ACE by passing a parameter to the ACE_Thread_ Manager::spawn () or spawn_n () methods. There are two problems with this approach, however:

                                                                                                                                                • 不可移植—— 不同的操作系统平台以不同的方式表示优先级，例如，在某些操作系统中，优先级越高，数值越高；而在其他操作系统中，优先级越高，数值越低。

                                                                                                                                                • Nonportable— Different OS plaforms represent priorities in different ways, for example, in some operating systems, higher priorities have higher numeric values, whereas in other operating systems, they have lower numeric values.

                                                                                                                                                • 非实时——大多数操作系统需要额外的（非标准的）步骤才能使线程按照第 5.5 节 所述的实时调度类运行。

                                                                                                                                                • Non-real-time— Most operating systems require additional (and non-standard) steps to make a thread run in the real-time scheduling class described in Section 5.5.

                                                                                                                                                在每个应用程序中解决这些问题既繁琐又容易出错，因此 ACE 提供了ACE_Sched_Params包装外观类和ACE_OS::sched_pa​​rams ()包装方法。

                                                                                                                                                Addressing these problems in each application is tedious and error prone, which is why ACE provides the ACE_Sched_Params wrapper facade class and the ACE_OS::sched_params () wrapper method.

                                                                                                                                                等级能力

                                                                                                                                                Class Capabilities

                                                                                                                                                ACE_Sched_Params类使用包装器外观模式来指导第 5.5 节中讨论的操作系统调度类 API 的封装。此类可以与ACE_OS::sched_pa​​rams()方法一起使用，以提供以下功能：

                                                                                                                                                The ACE_Sched_Params class uses the Wrapper Facade pattern to guide the encapsulation of the OS scheduling class APIs discussed in Section 5.5. This class can be used with the ACE_OS::sched_params () method to provide the following capabilities:

                                                                                                                                                • 一种可移植的方法来指定调度策略，例如先进先出（FIFO）和轮询调度。

                                                                                                                                                • A portable means to specify scheduling policies, such as first in, first out (FIFO) and round-robin

                                                                                                                                                • 一种为轮询调度策略指定时间片量子的方法

                                                                                                                                                • A way to specify a time-slice quantum for the round-robin scheduling policy

                                                                                                                                                • 一种指定策略适用范围的方法，例如，针对当前进程或当前线程；

                                                                                                                                                • A way to specify the scope in which the policy applies, for example, to the current process or the current thread, and

                                                                                                                                                • 需要对调度优先级进行一致的表示，因为在某些操作系统平台上，较高的调度优先级用较低的优先级值表示。

                                                                                                                                                • A consistent representation of scheduling priorities, which is necessary since higher scheduling priorities are indicated by lower priority values on some OS platforms.

                                                                                                                                                ACE_OS ::sched_pa​​rams ()方法封装了操作调度类的操作系统特定函数，而ACE_Sched_Params提供了此方法使用的值。

                                                                                                                                                The ACE_OS::sched_params () method encapsulates the OS-specific function(s) that manipulate the scheduling class and ACE_Sched_Params provides the values used by this method.

                                                                                                                                                ACE_Sched_Params类的接口如图 9.3所示，其主要方法概述如下表所示：

                                                                                                                                                The interface of the ACE_Sched_Params class is shown in Figure 9.3 and its key methods outlined in the following table:

                                                                                                                                                方法 描述
                                                                                                                                                ACE_Sched_Params() 为实时线程设置调度策略、优先级、范围和时间片。
                                                                                                                                                priority_min() 返回给定调度策略和范围的最低优先级。
                                                                                                                                                priority_max() 返回给定调度策略和范围的最大优先级。
                                                                                                                                                next_priority() 给定策略、优先级和范围，返回下一个更高的优先级，这里的“更高”指的是调度优先级，而不是优先级值本身。如果该优先级已经是指定策略的最高优先级，则直接返回该优先级。
                                                                                                                                                previous_priority() 给定策略、优先级和范围，返回之前的较低优先级，这里的“较低”指的是调度优先级，而不是优先级值本身。如果该优先级已经是指定策略的较低优先级，则返回该优先级。

                                                                                                                                                图 9.3. ACE_Sched_Params类图

                                                                                                                                                ACE_OS ::Sched_pa​​rams()方法通常在main()函数中调用，且在任何线程被创建之前。由于新创建的线程会继承其父线程的调度类和优先级，因此该调用会设置默认的基本优先级。各个线程的优先级可以在创建时通过ACE_Thread_Manager::spawn()方法指定，也可以通过ACE_OS::thr_prio()进行调整。

                                                                                                                                                The ACE_OS:: Sched_params () method is usually called from main () before any threads have been spawned. Since spawned threads inherit their parent's scheduling class and priority, this call sets the default base priority. Individual thread priorities can be designated when created by the ACE_Thread_Manager ::spawn () method or adjusted via ACE_OS ::thr_ prio().

                                                                                                                                                例子

                                                                                                                                                Example

                                                                                                                                                为了展示如何使用 ACE 以可移植的方式编写操作系统实时调度类功能，我们将修改9.2 节中每个连接一个线程的日志服务器示例。在仔细分析了我们的网络日志服务部署后，我们决定优先处理已连接的客户端，而不是新的连接请求。因此，接受连接的线程的实时优先级将低于我们为接收和处理日志记录而创建的线程。

                                                                                                                                                To show how ACE can be used to program OS real-time scheduling class features portably, we'll modify our thread-per-connection logging server example from Section 9.2. After a careful empirical analysis of our networked logging service deployments, we decided to give preference to connected clients, rather than to new connection requests. The thread that accepts connections will therefore run at a lower real-time priority than the threads we'll spawn to receive and process log records.

                                                                                                                                                在RT_Thread_Per_Connection_Logging_Server.h文件中，我们继承了Thread_Per_Connection_Logging_Server类，创建了一个网络日志服务器，其线程将在实时操作系统调度类中运行。

                                                                                                                                                In the RT_Thread_Per_Connection_Logging_Server.h file, we inherit from the Thread_Per_Connection_Logging_Server class to create a networked logging server whose threads will run in the real-time OS scheduling class.

                                                                                                                                                class RT_Thread_Per_Connection_Logging_Server
  : public Thread Per_Connection_Logging_Server
{
public:

                                                                                                                                                接下来，我们重写open()钩子方法，为进程中生成的所有线程启用 FIFO 调度。默认情况下，生成的线程将以最低实时线程优先级运行。如果应用程序权限不足，我们将回退到分时调度类中运行。

                                                                                                                                                We next override the open () hook method to enable FIFO scheduling for all threads spawned in the process. By default, spawned threads will run at the minimum real-time thread priority. If the application lacks sufficient permissions, we fall back to running in the time-shared scheduling class.

                                                                                                                                                virtual int open (u_short port) {
  ACE_Sched_Params fifo_sched_params
    (ACE_SCHED_FIFO,
    ACE_Sched_Params::priority_min (ACE_SCHED_FIFO),
    ACE_SCOPE_PROCESS);

  if (ACE_OS::sched_params (fifo_sched_params) == -1) {
    if (errno == EPERM 11 errno == ENOTSUP)
      ACE_DEBUG ((LM_DEBUG,
                 "Warning: user's not superuser, so "
                 "we'll run in the time-shared class\n"));
    else
      ACE_ERROR_RETURN ((LM_ERROR,
                        "%p\n", "ACE_OS::sched_params ()") , -1);
  }
  // Initialize the parent classes.
  return Thread_Per_Connection Logging_Server::open (port);
}

                                                                                                                                                最后，我们重写了handle_data()方法，以便提高处理来自已连接客户端的日志记录的每个线程的优先级。

                                                                                                                                                Finally, we override the handle_data () method so that it increases the priority of each thread that processes log records from connected clients.

                                                                                                                                                virtual int handle_data (ACE_SOCK_Stream *logging_client) {
  int prio  =
    ACE_Sched_Params::next_priority
      (ACE_SCHED_FIFO,
       ACE_Sched_Params::priority_min (ACE_SCHED_FIFO),
       ACE_SCOPE_THREAD);
  ACE_OS::thr_setprio (prio);
  return Thread_Per_Connection_Logging_Server::handle_data
           (logging client);
}

                                                                                                                                                我们利用面向对象设计、C++ 特性和 ACE 包装器外观，无需更改任何现有类或编写任何平台特定的代码，即可为我们的线程连接日志服务器添加实时调度类行为。main ()函数与第 9.2 节中的函数类似，只是将Thread_Per_Connection_Logging_Server类替换为我们自己的RT_Thread_Per_Connection_Logging_Server类的实例。

                                                                                                                                                Our use of object-oriented design, C++ features, and ACE wrapper facades allows us to add real-time scheduling class behavior to our thread-per-connection logging server without changing any existing classes or writing any platform-specific code. The main () function is like the one from Section 9.2, with an instance of our RT_Thread_Per_Connection_Logging_Server class in place of Thread_Per_Connection_Logging_Server.

                                                                                                                                                  9.4 ACE_TSS 类

                                                                                                                                                  9.4 The ACE_TSS Class

                                                                                                                                                  动机

                                                                                                                                                  Motivation

                                                                                                                                                  尽管 C++ 全局变量有时很有用，但它们潜在的有害副作用和未定义的初始化语义 [ LGS00 ] 会导致一些不易察觉的问题。这些问题在多线程应用程序中会更加严重。特别是，当多个线程同时访问未同步的全局变量时，信息可能会丢失或被错误地使用。

                                                                                                                                                  Although C++ global variables are sometimes useful, their potential for harmful side-effects and undefined initialization semantics [LGS00] can cause subtle problems. These problems are exacerbated in multithreaded applications. In particular, when multiple threads access unsynchronized global variables simultaneously, information can get lost or the wrong information can be used.

                                                                                                                                                  以 C 语言的errno变量为例。由于 errno 可以并发更改（例如，在系统函数中设置后和在应用程序代码中测试后），因此对单个进程的errno进行串行化访问毫无意义。因此， 6.4 节中概述的同步机制并不适用。每个线程都需要自己的errno副本，而这正是操作系统线程特定存储 (TSS) 机制所提供的。通过使用 TSS 机制，任何线程都无法看到其他线程的errno实例。

                                                                                                                                                  Consider the C errno variable for example. Serializing access to a single, per-process errno is pointless since it can be changed concurrently, for example, between when it's set in a system function and tested in application code. Therefore, the synchronization mechanisms outlined in Section 6.4 aren't relevant. Each thread needs its own copy of errno, which is what OS thread-specific storage (TSS) mechanisms provide. By using the TSS mechanism, no thread can see another thread's instance of errno.

                                                                                                                                                  遗憾的是，操作系统提供的原生 TSS C API 存在以下问题：

                                                                                                                                                  Unfortunately, the native TSS C APIs provided by operating systems have the following problems:

                                                                                                                                                  • 容易出错—— 大多数 TSS C API 将指向线程特定对象的指针存储为void*类型，这对于通用 API 来说是最合理的做法。然而，这也带来了另一个意想不到的复杂性来源，因为容易出错的void指针消除了类型安全性。它们还必须强制转换为实际类型，这又会引入程序员出错的可能性。

                                                                                                                                                  • Error prone— Most TSS C APIs store pointers to thread-specific objects as void*'s, which is the most sensible approach for a general-use API. It's also, however, another source of accidental complexity because the error prone void pointers eliminate type safety. They must also be cast to the actual type, introducing a source of programmer error.

                                                                                                                                                  • 不可移植性—— 除了 API 的差异外，TSS 的特性和用法在不同平台上也存在差异。例如，与 Pthreads 和 UI 线程不同，Win32 并没有提供可靠的方法来在线程退出时释放线程特定的对象。反之，在 UI 线程中，也没有用于删除键的 API。这些语义上的差异使得编写能够在不同操作系统平台上稳定运行的代码变得极具挑战性。

                                                                                                                                                  • Nonportable— In addition to API differences, TSS features and usage differ across platforms as well. For example, Win32, unlike Pthreads and UI threads, don't provide a reliable way to deallocate thread-specific objects when a thread exits. In UI threads, conversely, there's no API to delete a key. These diverse semantics make it challenging to write code that runs portably and robustly across OS platforms.

                                                                                                                                                  在每个应用程序中解决这些问题既繁琐又容易出错，因此 ACE 提供了ACE_TSS类。

                                                                                                                                                  Addressing these problems in each application is tedious and error prone, which is why ACE provides the ACE_TSS class.

                                                                                                                                                  等级能力

                                                                                                                                                  Class Capabilities

                                                                                                                                                  ACE_TSS类实现了线程特定存储模式，该模式封装并增强了原生操作系统 TSS API [ SSRB00 ]。此类提供以下功能：

                                                                                                                                                  The ACE_TSS class implements the Thread_Specific Storage pattern, which encapsulates and enhances the native OS TSS APIs [SSRB00]. This class provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                                                                                  • 它支持“物理上”特定于线程的数据，即线程私有的数据，但允许像“逻辑上”全局数据一样访问这些数据。

                                                                                                                                                  • It supports data that is "physically" thread specific, that is, private to a thread, but allows them to be accessed as though they were "logically" global to a program.

                                                                                                                                                  • 它使用 C++ 委托运算符 operator->()来提供线程特定的智能指针[ Mey96 ]。

                                                                                                                                                  • It uses the C++ delegation operator, operator- > (), to provide thread-specific smart pointers [Mey96].

                                                                                                                                                  • 它封装了与 TSS 对象关联的键的管理。

                                                                                                                                                  • It encapsulates the management of the keys associated with TSS objects.

                                                                                                                                                  • 对于像 Vx-Works 这样本身缺乏足够 TSS 支持的平台，ACE_TSS可以有效地模拟 TSS。

                                                                                                                                                  • For platforms that lack adequate TSS support natively, such as Vx-Works, ACE_TSS emulates TSS efficiently.

                                                                                                                                                  ACE_TSS类的接口如图 9.4所示，其主要方法如下所示：

                                                                                                                                                  The interface for the ACE_TSS class is shown in Figure 9.4, and its key methods are shown below:

                                                                                                                                                  方法 描述
                                                                                                                                                  运算符 -> () 获取与 TSS 键关联的线程特定对象。
                                                                                                                                                  清理 （） 一个静态方法，用于在线程退出时删除 TSS 对象。

                                                                                                                                                  图 9.4. ACE_TSS类图

                                                                                                                                                  ACE_TSS模板是一个代理，它将普通的 C++ 类转换为类型安全的类，这些类的实例驻留在线程特定的存储中。它结合了 ` operator->() ` 委托方法和其他 C++ 特性，例如模板、内联和重载。此外，它还使用了常见的同步模式和惯用法 [ SSRB00 ]，例如双重检查锁定优化和作用域锁定，如下面的`operator->()`实现所示：

                                                                                                                                                  The ACE_TSS template is a proxy that transforms ordinary C++ classes into type-safe classes whose instances reside in thread-specific storage. It combines the operator-> () delegation method with other C++ features, such as templates, inlining, and overloading. In addition, it uses common synchronization patterns and idioms [SSRB00], such as Double-Checked Locking Optimization and Scoped Locking, as shown in the implementation of operator-> () below:

                                                                                                                                                  template <class TYPE> TYPE *
ACE_TSS<TYPE>::operator-> () {
  if (once_ == 0) {
    // Ensure that we're serialized.
    ACE_GUARD_RETURN (ACE_Thread_Mutex, guard,   keylock_, 0);

    if (once_ == 0) {
      ACE_OS::thr_keycreate (&key_, &ACE_TSS<TYPE>::cleanup);
      once = 1;
    }
  }
  TYPE *ts_obj = 0;

  // Initialize <ts_obj> from thread-specific storage.
  ACE_OS::thr_getspecific (key_, (void **) &ts_obj);

  // Check if this method's been called in this thread.
  if (ts_obj == 0) {
      // Allocate memory off the heap and store it in a pointer.
      ts_obj = new TYPE;

      // Store the dynamically allocated pointer in TSS.
      ACE_OS::thr_setspecific (key_, ts_obj);
  }
  return ts_obj;
}

                                                                                                                                                  在实现 C++ 线程特定存储代理时需要考虑的更多问题，请参见 [ SSRB00 ]中的线程特定存储模式。

                                                                                                                                                  More issues to consider when implementing a C++ thread-specific storage proxy are shown in the Thread-Specific Storage pattern in [SSRB00].

                                                                                                                                                  例子

                                                                                                                                                  Example

                                                                                                                                                  本示例演示了如何将ACE_TSS应用于9.2 节中每个连接一个线程的日志服务器示例。在此实现中，每个线程都有自己的请求计数，该计数存储在线程特定的存储空间中。这种设计使我们能够在无需互斥锁的情况下缓解请求计数的竞争条件。此外，它还允许我们使用线程特定的存储空间，而无需引入与容易出错且不便携带的原生 C API 相关的各种复杂性。

                                                                                                                                                  This example illustrates how ACE_TSS can be applied to our thread-per-connection logging server example from Section 9.2. In this implementation, each thread gets its own request count that resides in thread-specific storage. This design allows us to alleviate race conditions on the request count without requiring a mutex. It also allows us to use thread-specific storage without incurring all the accidental complexity associated with the error prone and nonportable native C APIs.

                                                                                                                                                  我们首先定义一个简单的类来跟踪请求计数：

                                                                                                                                                  We start by defining a simple class that keeps track of request counts:

                                                                                                                                                  class Request_Count {
public:
  Request_Count (): count_ (0) {}
  void increment () { ++count ; }
  int value () const { return count_; }

private:
  int count_;
};

                                                                                                                                                  注意Request_Count并不了解线程特定的存储。然后，我们将此类用作ACE_TSS模板的类型参数，如下所示：

                                                                                                                                                  Note how Request_Count knows nothing about thread-specific storage.We then use this class as the type parameter to the ACE_TSS template, as follows:

                                                                                                                                                  static ACE_TSS<Request_Count> request_count;

                                                                                                                                                  现在每个线程都有一个独立的Request_Count副本，可以通过request_count访问。虽然这个对象看起来是“逻辑全局的”，也就是说，它的访问方式与其他文件作用域的对象一样，但它的状态实际上是“物理局部的”，仅限于使用它的线程。我们展示了如何轻松地将request_count集成到handle_data()方法中：

                                                                                                                                                  Each thread now has a separate copy of Request_Count, which is accessed via request_count. Although this object appears to be "logically global," that is, it's accessed just like any other object at file scope, its state is "physically local" to the thread in which it's used. We show how simple it is to integrate request_count into the handle_data () method:

                                                                                                                                                  virtual int handle_data (ACE_SOCK _Stream *) {
  while (logging_handler_. log_record () !_ -1)
    // Keep track of number of requests.
    request_count->increment ();

  ACE_DEBUG ((LM_DEBUG, "request_count = %d\n",
             request_count->value ()));
}

                                                                                                                                                  通过使用ACE_TSS包装器外观，我们无需锁定increment()和value()调用，从而消除争用和竞态条件。

                                                                                                                                                  By using the ACE_TSS wrapper facade, we needn't lock the increment () and value () calls, which eliminates contention and race conditions.

                                                                                                                                                    9.5 总结

                                                                                                                                                    9.5 Summary

                                                                                                                                                    不同的操作系统不仅提供的多线程 API 语法不同，而且这些 API 的语义也存在细微差别。为了缓解这种复杂性，ACE 线程包装器外观实现了一套可移植的功能集，导出统一的多线程语法和语义。本节展示了日志服务器示例的几个改进版本，其中我们演示了如何使用多线程而非多进程来处理多个客户端会话，以及如何控制服务器线程的实时调度属性。

                                                                                                                                                    Different operating systems not only provide multithreading APIs that differ syntactically, but the semantics of these APIs also vary in subtle ways. To alleviate this complexity, the ACE threading wrapper facades implement a portable set of capabilities that export uniform multithreading syntax and semantics. This section presented several more revisions of our logging server example, where we showed how to handle multiple client sessions using multiple threads rather than multiple processes, as well as how to control the real-time scheduling properties of server threads.

                                                                                                                                                    ACE 还提供了ACE_Task并发框架，使开发人员能够以强大且可扩展的面向对象方式使用线程。此外，ACE_Task并发框架不仅提供了在对象上下文中创建线程的功能，还提供了一种灵活而强大的队列机制，用于在面向消息和面向任务的架构中任务之间传输数据和对象。如 [ SH ] 中所述，ACE_Task框架可用于实现以下常见的并发模式 [ SSRB00 ]：

                                                                                                                                                    ACE also provides the ACE_Task concurrency framework that allows developers to use threading in a powerful and extensible object-oriented fashion. Moreover, the ACE_Task concurrency framework not only provides a facility for spawning threads in the context of an object, but also a flexible and powerful queueing mechanism for transferring data and objects between tasks in message-oriented and task-oriented architectures. As described in [SH], the ACE_Task framework can be applied to implement the following common concurrency patterns [SSRB00]:

                                                                                                                                                    • 活动对象模式将方法执行与方法调用解耦。其目的是增强并发性，并简化对驻留在各自线程中的对象的同步访问。

                                                                                                                                                    • The Active Object pattern, which decouples method execution from method invocation. Its purpose is to enhance concurrency and simplify synchronized access to objects that reside in their own threads.

                                                                                                                                                    • 半同步/半异步模式将并发系统中的同步和异步处理解耦，从而简化编程，同时又不至于过度降低性能。该模式引入了两个通信层：一个用于同步服务处理，另一个用于异步服务处理。队列层负责协调同步层和异步层之间的通信。

                                                                                                                                                    • The Half-Sync/Half-Async pattern, which decouples synchronous and asynchronous processing in concurrent systems to simplify programming without reducing performance unduly. This pattern introduces two communicating layers: one for synchronous and one for asynchronous service processing. A queueing layer mediates communication between the synchronous and asynchronous layers.

                                                                                                                                                      第十章 ACE同步包装器外观

                                                                                                                                                      Chapter 10. The ACE Synchronization Wrapper Facades

                                                                                                                                                      章节概要

                                                                                                                                                      Chapter Synopsis

                                                                                                                                                      本章介绍 ACE 封装器外观，它使用可移植的 C++ 类封装操作系统同步机制。我们展示了一系列相关示例，以说明这些类在实践中的应用。此外，我们还介绍了如何组合核心 ACE 同步封装器外观，以模拟操作系统本身不支持的同步机制。

                                                                                                                                                      This chapter describes the ACE wrapper facades that encapsulate OS synchronization mechanisms with portable C++ classes. We show a series of related examples to illustrate how these classes can be applied in practice. In addition, we describe how the core ACE synchronization wrapper facades can be combined to emulate synchronization mechanisms that aren't supported natively.

                                                                                                                                                        10.1 概述

                                                                                                                                                        10.1 Overview

                                                                                                                                                        硬件特性会对操作系统线程机制的行为产生显著影响。例如，多个线程可以在不同的处理器上并行运行。在单处理器系统中，任何时刻只有一个线程处于活动状态，尽管线程可能会被调度进出执行，从而造成并行运行的假象。然而，在这两种情况下，开发人员都必须使用同步机制来避免竞争条件，并确保应用程序协调对共享资源的访问。

                                                                                                                                                        Hardware characteristics can affect the behavior of OS threading mechanisms significantly. For example, multiple threads can run in parallel on separate processors. On a uniprocessor, only one thread is active at any point in time, though threads may be scheduled in and out of execution, giving the appearance of running in parallel. In both of these scenarios, however, developers must use synchronization mechanisms to avoid race conditions and to ensure that their applications coordinate their access to shared resources.

                                                                                                                                                        不同的操作系统提供不同的同步机制，这些机制语义各异，并使用不同的 API。其中一些 API 符合国际标准，例如 Pthreads [ IEE96 ]。另一些 API 则符合事实标准，例如 Win32 [ Sol98 ]。本章将介绍以下 ACE 类，网络应用程序可以使用这些类来实现线程和/或进程的可移植同步：

                                                                                                                                                        Different operating systems provide different synchronization mechanisms with different semantics using different APIs. Some of these APIs conform to international standards, such as Pthreads [IEE96]. Other APIs conform to de facto standards, such as Win32 [Sol98]. This chapter describes the following ACE classes that networked applications can use to synchronize threads and/or processes portably:

                                                                                                                                                        ACE 级 描述 
                                                                                                                                                        ACE_Guard
ACE_Read_Guard
ACE_Write_Guard
                                                                                                                                                        		应用作用域锁定惯用法 [ SSRB00 ] 以确保在进入和退出 C++ 代码块时分别自动获取和释放锁。 
                                                                                                                                                        ACE_Thread_Mutex
ACE_Process_Mutex
ACE_Null_Mutex
                                                                                                                                                        		提供一种简单高效的机制，供并发应用程序序列化对共享资源的访问。 
                                                                                                                                                        ACE_RW_Thread_Mutex
ACE_RW_Process_Mutex
                                                                                                                                                        		允许高效、并发地访问资源，这些资源的搜索频率远高于其更改频率。 
                                                                                                                                                        ACE_Thread_Semaphore
ACE_Process_Semaphore
ACE_ Null Semaphore
                                                                                                                                                        		实现计数信号量，这是一种用于同步多个控制线程的通用机制。 
                                                                                                                                                        ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex
ACE_Null_Condition
                                                                                                                                                        		允许线程协调并高效地安排其处理任务。

                                                                                                                                                        这些外立面包装器具有以下优点：

                                                                                                                                                        These wrapper facades provide the following benefits:

                                                                                                                                                        • 通过以下方式提高打字安全性

                                                                                                                                                          - 自动初始化同步对象，例如，当它们作为 C++ 类中的数据成员出现时。

                                                                                                                                                          - 防止错误使用，例如将一个互斥锁复制到另一个互斥锁。

                                                                                                                                                          - 确保在进入和退出作用域时自动获取和释放锁，即使发生异常或错误。

                                                                                                                                                        • Improve type safety by

                                                                                                                                                          - Automating the initialization of synchronization objects, for example, when they appear as data members in C++ classes.

                                                                                                                                                          - Preventing incorrect usage, for example, copying one mutex to another.

                                                                                                                                                          - Ensuring that locks are acquired and released automatically as scopes are entered and exited, even if exceptions or errors occur.

                                                                                                                                                        • 确保跨异构操作系统平台的可移植性。例如，ACE 为那些本身不支持读写锁和条件变量同步机制的平台提供了可移植的实现。

                                                                                                                                                        • Ensure portability across heterogeneous OS platforms. For example, ACE provides portable implementations of readers/writer locks and condition variables on platforms that don't support these synchronization mechanisms natively.

                                                                                                                                                        • 在不影响效率的前提下，增强抽象性和模块化。利用 C++ 语言特性，例如内联函数和模板，可以确保 ACE 同步包装器外观几乎不会产生额外的时间和空间开销。

                                                                                                                                                        • Enhance abstraction and modularity without compromising efficiency. Using C++ language features, such as inline functions and templates, ensures that the ACE synchronization wrapper facades incur little or no additional time and space overhead.

                                                                                                                                                        • 导出统一的同步接口，使应用程序能够获取和释放各种类型的锁。例如，ACE 互斥锁、读写器、信号量和文件锁机制都支持图 10.1所示的ACE_LOCK*接口。ACE_LOCK *是一个“伪类”，也就是说，它不是 ACE 中的真正 C++ 类。我们使用它只是为了说明许多 ACE 同步类（例如ACE_Thread_Mutex、ACE_Process_Mutex和ACE_Thread_Semaphore）所支持的签名的统一性。

                                                                                                                                                          图 10.1. ACE_LOCK*伪类

                                                                                                                                                        • Export a uniform synchronization interface that enables applications to acquire and release various types of locks. For example, the ACE mutex, readers/writer, semaphore, and file lock mechanisms all support the ACE_LOCK* interface shown in Figure 10.1. ACE_LOCK* is a "pseudo-class," that is, it's not a real C++ class in ACE. We just use it to illustrate the uniformity of the signatures supported by many of the ACE synchronization classes, such as ACE_Thread_Mutex, ACE_Process_Mutex, and ACE_Thread_Semaphore.

                                                                                                                                                          Figure 10.1. The ACE_LOCK* Pseudo-class

                                                                                                                                                        • 减少为实现线程安全所需的侵入式更改。ACE 同步接口的统一性使得单个ACE_Guard模板类能够确保大多数类型的锁可以在作用域进入和退出时分别获取和释放。

                                                                                                                                                        • Reduce the amount of obtrusive changes needed to make code thread-safe. The uniformity of the ACE synchronization interfaces enables a single ACE_Guard template class to ensure that most types of locks can be acquired and released as scopes are entered and exited, respectively.

                                                                                                                                                        本章阐述了 ACE 核心同步包装器外观类的功能及其背后的原因。我们提供了每个类的示例，以说明它们如何简化并发网络应用程序遇到的常见同步问题。

                                                                                                                                                        This chapter motivates and describes the capabilities of the core ACE synchronization wrapper facade classes. We present examples of each class to illustrate how they can simplify common synchronization issues encountered by concurrent networked applications.

                                                                                                                                                          10.2 ACE 卫队课程

                                                                                                                                                          10.2 The ACE Guard Classes

                                                                                                                                                          动机

                                                                                                                                                          Motivation

                                                                                                                                                          ACE 同步包装器外观接口的统一性使其易于正确使用，这有助于克服跨平台网络编程中一些意想不到的复杂性。另一个常见的问题是锁的作用域。不正确的锁获取和释放会导致系统死锁或意外的竞态条件。当显式地获取和释放锁时，很难确保代码中的所有路径都能释放锁，尤其是在抛出 C++ 异常时。ACE 提供了ACE_Guard类及其关联的子类，以帮助确保锁的正确获取和释放。

                                                                                                                                                          The uniformity of ACE's synchronization wrapper facade interfaces makes it easy to use them correctly, which helps to overcome several accidental complexities of cross-platform network programming. A separate issue that often occurs is related to lock scoping. Improper lock acquisition and release can result in system deadlock or inadvertent race conditions. When acquiring and releasing locks explicitly, it can be hard to ensure that all paths through the code release the lock, especially when C++ exceptions are thrown. ACE provides the ACE_Guard class and its associated subclasses to help assure that locks are acquired and released properly.

                                                                                                                                                          等级能力

                                                                                                                                                          Class Capabilities

                                                                                                                                                          ACE_Guard 、ACE_Read_Guard和ACE_Write_Guard类实现了作用域锁定惯用法[ SSRB00 ]，该惯用法利用 C++ 类构造函数和析构函数的语义，确保在进入和退出 C++ 代码块时分别自动获取和释放锁。图 10.2展示了这些类的接口及其相互关系。

                                                                                                                                                          The ACE_Guard, ACE_Read_Guard, and ACE_Write_Guard classes implement the Scoped Locking idiom [SSRB00], which leverages the semantics of C++ class constructors and destructors to ensure a lock is acquired and released automatically upon entry to and exit from a block of C++ code, respectively. Figure 10.2 shows the interface of these classes and their relationships to each other.

                                                                                                                                                          图 10.2. ACE_Guard系列类图

                                                                                                                                                          以下来自ACE_Guard类的 C++ 源代码片段展示了它是如何实现作用域锁定惯用法的：

                                                                                                                                                          The following C++ source code segment from the ACE_Guard class shows how it implements the Scoped Locking idiom:

                                                                                                                                                          template <class LOCK>
class ACE_Guard
{
public:
  // Implicitly and automatically acquire the lock.
  ACE_Guard (LOCK &lock): lock_ (&lock) { acquire (); }
  // Implicitly release the lock.
  ~ACE_Guard () { release (); }

  // Explicitly acquire the lock.
  int acquire (); {
    return owner_ = lock_->acquire ();
  }

  // Explicitly release the lock.
  int release () {
    if (owner_ = -1)
      return -1;
    else {
      owner_ = -1
      return lock_->release ();
    }
  }

  int locked () const { return owner_ != -1; }
  // ... Other methods omitted

protected:
  // Used by subclasses to store pointer.
  ACE_Guard (LOCK *lock): lock_ (lock) {}

  // Pointer to the LOCK we're guarding.
  LOCK *lock_;

  // Keeps track of whether we acquired the lock or failed.
  int owner_;
};

                                                                                                                                                          ACE_Guard实例定义了一个代码作用域，在该作用域内，当守卫对象创建和销毁时，会自动获取并释放锁。ACE_Guard是一个类模板，适用于任何LOCK类，只要其公共方法的签名与图 10.1 （第 209 页）所示的ACE_LOCK*伪类中的签名相匹配即可。正如后文所述，这包括本章介绍的大多数 ACE 同步包装器外观。

                                                                                                                                                          An instance of ACE_Guard defines a scope of code over which a lock is acquired and then released automatically when the guard object is created and destroyed. ACE_Guard is a class template that works for any LOCK class whose public methods match the signatures contained in the ACE_LOCK* pseudo-class shown in Figure 10.1 on page 209. As illustrated later, this includes most of the ACE synchronization wrapper facades presented in this chapter.

                                                                                                                                                          ACE_Read_Guard和ACE_Write_Guard模板类与ACE_Guard类具有相同的接口。但是，它们的acquire()方法分别通过LOCK模板参数上定义的acquire_read()和acquire_write()方法获取读锁和写锁，如下所示：

                                                                                                                                                          The ACE_Read_Guard and ACE_Write_Guard template classes have the same interface as the ACE_Guard class. However, their acquire() methods acquire read locks and write locks, respectively, via the acquire_read() and acquire_write() methods defined on the LOCK template parameter, as shown below:

                                                                                                                                                          template <class LOCK>
class ACE_Write_Guard : public ACE_Guard<LOCK>
{
public:
  // Automatically acquire the lock for writing.
  ACE_Write_Guard (LOCK &lock): ACE_Guard (&lock)
  { owner_ = lock_.acquire_write (); }

  // ... Same operations as <ACE_Guard>.
};

template <class LOCK>
class ACE_Read_Guard : public ACE_Guard<LOCK>
{
public:
  // Automatically acquire the lock for reading.
  ACE_Read_Guard (LOCK &lock): ACE_Guard (&lock)
  { owner_ = lock_.acquire_read (); }

  // ... Same operations as <ACE Guard>.
};

                                                                                                                                                          第 220 页的Atomic_Op实现说明了ACE_Write_Guard和ACE_Read_Guard类的用法。

                                                                                                                                                          The Atomic_Op implementation on page 220 illustrates the use of the ACE_Write_Guard and ACE_Read_Guard classes.

                                                                                                                                                            10.3 ACE互斥锁类

                                                                                                                                                            10.3 The ACE Mutex Classes

                                                                                                                                                            动机

                                                                                                                                                            Motivation

                                                                                                                                                            大多数操作系统都提供某种形式的互斥锁机制，并发应用程序可以使用该机制来串行化对共享资源的访问。与本书中介绍的大多数其他平台特定功能一样，不同操作系统平台之间的互斥锁在语法和语义上存在细微差别。互斥锁的初始化要求也各不相同。ACE 互斥锁包装器外观旨在以一种便捷的方式解决所有这些问题。

                                                                                                                                                            Most operating systems provide some form of mutex mechanism that concurrent applications can use to serialize access to shared resources. As with most of the other platform-specific capabilities we've seen in this book, there are subtle variations in syntax and semantics between different OS platforms. Mutexes also have different initialization requirements. The ACE mutex wrapper facades were designed to overcome all these problems in a convenient way.

                                                                                                                                                            等级能力

                                                                                                                                                            Class Capabilities

                                                                                                                                                            ACE 使用包装器外观模式来指导对原生操作系统互斥锁同步机制的封装，具体方法是使用ACE_Process_Mutex和ACE_Thread_Mutex类，它们分别在系统级和进程级实现了可移植的非递归互斥锁语义。[1]因此，它们可用于在进程间或单个进程内串行化线程对临界区的访问。ACE_Thread_Mutex 类的接口与第 209 页图 10.1所示的ACE_LOCK*伪类相同。以下C++ 类片段演示了如何使用 Pthreads 实现ACE_Thread_Mutex ：

                                                                                                                                                            ACE uses the Wrapper Facade pattern to guide the encapsulation of native OS mutex synchronization mechanisms with the ACE_Process_Mutex and ACE_Thread_Mutex classes, which implement nonrecursive mutex semantics portably at system scope and process scope, respectively.[1] They can therefore be used to serialize thread access to critical sections across processes or in one process. The interface for the ACE_Thread_Mutex class is identical to the ACE_LOCK* pseudo-class shown in Figure 10.1 on page 209. The following C++ class fragment illustrates how the ACE_Thread_Mutex can be implemented using Pthreads:

                                                                                                                                                            [1]进程作用域递归互斥锁在ACE_Recursive_Thread_Mutex类中实现，如第 229 页第10.6 节所示。

                                                                                                                                                            [1] Process-scoped recursive mutexes are implemented in the ACE_Recursive_Thread_Mutex class, which is shown in Section 10.6 on page 229.

                                                                                                                                                            class ACE Thread_Mutex
{
public:
  ACE_Thread_Mutex (const char * = 0, ACE_mutexattr_t *attrs = 0)
  {pthread_mutex_init (&lock_, attrs);}
  ~ACE_Thread_Mutex () { pthread_mutex_destroy (&lock_); }
  int acquire () { return pthread_mutex_lock (&lock_); }
  int acquire (ACE_Time_Value *timeout) {
    return pthread_mutex_timedlock
      (&lock_, timeout == 0 ? 0 : *timeout);
  }
  int release () { return pthread_mutex_unlock (&lock_); }
  //... Other methods omitted...
private:
  pthread_mutex_t lock_; // Pthreads mutex mechanism.
};

                                                                                                                                                            所有对ACE_Thread_Mutex对象的acquire()方法的调用都会阻塞，直到当前持有该锁的线程离开其临界区。要离开临界区，线程必须对其持有的互斥锁对象调用release()方法，从而使另一个被该互斥锁阻塞的线程能够进入其临界区。

                                                                                                                                                            All calls to the acquire() method of an ACE_Thread_Mutex object will block until the thread that currently owns the lock has left its critical section. To leave a critical section, a thread must invoke the release() method on the mutex object it owns, thereby enabling another thread blocked on the mutex to enter its critical section.

                                                                                                                                                            在 Win32 平台上，ACE_Thread_Mutex类使用CRITICAL_SECTION实现，CRITICAL_SECTION 是一种轻量级的 Win32 锁，用于对单个进程内的线程进行序列化。相比之下，ACE_Process_Mutex实现则在 Win32 上使用基于HANDLE 的互斥锁，它可以在同一台机器上的进程内或进程间工作：

                                                                                                                                                            On the Win32 platform, the ACE_Thread_Mutex class is implemented with a CRITICAL_SECTION, which is a lightweight Win32 lock that serializes threads within a single process. In contrast, the ACE_Process_Mutex implementation uses the HANDLE-based mutex on Win32, which can work within or between processes on the same machine:

                                                                                                                                                            class ACE_Process_Mutex
{
public:
  ACE_Process_Mutex (const char *name, ACE_mutexattr_t *)
  { lock_ = CreateMutex (0, FALSE, name); }
  ~Thread_Mutex () { CloseHandle (lock_); }
  int acquire ()
  { return WaitForSingleObject (lock_, INFINITE); }
  int acquire (ACE_Time_Value *timeout) {
    return WaitForSingleObject
      (lock_, timeout == 0 ? INFINITE : timeout->msec {});
  }
  int release () { return ReleaseMutex (lock_); }
  // ... Other methods omitted ...
private:
  HANDLE lock_; // Win32 serialization mechanism.
};

                                                                                                                                                            ACE_Thread_Mutex类在所有操作系统平台上都使用原生进程作用域互斥锁机制实现。然而，根据操作系统平台的特性，ACE_Process_Mutex可以使用不同的机制来实现，例如：

                                                                                                                                                            The ACE_Thread_Mutex class is implemented using the native process-scoped mutex mechanisms on all OS platforms. Depending on the characteristics of the OS platform, however, the ACE_Process_Mutex can be implemented with different mechanisms, for example:

                                                                                                                                                            • 如上所示，Win32 系统使用原生互斥锁。

                                                                                                                                                            • A native mutex is used on Win32, as shown above.

                                                                                                                                                            • 某些 UNIX 线程实现，例如 Pthreads 和 UI 线程，要求进程间互斥锁必须从共享内存中分配。在这些平台上，ACE 会优先使用 UNIX System V 信号量（如果可用），因为与原生进程间互斥锁相比，它提供了一种更可靠的系统资源回收机制。

                                                                                                                                                            • Some UNIX threading implementations, such as Pthreads and UI threads, require that interprocess mutexes be allocated from shared memory. On these platforms, ACE prefers to use a UNIX System V semaphore if available, since that provides a more reliable mechanism for recovering system resources than the native interprocess mutexes.

                                                                                                                                                            • 有些应用程序需要的信号量超过了 System V IPC 内核参数允许的数量，或者需要执行定时获取操作。在这种情况下，可以将 ACE 配置为在共享内存中使用本地互斥锁，这使得应用程序开发人员需要承担更多责任，以确保正确清理内存。

                                                                                                                                                            • Some applications require more semaphores than the System V IPC kernel parameters allow, or they require the ability to do a timed acquire() operation. In such cases, ACE can be configured to use a native mutex in shared memory, which puts more responsibility on the application developer to ensure proper cleanup.

                                                                                                                                                            无论 ACE 使用哪种底层机制，其类接口都是相同的，这使得应用程序开发人员可以在不更改源代码的情况下尝试不同的配置。

                                                                                                                                                            Regardless of which underlying mechanism ACE uses, the class interface is identical, which allows application developers to experiment with different configurations without changing their source code.

                                                                                                                                                            ACE_Null_Mutex是ACE 支持的另一种互斥锁类型。其部分接口和实现如下所示：

                                                                                                                                                            The ACE_Null_Mutex is another type of mutex supported by ACE. Part of its interface and implementation are shown below:

                                                                                                                                                            class ACE_Null_Mutex
{
public:
  ACE_Null_Mutex (const char * = 0, ACE_mutexattr_t * = 0) {}
  int acquire () { return 0; }
  int release () { return 0; }
  //...
};

                                                                                                                                                            ACE_Null_Mutex类将其所有方法都实现为“空操作”内联函数，这些函数可以被编译器优化器完全移除。该类为其他 ACE C++ 封装器共享的用于线程和同步的伪ACE_LOCK*接口提供了一个零开销的实现。

                                                                                                                                                            The ACE_Null_Mutex class implements all of its methods as "no-op" inline functions, which can be removed completely by a compiler optimizer. This class provides a zero-overhead implementation of the pseudo ACE_LOCK* interface shared by the other ACE C++ wrapper facades for threading and synchronization.

                                                                                                                                                            ACE_Null_Mutex是空对象模式 [ Woo97 ] 的一个例子。它可以与策略性锁定模式 [ SSRB00 ]结合使用，使应用程序能够在不修改代码的情况下参数化所需的同步类型。此功能适用于不需要互斥的情况，例如，当应用程序配置在单线程中运行，并且/或者从不与其他线程争用资源时。

                                                                                                                                                            ACE_Null_Mutex is an example of the Null Object pattern [Woo97]. It can be used in conjunction with the Strategized Locking pattern [SSRB00] so that applications can parameterize the type of synchronization they require without changing application code. This capability is useful for cases where mutual exclusion isn't needed, for example, when an application configuration runs in a single thread and/or never contends with other threads for access to resources.

                                                                                                                                                            例子

                                                                                                                                                            Example

                                                                                                                                                            以下代码说明了如何应用ACE_Thread_Mutex来解决第 6.5 节第135 页所示的 UNIX International 互斥锁解决方案的一些问题。

                                                                                                                                                            The following code illustrates how the ACE_Thread_Mutex can be applied to address some of the problems with the UNIX International mutex solution shown on page 135 in Section 6.5.

                                                                                                                                                            #include "ace/Synch.h"

typedef u_long COUNTER;

static COUNTER request_count; // File scope global variable.

// Mutex protecting request _count (constructor initializes).
static ACE_Thread_Mutex m;

// ...

  virtual int handle_data (ACE_SOCK_Stream *) {
    while (logging_handler_.log_record () != -1) {
      // Try to acquire the lock.
      if (m.acquire () == -1) return 0;
      ++request_count; // Count # of requests
      m.release (); // Release lock.
    }

    m.acquire ();
    int count = request_count;
    m.release ();
    ACE_DEBUG ((LM_DEBUG, "request_count = %d\n", count));
}

                                                                                                                                                            使用ACE_Thread_Mutex C++ 包装类可以稍微简化原始代码，提高可移植性，并在实例化时自动初始化底层互斥对象。

                                                                                                                                                            The use of the ACE_Thread_Mutex C++ wrapper class cleans up the original code somewhat, improves portability, and initializes the underlying mutex object automatically when it's instantiated.

                                                                                                                                                            侧边栏 22： ACE_GUARD宏概述

                                                                                                                                                            Sidebar 22: Overview of the ACE_GUARD Macros

                                                                                                                                                            ACE 定义了一组宏，简化了ACE_Guard 、 ACE_Write_Guard和ACE_Read_Guard类的使用。这些宏用于检测死锁，并在底层锁的操作失败时发出警报。如下所示，它们会先检查锁是否确实已锁定，然后再继续执行操作：

                                                                                                                                                            ACE defines a set of macros that simplify the use of the ACE_Guard, ACE_Write_Guard, and ACE_Read_Guard classes. These macros test for deadlock and detect when operations on the underlying locks fail. As shown below, they check to make sure that the lock Is actually locked before proceeding:

                                                                                                                                                            # define ACE_GUARD (MUTEX, OBJ, LOCK) \
  ACE_Guard< MUTEX > OBJ (LOCK); \
    if (OBJ.locked () == 0) return;
# define ACE_GUARD_RETURN (MUTEX, OBJ, LOCK, RETURN) \
  ACE_Guard< MUTEX > OBJ (LOCK); \
    if (OBJ.locked () == 0) return RETURN;
# define ACE_WRITE_GUARD (MUTEX, OBJ, LOCK) \
  ACE_Write_Guard< MUTEX > OBJ (LOCK); \
    if (OBJ.locked () _= 0) return;
# define ACE_WRITE_GUARD_RETURN (MUTEX, OBJ, LOCK, RETURN) \
  ACE_Write_Guard< MUTEX  > OBJ (LOCK); \
    if (OBJ.locked () == 0) return RETURN;
#  define ACE_READ_GUARD (MUTEX, OBJ, LOCK) \
  ACE_Read_Guard< MUTEX > OBJ (LOCK); \
    if (OBJ.locked () == 0) return;
# define ACE_READ_GUARD_RETURN (MUTEX, OBJ, LOCK, RETURN) \
  ACE_Read_Guard< MUTEX > OBJ (LOCK); \
    if (OBJ.locked () == 0) return RETURN;

                                                                                                                                                            然而， ACE 并发包装器外观并不能解决6.5 节中指出的所有问题。例如，程序员仍然需要手动释放互斥锁，这可能会因为程序员的疏忽或 C++ 异常的发生而导致错误。此外，程序员显式地检查互斥锁是否已被获取既繁琐又容易出错。例如，你会注意到，我们在将request_count赋值给count之前，忽略了检查ACE_Thread_Mutex::acquire()方法是否成功。我们可以通过应用作用域锁定惯用法 [ SSRB00 ]来简化这个示例，具体方法是使用侧边栏 22中描述的ACE_GUARD*宏。

                                                                                                                                                            The ACE concurrency wrapper facades don't solve all the problems identified in Section 6.5, however. For example, programmers must still release the mutex manually, which can yield bugs due to programmer negligence or due to the occurrence of C++ exceptions. Moreover, it is tedious and error prone for programmers to check explicitly whether the mutex was actually acquired. For instance, you'll notice that we neglected to check if the ACE_Thread_Mutex::acquire() method succeeded before assigning request_count to count. We can simplify this example by applying the Scoped Locking idiom [SSRB00] via the ACE_GUARD* macros described in Sidebar 22.

                                                                                                                                                            virtual int handle_data (ACE_SOCK_Stream *) {
  while (logging_handler_.log_record () !_ -1) {
    // Acquire lock in constructor.
    ACE_GUARD_RETURN (ACE_Thread_Mutex, guard, m, -1);
    ++request_count; // Count # of requests
    // Release lock in destructor.
  }

  int count;
  {
    ACE_GUARD_RETURN (ACE_Thread_Mutex, guard, m, -1);
    count = request_count;
  }
  ACE DEBUG ((LM DEBUG, "request_count = %d\n", count));
}

                                                                                                                                                            通过对代码进行少量修改，我们现在确保了ACE_Thread_Mutex的自动获取和释放。我们也确保能够正确处理互斥锁失效的情况。

                                                                                                                                                            By making a slight change to the code, we've now ensured that the ACE_Thread_Mutex is acquired and released automatically. We've also ensured that we'll handle mutex failures properly.

                                                                                                                                                            尽管我们已经解决了第 6.5 节中概述的许多问题，但以下两个问题仍然存在：

                                                                                                                                                            Although we've addressed many issues outlined in Section 6.5, the following two problems still remain:

                                                                                                                                                            • 该解决方案仍然比较繁琐，也就是说，我们必须手动将ACE_GUARD宏插入到用花括号括起来的新语句作用域中。第 10.4 节展示了如何消除这种繁琐性。

                                                                                                                                                            • The solution is still obtrusive, that is, we must insert the ACE_GUARD macros manually within a new statement scope delimited by curly braces. Section 10.4 shows how to eliminate this obtrusiveness.

                                                                                                                                                            • 该解决方案也容易出错，也就是说，静态全局对象` ACE_Thread_Mutex`必须在调用`handle_data()`方法之前正确初始化。令人惊讶的是，要确保这一点非常困难，因为 C++ 并不保证不同文件中全局对象和静态对象的初始化顺序。侧边栏 23介绍了 ACE 如何通过其`ACE_Object_Manager`类来解决这个问题。

                                                                                                                                                            • The solution is also error prone, that is, the static ACE_Thread_Mutex global object m must be initialized properly before the handle_data() method is called. It's surprisingly hard to ensure this since C++ doesn't guarantee the order of initialization of global and static objects in different files. Sidebar 23 describes how ACE addresses this problem via its ACE_Object_Manager class.

                                                                                                                                                            ACE_Object_Manager类提供了一个全局递归互斥锁，我们可以在日志服务器示例中使用它：

                                                                                                                                                            The ACE_Object_Manager class provides a global recursive mutex that we could use in our logging server example:

                                                                                                                                                            //...
while (logging_handler_.log_record () != -1) {
  // Acquire lock in constructor.
  ACE_GUARD_RETURN (ACE_Recursive_Thread_Mutex, guard,
                    ACE_Static_Object_Lock::instance (),
                    -1);
  ++request_count;   // Count # of requests
  // Release lock in destructor.
}
// ...

                                                                                                                                                            侧边栏 23：ACE_Object_Manager 类

                                                                                                                                                            Sidebar 23: The ACE_Object_Manager Class

                                                                                                                                                            为了确保全局对象和静态对象的初始化顺序一致，ACE 提供了ACE_Object_Manager类，该类实现了对象生命周期管理器模式 [ LGS00 ]。此模式管理对象的整个生命周期，从首次使用前创建对象到确保在程序终止时正确销毁对象。ACE_Object_Manager类提供以下功能，有助于将静态对象的创建/销毁替换为自动动态对象的预分配/释放：

                                                                                                                                                            To ensure consistent initialization order of global and static objects, ACE provides the ACE_Object_Manager class, which implements the Object Lifetime Manager pattern [LGS00]. This pattern governs the entire lifetime of objects, from creating them prior to their first use to ensuring they are destroyed properly at program termination. The ACE_Object_Manager class provides the following capabilities that help replace static object creation/destruction with automatic dynamic object preallocation/deallocation:

                                                                                                                                                            • 它负责在程序终止时清理对象（通常是单例对象）。除了管理 ACE 库的清理工作外，它还提供了一个接口，供应用程序注册要清理的对象。

                                                                                                                                                            • It manages object cleanup (typically singletons) at program termination. In addition to managing the cleanup of the ACE library, it provides an interface for applications to register objects to be cleaned up.

                                                                                                                                                            • 程序终止时，它会关闭 ACE 库服务，以便回收其存储空间。其工作原理是创建一个静态实例，该实例的析构函数会与其他所有静态对象的析构函数一起被调用。程序还提供了钩子，供应用程序代码注册对象和数组，以便在程序终止时进行清理。这些清理调用的顺序与注册顺序相反（后进先出，LIFO）；也就是说，最后注册的对象/数组会最先被清理。

                                                                                                                                                            • It shuts down ACE library services at program termination so that they can reclaim their storage. This works by creating a static instance whose destructor gets called along with those of all other static objects. Hooks are provided for application code to register objects and arrays for cleanup when the program terminates. The order of these cleanup calls is in the reverse (LIFO) order of their registration; that is, the last object/array to register gets cleaned up first.

                                                                                                                                                            • 它会预先初始化某些对象，例如ACE_Static_Object_Lock ，以便在main()函数运行之前创建它们。

                                                                                                                                                            • It preinitializes certain objects, such as ACE_Static_Object_Lock, so that they will be created before the main() function runs.

                                                                                                                                                            由于ACE_Static_Object_Lock实例由ACE_Object_Manager控制，因此可以保证在程序启动时对其进行初始化，并在程序退出时对其进行正确销毁。

                                                                                                                                                            Since the ACE_Static_Object_Lock instance is controlled by the ACE_Object_Manager it's guaranteed to be initialized when a program starts and will be destroyed properly when the program exits.

                                                                                                                                                              10.4 ACE读者/作家锁定类别

                                                                                                                                                              10.4 The ACE Readers/Writer Lock Classes

                                                                                                                                                              动机

                                                                                                                                                              Motivation

                                                                                                                                                              读写锁允许对资源进行高效的并发访问，这些资源的访问频率远高于其更改频率。许多操作系统在其文件锁定 API 中支持读写语义。然而，将文件系统参与同步活动效率低下，并且在某些不可预测的情况下（例如使用网络挂载存储作为锁定文件时）可能会阻塞。此外，文件锁定机制仅在系统级别起作用，而非进程级别。

                                                                                                                                                              Readers/writer locks allow efficient concurrent access to resources whose contents are searched much more often than they are changed. Many operating systems support readers/writer semantics in their file-locking APIs. Involving the file system in synchronization activities is unnecessarily inefficient, however, and can block under unpredictable situations, such as when using network-mounted storage for the lock file. Moreover, file-locking mechanisms work only at the system-scope level, rather than at process scope.

                                                                                                                                                              令人惊讶的是，只有极少数操作系统在进程级范围内提供读写锁实现。例如，Pthreads（不带 UNIX98 扩展）、Win32 线程以及许多实时操作系统都不原生支持读写锁。UI 线程通过rwlock_t类型支持读写锁。在每个应用程序中处理这些可移植性差异既繁琐又容易出错，因此 ACE 提供了读写锁包装器外观。

                                                                                                                                                              Surprisingly few operating systems provide readers/writer lock implementations at the process-scope level.
