For example, Pthreads (without UNIX98 extensions), Win32 threads, and many real-time operating systems don't support them natively. UI threads support readers/writer locks via the rwlock_t type. Addressing these portability variations in each application is tedious and error prone, which is why ACE provides the readers/writer lock wrapper facades.

                                                                                                                                                              等级能力

                                                                                                                                                              Class Capabilities

                                                                                                                                                              ACE 使用ACE_RW_Thread_Mutex和ACE_RW_Process_Mutex类封装了原生操作系统读写锁机制。这些类应用了包装器外观模式，以可移植的方式实现了进程级和系统级读写锁的语义。这些类的接口与第 209 页图 10.1所示的ACE_LOCK*伪类的签名完全相同。

                                                                                                                                                              ACE encapsulates the native OS readers/writer lock mechanisms with the ACE_RW_Thread_Mutex and ACE_RW_Process_Mutex classes. These classes apply the Wrapper Facade pattern to implement the semantics of process- and system-scoped readers/writer locks portably. The interface for these classes is identical to the signatures of ACE_LOCK* pseudo-class shown in shown in Figure 10.1 on page 209.

                                                                                                                                                              如果平台支持进程作用域的读写锁，ACE_RW_Thread_Mutex类会简单地封装原生同步变量。然而，在不支持原生读写锁的操作系统平台上，ACE 会使用现有的底层同步机制（例如互斥锁、条件变量或信号量）来实现读写锁。ACE 的读写锁实现会优先获取写锁。因此，如果有多个读者和一个写者在等待锁，则写者会优先获得锁。

                                                                                                                                                              If a platform supports process-scoped readers/writer locks, the ACE_RW_Thread_Mutex class simply encapsulates the native synchronization variable. On OS platforms that lack native readers/writer locks, however, ACE provides readers/writer implementations using existing low-level synchronization mechanisms, such as mutexes, condition variables, or semaphores. The ACE readers/writer implementation gives preference to writers. Thus, if there are multiple readers and a single writer waiting on the lock, the writer will acquire it first.

                                                                                                                                                              例子

                                                                                                                                                              Example

                                                                                                                                                              尽管第 216 页示例中基于ACE_Guard的handle_data()实现解决了几个问题，但它仍然需要对代码进行侵入式修改，即在循环内部添加ACE_GUARD_RETURN 。一种更不容易出错且侵入式的解决方案利用了……

                                                                                                                                                              Although the ACE_Guard-based implementation of handle_data() in the example on page 216 solved several problems, it still required obtrusive code changes, that is, adding the ACE_GUARD_RETURN inside the loop. A less error prone and obtrusive solution leverages

                                                                                                                                                              • C++运算符重载

                                                                                                                                                              • C++ operator overloading

                                                                                                                                                              • ACE_RW_Thread_Mutex

                                                                                                                                                              • ACE_RW_Thread_Mutex

                                                                                                                                                              • 通过使用ACE_WRITE_GUARD和ACE_READ_GUARD宏，可以实现作用域锁定。

                                                                                                                                                              • The Scoped Locking idiom, through use of the ACE_WRITE_GUARD and ACE_READ_GUARD macros

                                                                                                                                                              我们利用以下这些功能创建了一个支持线程安全算术运算的Atomic_Op类：

                                                                                                                                                              We use these capabilities below to create an Atomic_Op class that supports thread-safe arithmetic operations:

                                                                                                                                                              class Atomic_op
{
public:
  // Initialize <count_> to <count>.
  Atomic_op (long count = 0)
    : count_ (count) {}

  // Atomically pre-increment <count_>.
  long operator++ () {
    // Use the <acquire_write> method to acquire a write lock.
    ACE_WRITE_GUARD_RETURN (ACE_RW_Thread_Mutex, guard, lock_,
                            -1);
    return ++count_;
  }

  // Atomically return <count_>.
  operator long () {
    // Use the <acquire_read> method to acquire a read lock.
    ACE_READ_GUARD_RETURN (ACE_RW_Thread_Mutex, guard, lock_,
                           0);
    return count_;
  }

  // ... Other arithmetic operators omitted.

private:
  // Readers/writer lock.
  ACE_RW_Thread_Mutex lock_;

  // Value of the <Atomic_Op> count.
  long count_;
};

                                                                                                                                                              Atomic_Op类重载了long数据类型的标准算术运算符，即 ++、--、+= 等。由于这些方法会修改count_，因此需要获取写锁才能实现独占访问。相比之下，对于long() 运算符，只需获取读锁即可，因为它允许多个线程并发读取count_。

                                                                                                                                                              The Atomic_Op class overloads the standard arithmetic operators, that is, ++, --, +=, etc., on long data types. Since these methods modify the count_ they achieve exclusive access by acquiring a write lock. In contrast, a read lock will suffice for the operator long() since it allows multiple threads to read the count_ concurrently.

                                                                                                                                                              通过应用Atomic_Op类，我们现在可以编写以下代码，该代码几乎与原始的非线程安全代码完全相同。只有COUNTER的类型定义发生了变化：

                                                                                                                                                              By applying the Atomic_Op class, we can now write the following code, which is almost identical to the original nonthread-safe code. Only the typedef of COUNTER has changed:

                                                                                                                                                              typedef Atomic_Op COUNTER;

static COUNTER request_count; // File scope global variable.

  virtual int handle_data (ACE_SOCK_Stream *) {
    while (logging_handler_.log_record () != -1)
    // Keep track of number of requests.
    ++request_count; // Actually calls <Atomic_Op::operator++>.

    ACE_DEBUG ((LM_DEBUG, "request_count = %d\n",
               // Actually calls <Atomic_Op::operator long>.
               (long) request_count));
  }

                                                                                                                                                              对operator++()和operator long()的调用分别使用了ACE_RW_Thread_Mutex上的acquire_write()和acquire_read()方法。因此，现在在多处理器上，对已实例化的Atomic_Op类的对象进行算术运算，无需对现有应用程序代码进行太多更改，即可正确地递增/递减计数器！

                                                                                                                                                              The calls to both operator++() and operator long() use the acquire_write() and acquire_read() methods on the ACE_RW_Thread_Mutex, respectively. Thus, arithmetic operations on objects of instantiated Atomic_Op classes now increment/decrement counters correctly on a multiprocessor, without changing much existing application code!

                                                                                                                                                              上面所示的Atomic_Op类实际上是ACE_Atomic_Op类模板的简化版本，其部分定义如下：

                                                                                                                                                              The Atomic_Op class shown above is actually a simplification of the ACE_Atomic_Op class template, a portion of which is defined below:

                                                                                                                                                              template <class TYPE, class LOCK>
class ACE_Atomic_Op {
public:
  //... Constructors and arithmetic operators omitted.
private:
  LOCK lock_;
  TYPE type_;
};

                                                                                                                                                              ACE_Atomic_Op通过结合以下方式生成一个简单但表达力极强的参数化类抽象：

                                                                                                                                                              The ACE_Atomic_Op produces a simple, yet remarkably expressive parameterized class abstraction by combining

                                                                                                                                                              • 范围锁定惯用法和策略锁定模式

                                                                                                                                                              • The Scoped Locking idiom and Strategized Locking pattern with

                                                                                                                                                              • C++模板和运算符重载的使用。

                                                                                                                                                              • The use of C++ templates and operator overloading.

                                                                                                                                                              此模板类能够正确且原子地处理需要原子操作的类型族。例如，为了向其他算术类型提供相同的线程安全功能，我们可以简单地按如下方式实例化ACE_Atomic_Op模板类的新对象：

                                                                                                                                                              This template class operates correctly and atomically on the family of types requiring atomic operations. To provide the same thread-safe functionality for other arithmetic types, for example, we can simply instantiate new objects of the ACE_Atomic_Op template class as follows:

                                                                                                                                                              ACE_Atomic_Op<double, ACE_Null_Mutex> double_counter;
ACE_Atomic_Op<Complex, ACE_RW_Thread_Mutex> complex_counter;

                                                                                                                                                                10.5 ACE信号灯类

                                                                                                                                                                10.5 The ACE Semaphore Classes

                                                                                                                                                                动机

                                                                                                                                                                Motivation

                                                                                                                                                                信号量是一种强大的机制，用于在并发应用程序中锁定和/或同步对共享资源的访问。信号量包含一个计数，用于指示共享资源的状态。应用程序设计者需要定义信号量计数的含义及其初始值。因此，信号量可用于协调对资源池的访问。

                                                                                                                                                                Semaphores are a powerful mechanism used to lock and/or synchronize access to shared resources in concurrent applications. A semaphore contains a count that indicates the status of a shared resource. Application designers assign the meaning of the semaphore's count, as well as its initial value. Semaphores can therefore be used to mediate access to a pool of resources.

                                                                                                                                                                由于释放信号量会使其计数递增，而与等待者是否存在无关，因此它们对于跟踪改变共享程序状态的事件非常有用。线程可以基于这些事件做出决策，即使这些事件已经发生。虽然大多数操作系统都提供了某种形式的信号量机制，但 ACE 信号量包装器外观解决了由于各种环境下语法和语义的细微差异而导致的问题。

                                                                                                                                                                Since releasing a semaphore increments its count regardless of the presence of waiters, they are useful for keeping track of events that change shared program state. Threads can make decisions based on these events, even if they've already occurred. Although some form of semaphore mechanism is available on most operating systems, the ACE semaphore wrapper facades resolve issues arising from subtle variations in syntax and semantics across a broad range of environments.

                                                                                                                                                                等级能力

                                                                                                                                                                Class Capabilities

                                                                                                                                                                ACE_Thread_Semaphore和ACE_Process_Semaphore类分别按照包装器外观模式，可移植地封装进程作用域和系统作用域的信号量。这些类的接口与第 209 页图 10.1 所示的 ACE_LOCK* 伪类基本相同。但是，构造函数略有不同，因为信号量的初始化比互斥锁和读写锁更具表达力，允许设置信号量的初始计数。ACE_Thread_Semaphore API 的相关部分如下所示：

                                                                                                                                                                The ACE_Thread_Semaphore and ACE_Process_Semaphore classes portably encapsulate process-scoped and system-scoped semaphores, respectively, in accordance with the Wrapper Facade pattern. These class interfaces are largely the same as the ACE_LOCK* pseudo-class shown in Figure 10.1 on page 209. The constructor is slightly different, however, since semaphore initialization is more expressive than mutexes and readers/writer locks, allowing the semaphore's initial count to be set. The relevant portion of the ACE_Thread_Semaphore API is shown below:

                                                                                                                                                                class ACE_Thread_Semaphore
{
public:
  // Initialize the semaphore, with an initial value of <count>,
  // a maximum value of <max>, and unlocked by default.
  ACE_Thread_Semaphore (u_int count = 1,
                        const char *name = 0,
                        void *arg = 0,
                        int max = 0x7FFFFFFF);
  // ... same as pseudo <ACE_LOCK> signatures.
};

                                                                                                                                                                ACE_Process_Semaphore具有相同的接口，但它是在系统范围内而不是进程范围内同步线程。

                                                                                                                                                                The ACE_Process_Semaphore has the same interface, though it synchronizes threads at the system scope rather than at the process scope.

                                                                                                                                                                这两个 ACE 类尽可能地封装了操作系统原生的信号量机制，如果操作系统平台本身不支持信号量，则会对其进行模拟。这使得应用程序能够使用信号量，并且无论新平台是否原生支持信号量，都能移植到新平台上。第 251 页的A.5.2 节展示了在不支持ACE_Thread_Semaphore 的平台上对其进行模拟的方法。

                                                                                                                                                                These two ACE classes encapsulate OS-native semaphore mechanisms whenever possible, emulating them if the OS platform doesn't support semaphores natively. This allows applications to use semaphores and still be ported to new platforms regardless of the native semaphore support, or lack thereof. Section A.5.2 on page 251 shows an emulation of ACE_Thread_Semaphore on platforms that don't support it natively.

                                                                                                                                                                ACE_Null_Semaphore类将其所有方法都实现为“空操作”内联函数。下面我们实现它的两个acquire()方法：

                                                                                                                                                                The ACE_Null_Semaphore class implements all of its methods as "no-op" inline functions. We implement two of its acquire() methods below:

                                                                                                                                                                class ACE_Null_Semaphore
{
public:
  int acquire () { return 0; }
  int acquire (ACE_Time_Value *) { errno = ETIME; return -1; }
  // ...
};

                                                                                                                                                                请注意，定时版本的acquire()函数会返回 -1 并将errno设置为 ETIME，以确保ACE_Null_Semaphore可以与策略锁定模式 [ SSRB00 ]正确互换使用。对于非空 ACE 信号量，阻塞版本的acquire()函数通常用于串行化对临界区的访问，而定时版本通常用于等待另一个线程更新某些条件或更改某些共享状态。然而，在使用ACE_Null_Semaphore时，没有其他线程参与更改状态或条件。否则，使用空信号量是不合适的。返回错误值表示状态或条件尚未（且无法）更改，这与线程情况下的行为一致，即在状态或条件更改之前发生超时。

                                                                                                                                                                Note that the timed version of acquire() returns –1 and sets errno to ETIME to ensure that ACE_Null_Semaphore can be interchanged properly in conjunction with the Strategized Locking pattern [SSRB00]. For the non-null ACE semaphores, the blocking version of acquire() is often used to serialize access to a critical section, whereas the timed version is often used to wait for another thread to update some condition or change some shared state. When using an ACE_Null_Semaphore, however, there's no other thread involved to change a state or condition. Otherwise, a null semaphore would be inappropriate. Returning an error value signifies that the state or condition has not been (and can't be) changed, which is consistent with the behavior of the threaded case in which a timeout occurs before the state or condition is changed.

                                                                                                                                                                例子

                                                                                                                                                                Example

                                                                                                                                                                尽管信号量可以协调多个线程的处理，但它们本身并不在线程间传递任何数据。然而，在线程间传递数据是一种常见的并发编程技术，因此某种轻量级的进程内消息队列机制会非常有用。为此，我们展示了一个Message_Queue类的实现，它提供了以下功能：

                                                                                                                                                                Although semaphores can coordinate the processing of multiple threads, they don't themselves pass any data between threads. Passing data between threads is a common concurrent programming technique, however, so some type of lightweight intraprocess message queueing mechanism can be quite useful. We therefore show a Message_Queue class implementation that provides the following capabilities:

                                                                                                                                                                • 它允许将消息（ACE_Message_Block对象）入队到队列末尾，并从队列开头出队。

                                                                                                                                                                • It allows messages (ACE_Message_Block objects) to be enqueued at the rear of the queue and dequeued from the front of the queue.

                                                                                                                                                                • 它支持可调流量控制，防止快速消息生产线程占用较慢消息消费者线程的资源。

                                                                                                                                                                • It supports tunable flow control that prevents fast message producer threads from swamping the resources of slower message consumer threads.

                                                                                                                                                                • 它允许对入队和出队操作指定超时时间，以避免必要时出现无限阻塞。

                                                                                                                                                                • It allows timeouts to be specified on both enqueue and dequeue operations to avoid unlimited blocking when necessary.

                                                                                                                                                                下面展示了Message_Queue类实现的关键部分，并演示了ACE_Thread_Semaphore的用法。为了简化代码的设计和演进，我们还应用了 POSA2 [ SSRB00 ]中的以下模式和惯用法：

                                                                                                                                                                We show the key parts of the Message_Queue class implementation below and showcase the use of ACE_Thread_Semaphore. To simplify the design and evolution of this code, we also apply the following patterns and idioms from POSA2 [SSRB00]:

                                                                                                                                                                • 监视对象——Message_Queue 的公共方法按照监视对象设计模式 [ SSRB00 ] 的行为作为同步方法，确保对象中一次只有一个方法运行，并允许对象的方法协作地安排其执行顺序。

                                                                                                                                                                • Monitor Object— The public methods of Message_Queue behave as synchronized methods in accordance with the Monitor Object design pattern [SSRB00], which ensures that only one method at a time runs within an object and allows an object's methods to schedule their execution sequences cooperatively.

                                                                                                                                                                • 线程安全接口——根据线程安全接口模式， Message_Queue的公共方法会获取锁，并将实际的排队行为委托给私有实现方法。这种设计模式最大限度地减少了锁定开销，并确保对象内部的方法调用不会因为试图重新获取对象已持有的锁而导致“自我死锁”。

                                                                                                                                                                • Thread-Safe Interface— The Message_Queue public methods acquire locks and delegate the actual queueing behavior to the private implementation methods in accordance with the Thread-Safe Interface pattern. This design pattern minimizes locking overhead and ensures that intraobject method calls don't "self-deadlock" by trying to reacquire a lock that an object already holds.

                                                                                                                                                                • 作用域锁定 —ACE_GUARD *宏确保任何签名符合ACE_LOCK*伪类的同步包装器外观都按照作用域锁定惯用法自动获取和释放 [ SSRB00 ]。

                                                                                                                                                                • Scoped Locking— The ACE_GUARD* macros ensure that any synchronization wrapper facade whose signature conforms to the ACE_LOCK* pseudo-class is acquired and released automatically in accordance with the Scoped Locking idiom [SSRB00].

                                                                                                                                                                POSA2 书中的大多数模式都可以使用 ACE 并发和同步类来实现。

                                                                                                                                                                Most of the patterns from the POSA2 book can be implemented using ACE concurrency and synchronization classes.

                                                                                                                                                                我们首先定义Message_Queue类：

                                                                                                                                                                We start with the definition of the Message_Queue class:

                                                                                                                                                                class Message_Queue
{
public:
  // Default high and low water marks.
  enum {
    DEFAULT_LWM = 0,        // 0 is the low water mark.
    DEFAULT_HWM = 16 * 1024 // 16 K is the high water mark.
  };
  // Initialize.
  Message_Queue (size_t = DEFAULT_HWM, size_t = DEFAULT_LWM);

  // Destroy.
  ~Message_Queue ();

  // Checks if queue is full/empty.
  int is_full () const;
  int is_empty () const;

  // Interface for enqueueing and dequeueing ACE_Message_Blocks.
  int enqueue_tail (ACE_Message_Block *, ACE_Time_Value * = 0);
  int dequeue_head (ACE_Message_Block *&, ACE_Time_Value * = 0);

private:
  // Implementations that enqueue/dequeue ACE_Message_Blocks.
  int enqueue_tail_i (ACE_Message_Block *, ACE_Time_Value * = 0);
  int dequeue_head_i (ACE_Message_Block *&, ACE_Time_Value * = 0);

  // Implement the checks for boundary conditions.
  int is_empty_i () const;
  int is_full_i () const;

  // Lowest number before unblocking occurs.
  int low_water_mark_;
  // Greatest number of bytes before blocking.
  int high_water_mark_;
  // Current number of bytes in the queue.
  int cur_bytes_;
  // Current number of messages in the queue.
  int cur_count_;
  // Number  of threads waiting to dequeue a message.
  size_t dequeue_waiters_;
  // Number of threads waiting to enqueue a message.
  size_t enqueue_waiters_;

  // C++ wrapper facades to coordinate concurrent access.
  mutable ACE_Thread_Mutex lock_;
  ACE_Thread_Semaphore notempty_;
  ACE_Thread_Semaphore notfull_;

  // Remaining details of queue implementation omitted....
};

                                                                                                                                                                下面显示的 Message_Queue构造函数创建一个空的消息列表，并将ACE_Thread_Semaphores初始化为初始计数为 O（互斥锁lock_由其默认构造函数自动初始化）。

                                                                                                                                                                The Message_Queue constructor shown below creates an empty message list and initializes the ACE_Thread_Semaphores to start with a count of O (the mutex lock_ is initialized automatically by its default constructor).

                                                                                                                                                                Message_Queue::Message_Queue (size_t hwm, size_t lwm)
  : low_water_mark_ (lwm),
  high_water_mark (hwm),
  cur_bytes_(0),
  cur_count_ (0),
  dequeue_waiters_ (0),
  enqueue_waiters_ (0),
  notempty_ (0),
  notfull_ (0)
{ /* Remaining constructor implementation omitted ... */ }

                                                                                                                                                                以下方法检查队列是否为“空”（即不包含任何消息）或“满”（即包含的消息数量超过high_water_mark_字节）。这些方法与下面的其他方法一样，均按照线程安全接口模式 [ SSRB00 ] 设计。

                                                                                                                                                                The following methods check if a queue is "empty," that is, contains no messages, or "full," that is, contains more than high_water_mark_ bytes in it. These methods, like the others below, are designed in accordance with the Thread-Safe Interface pattern [SSRB00].

                                                                                                                                                                我们首先来看is_empty()和is_full()接口方法：

                                                                                                                                                                We start with the is_empty() and is_full() interface methods:

                                                                                                                                                                int Message_Queue::is_empty () const {
  ACE_GUARD_RETURN (ACE_Thread_Mutex, guard, lock_, -1);
  return is_empty_i ();
}

int Message_Queue::is_full () const {
  ACE_GUARD_RETURN (ACE_Thread_Mutex, guard, lock_, -1);
  return is_full_i ();
}

                                                                                                                                                                这些方法获取lock_，然后将调用转发给以下实现方法之一：

                                                                                                                                                                These methods acquire the lock_ and then forward the call to one of the following implementation methods:

                                                                                                                                                                int Message_Queue::is_empty_i () const {
  return cur_bytes_ <= 0 && cur count_ <= 0;
}

int Message_Queue::is_full_i () const {
  return cur _bytes_ >= high_water_mark_;
}

                                                                                                                                                                这些方法假定lock_已被持有，并实际执行工作。

                                                                                                                                                                These methods assume the lock_ is held and actually perform the work.

                                                                                                                                                                ` enqueue_tail()`方法会在队列末尾插入一个新项，并返回队列中消息的数量。与 ` dequeue_head()`方法类似，如果`timeout`参数为 0，则调用者会阻塞，直到可以执行操作为止。否则，调用者只会阻塞`timeout`指定的时间。阻塞的调用可以在收到信号或`timeout`指定的时间到期时返回，此时`errno`会被设置为 `EWOULDBLOCK`。

                                                                                                                                                                The enqueue_tail() method inserts a new item at the end of the queue and returns a count of the number of messages in the queue. As with the dequeue_head() method, if the timeout parameter is 0, the caller will block until action is possible. Otherwise, the caller will block only up to the amount of time in *timeout. A blocked call can return when a signal occurs or if the time specified in timeout elapses, in which case errno is set to EWOULDBLOCK.

                                                                                                                                                                int Message_Queue::enqueue_tail (ACE_Message_Block *new_mblk,
                                 ACE_Time_Value *timeout)
{
  ACE_GUARD_RETURN (ACE_Thread_Mutex, guard, lock_, -1);
  int result = 0;

  // Wait until the queue is no longer full.
  while (is_full_i () && result != -1) {
    ++enqueue_waiters_;
    guard.release ();
    result = notfull_.acquire (timeout);
    guard.acquire ();
  }

  if (result == -1) {
    if (enqueue_waiters_ > 0)
      --enqueue_waiters_;
    if (errno == ETIME)
      errno = EWOULDBLOCK;
    return -1;
  }

  // Enqueue the message at the tail of the queue.
  int queued_messages = enqueue_tail_i (new_mblk);

  // Tell any blocked threads that the queue has a new item!
  if (dequeue_waiters_ > 0) {
    --dequeue_waiters_;
    notempty_.release ();
  }
  return queued_messages; // guard's destructor releases lock_.
}

                                                                                                                                                                当至少有一个线程等待出队消息时，`enqueue_tail()` 方法会释放 `notempty_` 信号量。实际的入队逻辑位于 `enqueue_tail_i()` 中，由于它是底层实现细节，因此此处省略。请注意，在调用`not_full_acquire()`和重新获取保护锁之间的时间窗口内可能存在竞争条件。另一个线程有可能在这段短暂的时间窗口内调用`dequeue_head()`，从而递减`enqueue_waiters_` 的值。因此，在重新获取锁之后，会检查计数以防止`enqueue_waiters_` 的值低于 0。

                                                                                                                                                                The enqueue_tail() method releases the notempty_ semaphore when there's at least one thread waiting to dequeue a message. The actual enqueueing logic resides in enqueue_tail_i(), which we omit here since it's a low-level implementation detail. Note the potential race condition in the time window between the call to not_full_acquire() and reacquiring the guard lock. It's possible for another thread to call dequeue_head (), decrementing enqueue_waiters_ in that small window of time. After the lock is reacquired, therefore, the count is checked to guard against decrementing enqueue_waiters_ below 0.

                                                                                                                                                                dequeue_head ()方法从队列中移除队首元素，将其返回给调用者，并返回队列中剩余元素的数量，如下所示：

                                                                                                                                                                The dequeue_head() method removes the front item from the queue, passes it back to the caller, and returns a count of the number of items still in the queue, as follows:

                                                                                                                                                                int Message_Queue::dequeue_head (ACE_Message_Block *&first_item,
                                 ACE_Time_Value *timeout)
{
  ACE_GUARD_RETURN (ACE_Thread_Mutex, guard, lock_, -1);
  int result = 0;

  // Wait until the queue is no longer empty.
  while (is_empty_i () && result != -1) {
    ++dequeue_waiters_;
    guard.release ();
    result = notempty_.acquire (timeout);
    guard.acquire ();
  }

  if (result == -1) {
    if (dequeue_waiters_ > 0)
      --dequeue_waiters
    if (errno == ETIME)
      errno = EWOULDBLOCK;
    return -1;
  }

  // Remove the first message from the queue.
  int queued_messages = dequeue_head_i (first_item);

  // Only signal if we've fallen below the low water mark.
  if (cur_bytes_ <= low_water_mark_ && enqueue_waiters_ > 0) {
    enqueue_waiters_--;
    notfull_.release ();
  }
  return queued messages; // <guard> destructor releases <lock_>
}

                                                                                                                                                                上面所示的Message_Queue类实现了ACE_Message_Queue和ACE_Message_Queue_Ex的部分功能，这些功能在 [ SH ]中有所介绍。这些 ACE 消息队列类与上面所示的Message_Queue实现的不同之处如下：

                                                                                                                                                                The Message_Queue class shown above implements a subset of the features in the ACE_Message_Queue and ACE_Message_Queue_Ex, which are presented in [SH]. These ACE message queue classes differ from the Message_Queue implementation shown above in the following ways:

                                                                                                                                                                • 除了先进先出 (FIFO) 排队之外，它们还允许将消息插入队列的前端（即后进先出 (LIFO) 顺序）或按优先级顺序插入。

                                                                                                                                                                • In addition to FIFO queueing, they also allow messages to be inserted at the front of the queue (i.e., LIFO order) or in priority order.

                                                                                                                                                                • 他们使用 C++ 特性和策略锁定模式来参数化其同步机制，这使得程序员可以在单线程队列配置中牺牲严格的线程安全同步来换取更高的效率。

                                                                                                                                                                • They use C++ traits and the Strategized Locking pattern to parameterize their synchronization mechanisms, which allows programmers to trade off strict thread-safe synchronization for greater efficiency in single-threaded queue configurations.

                                                                                                                                                                • 它们提供分配器，使消息内存能够从各种来源获取，例如共享内存、堆内存、静态内存或线程特定内存。

                                                                                                                                                                • They provide allocators that enable the memory for messages to be obtained from various sources, such as shared memory, heap memory, static memory, or thread-specific memory.

                                                                                                                                                                • 它们可以配置为通过ACE_Thread_Semaphore或ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex来调度线程执行顺序，分别以更高的效率换取更多的功能。

                                                                                                                                                                • They can be configured to schedule thread execution order via either ACE_Thread_Semaphore or ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex to trade off higher efficiency for more features, respectively.

                                                                                                                                                                • ACE_Message_Queue_Ex是ACE_Message_Queue的强类型版本，它对MESSAGE_TYPE模板参数的实例进行入队和出队操作，而不是对ACE_Message_Block进行入队和出队操作。

                                                                                                                                                                • ACE_Message_Queue_Ex is a strongly-typed version of ACE_Message_Queue that enqueues and dequeues instances of a MESSAGE_TYPE template parameter, rather than an ACE_Message_Block.

                                                                                                                                                                  10.6 ACE 条件变量类

                                                                                                                                                                  10.6 The ACE Condition Variable Classes

                                                                                                                                                                  动机

                                                                                                                                                                  Motivation

                                                                                                                                                                  条件变量允许线程协调并高效地调度其处理。尽管 Pthreads 标准强制要求使用条件变量，但一些广泛使用的操作系统平台（例如 Win32 和 VxWorks）并未原生支持条件变量。虽然可以使用其他原生同步机制（例如信号量和互斥锁）来模拟条件变量，但对于应用程序开发人员来说，编写这些模拟代码既浪费资源又容易出错。ACE 提供了ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex条件变量包装器外观来缓解这个问题。

                                                                                                                                                                  Condition variables allow threads to coordinate and schedule their processing efficiently. Although condition variables are mandated in the Pthreads standard, some widely used OS platforms, such as Win32 and VxWorks, do not implement condition variables natively. Although condition variables can be emulated using other native synchronization mechanisms, such as semaphores and mutexes, it's unnecessarily wasteful and error-prone for application developers to write these emulations. ACE provides the ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex condition variable wrapper facade to alleviate this problem.

                                                                                                                                                                  等级能力

                                                                                                                                                                  Class Capabilities

                                                                                                                                                                  ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex使用包装器外观模式来封装进程作用域的条件变量语义。ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex 类的接口如图10.3所示，下表概述了其关键方法：

                                                                                                                                                                  The ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex uses the Wrapper Facade pattern to guide its encapsulation of process-scoped condition variable semantics. The interface of the ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex class is shown in Figure 10.3 and the following table outlines its key methods:

                                                                                                                                                                  方法 描述
                                                                                                                                                                  等待（） 原子地释放与条件变量关联的互斥锁，并休眠等待超时或通过signal()或broadcast()方法从另一个线程收到后续通知。
                                                                                                                                                                  信号（） 通知正在等待条件变量的线程。
                                                                                                                                                                  播送（） 通知所有等待条件变量的线程。

                                                                                                                                                                  图 10.3. ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex类图

                                                                                                                                                                  如果`ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex::wait()`的`time`参数不为 0，则该方法会阻塞到指定的绝对时间点（由 ` ACE_Time_Value`指定）。如果在通知条件变量之前超时，该方法会向调用者返回 -1 和 `ETIME errno`，表示超时已发生。无论`wait()`返回什么值，与条件变量关联的互斥锁始终处于锁定状态。

                                                                                                                                                                  If the time parameter to ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex::wait() is non-0 the method will block up to that absolute point of time, which is specified as an ACE_Time_Value. If the time elapses before the condition variable is notified, the method returns -1 to the caller with an ETIME errno, signifying that a timeout has occurred. Regardless of how wait() returns, the mutex associated with the condition variable will always be locked.

                                                                                                                                                                  当需要复杂的条件表达式或调度行为时，条件变量比互斥锁或信号量更合适。例如，条件变量常用于实现同步消息队列，以提供“生产者/消费者”通信机制，从而在线程间传递消息。当消息队列已满时，条件变量会阻塞生产者线程；当队列为空时，条件变量会阻塞消费者线程。由于无需维护事件历史记录，条件变量无需记录其发出信号的时间。

                                                                                                                                                                  Condition variables are more appropriate than mutexes or semaphores when complex condition expressions or scheduling behaviors are needed. For instance, condition variables are often used to implement synchronized message queues that provide "producer/consumer" communication to pass messages between threads. The condition variables block producer threads when a message queue is full and block consumer threads when the queue is empty. Since there's no need to maintain event history, condition variables needn't record when they are signaled.

                                                                                                                                                                  ACE_Null_Condition类是一个零成本实现，它遵循ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex接口。该类与10.3 节中描述的ACE_Null_Mutex类类似；也就是说，它的所有方法都按照空对象模式 [ Woo97 ] 实现为空操作。ACE_Null_Condition类如下所示：

                                                                                                                                                                  The ACE_Null_Condition class is a zero-cost implementation that conforms to the ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex interface. This class is similar to the ACE_Null_Mutex class described in Section 10.3; that is, all its methods are implemented as no-ops in accordance with the Null Object pattern [Woo97]. The ACE_Null_Condition class is presented below:

                                                                                                                                                                  class ACE_Null_Condition
{
public:
  ACE_Null_Condition (const ACE_Null_Mutex&, int =0, void* =0) {}
  ~ACE_Null_Condition () {}
  int remove () { return 0; }
  int wait (ACE_Time_Value* =0) const {errno = ETIME; return -1;}
  int signal () const { return 0;}
  int broadcast () const { return 0; }
};

                                                                                                                                                                  wait()方法返回 -1，并将errno设置为 ETIME，以便ACE_Null_Condition在与策略锁定模式结合使用时能够正常工作，例如第 10.5 节中所示的Message_Queue类。

                                                                                                                                                                  The wait() method returns –1 with errno set to ETIME so that ACE_Null_Condition works correctly when used in conjunction with the Strategized Locking pattern for classes like the Message_Queue shown in Section 10.5.

                                                                                                                                                                  例子

                                                                                                                                                                  Example

                                                                                                                                                                  默认情况下，UI线程的互斥锁实现是非递归的；也就是说，持有互斥锁的线程不能在不发生自身死锁的情况下重新获取同一个互斥锁。[2]虽然非递归互斥锁效率很高，但在某些情况下限制过多。例如，递归互斥锁对于回调驱动的C++框架尤其有用，因为框架事件循环会回调用户自定义代码。由于用户自定义代码随后可能通过方法入口点重新进入框架代码，递归互斥锁有助于防止在回调期间框架内同一线程持有的互斥锁发生死锁。

                                                                                                                                                                  By default, a UI threads mutex implementation is nonrecursive; that is, a thread that owns a mutex can't reacquire the same mutex without deadlocking on itself.[2] Although nonrecursive mutexes are efficient, they are too restrictive in certain circumstances. For example, recursive mutexes are particularly useful for callback-driven C++ frameworks, where the framework event loop performs a callback to user-defined code. Since the user-defined code may subsequently reenter framework code via a method entry point, recursive mutexes help prevent deadlock from occurring on mutexes held by the same thread within the framework during the callback.

                                                                                                                                                                  [2]请注意，Pthreads 和 Win32 本身就提供了递归互斥锁。

                                                                                                                                                                  [2] Note that Pthreads and Win32 provide recursive mutexes natively.

                                                                                                                                                                  为了应对这类场景，ACE 通过ACE_Recursive_Thread_Mutex类提供了对进程作用域递归互斥锁的支持。该类的接口如图 10.4所示。该类的公共接口符合第 209 页图 10.1中的ACE_LOCK*伪类。以下代码演示了如何使用ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex在原生不支持递归互斥锁的平台上实现递归互斥锁语义。

                                                                                                                                                                  To address these types of scenarios, ACE provides support for process-scoped recursive mutexes via the ACE_Recursive_Thread_Mutex class. The interface for this class is shown in Figure 10.4. The public interface of this class conforms to the ACE_LOCK* pseudo-class in Figure 10.1 on page 209. The following code illustrates how an ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex can be used to implement recursive mutex semantics on platforms that don't support them natively.

                                                                                                                                                                  图 10.4. ACE_Recursive_Thread_Mutex类图

                                                                                                                                                                  `nesting_level_`记录了具有`owner_id_` 的线程获取递归互斥锁的次数。`lock_`对` nesting_level_` 和 `owner_id_` 的访问进行序列化。`lock_available_`条件变量用于挂起等待嵌套级别降至 0 且互斥锁被释放的非所有者线程。`ACE_Recursive_Thread_Mutex`构造函数初始化这些数据成员：

                                                                                                                                                                  The nesting_level_ keeps track of the number of times a thread with owner_id_ has acquired the recursive mutex. The lock_ serializes access to the nesting_level_ and owner_id_. The lock_available_ condition variable is used to suspend nonowner threads that are waiting for the nesting level to drop to 0 and the mutex to be released. The ACE_Recursive_Thread_Mutex constructor initializes these data members:

                                                                                                                                                                  ACE_Recursive_Thread_Mutex::ACE_Recursive_Thread_Mutex
  (const char *name, void *arg)
  : nesting_level_ (0), owner_id_ (0), lock_ (name, arg),
    // Initialize the condition variable.
    lock_available_ (lock_, name, arg) {}

                                                                                                                                                                  接下来，我们将展示如何获得递归互斥锁。

                                                                                                                                                                  We next show how to acquire a recursive mutex.

                                                                                                                                                                   1 int ACE_Recursive_Thread_Mutex::acquire ()
 2 {
 3   ACE_thread_t t_id = ACE_OS::thr_self ();
 4
 5   ACE_GUARD_RETURN (ACE_Thread_Mutex, guard, lock_, -1);
 6
 7   if (nesting_level_ == 0) {
 8     owner_id_ = t_id;
 9     nesting_level_ = 1;
10   }
11   else if (t_id == owner_id_)
12     nesting_level_++;
13   else {
14     while (nesting_level_ > 0)
15       lock_available_.wait ();
16
17     owner_id_ = t_id;
18     nesting_level_ = 1;
19   }
20   return 0;
21 }

                                                                                                                                                                  第 3-5 行 我们首先确定是从哪个线程调用我们的，然后使用作用域锁定惯用法获取lock_互斥锁。

                                                                                                                                                                  Lines 3–5 We start by determining which thread we're called from and then acquire the lock_ mutex using the Scoped Locking idiom.

                                                                                                                                                                  第 7-12 行： 如果没有争用，则立即假定拥有互斥锁。否则，如果我们已经拥有互斥锁，则只需增加嵌套层级并继续执行，以避免自身死锁。

                                                                                                                                                                  Lines 7–12 If there's no contention, assume mutex ownership immediately. Otherwise, if we own the mutex already, just increment nesting level and proceed to avoid self-deadlock.

                                                                                                                                                                  第 13-20 行： 如果互斥锁被另一个线程持有，我们使用条件变量lock_available_等待嵌套级别降至零。当对lock_available_调用wait()方法时，它会原子地释放lock_互斥锁，并将调用线程置于睡眠状态。当嵌套级别最终降至零时，我们可以获取 lock_并接管递归互斥锁的所有权。guard函数的析构函数通过作用域锁定机制释放lock_ 。

                                                                                                                                                                  Lines 13–20 If the mutex is owned by another thread, we use the condition variable lock_available_ to wait for the nesting level to drop to zero. When the wait() method is invoked on lock_available_ it atomically releases the lock_ mutex and puts the calling thread to sleep. When the nesting level finally drops to zero, we can acquire the lock_ and assume ownership of the recursive mutex. The destructor of guard releases the lock_via the Scoped Locking idiom.

                                                                                                                                                                  接下来我们展示ACE_Recursive_Thread_Mutex::release()方法：

                                                                                                                                                                  We show the ACE_Recursive_Thread_Mutex::release () method next:

                                                                                                                                                                  int ACE Recursive Thread _Mutex::release ()
{
  ACE_thread_t t_id = ACE_OS::thr_self ();

  // Automatically acquire mutex.
  ACE_GUARD_RETURN (ACE_Thread_Mutex, guard, lock_, -1);

  nesting_level_--;
  if (nesting_level_  == 0)
    lock_available_.signal  (); // Inform waiters the lock is free.

  return 0; // Destructor of <guard> releases the <lock_>.
}

                                                                                                                                                                  当对lock_available_调用signal()方法时，它会唤醒等待发出该条件信号的线程之一。

                                                                                                                                                                  When the signal() method is invoked on lock_available_, it wakes up one of the threads waiting for the condition to be signaled.

                                                                                                                                                                    10.7 总结

                                                                                                                                                                    10.7 Summary

                                                                                                                                                                    操作系统平台为网络应用程序开发者提供了多种同步机制，供其在设计并发应用程序时使用。除了前几章中提到的与可移植性和 API 使用相关的复杂性之外，同步机制还带来了另一个挑战：并非所有同步机制在当今的操作系统上都可用。本章将介绍如何解决这些复杂性，设计有助于开发者减少错误的同步类，以及如何利用现有的同步机制来模拟缺失的机制。最终，我们得到了一组 ACE 同步包装器外观，应用程序开发者可以将其以可移植且稳健的方式应用，从而满足多种同步需求。

                                                                                                                                                                    OS platforms offer a variety of synchronization mechanisms for developers of networked applications to use when designing concurrent applications. In addition to the accidental complexities related to portability and API usage shown in previous chapters, synchronization mechanisms present another challenge: they aren't all available on today's operating systems. In this chapter, we showed how to resolve complexities, design synchronization classes that help developers make fewer mistakes, and use existing synchronization mechanisms to emulate missing ones. The result is a set of ACE synchronization wrapper facades that application developers can apply portably and robustly to satisfy many synchronization needs.

                                                                                                                                                                    ACE 同步接口将语法不兼容的原生操作系统同步机制适配到 C++ 类看来统一的层面。这些封装接口允许您在网络应用程序中同步进程和线程。本章介绍了最常用的 ACE 面向对象同步封装接口。ACE 网站 ( http://ace.ece.uci.edu ) 介绍了 ACE 提供的其他同步封装接口。

                                                                                                                                                                    The ACE synchronization interfaces adapt the syntactically incompatible native OS synchronization mechanisms to appear uniform from the perspective of other C++ classes. These wrapper facades allow you to synchronize both processes and threads in networked applications. This chapter described the most commonly used ACE object-oriented synchronization wrapper facades. The ACE Web site (http://ace.ece.uci.edu) describes other synchronization wrapper facades that ACE provides.

                                                                                                                                                                      附录 A. ACE C++ 封装外观的设计原则

                                                                                                                                                                      Appendix A. Design Principles for ACE C++ Wrapper Facades

                                                                                                                                                                      概要

                                                                                                                                                                      Synopsis

                                                                                                                                                                      本附录是对我们之前讨论的关于使用原生操作系统 API 时可能出现的复杂性以及 ACE 如何使用包装器外观模式解决这些问题的后续内容。我们总结了 ACE 进程间通信 (IPC) 和并发包装器外观类背后的设计原则，以便您可以遵循并将其应用到您自己的项目中。希望您能将这些原则应用于未来 ACE 类的设计和开发！

                                                                                                                                                                      This appendix is a follow-on to our discussions regarding the accidental complexities associated with using native OS APIs and how ACE resolves them using the Wrapper Facade pattern. We summarize the design principles that underlie the ACE IPC and concurrency wrapper facade classes so that you can follow and adapt them to your own projects. Hopefully, you can apply them to design and develop future classes for inclusion in ACE!

                                                                                                                                                                        A.1 概述

                                                                                                                                                                        A.1 Overview

                                                                                                                                                                        在本附录中，我们将介绍在 ACE 外立面设计中应用的以下原则：

                                                                                                                                                                        In this appendix, we describe the following principles applied throughout the design of the ACE wrapper facades:

                                                                                                                                                                        • 使用包装器外观来增强字体安全性。

                                                                                                                                                                        • Use wrapper facades to enhance type safety.

                                                                                                                                                                        • 简化为常见情况。

                                                                                                                                                                        • Simplify for the common case.

                                                                                                                                                                        • 利用层级结构来增强设计的清晰度和可扩展性。

                                                                                                                                                                        • Use hierarchies to enhance design clarity and extensibility.

                                                                                                                                                                        • 尽可能隐藏平台差异。

                                                                                                                                                                        • Hide platform differences whenever possible.

                                                                                                                                                                        • 优化效率。

                                                                                                                                                                        • Optimize for efficiency.

                                                                                                                                                                        我们在此以简明模式的形式记录这些原则，以便您了解塑造 ACE 的各种因素，并将其应用到您自己的框架和应用程序中。所有这些原则的背景是为系统级进程间通信 (IPC) 和并发机制开发包装外观。可移植性和效率是 ACE 的主要关注点，因此我们做出了一些权衡，而这些权衡在更高级别的面向对象应用程序框架中可能并非必要或合适。

                                                                                                                                                                        We document these principles here in abbreviated pattern form so you can understand the forces that shape ACE and apply them to your own frameworks and applications. The context for all these principles is developing wrapper facades for system-level IPC and concurrency mechanisms. Portability and efficiency are chief concerns in ACE, so we make tradeoffs that may not be necessary or appropriate in higher-level object-oriented application frameworks.

                                                                                                                                                                          A.2 使用外立面增强型式安全性

                                                                                                                                                                          A.2 Use Wrapper Facades to Enhance Type Safety

                                                                                                                                                                          诸如 C++ 和 Java 之类的高级编程语言提供了增强的类型安全，确保操作不会应用于不支持该操作的对象。理想情况下，类型错误应该在编译时被捕获。然而，操作系统库（例如实现 C 运行时、Socket 或 Pthreads 的库）很少公开内部数据结构，因为这样做会……

                                                                                                                                                                          Higher-level programming languages, such as C++ and Java, provide enhanced type safety, which ensures that operations can't be applied to objects that don't support them. Ideally, type errors should be caught at compile time. However, OS libraries, such as those that implement the C run time, Sockets, or Pthreads, seldom expose internal data structures since that would

                                                                                                                                                                          • 为实现向上兼容性而做出的妥协努力

                                                                                                                                                                          • Compromise efforts to provide upward compatibility

                                                                                                                                                                          • 在某些平台上实现对多种编程语言的支持较为困难

                                                                                                                                                                          • Make multiple programming language support hard on some platforms

                                                                                                                                                                          • 允许访问不应被应用程序使用的私人详细信息。

                                                                                                                                                                          • Allow access to private details that should not be used by applications

                                                                                                                                                                          因此，操作系统 API 通常会公开类似 C 语言的接口，使用底层且不透明的方式表示其内部数据结构，例如 I/O 句柄和套接字句柄。这些不透明类型使得编译器难以检测类型错误。因此，这些错误只能在运行时检测，这增加了开发和调试工作量，使错误处理更加复杂，并降低了应用程序的健壮性。本节将介绍一种在编译时增强类型安全性的设计原则，以及一种在严格类型安全过于严格的情况下提供“逃生通道”的原则。

                                                                                                                                                                          OS APIs therefore often expose a C-like interface, using low-level, opaque representations of their internal data structures, for example, I/O handles and socket handles. These opaque types make it hard for compilers to detect type errors. Consequently, these errors can be detected only at run time, which increases development and debugging effort, complicates error handling, and reduces application robustness. This section describes a design principle that enhances type safety at compile time, as well as a principle that provides an escape hatch for cases in which strict type safety is overly restrictive.

                                                                                                                                                                          A.2.1 设计强制正确使用的 C++ 类

                                                                                                                                                                          A.2.1 Design C++ Classes That Force Correct Usage

                                                                                                                                                                          问题：第 2.3 节 讨论的 Socket API 的许多局限性源于其缺乏类型安全而导致的以下问题：

                                                                                                                                                                          Problem: Many limitations with the Socket API discussed in Section 2.3 stem from the following problems caused by its lack of type safety:

                                                                                                                                                                          1. 不可移植 ——I/O句柄的类型名称和底层表示形式在不同平台上有所不同，因此它们不具备可移植性。例如，套接字句柄在UNIX平台上是整数，而在Win32平台上是指针。

                                                                                                                                                                          2. Nonportable— The type names and underlying representations of I/O handles vary across platforms, making them nonportable. For example, socket handles are integers on UNIX platforms and pointers on Win32.

                                                                                                                                                                          3. 容易被误用 ——底层表示形式允许以只能在运行时检测到的方式误用 I/O 句柄。例如，如果对一个旨在通过recv()和send()传输数据的数据模式套接字句柄调用accept()函数，则很容易错误地应用 Socket API 。

                                                                                                                                                                          4. Easily misused— Low-level representations permit I/O handles to be misused in ways that can be detected only at run time. For example, the Socket API can easily be applied incorrectly by invoking the accept() function on a data-mode socket handle that's intended to transfer data via recv() and send().

                                                                                                                                                                          解决方案设计：创建强制正确使用的 C++ 类。 弱类型 I/O 句柄可以封装在 C++ 类中，这些类为用户导出强类型方法。当应用程序代码使用这些新类时，C++ 编译器可以确保只调用合法的方法。

                                                                                                                                                                          Solution Design C++ classes that force correct usage. Weakly typed I/O handles can be encapsulated in C++ classes that export strongly typed methods for that class's users. When application code uses these new classes, C++ compilers can ensure that only legal methods are invoked.

                                                                                                                                                                          以下 C++ 代码说明了如何将此原理应用于第 2.3.1 节第 37 页的echo_server()函数：

                                                                                                                                                                          The following C++ code illustrates the application of this principle to the echo_server () function on page 37 in Section 2.3.1:

                                                                                                                                                                          int echo_server (const ACE_INET_Addr &addr)
{
  ACE_SOCK_Acceptor acceptor;  // Connection factory.
  ACE_SOCK_Stream peer_stream; // Data transfer object.
  ACE_INET_Addr peer_addr;     // Peer address object.

  // Initialize the passive acceptor and accept a new connection.
  if (acceptor.open (addr) != -1
      && acceptor.accept (peer_stream, &peer_addr) != -1) {
    char buf[BUFSIZ];

    for (size_t n; (n =peer_stream.recv (buf, sizeof buf)) > 0;)
      // send_n() handles "short writes."
      if (peer_stream.send_n (buf, n) != n)
        // Error handling omitted...
  }
}

                                                                                                                                                                          此次修订解决了 Socket API 和 C 语言使用中的诸多问题。例如，ACE_SOCK_Acceptor类仅公开了适用于被动建立连接的方法。由于这些包装类是强类型的，因此无效操作会在编译时而非运行时被检测出来。所以，无法在ACE_SOCK_Acceptor上调用recv()/send()，也无法在ACE_SOCK_Stream上调用 accept()，因为这些方法不属于这些包装类接口。

                                                                                                                                                                          This revision solves many problems with the Socket API and the use of C. For example, the ACE_SOCK_Acceptor class only exposes methods suitable for passively establishing connections. Since these wrapper facade classes are strongly typed, invalid operations are detected at compile time rather than at run time. It's therefore not possible to invoke recv()/send() on an ACE_SOCK_Acceptor or accept() on an ACE_SOCK_Stream since these methods aren't part of those wrapper facade interfaces.

                                                                                                                                                                          A.2.2 允许受控的型式安全违规行为

                                                                                                                                                                          A.2.2 Allow Controlled Violations of Type Safety

                                                                                                                                                                          问题： 如上所示，包装器外观可以保护网络应用程序免受易出错或平台特定的实现细节的影响，例如套接字句柄是用整数还是指针表示。然而，在某些情况下，这种额外的抽象和类型安全实际上会阻碍开发人员以最初设计者未预料到的方式使用包装器外观。这种令人沮丧的体验可能会使开发人员放弃利用包装器外观的其他重要优势。

                                                                                                                                                                          Problem: As shown above, wrapper facades can shield networked applications from error-prone or platform-specific implementation details, such as whether a socket handle is represented as an integer or a pointer. Situations arise, however, in which this additional abstraction and type safety actually prevent developers from using a wrapper facade in useful ways not anticipated by its original designer. This frustrating experience can discourage developers from leveraging the other important benefits of wrapper facades.

                                                                                                                                                                          解决方案：允许通过“逃生通道”进行受控违规。此原则旨在使正确使用包装器外观变得容易，错误使用变得困难，但并非完全不可能以类设计者最初未预料到的方式使用它们。ACE_IPC_SAP中的get_handle()和set_handle()方法体现了此原则， ACE_IPC_SAP是第 52 页第 3.3 节中描述的 ACE IPC 包装器外观的根基类。公开这两个用于获取或设置 I/O 句柄的方法允许应用程序在必须使用基于句柄的系统函数时绕过 ACE IPC 包装器外观的类型检查。

                                                                                                                                                                          Solution Allow controlled violations via "escape hatches." The intent of this principle is to make it easy to use wrapper facades correctly, hard to use them incorrectly, but not impossible to use them in ways that class designers did not anticipate originally. This principle is exemplified by the get_handle() and set_handle() methods in ACE_IPC_SAP, which is the root base class of the ACE IPC wrapper facades described in Section 3.3 on page 52. Exposing these two methods to get or set an I/O handle allows applications to circumvent ACE IPC wrapper facade type checking when applications must use handle-based system functions.

                                                                                                                                                                          例如，可能需要获取套接字句柄以便与ACE_Handle_Set类和select()函数一起使用，如下所示：

                                                                                                                                                                          For example, it may be necessary to obtain a socket handle for use with the ACE_Handle_Set class and select() function, as shown below:

                                                                                                                                                                          ACE_SOCK_Acceptor acceptor;
ACE_Handle_Set ready_handles;
// . . .

if (ready_handles.is_set (acceptor.get_handle ())
ACE::select ((int)acceptor.get_handle () + 1, ready_handles ());

                                                                                                                                                                          当然，这些“逃生舱”机制应该谨慎使用，因为它们会降低可移植性并增加出错的可能性，从而抵消包装外观模式的关键优势。在需要混合面向对象和非面向对象抽象的情况下（例如在 ACE 本身的某些层实现中），理想情况下应该在类实现中处理，并且尽量避免暴露给类用户。如果类用户经常需要使用“逃生舱”，最好重新审视类接口设计，寻找重构或重新设计的机会，以恢复类型安全。

                                                                                                                                                                          Naturally, these escape hatch mechanisms should be used sparingly since they decrease portability and increase the potential for errors, thereby defeating key benefits of the Wrapper Facade pattern. Situations where it's necessary to mix object-oriented and non-object-oriented abstractions, such as within the implementation of certain layers of ACE itself, should ideally be within class implementations and seldom exposed to class users. If the need for escape hatches arises often for class users, it's best to re-examine the class interface design for opportunities to refactor or redesign in order to restore type safety.

                                                                                                                                                                            A.3 简化为常见情况

                                                                                                                                                                            A.3 Simplify for the Common Case

                                                                                                                                                                            API 开发人员负责设计机制，使应用程序开发人员能够使用 API 支持的任何功能。现代操作系统、文件系统、协议栈和线程机制提供了广泛的功能。因此，如今的 API 通常规模庞大且复杂，提供大量函数，而选择所需的行为可能需要许多参数。

                                                                                                                                                                            API developers are responsible for devising mechanisms that enable application developers to use any functionality that the API supports. Modern operating systems, file systems, protocol stacks, and threading facilities offer a wide range of capabilities.
