Today's APIs are therefore often large and complex, offering a myriad of functions that may require numerous arguments to select the desired behavior.

                                                                                                                                                                            幸运的是，帕累托法则（也称为“80/20”法则）适用于软件 API；也就是说，大多数常用功能都可以用可用功能的一小部分来实现 [ PS90 ]。此外，相同的函数集通常以相同的顺序使用，以实现相同或相似的目标。设计良好的软件工具包会利用这一原则，识别并简化这些常见用例。ACE 包装器外观通过以下方式简化常见用例。

                                                                                                                                                                            Fortunately, the Pareto Principle, also known as the "80:20" rule, applies to software APIs; that is, most of what's commonly needed can be accomplished with a small subset of the available functionality [PS90]. Moreover, the same sets of functions are often used in the same sequence to accomplish the same or similar goals. Well-designed software toolkits take advantage of this principle by identifying and simplifying for these common use cases. The ACE wrapper facades simplify for common cases in the following ways.

                                                                                                                                                                            A.3.1 将多个函数合并为一个方法

                                                                                                                                                                            A.3.1 Combine Multiple Functions into a Single Method

                                                                                                                                                                            问题： C 级操作系统系统函数 API 通常包含许多用于支持相对不常见用例的函数。例如，如第 2.3.2 节所述，Socket API 支持多种协议族，例如 TCP/IP、IPX/SPX、X.25、ISO OSI 和 UNIX 域套接字。为了支持如此广泛的协议族，Socket API 的原始设计者在 Socket API 中定义了单独的 C 函数，这些函数用于支持不同的协议族。

                                                                                                                                                                            Problem: C-level OS system function APIs often contain a number of functions that exist to support relatively uncommon use cases. As discussed in Section 2.3.2, for example, the Socket API supports many protocol families, such as TCP/IP, IPX/SPX, X.25, ISO OSI, and UNIX-domain sockets. To support this range of protocol families, the original Socket API designers defined separate C functions in the Socket API that

                                                                                                                                                                            1. 创建套接字句柄

                                                                                                                                                                            2. Create a socket handle

                                                                                                                                                                            3. 将套接字句柄绑定到通信端点

                                                                                                                                                                            4. Bind a socket handle to a communication endpoint

                                                                                                                                                                            5. 将通信端点标记为“被动模式”工厂

                                                                                                                                                                            6. Mark a communication endpoint as being a "passive-mode" factory

                                                                                                                                                                            7. 接受连接并返回数据模式句柄

                                                                                                                                                                            8. Accept a connection and return a data-mode handle

                                                                                                                                                                            因此，创建和初始化被动模式的互联网域套接字需要多次调用，如下所示：

                                                                                                                                                                            Therefore, creating and initializing a passive-mode Internet-domain socket requires multiple calls, as shown below:

                                                                                                                                                                            sockaddr_in addr;
int addr_len = sizeof addr;
int n_handle, s_handle = socket (PF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);

memset (&addr, 0, sizeof addr);
addr.sin_family = AF_INET;
addr.sin_port = htons (port);
addr.sin_addr.s_addr = INADDR_ANY;

bind (s_handle, &addr, addr_len);
listen (s_handle);
// ...
n_handle = accept (s_handle, &addr, &addr_len);

                                                                                                                                                                            许多 TCP/IP 服务器都有一系列函数或相应的函数集来主动连接套接字。端口号的选择方式略有不同，但基本上每个基于 TCP/IP 的新应用程序都需要重写相同的代码。正如2.3.1 节所示，这种重复是潜在编程错误和增加调试时间的主要来源，而所有项目都应该避免这种情况。以简单且类型安全的方式使这组操作可重用，可以为每个联网应用程序节省时间和精力。

                                                                                                                                                                            Many TCP/IP servers have a sequence of either these functions or a corresponding set that connect a socket actively. There are minor variations for how port numbers are selected, but it's basically the same code rewritten for every new TCP/IP-based application. As shown in Section 2.3.1, this repetition is a major source of potential programming errors and increased debugging time that all projects can do without. Making this set of operations reuseable in a simple and type-safe manner saves time and trouble for every networked application.

                                                                                                                                                                            解决方案：将多个函数合并为一个方法。 这种简化方法避免了每个项目重复编写繁琐且容易出错的代码，例如上面所示的被动模式连接初始化代码。合并的代码行数越多，这种方法的优势就越明显。无需进行具体的函数调用，从而降低了参数使用错误的可能性。然而，这种方法的主要优势在于它封装了要调用的函数集及其调用顺序，从而避免了一个主要的潜在错误来源。

                                                                                                                                                                            Solution Combine multiple functions into a single method. This simplification alleviates the need for each project to (re)write tedious and error-prone code, such as the passive-mode connection initialization code shown above. The benefits of this approach increase with the number of lines of code that are combined. The specific calls needn't be made, which reduces the potential for errors in parameter usage. The main advantage of this approach, however, is the encapsulated knowledge of the set of functions to be called and the order to call them, which avoids a major source of potential errors.

                                                                                                                                                                            例如，ACE_SOCK_Acceptor是一个用于建立被动连接的工厂。它的open()方法会调用socket()、bind()和listen()函数来创建一个被动模式的通信端点。因此，要实现前面介绍的功能，应用程序只需编写以下代码：

                                                                                                                                                                            For example, the ACE_SOCK_Acceptor is a factory for passive connection establishment. Its open() method calls the socket(), bind(), and listen() functions to create a passive-mode communication endpoint. To achieve the functionality presented earlier therefore, applications can simply write the following:

                                                                                                                                                                            ACE_SOCK_Acceptor acceptor;
ACE_SOCK_Stream stream;

acceptor.open (ACE_INET_Addr (port));
acceptor.accept (stream);
// . . .

                                                                                                                                                                            同样， ACE_INET_Addr的构造函数最大限度地减少了直接使用基于 C 语言的struct sock-addr数据结构时常见的编程错误。例如，它会自动清除sockaddr_in地址结构(inet_addr_)，并将端口号转换为网络字节序，如下所示：

                                                                                                                                                                            Likewise, the constructor of ACE_INET_Addr minimizes common programming errors associated with using the C-based family of struct sock-addr data structures directly. For example, it clears the sockaddr_in address structure (inet_addr_) automatically and converts the port number to network byte order, as follows:

                                                                                                                                                                            ACE_INET_Addr::ACE_INET_Addr (u_short port, long ip_addr) {
  memset (&this->inet_addr , 0, sizeof this->inet_addr_);
  this->inet_addr_.sin_family = AF_INET;
  this->inet_addr_.sin_port = htons (port);
  memcpy (&this->inet_addr_.sin_addr, &ip_addr, sizeof ip_addr);
}

                                                                                                                                                                            总的来说，这种方法可以生成更简洁、更轻松、更不容易出错的代码，因为它应用了包装外观模式来避免类型安全问题。

                                                                                                                                                                            In general, this approach yields code that's more concise, less tedious, and less error prone since it applies the Wrapper Facade pattern to avoid type-safety problems.

                                                                                                                                                                            A.3.2 将功能合并到统一的包装外观下

                                                                                                                                                                            A.3.2 Combine Functions Under a Unified Wrapper Facade

                                                                                                                                                                            问题： 如今的计算平台通常提供一些常见的功能，但访问这些功能的方式却截然不同。有些功能本质上相同，但名称却可能不同。也可能存在完全不同的功能，在不同的平台上调用这些功能必须遵循不同的顺序。这种核心 API 和语义的不断变化使得应用程序难以移植到新平台。

                                                                                                                                                                            Problem: Today's computing platforms often supply some common types of functionality, but provide access to them quite differently. There may simply be different function names that do essentially the same thing. There may also be different functions altogether, which must be called in different orders on different platforms. This shifting set of core APIs and semantics makes it hard to port applications to new platforms.

                                                                                                                                                                            多线程很好地体现了不同平台上的 API 和语义是如何变化的。创建具有不同属性的线程的步骤在 POSIX 线程 (Pthreads)、UNIX 国际 (UI) 线程、Win32 线程和实时操作系统中差异很大。以下列表描述了一些主要区别：

                                                                                                                                                                            Multithreading is a good example of how APIs and semantics change across platforms. The steps to create a thread with different attributes varies widely across POSIX threads (Pthreads), UNIX International (UI) threads, Win32 threads, and real-time operating systems. The following list describes some of the key differences:

                                                                                                                                                                            • 函数名称——在 Pthreads 中， 生成线程的函数名为pthread_create() ；在 UI 线程中，该函数名为thr_create() ；在 Win32 中，该函数名为 Create_Thread() 。

                                                                                                                                                                            • Function names— The function to spawn threads is named pthread_create() in Pthreads, thr_create() in UI threads, and Create_Thread() in Win32.

                                                                                                                                                                            • 返回值—— 有些线程 API 在成功时返回线程 ID（或句柄），而另一些则返回 0。对于错误，有些返回一个不同的值（错误代码存储在其他地方），而另一些则直接返回错误代码。

                                                                                                                                                                            • Return values— Some threading APIs return a thread ID (or handle) on success, whereas others return 0. For errors, some return a distinct value (with the error code stored elsewhere) and others return an error code directly.

                                                                                                                                                                            • 函数数量—— 要指定线程属性（例如堆栈大小或优先级），所有属性都会传递给Win32 线程的CreateThread() 函数或 UI 线程的thr_create() 函数。然而，在 Pthreads 中，使用单独的函数来创建、修改和销毁线程属性数据结构，然后将这些数据结构传递给pthread_create()函数。

                                                                                                                                                                            • Number of functions— To specify thread attributes, such as stack size or priority, all of the attributes are passed to CreateThread() on Win32 or thr_create() on UI threads. In Pthreads, however, separate functions are used to create, modify, and later destroy thread attributes data structures, which are then passed to the pthread_create() function.

                                                                                                                                                                            • 函数调用顺序—— 当需要多次调用函数时，它们的调用顺序有时需要不同。例如，Pthreads 草案 4 API 要求线程在创建后才被标记为可加入，而其他 Pthreads 实现则要求在创建前进行标记。

                                                                                                                                                                            • Order of function calls— When multiple function calls are required, they're sometimes required to be in different orders. For example, the Pthreads draft 4 API requires a thread to be marked joinable after it's created, while other Pthreads implementations require it before.

                                                                                                                                                                            解决方案是将功能合并到一个统一的包装器外观下，以便妥善管理移植到不同平台时所需的更改。例如，为了应对线程创建的多平台要求，` ACE_Thread_Manager::spawn()`方法通过参数接收所有必需信息（有关参数的重要原则，请参见A.3.3 节），并按正确的顺序调用所有操作系统系统函数。该方案考虑了不同平台的返回值约定，并将其统一为 ACE 中通用的返回值约定：成功返回 0，失败返回 -l，并将失败原因存储在`errno`中。此方案允许在所有平台上，只需一次方法调用即可完成 ACE 本身以及用户应用程序中的所有线程创建。

                                                                                                                                                                            Solution Combine functions under a unified wrapper facade to properly manage the changes required when porting to different platforms. To deal with the multiple platform requirements of thread creation, for instance, the ACE_Thread_Manager::spawn () method accepts all its needed information via arguments (see Section A.3.3 for an important principle regarding arguments) and calls all of the OS system functions in the proper order. The different return value conventions of the platforms are accounted for and unified into one return convention used throughout ACE, that is, 0 on success, –l on failure with the failure reason stored in errno. This solution allows all thread creation in ACE itself, and in user applications, to be accomplished with a single method call across all platforms.

                                                                                                                                                                            设计统一函数时，您面临的挑战在于选择要公开的接口粒度，以及要合并哪些底层函数。在做决定时，请记住以下几点：

                                                                                                                                                                            Your challenge when designing unifying functions is to choose the granularity of the interface to expose, and which low-level functions to combine. Keep these points in mind when deciding:

                                                                                                                                                                            • 可移植性—— 包装器外观方法应力求在所有平台上提供相同的语义。但这并非总是可行；例如，并非所有操作系统平台都允许创建系统级线程，如第 5.4 节所述。然而，在许多情况下，该方法可以通过模拟不支持的功能或忽略非必要的请求功能或属性来掩盖这些差异。有关此方面的更多指导，请参阅第 A.5 节。

                                                                                                                                                                            • Portability— The wrapper facade method should strive to offer the same semantics across all platforms. This isn't always possible; for example, not all OS platforms allow creation of system-scope threads, as discussed in Section 5.4, In many cases, however, the method can mask these differences by emulating unsupported features or ignoring requested features or attributes that aren't essential. See Section A.5 for more guidance on this point.

                                                                                                                                                                            • 易用性—— 调用者应该能够清楚地了解如何使用你的包装器外观方法，调用前需要做哪些准备工作（例如创建属性），以及返回值及其含义。通常，方法数量少比相关方法多更容易使用。此外，还要注意一些副作用，例如内部内存分配，调用者必须记住处理这些副作用。

                                                                                                                                                                            • Ease of use— The caller should be able to identify how to use your wrapper facade method, what preparations need to be made before calling, such as creating attributes, and what are the return values and their meanings. Having a small number of methods is often easier to use than a larger number of related methods. In addition, beware of side effects, such as internal memory allocation, that callers must remember to handle.

                                                                                                                                                                            A.3.3 重新订购参数和供应默认值

                                                                                                                                                                            A.3.3 Reorder Parameters and Supply Default Values

                                                                                                                                                                            问题： 操作系统库包含的系统函数必须满足各种预期用途，并允许访问系统的所有功能。因此，这些函数通常有很多很少使用的参数，但其默认值必须显式提供。此外，函数原型中参数的顺序并不总是与应用程序向函数传递非默认值的频率相匹配，这增加了编码错误的概率。操作系统库通常用 C 语言实现，以便可以从多种语言调用，但这限制了使用语言特性和设计抽象来缓解这些问题。

                                                                                                                                                                            Problem: OS libraries contain system functions that must address a wide variety of anticipated uses, and allow access to all of a system's functionality. These functions therefore often have many arguments that are seldom used, but whose default values must be supplied explicitly. Moreover, the order of parameters in a function prototype doesn't always match the frequency with which applications pass nondefault values to the function, which increases the likelihood of coding errors. OS libraries are also often implemented in C so they can be called from a variety of languages, which prevents the use of language features and design abstractions that could help to alleviate these problems.

                                                                                                                                                                            例如，UI线程的thr_create()函数接受六个参数：

                                                                                                                                                                            For example, the UI threads thr_create() function takes six parameters:

                                                                                                                                                                            1. 栈指针

                                                                                                                                                                            2. Stack pointer

                                                                                                                                                                            3. 堆叠大小

                                                                                                                                                                            4. Stack size

                                                                                                                                                                            5. 入口点函数

                                                                                                                                                                            6. Entry point function

                                                                                                                                                                            7. void *入口点函数的参数

                                                                                                                                                                            8. void * argument for the entry point function

                                                                                                                                                                            9. 用于创建线程的标志

                                                                                                                                                                            10. Flags used to create the thread

                                                                                                                                                                            11. 已创建线程的标识符

                                                                                                                                                                            12. Identifier of the created thread

                                                                                                                                                                            由于大多数应用程序都希望使用默认的栈语义，因此参数 1 和 2 通常为 0。然而，开发人员必须记住传入这些 0 值，这既繁琐又容易出错。此外，并发应用程序通常会创建具有“可连接”语义的线程，这意味着另一个线程会与该线程汇合，并在其退出时回收其状态。因此，参数 5 有一个通用值，但会根据具体用例而变化。参数 3 和 4 是最常更改的值。参数 6 由`thr_create()`函数设置，因此必须由调用者提供。

                                                                                                                                                                            Since most applications want default stack semantics, parameters 1 and 2 are usually 0. Yet, developers must remember to pass in the 0 values, which is tedious and error prone. It's also common for concurrent applications to spawn threads with "joinable" semantics, which means that another thread will rendezvous with and reap the thread's status when it exits. So parameter 5 has a common value, but it does change depending on the use case. Parameters 3 and 4 are the most commonly changed values. Parameter 6 is set by thr_create(), so it must be supplied by the caller.

                                                                                                                                                                            解决方案： 重新排列参数并提供默认值，以简化最常见的情况。设计包装外观类时，您可以利用两个重要因素：

                                                                                                                                                                            Solution Reorder parameters and supply default values in order to simplify for the most common cases. When designing wrapper facade classes, you can take advantage of two important factors:

                                                                                                                                                                            • 您了解常见的使用场景，可以设计界面，使应用程序开发人员能够轻松应对这些常见场景。

                                                                                                                                                                            • You know the common use cases and can design your interface to make the common cases easy for application developers to use.

                                                                                                                                                                            • 您可以指定并使用面向对象的实现语言，例如 C++，并利用其特性以及面向对象设计所实现的高级抽象。

                                                                                                                                                                            • You can specify and use an object-oriented implementation language, such as C++, and take advantage of its features and the higher-level abstractions enabled by object-oriented design.

                                                                                                                                                                            从上面所示的问题中，您可以重新排列参数顺序，将常用参数放在前面，将不常用参数放在最后，并为它们赋予默认值。

                                                                                                                                                                            From the problem illustrated above, you can reorder the parameters to put commonly used parameters first and seldomly used parameters at the end, where you can give them default values.

                                                                                                                                                                            例如，ACE_Thread_Manager::spawn()的参数顺序是这样的：最常更改的参数（例如线程函数及其void *参数）排在最前面。其他参数则使用默认值；例如，默认的线程同步行为是 THR-JOINABLE。因此，大多数应用程序只需传递常见情况下所需的最少信息即可。

                                                                                                                                                                            For example, the ACE_Thread_Manager::spawn() parameters are ordered so that the most frequently changing parameters, such as the thread function and its void * argument, appear first. Default values are then given for the other parameters; for example, the default thread synchronization behavior is THR-JOINABLE. As a result, most applications can just pass the minimum amount of information necessary for the common case.

                                                                                                                                                                            C++ 默认参数还可以用于其他用途。例如，ACE_SOCK_Connector类中的connect()方法具有以下签名：

                                                                                                                                                                            C++ default parameters can be used for other purposes, as well. For instance, the connect() method in the ACE_SOCK_Connector class has the following signature:

                                                                                                                                                                            int ACE_SOCK_Connector::connect
  (ACE_SOCK_Stream &new_stream,
   const ACE_SOCK_Addr &remote_sap,
   ACE_Time_Value  *timeout = 0,
   const ACE_Addr &local_sap = ACE_Addr::sap_any,
   int reuse_addr = 0,
   int flags = 0,
   int perms = 0,
   int protocol_family =
   PF_INET, int protocol = 0);

                                                                                                                                                                            相比之下，ACE_TLI_Connector的connect()方法的签名略有不同：

                                                                                                                                                                            In contrast, the ACE_TLI_Connector's connect() method has a slightly different signature:

                                                                                                                                                                            int ACE_TLI_Connector::connect
  (ACE_TLI_Stream &new_stream,
   const ACE_Addr &remote_sap,
   ACE_Time_Value *timeout = 0,
   const ACE_Addr &local_sap = ACE_Addr::sap_any,
   int reuse_addr = 0,
   int flags = O_RDWR,
   int perms = 0,
   const char device[] = ACE_TLI_TCP_DEVICE,
   struct t_info *info = 0,
   int rw_flag = 1,
   struct netbuf *udata = 0,
   struct netbuf *opt = 0);

                                                                                                                                                                            实际上，connect()方法每次调用时只有前几个参数会有所不同。因此，为了简化编程，这些类的connect()方法都使用了默认值，这样开发人员就不必每次都提供这些默认值。因此，这两个类的常见情况几乎完全相同。例如，ACE_SOCK_Connector 的代码如下所示：

                                                                                                                                                                            In practice, only the first several parameters of connect() vary from call to call. To simplify programming, therefore, default values are used in the connect() methods of these classes so that developers needn't provide them every time. As a result, the common case for both classes are almost identical. For example, ACE_SOCK_Connector looks like this:

                                                                                                                                                                            ACE_SOCK_Stream stream;
ACE_SOCK_Connector connector;

// Compiler supplies default values.
connector.connect (stream, ACE_INET_Addr (port, host));
// . . .

                                                                                                                                                                            ACE_TLI_Connector看起来像这样：

                                                                                                                                                                            and ACE_TLI_Connector looks like this:

                                                                                                                                                                            ACE_TLI_Stream stream;
ACE_TLI_Connector connector;

// Compiler supplies default values.
connector.connect (stream, ACE_INET_Addr (port, host));
// ...

                                                                                                                                                                            默认参数提供的通用签名可以与 [ SH ]中讨论的参数化类型结合使用，以增强生成式编程[ CE00 ] 并使用参数化类型处理可变性，如A.5.3 节所述。

                                                                                                                                                                            The common signature provided by default parameters can be used in conjunction with the parameterized types discussed in [SH] to enhance generative programming [CE00] and handle variability using parameterized types, as described in Section A.5.3.

                                                                                                                                                                            A.3.4 明确关联内聚对象

                                                                                                                                                                            A.3.4 Associate Cohesive Objects Explicitly

                                                                                                                                                                            问题： 由于操作系统级库的通用性，多个函数和数据结构之间通常存在依赖关系。然而，由于这些依赖关系是隐式的，因此很难自动识别和强制执行。第 2.3.1 节以socket()、bind()、listen()和accept()函数之间的关系为例说明了这一点。当多个数据对象有时一起使用，有时单独使用时，这个问题会更加严重。

                                                                                                                                                                            Problem: Due to the general-purpose nature of OS-level libraries, there are often dependencies between multiple functions and data structures. Since these dependencies are implicit, however, they are hard to identify and enforce automatically. Section 2.3.1 illustrates this using the relationship between the socket(), bind(), listen(), and accept() functions. This problem is exacerbated when multiple data objects are sometimes used together, and other times used alone.

                                                                                                                                                                            例如，在使用线程功能时，互斥锁是一种常见的同步机制。互斥锁也常与条件变量一起使用；也就是说，条件变量和互斥锁通常在条件变量的生命周期内保持关联。Pthreads API 在这方面容易出错，因为它没有明确地定义这种关联。`pthread_cond _*() ` 函数的签名接受一个 ` pthread_mutex_t*`类型的参数。因此，仅从语法上看，` pthread_cond_t`和特定的 ` pthread_mutex_t`之间并没有紧密的关联。此外，Pthreads 条件变量 API 的使用也很繁琐，因为每次调用`pthread_cond_wait()`函数时都必须将互斥锁作为参数传递。

                                                                                                                                                                            For example, when using threading facilities, a mutex is a common synchronization mechanism. A mutex is also used together with a condition variable; that is, a condition variable and a mutex are usually associated for the condition variable's lifetime. The Pthreads API is error prone in this regard because it doesn't make this association explicit. The signatures of the pthread_cond_*() functions take a pthread_mutex_t*. The syntax alone therefore doesn't denote the tight coupling between a pthread_cond_t and a specific pthread_mutex_t. Moreover, the Pthread condition variable API is tedious to use because the mutex must be passed as a parameter every time the pthread_cond_wait() function is called.

                                                                                                                                                                            解决 方案：明确关联内聚对象，以最大程度地减少应用程序开发人员需要记住的细节。作为包装外观设计者，您的职责是让类的用户能够轻松正确地完成工作，并尽可能避免（甚至不可能）出错。设计一个封装多个相关对象的类是实现此目标的一种方法，因为它明确定义了内聚对象之间的关联。

                                                                                                                                                                            Solution Associate cohesive objects explicitly to minimize the details that application developers must remember. Your job as a wrapper facade designer is to make the class user's job easy to do correctly and make it inconvenient (or impossible) to do it wrong. Designing one class that encapsulates multiple, related objects is one technique for accomplishing this goal because it codifies the association between cohesive objects.

                                                                                                                                                                            这一原则比A.2 节中描述的使用包装器外观来提高类型安全性的方法更进一步。A.2 节的目标是应用 C++ 类型系统来确保强类型检查。而这里的目标是利用 C++ 特性来强制强类型对象之间的依赖关系。例如，为了强制执行上述示例中条件变量与其互斥锁之间的关联，第229 页10.6 节中描述的ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex类同时包含条件变量和互斥锁引用：

                                                                                                                                                                            This principle goes a step further than the use of wrapper facades to improve type safety described in Section A.2. The goal there was to apply the C++ type system to ensure strong type-checking. The goal here is to use C++ features to enforce dependencies between strongly typed objects. For example, to enforce the association between a condition variable and its mutex from the example above, the ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex class described in Section 10.6 on page 229 contains both a condition variable and a mutex reference:

                                                                                                                                                                            class ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex {
  // ....
private:
  ACE_cond_t cond_; // Condition variable instance.
  ACE Thread Mutex &mutex ; // Reference to a mutex lock.
};

                                                                                                                                                                            此类的构造函数需要对ACE_Thread_Mutex对象进行引用，强制用户正确关联互斥锁，如下所示：

                                                                                                                                                                            The constructor of this class requires a reference to an ACE_Thread_Mutex object, forcing the user to associate the mutex correctly, as shown below:

                                                                                                                                                                            ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex::ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex
  (const ACE_Thread_Mutex &m): mutex_ (m) ( /* ... */}

                                                                                                                                                                            任何其他使用尝试都将被 C++ 编译器捕获并拒绝。

                                                                                                                                                                            Any other attempted use will be caught by the C++ compiler and rejected.

                                                                                                                                                                              A.4 利用层级结构增强设计清晰度和可扩展性

                                                                                                                                                                              A.4 Use Hierarchies to Enhance Design Clarity and Extensibility

                                                                                                                                                                              继承是面向对象设计技术和编程语言的一个定义性属性[ Mey97 ]。尽管经验表明，深层次的继承结构可能难以管理[ GHJV95 ]，但合理地使用继承以层次化的方式对软件抽象进行建模是有益的，如下所述。

                                                                                                                                                                              Inheritance is a defining property of object-oriented design techniques and programming languages [Mey97]. Although experience shows that deep inheritance hierarchies can be unwieldy [GHJV95], there are benefits of using inheritance judiciously to model software abstractions in a hierarchical manner, as described below.

                                                                                                                                                                              A.4.1 用层级结构取代一维 API

                                                                                                                                                                              A.4.1 Replace One-Dimensional APIs with Hierarchies

                                                                                                                                                                              问题： Socket API 的复杂性部分源于其过于宽泛且单一的设计 [ Mar64 ]。例如，所有功能都位于同一抽象层级，如图A.1所示。这种单一的设计增加了学习和正确使用 Socket API 所需的工作量。例如，要编写一个联网应用程序，程序员必须理解 Socket API 的大部分内容，即使他们只使用其中的一部分。此外，功能分散，导致代码重复。

                                                                                                                                                                              Problem: The complexity of the Socket API stems in part from its overly broad and one-dimensional design [Mar64]. For instance, all the functions appear at a single level of abstraction, as shown in Figure A.1. This one-dimensional design increases the effort needed to learn and use the Socket API correctly. To write a networked application, for example, programmers must understand most of the Socket API, even if they use only part of it. Moreover, functionality is decentralized, which duplicates code.

                                                                                                                                                                              图 A.1. Socket API 中的函数

                                                                                                                                                                              解决方案：用层次结构取代一维 API，以最大限度地提高代码重用性和共享性。这一原则涉及使用层次相关的类来重构现有的一维 API。例如，ACE Socket 包装器外观的设计方法是将图 A.1所示的 Socket API 函数聚类成图 3.1 （第 47 页）所示的类层次结构。继承提高了 ACE 中的代码重用性并增强了模块化，具体如下：

                                                                                                                                                                              Solution Replace one-dimensional APIs with hierarchies to maximize reuse and code sharing. This principle involves using hierarchically related classes to restructure existing one-dimensional APIs. For instance, the ACE Socket wrapper facades were designed by clustering the Socket API functions shown in Figure A.1 into a hierarchy of classes shown in Figure 3.1 on page 47. Inheritance increases code reuse and improves modularity in ACE as follows:

                                                                                                                                                                              • 基类表达相似性。 层次结构设计避免了不必要的代码重复，因为基类表达了继承层次结构根部提供的通用机制。例如，ACE IPC 包装器外观类在继承层次结构的根部共享机制，例如在ACE_IPC_SAP和ACE_SOCK基类中。这些机制包括用于打开/关闭和设置/检索底层 I/O 句柄的方法，以及所有派生包装器外观类通用的某些选项管理函数。

                                                                                                                                                                              • Base classes express similarities. Hierarchical designs avoid unnecessary duplication of code since base classes express common mechanisms provided at the root of the inheritance hierarchy. For example, the ACE IPC wrapper facades share mechanisms toward the root of the inheritance hierarchy, for example, in the ACE_IPC_SAP and ACE_SOCK base classes. These mechanisms include methods for opening/closing and setting/retrieving the underlying I/O handles, as well as certain option management functions common to all the derived wrapper facade classes.

                                                                                                                                                                              • 派生类体现了差异。 位于继承层次结构叶节点附近的子类实现了针对特定通信类型定制的专用方法。例如，ACE_SOCK的子类分别提供流式通信与数据报通信，以及本地通信与远程通信。

                                                                                                                                                                              • Derived classes express differences. Subclasses located toward the leaves of the inheritance hierarchy implement specialized methods that are customized for the type of communication provided. For example, subclasses of ACE_SOCK provide stream versus datagram communication and local versus remote communication.

                                                                                                                                                                              A.4.2 用 C++ 继承替换伪继承

                                                                                                                                                                              A.4.2 Replace Pseudo-Inheritance with C++ Inheritance

                                                                                                                                                                              问题： 许多 C 语言级别的系统编程 API 由于层次抽象不足而容易出错。例如，Socket API 的网络寻址机制使用 C 语言结构和类型转换，为 Internet 域和 UNIX 域地址提供了一种笨拙的“继承”形式。最通用的套接字寻址结构是`sockaddr`，它定义了一个用于定义地址信息的伪“基类”。它的第一个字段指示所需的地址族，第二个字段是一个准不透明的字节数组。具体的地址族结构通过覆盖该字节数组来定义寻址信息。这种伪继承设计会产生许多不易察觉的错误，如第 2.3.1 节和第 3.2 节所述。特别是，类型转换的使用——结合弱类型化的基于句柄的 Socket API——使得编译器难以在编译时检测到程序员的错误。

                                                                                                                                                                              Problem: Many C-level system programming APIs are error-prone due to insufficient hierarchical abstraction. For example, the Socket API network addressing mechanisms use C structures and typecasts, which provide an awkward form of "inheritance" for Internet-domain and UNIX-domain addresses. The most general socket addressing structure is sockaddr, which defines a pseudo "base class" for defining address information. Its first field indicates the desired address family and its second field is a quasi-opaque byte array. Specific address family structures then define addressing information by overlaying the byte array. This pseudo-inheritance design yields many subtle bugs, as described in Section 2.3.1 and Section 3.2. In particular, the use of typecasts—combined with the weakly typed handle-based Socket API—makes it hard for compilers to detect programmer mistakes at compile time.

                                                                                                                                                                              解决方案：用 C++ 继承替换伪继承。 此原则利用 C++ 的面向对象编程语言特性，而非强迫应用程序开发人员处理类型转换和类型覆盖。例如，ACE 定义了3.2 节中描述的ACE_Addr类层次结构，为各种网络寻址格式（例如图 A.2所示的 Internet 和 UNIX 域地址、STREAM 管道、文件和设备）提供类型安全的包装器外观。每个子类都将特定于地址族的细节隐藏在一个通用 API 之后。

                                                                                                                                                                              Solution Replace pseudo-inheritance with C++ inheritance. Rather than forcing application developers to wrestle with casts and type overlays, this principle leverages object-oriented programming language features in C++. For example, ACE defines the ACE_Addr class hierarchy described in Section 3.2 to provide type-safe wrapper facades for diverse network addressing formats, such as the Internet- and UNIX-domain addresses, STREAM pipes, files, and devices shown in Figure A.2. Each subclass hides address family-specific details behind a common API.

                                                                                                                                                                              图 A.2. ACE IPC 地址层次结构

                                                                                                                                                                                A.5 尽可能隐藏平台差异

                                                                                                                                                                                A.5 Hide Platform Differences Whenever Possible

                                                                                                                                                                                多平台软件开发给类设计者带来了诸多挑战，因为不同平台的功能可能存在很大差异。这些差异通常表现为以下几种形式：

                                                                                                                                                                                Multiplatform software development presents many challenges to class de-signers because functionality can differ widely across platforms. These differences often take one of the following forms:

                                                                                                                                                                                • 缺失且不可能—— 有些平台​​根本不提供其他平台提供的功能；例如，有些平台没有僵尸概念（第 8 章），因此既没有办法也没有必要提供避免它们的方法。

                                                                                                                                                                                • Missing and impossible— Some platforms simply don't supply a capability that others do; for example, some platforms do not not have a zombie concept (from Chapter 8) so there is no way and no need to offer a way to avoid them.

                                                                                                                                                                                • 缺失但可模拟——有些平台​​不提供其他平台提供的功能，但它们确实提供了足够的其他功能来模拟缺失的功能；例如，第 10 章 中描述的条件变量和读写锁在某些操作系统平台上是可以模拟的。

                                                                                                                                                                                • Missing but can be emulated— Some platforms don't provide a capability that others do, but they do supply enough other functionality to emulate the missing capability; for example, the condition variable and readers/writer locks described in Chapter 10 are emulated on certain OS platforms.

                                                                                                                                                                                • 缺少但同样优秀的功能—— 有些平台​​不提供某些功能（例如 Sockets API），但提供了等效功能（例如 TLI）。在其他情况下，两种功能可能都可用，但平台对其中一种功能的实现方式可能更优。例如，一种功能可能性能更好或缺陷更少。

                                                                                                                                                                                • Missing but an equally good feature is available— Some platforms do not provide a capability, such as the Sockets API, but do provide an equivalent capability, such as TLI. In other situations, both features may be available, but the platform's implementation of one is more favorable than the other. For example, one may have better performance or fewer defects.

                                                                                                                                                                                本节介绍如何处理这些情况，从而得到一组 C++ 类，以便开发易于移植的网络应用程序。

                                                                                                                                                                                This section describes how to deal with these situations to arrive at a set of C++ classes that allow development of easily portable networked applications.

                                                                                                                                                                                A.5.1 允许源构建任何有益的东西

                                                                                                                                                                                A.5.1 Allow Source to Build Whatever Is Beneficial

                                                                                                                                                                                问题： 平台特性集有时会存在一些差异，而包装器外观无法掩盖这些差异。例如，如果平台特性集中根本不存在内核线程语义，包装器外观就无法凭空创造出来。这时，类设计者就面临一个问题：是否应该设计一个缺少与缺失功能相对应的方法或方法集的类？

                                                                                                                                                                                Problem: Platform feature sets sometimes diverge in ways that wrapper facades can't hide. For example, a wrapper facade can't magically invent kernel-thread semantics if it simply doesn't exist in the platform's feature set. The class designer now has a problem: Should a class be designed that lacks a method, or set of methods, corresponding to the missing capability?

                                                                                                                                                                                软件移植到足够多的平台后，最终会遇到某个平台不支持某个重要功能的情况。对此，最初的应对措施可能是避免提供与该功能对应的类或类方法，从而强制编译器在编译时检测问题。当缺失的功能对应用程序至关重要时，这种做法是合适的。例如，创建新进程的功能是许多网络应用程序的核心功能。如果某个平台不支持多进程，那么在编译时了解这一点通常是有利的。然而，在很多情况下，应用程序应该能够在运行时运行并响应任何潜在问题，此时可以尝试其他方法。

                                                                                                                                                                                Software that's ported to enough platforms will eventually encounter one in which an important feature isn't supported. The first reaction to this problem may be to avoid offering a class or a class method, corresponding to that capability, forcing the compiler to detect the problem at compile time. This choice is appropriate when the missing feature is of central importance to the application. For example, the ability to create a new process is a central feature to many networked applications. If a platform doesn't offer multiprocessing, it's often advantageous to know that at compile time. There are may cases, however, in which an application should be allowed to run and react to any potential issues at run time, where alternate approaches can be attempted.

                                                                                                                                                                                解决方案：允许源代码构建任何有益的功能。 在某些情况下，即使源代码尝试访问的功能不存在且无法模拟，也最好允许其正确编译。这可能是由于以下原因造成的：

                                                                                                                                                                                Solution Allow source to build whatever's beneficial. There are situations in which it's better to allow source code to compile correctly, even when the functionality it's trying to access isn't present and can't be emulated. This may be due to:

                                                                                                                                                                                • 能够在运行时检测问题并允许应用程序选择替代方案的能力至关重要。 这种情况经常出现在类库设计中，因为设计人员无法预测类可能被使用的所有场景。在这种情况下，最好实现一个方法，该方法向调用者返回“未实现”指示。这样，调用者就可以自由选择其他技术或功能、报告错误并尝试继续运行，或者终止程序。ACE 定义了一个名为 ACE_NOTSUP_RETURN 的宏来实现此目的。

                                                                                                                                                                                • The ability to detect the issue at run time and allow the application to select an alternate plan of action. This case often arises in class library design because designers can't predict all the situations in which the class may be used. In such cases, it may be better to implement a method that returns a "not implemented" indication to the caller. Thus, the caller has the freedom to choose another technique or capability, report the error and try to contine, or terminate. ACE defines a macro called ACE_NOTSUP_RETURN that serves this purpose.

                                                                                                                                                                                • 忽略缺失的功能与拥有该功能的效果相同。 例如，考虑一个使用 ` ACE_Process_Options::avoid_zombies()`方法来避免处理僵尸进程的 UNIX 应用程序（参见第 168 页）。如果该应用程序移植到 Win32，则不存在僵尸进程的概念。在这种情况下，调用 ` avoid_zombies()`方法并使其返回成功是完全可以接受的，因为该方法的原始目的已经通过什么都不做而实现。

                                                                                                                                                                                • Ignoring the missing feature yields the same effect as having it. For this case, consider a UNIX application that uses the ACE_Process_Options::avoid_zombies() method to avoid dealing with zombie processes (see page 168). If the application is ported to Win32, there's no such concept as a zombie process. In this case, it's perfectly acceptable to call the avoid_zombies() method and have it indicate success because the original intent of the method has been accomplished by doing nothing.

                                                                                                                                                                                A.5.2 模拟缺失的功能

                                                                                                                                                                                A.5.2 Emulate Missing Capabilities

                                                                                                                                                                                问题： 由于当今计算平台的功能和标准多种多样，功能集往往存在差异。当移植到新平台时，这种差异会导致某些功能缺失，而这些功能是项目在先前平台上所依赖的。然而，仔细分析这些功能背后的概念，通常可以发现一些替代功能，这些功能可以组合起来模拟缺失的功能。

                                                                                                                                                                                Problem: Due to the wide range of capabilities and standards implemented in today's computing platforms, there's often divergence in feature sets. When porting to a new platform, this divergence yields an area of missing functionality that a project has come to rely on from previous platforms. A careful analysis of the concepts behind the features, however, often reveals alternate capabilities that can be combined to emulate the missing functionality.

                                                                                                                                                                                与普遍认知相反，标准并非可移植软件的万灵药。标准种类繁多，不同平台实现的标准集也各不相同，而且操作系统版本更新时，标准往往也会有所变化。即使在同一标准内部，某些功能也常常是可选的。例如，Pthreads 中的信号量和实时调度类功能就是可选的。

                                                                                                                                                                                Contrary to popular belief, standards are not a panacea for portable software. There are a great many standards, and platforms implement different sets of standards, often changing between OS releases. Even within a standard some features are often optional. For example, the semaphore and real-time scheduling class capabilities are optional parts of Pthreads.

                                                                                                                                                                                当软件是为某个或多个平台开发的，尝试将其移植到新平台时，常常会发现软件使用的某些功能在新平台上不可用。为了绕过缺失的功能，需要进行一系列修改，这可能会对整个项目产生连锁反应。然而，如果仔细分析新平台的功能集，或许可以发现一些功能组合起来，用来模拟缺失的功能。因此，如果项目能够巧妙地使用 C++ 封装外观类，就可以避免一系列代价高昂的设计和代码修改。

                                                                                                                                                                                When software has been developed for one platform, or set of platforms, an effort to port it to a new platform often reveals that capabilities used by the software aren't available on the new platform. This can cause a ripple effect throughout the project as changes are made to work around the missing feature. If a careful analysis of the new platform's feature set is made, however, it may reveal a set of features that, when combined, can be used to emulate the missing capability. If a project uses C++ wrapper facade classes intelligently, therefore, it may be able to avoid a series of expensive design and code changes.

                                                                                                                                                                                解决方案：模拟缺失的功能。 根据包装器外观模式设计的类可以方便且类型安全地封装平台的原生功能。它们还可以包含使用平台现有特性来模拟某些未提供功能的原生代码。例如，以下 C++ 代码演示了如何使用 ACE 条件变量和互斥锁类为未原生实现信号量的操作系统平台实现进程作用域的信号量包装器外观。

                                                                                                                                                                                Solution Emulate missing capabilities. Classes designed according to the Wrapper Facade pattern can encapsulate a platform's native capabilities in convenient and type-safe ways. They can also contain native code that uses a platform's existing features to emulate some capability not provided otherwise. For example, the following C++ code illustrates how the ACE condition variable and mutex classes can be used to implement a process-scoped semaphore wrapper facade for OS platforms that don't implement it natively.

                                                                                                                                                                                class ACE_Thread_Semaphore
{
private:
  ACE_Thread_Mutex mutex_; // Serialize access.
  // Wait for <count_> to become non-zero.
  ACE_Condition_Thread_Mutex count_nonzero_;
  u_long count_; // Keep track of the semaphore count.
  u_long waiters_; // Keeps track of the number of waiters.
public:
  ACE_Thread_Semaphore (u_int count = 1)
    : count_nonzero_ (mutex ), // Associate mutex and condition.
      count_ (count),
      waiters_ (0) {}

                                                                                                                                                                                请注意count_nonzero_的初始化器如何将mutex_对象绑定到自身，这符合第 245 页A.3.4 节中描述的显式关联内聚对象的原则。

                                                                                                                                                                                Note how the initializer for count_nonzero_ binds the mutex_ object to itself, in accordance with the principle of associating cohesive objects explicitly, described in Section A.3.4 on page 245.

                                                                                                                                                                                acquire ()方法会阻塞调用线程，直到信号量计数大于 0，如下所示。

                                                                                                                                                                                The acquire() method blocks the calling thread until the semaphore count becomes greater than 0, as shown below.

                                                                                                                                                                                int acquire () {
  ACE_GUARD_RETURN (ACE_Thread_Mutex, guard, mutex_, -1);
  int result = 0;

  // Count # of waiters so we can signal them in <release()>.
  waiters_++;

  // Put calling thread to sleep waiting on semaphore.
  while (count_ == 0 && result == 0)
    // Release/reacquire <mutex_>
    result = count_nonzero_.wait ();
  --waiters_;
  if (result == 0) --count_; return result;
}

                                                                                                                                                                                为了完整起见，我们在下面实现了ACE_Thread_Semaphore 的 release()方法，该方法会递增信号量计数，从而可能解除等待count_nonzero_条件变量的线程的阻塞。

                                                                                                                                                                                For completeness, we implement the ACE_Thread_Semaphore's release() method below, which increments the semaphore count, potentially unblocking a thread that's waiting on the count_nonzero_ condition variable.

                                                                                                                                                                                  int release () {
    ACE_GUARD_RETURN (ACE_Thread_Mutex, guard, mutex_, -1);

    // Notify waiters that the semaphore has been released.
    if (waiters_ > 0) count_nonzero_.signal ();

    ++count_;
    return 0;
  }
  // ... Other methods omitted ...
};

                                                                                                                                                                                请注意，ACE_Thread_Semaphore类的acquire()和release()方法都使用了ACE_GUARD_RETURN宏（详见第 216 页的侧边栏 22），该宏封装了作用域锁定惯用法 [ SSRB00 ]，以确保互斥锁自动锁定和解锁。这种设计是简化常见情况原则的又一例证（详见第 238 页的A.3 节）。

                                                                                                                                                                                Note how the ACE_Thread_Semaphore class's acquire() and release() methods both use the ACE_GUARD_RETURN macro (described in Sidebar 22 on page 216), which encapsulates the Scoped Locking idiom [SSRB00] to ensure the mutex_ is locked and unlocked automatically. This design is yet another example of the principle of simplifying for the common case (described in Section A.3 on page 238).

                                                                                                                                                                                A.5.3 通过参数化类型处理可变性

                                                                                                                                                                                A.5.3 Handle Variability via Parameterized Types

                                                                                                                                                                                问题： 网络应用程序和中间件通常需要在各种平台上运行，而这些平台的操作系统功能可用性和效率差异很大。例如，某些操作系统平台可能拥有不同的底层网络 API，例如支持 Socket 但不支持 TLI，反之亦然。同样，不同的操作系统平台对这些 API 的实现效率也可能有所不同。在为这类异构平台编写可重用软件时，必须解决以下问题：

                                                                                                                                                                                Problem: Networked applications and middleware often must run on a range of platforms that vary greatly in the availability and efficiency of OS capabilities. For example, certain OS platforms may possess different underlying networking APIs, such as Sockets but not TLI or vice versa. Likewise, different OS platforms may implement these APIs more or less efficiently. When writing reusable software in such heterogeneous platforms, the following forces must be resolved:

                                                                                                                                                                                • 不同的应用程序可能需要不同的中间件策略配置，例如不同的同步或进程间通信（IPC）机制。添加新的或改进的策略应该很简单。理想情况下，每个应用程序函数或类都应该只保留一个副本，以避免版本偏差。

                                                                                                                                                                                • Different applications may require different configurations of middleware strategies, such as different synchronization or IPC mechanisms. Adding new or improved strategies should be straightforward. Ideally, each application function or class should be limited to a single copy to avoid version skew.

                                                                                                                                                                                • 所选的变通机制不应过度影响运行时性能。特别是，继承和动态绑定由于虚方法的间接性，可能会产生额外的运行时开销[ HLS97 ]。

                                                                                                                                                                                • The mechanism selected for variation should not unduly affect runtime performance. In particular, inheritance and dynamic binding can incur additional run-time overhead due to the indirection of virtual methods [HLS97].

                                                                                                                                                                                解决方案：通过参数化类型而非继承和动态绑定来处理可变性。参数化类型使应用程序摆脱对特定策略（例如同步或进程间通信 API）的依赖，而不会产生运行时开销。尽管参数化类型可能会产生编译和链接时开销，但它们通常可以编译成高效的代码 [ Bja00 ]。

                                                                                                                                                                                Solution Handle variability via parameterized types rather than inheritance and dynamic binding. Parameterized types decouple applications from reliance on specific strategies, such as synchronization or IPC APIs, without incurring run-time overhead. Although parameterized types can incur compile- and link-time overhead, they generally compile into efficient code [Bja00].

                                                                                                                                                                                例如，使用 C++ 类（而非独立的 C 函数）封装 Socket API 有助于提高可移植性，因为它允许通过参数化类型全面替换网络编程机制。以下代码通过应用生成式 [ CE00 ] 和泛型 [Ale01] 编程技术来修改echo_server()函数，使其成为 C++ 函数模板，从而阐明了这一原则。

                                                                                                                                                                                For example, encapsulating the Socket API with C++ classes (rather than stand-alone C functions) helps improve portability by allowing the wholesale replacement of network programming mechanisms via parameterized types. The following code illustrates this principle by applying generative [CE00] and generic [Ale01] programming techniques to modify the echo_server() so that it's a C++ function template.

                                                                                                                                                                                template <class ACCEPTOR>
int echo_server (const typename ACCEPTOR::PEER_ADDR &addr)
{
  // Connection factory.
  ACCEPTOR acceptor;
  // Data transfer object.
  typename ACCEPTOR::PEER_STREAM peer_stream;
  // Peer address object.
  typename ACCEPTOR::PEER_ADDR peer_addr;
  int result = 0;

  // Initialize passive mode server and accept new connection.
  if (acceptor.open (addr) != -1
      && acceptor.accept (peer_stream, &peer_addr) != -1) {
    char buf[BUFSIZ];

    for (size_t n; (n = peer_stream.recv (buf, sizeof buf)) > 0;)
      if (peer_stream.send_n (buf, n) != n) {
        result = -1;
        break;
      }

    peer_stream.close ();
  }
  return result;
}

                                                                                                                                                                                通过使用 ACE 和 C++ 模板，可以根据底层操作系统平台的特性，使用 C++ Socket 或 TLI 包装器外观来编写透明的参数化应用程序：

                                                                                                                                                                                By using ACE and C++ templates, applications can be written to be parameterized transparently with either C++ Socket or TLI wrapper facades, depending on the properties of the underlying OS platform:

                                                                                                                                                                                // Conditionally select IPC mechanism.
#if defined (USE_SOCKETS)
typedef ACE_SOCK_Acceptor ACCEPTOR;
#elif defined (USE_TLI)
typedef ACE_TLI_Acceptor ACCEPTOR;
#endif /* USE_SOCKETS. */

int driver_function (u_short port_num)
 {
  // ...

  // Invoke the <echo_server()> with appropriate network
  // programming APIs. Note use of template traits for <addr>.
  typename ACCEPTOR::PEER_ADDR addr (port_num);
  echo_server<ACCEPTOR> (addr);
}

                                                                                                                                                                                这种方法之所以有效，原因如下：

                                                                                                                                                                                This technique works for the following reasons:

                                                                                                                                                                                • ACE C++ Socket 和 TLI 包装器外观类公开了一个具有通用签名的面向对象接口。如果接口最初设计时并未考虑一致性，则可以应用适配器模式 [ GHJV95 ] 来使其保持一致，如A.3.3 节所述。

                                                                                                                                                                                • The ACE C++ Socket and TLI wrapper facade classes expose an object-oriented interface with a common signature. In cases where interfaces aren't originally designed to be consistent, the Adapter pattern [GHJV95] can be applied to make them consistent, as described in Section A.3.3.

                                                                                                                                                                                • C++ 模板支持基于签名的类型一致性，它不需要类型参数来涵盖所有潜在功能。相反，模板参数化应用程序代码，这些代码旨在仅调用各种网络编程方法（例如open()、close()、send()和recv()）通用的方法子集。

                                                                                                                                                                                • C++ templates support signature-based type conformance that does not require type parameters to encompass all potential functionality. Instead, templates parameterize application code that is designed to invoke only a subset of methods that are common to the various network programming methods, such as open(), close(), send(), and recv().

                                                                                                                                                                                总的来说，参数化类型比其他替代方案（例如实现多个版本的echo_server()函数或在应用程序源代码中散布条件编译指令）侵入性更小、可扩展性更强。

                                                                                                                                                                                In general, parameterized types are less intrusive and more extensible than alternatives, such as implementing multiple versions of the echo_server() function or littering conditional compilation directives throughout application source code.

                                                                                                                                                                                  A.6 优化效率

                                                                                                                                                                                  A.6 Optimize for Efficiency

                                                                                                                                                                                  用于高级应用程序和图形用户界面框架的设计原则未必适用于低级网络编程工具包。特别是，性能方面的考虑通常会限制某些语言特性、惯用法和模式的使用，我们将在本节中进行描述。

                                                                                                                                                                                  The design principles used for higher-level applications and GUI frameworks aren't necessarily appropriate for lower-levels of network programming toolkits. In particular, performance considerations often preclude the use of certain languages features, idioms, and patterns, as we describe in this section.

                                                                                                                                                                                  A.6.1 设计提高效率的外立面

                                                                                                                                                                                  A.6.1 Design Wrapper Facades for Efficiency

                                                                                                                                                                                  问题： 尽管面向对象技术和 C++ 语言已成功部署多年，但在某些应用领域，人们仍然普遍认为它们不适用于对性能要求较高的系统。例如，面向对象编程语言的动态绑定和原生异常处理特性在需要可预测运行时行为、低延迟和小资源占用的实时嵌入式应用中可能会带来问题。然而，许多实时应用领域，例如航空航天、呼叫处理、过程控制和分布式交互式仿真，都可以从灵活且可移植的主机基础设施中间件中受益。因此，针对这些领域设计的面向对象软件必须经过精心设计，以避免使用会增加不必要开销的语言特性和模式。

                                                                                                                                                                                  Problem: Despite years of successful deployment, a belief persists in some application domains that object-oriented techniques and C++ are not suitable for performance-sensitive systems. For example, the dynamic binding and native exception handling features of object-oriented programming languages can be problematic in real-time embedded applications that require predictable run-time behavior, low latency, and small footprint. However, many real-time application domains, such as aerospace, call processing, process control, and distributed interactive simulation, can benefit from flexible and portable host infrastructure middleware. It's therefore essential that object-oriented software intended for these domains be designed carefully to avoid language features and patterns that add gratuitous overhead.

                                                                                                                                                                                  为了提高效率，ACE 设计了高效的包装式外观。ACE 使用以下技术来确保其包装式外观的高效性：

                                                                                                                                                                                  Solution Design wrapper facades for efficiency. ACE uses the following techniques to ensure that its wrapper facades are efficient:

                                                                                                                                                                                  • 许多 ACE 包装器外观都是具体类型；也就是说，它们的方法是非虚方法。这种设计消除了动态绑定方法的调度开销，增加了方法内联的机会，并允许在适当的时候将对象放置在共享内存中。

                                                                                                                                                                                  • Many ACE wrapper facades are concrete types; that is, their methods are nonvirtual. This design eliminates the overhead of dispatching dynamically bound methods, increases opportunities for method inlining, and enables objects to be placed in shared memory where appropriate.

                                                                                                                                                                                  • 所有 ACE IPC 包装器外观都包含显式的open()和close()方法，并且它们的析构函数不会关闭句柄。这种设计可以防止在按值传递 I/O 句柄时，因句柄过早关闭而导致的隐性错误。ACE 的包装器外观特意避免使用桥接模式 [ GHJV95 ]，因为这会导致动态内存分配，降低效率，而不是提高效率。相反，我们在 ACE 中应用的原则是不向类层次结构的根级执行某些类型的隐式操作。这些功能由更高层的抽象层在需要时提供。例如，4.4.1 节第 81 页的Logging_Server类在其析构函数中关闭了 acceptor 套接字句柄，这是该抽象级别的常见用例。

                                                                                                                                                                                  • All the ACE IPC wrapper facades contain explicit open() and close() methods and their destructors don't close handles.
