This design prevents subtle errors caused if I/O handles are closed prematurely when transferred by value from one object to another. ACE's wrapper facades purposely avoid the use of the Bridge pattern [GHJV95] since that would incur dynamic memory allocation and reduce efficiency, rather than improve it. Instead, the principle we apply in ACE is to not perform certain types of implicit operations towards the root of class hierarchies. Rather, higher layer abstracts provide these capabilities when needed. For example, the Logging_Server class on page 81 in Section 4.4.1 closes the acceptor socket handle in its destructor, which is the common use case at that level of abstraction.

                                                                                                                                                                                  A.6.2 在线性能关键方法

                                                                                                                                                                                  A.6.2 Inline Performance-Critical Methods

                                                                                                                                                                                  问题： 包装外观（Wrapper facade）通过提供额外的抽象层，增强了原生 C 级函数 API 的可移植性和类型安全性。然而，如果这些包装外观的实现效率不高，许多网络应用程序开发人员就不会选择使用它们，而是会继续使用现有的底层 C 网络 API。网络应用程序通常对时间非常敏感，其开发人员必须密切关注如何降低延迟和提高响应速度，因为网络本身就会加剧这些问题。由于操作系统平台调用通常位于执行路径中对时间要求极高的部分，因此网络应用程序的开发人员往往会对任何可能降低性能的开销保持警惕。

                                                                                                                                                                                  Problem: Wrapper facades enhance the portability and type safety of native C-level function APIs by providing an additional level of abstraction. If these wrapper facades aren't implemented efficiently, however, many networked application developers won't use them in lieu of existing low-level C networking APIs. Networked applications are often time-sensitive, and their developers must be vigilant about reducing latency and improving responsiveness because the network itself already exacerbates these problems. Since OS platform calls are often in time-critical parts of the execution path, developers of networked applications tend to be leery of any overhead that may decrease performance.

                                                                                                                                                                                  解决方案：对性能关键型方法进行内联，以最大程度地减少或消除因类型安全性提高而带来的任何性能开销。ACE 大量使用 C++ 内联来消除其操作系统适配层和 C++ 包装器外观中额外抽象所带来的方法调用开销。关键性能路径中的方法，例如ACE_SOCK_Stream的recv()和send()方法，均被指定为 C++ 内联函数。由于这些方法都很短（例如，每个方法只有 1 到 2 行），因此内联非常节省时间和空间。此外，ACE 在性能关键型部分中谨慎使用虚方法，因为许多 C++ 编译器优化器无法完全消除虚方法的开销 [ HLS97 ]。

                                                                                                                                                                                  Solution Inline performance-critical methods to minimize or eliminate any performance overhead resulting from increased type safety. ACE uses C++ inlining extensively to eliminate method call overhead stemming from the additional abstraction in its OS adaptation layer and C++ wrapper facades. Methods in the critical performance path, such as the recv() and send() methods of ACE_SOCK_Stream, are specified as C++ inline functions. Inlining is time and space efficient since these methods are short (e.g., 1 to 2 lines per method). In addition, virtual methods are used sparingly in the performance-critical parts of ACE since many C++ compiler optimizers don't fully eliminate virtual method overhead [HLS97].

                                                                                                                                                                                  A.6.3 避免在系统级工具包中进行异常处理

                                                                                                                                                                                  A.6.3 Avoid Exception Handling in System-Level Toolkits

                                                                                                                                                                                  问题： 经验丰富的 C++ 程序员会注意到，本书以及 ACE 中的类定义都没有包含异常规范。乍一看，这似乎是一个缺陷，因为处理调用链中的错误指示可能很困难，而这正是 C++ 异常处理机制的主要动机。然而，在系统级工具包中使用原生 C++ 异常处理存在两个问题：

                                                                                                                                                                                  Problem: Experienced C++ programmers will notice that the class definitions throughout the book and in ACE don't contain exception specifications. This may seem a shortcoming at first glance since handling error indications in a call chain can be hard, and is a prime motivation for C++'s exception handling mechanisms. There are two problems, however, with using native C++ exception handling in system-level toolkits:

                                                                                                                                                                                  1. 可移植性 ——ACE 诞生于 1991 年，远早于异常成为 C++ 标准的一部分。即使在今天，编译器对异常的支持也并非完全一致，而且由于遗留依赖关系，并非所有最终用户都能迁移到新的编译器。由于 ACE 必须在各种编译器和平台上运行，任何对原生异常的依赖都会使其在某些环境中无法移植使用。

                                                                                                                                                                                  2. Portability— ACE began in 1991, well before exceptions were a part of the C++ standard. Even today, compilers are not uniform in their support of exceptions, nor can all end users migrate to new compilers due to legacy dependencies. Since ACE must run on a wide range of compilers and platforms, any dependencies on native exceptions would preclude its portable use in some environments.

                                                                                                                                                                                  3. 性能—— 许多编译器带来的时间和空间开销对于某些类型的应用程序来说是不可接受的。例如，原生异常处理所占用的额外内存空间和执行时间对于嵌入式系统中的实时应用程序来说是难以承受的。因此，即使某个平台支持原生异常处理，该平台上的实时和嵌入式应用程序也可能无法使用它。

                                                                                                                                                                                  4. Performance— The time and space overhead incurred by many compilers is unacceptable for certain types of applications. For example, the additional memory space and execution time incurred by native exception handling is prohibitive for real-time applications in embedded systems. Even if a platform supports native exception handling, therefore, real-time and embedded applications on that platform may be unable to use it.

                                                                                                                                                                                  解决方案：避免在系统级工具包中进行异常处理。ACE 不会抛出异常，原因如上所述。它内部使用线程特定存储模式 [ SSRB00 ] 在调用者和被调用者之间传递错误状态信息。这种模式允许线程内的顺序操作以原子方式访问公共数据，而无需为每次访问都增加锁定开销。通过将错误信息放入线程特定存储中，每个线程都可以可靠地设置和测试该线程内操作的状态，而无需使用额外的锁或复杂的同步协议。

                                                                                                                                                                                  Solution Avoid exception handling in system-level toolkits. ACE doesn't throw exceptions for the reasons outlined above. Internally, it uses the Thread-Specific Storage pattern [SSRB00] to convey error status information between caller and callee. This pattern allows sequential operations within a thread to access common data atomically without incurring locking overhead for each access. By placing error information into thread-specific storage, each thread can reliably set and test the status of operations within that thread without using additional locks or complex synchronization protocols.

                                                                                                                                                                                  对于希望在应用程序中使用异常处理的系统，ACE 可以编译时启用原生 C++ 异常支持。对于使用make构建 ACE 的平台，只需在命令行或platform_macros.GNU文件中添加 exceptions=1 即可。

                                                                                                                                                                                  For systems that want to use exceptions in their application software, ACE can be compiled with native C++ exception support. For platforms that use make to build ACE, simply add exceptions=1 to the command line or to the platform_macros.GNU file.

                                                                                                                                                                                    A.7 总结

                                                                                                                                                                                    A.7 Summary

                                                                                                                                                                                    本附录介绍了ACE为实现其目标（即提供0.3.1节讨论的主机基础设施中间件的优势）而遵循的设计原则。其中一些原则在生成式编程社区[ CE00 ]中广为人知，但在网络程序员中却鲜为人知。其他原则在[ SSRB00 ]的包装器外观模式描述中以更抽象的方式进行了阐述。由于ACE体现了经过深思熟虑且久经考验的设计基础，因此它是一个灵活、强大且可移植的工具包，已帮助数千个项目避免了本书讨论的意外复杂性所带来的陷阱。

                                                                                                                                                                                    This appendix presented design principles followed throughout ACE to achieve its goals of providing the benefits of host infrastructure middleware discussed in Section 0.3.1. Some of these principles are well known in the generative programming community [CE00], but aren't widely known to network programmers. Other principles are described more abstractly in the Wrapper Facade pattern description in [SSRB00]. Due to the well-considered and time-proven design fundamentals embodied in ACE, it's a flexible, powerful, and portable toolkit that's helped thousands of projects avoid the pitfalls associated with the accidental complexities discussed in this book.

                                                                                                                                                                                      附录B. ACE的过去、现在和未来

                                                                                                                                                                                      Appendix B. The Past, Present, and Future of ACE

                                                                                                                                                                                      概要

                                                                                                                                                                                      Synopsis

                                                                                                                                                                                      本附录简要回顾了ACE的发展历程，阐述了其诞生和过去十年来的开源演变。随后，我们概述了基于ACE并与之捆绑的、符合标准的中间件。最后，我们展望了ACE的未来发展方向。

                                                                                                                                                                                      This appendix presents a briezf history of ACE that explains its inception and open-source evolution over the past decade. We then outline the standards-based middleware based on—and bundled with—ACE. We close by discussing where we see ACE heading in the future.

                                                                                                                                                                                        B.1 ACE的演变

                                                                                                                                                                                        B.1 The Evolution of ACE

                                                                                                                                                                                        开源运动的先驱之一埃里克·雷蒙德 (Eric Raymond) [ O'R98 ] 常说：“所有优秀的软件作品都始于解决开发者的个人痛点” [ Ray01 ]。虽然并非总是如此，但这句话无疑适用于 ACE。本节将介绍 ACE 的发展历程——从最初旨在简化单个研究人员工作的工具，发展成为世界上最便携、应用最广泛的 C++ 网络编程工具包之一。

                                                                                                                                                                                        Eric Raymond, a pioneer of the open-source movement [O'R98], is fond of saying that "Every good work of software starts by scratching a developer's personal itch" [Ray01]. While this isn't always the case, it certainly applies to ACE. This section describes the evolution of ACE—from its origins as a tool to simplify the life of a single researcher to one of the most portable and widely used C++ network programming toolkits in the world.

                                                                                                                                                                                        B.1.1 形成期的渴望

                                                                                                                                                                                        B.1.1 The Formative Itch

                                                                                                                                                                                        1990 年，道格·施密特 (Doug Schmidt) 暂时中断了他在加州大学尔湾分校 (UCI) 的博士学习，前往硅谷一家名为 Independence Technologies Inc. (ITI) 的初创公司工作。该公司最终被 BEA Systems, Inc. 收购。ITI 专注于基于 UNIX 的在线事务处理 (OLTP)，这在 1990 年还是一项新技术。正是在 ITI，道格接触到了理查德·史蒂文斯 (Richard Stevens) 的经典著作《UNIX 网络编程》，他吸收了书中的知识，并将其应用于开发一个用 C 和 C++ 编写的 OLTP 中间件平台。

                                                                                                                                                                                        In 1990, Doug Schmidt took a break from his doctorate studies at the University of California, Irvine (UCI) to work at a Silicon Valley start-up company called Independence Technologies Inc. (ITI), which was ultimately bought by BEA Systems, Inc. ITI specialized in UNIX-based online transaction processing (OLTP), which was a novelty in 1990. It was at ITI that Doug was exposed to Richard Stevens's classic book UNIX Network Programming, which Doug absorbed and applied to help develop an OLTP middleware platform written in C and C++.

                                                                                                                                                                                        1991年，道格回到加州大学尔湾分校完成他的并发网络协议处理博士论文[ SS95 ]。他的博士项目专注于动态组装协议转换、集成和评估环境（ADAPTIVE）的设计和优化[ SBS93 ]。ADAPTIVE提供了可定制的轻量级自适应协议机器，有助于提高端到端应用程序性能并降低传输系统开销[ SS93 ]。

                                                                                                                                                                                        In 1991 Doug returned to UCI to finish his dissertation on concurrent networking protocol processing [SS95]. His doctorate project focused on the design and optimization of A Dynamically Assembled Protocol Transformation, Integration, and evaluation Environment (ADAPTIVE) [SBS93]. ADAPTIVE provided customizable lightweight and adaptive protocol machines that helped improve end-to-end application performance and reduce transport system overhead [SS93].

                                                                                                                                                                                        20 世纪 90 年代初期，编写 ADAPTIVE 等系统软件时，存在两个令人头疼的意外复杂性来源：

                                                                                                                                                                                        In the early 1990s there were two vexing sources of accidental complexity associated with writing systems software such as ADAPTIVE:

                                                                                                                                                                                        1. ADAPTIVE 中的协议代码采用面向对象的设计技术和 C++ 编写。然而，在访问操作系统资源（例如进程、线程、锁、套接字、共享内存、DLL 和文件）时，必须改用 C 函数 API 和算法设计。

                                                                                                                                                                                        2. The protocol code in ADAPTIVE was written using object-oriented design techniques and C++. It was necessary to revert to C function APIs and algorithmic design, however, when accessing OS resources, such as processes, threads, locks, sockets, shared memory, DLLs, and files.

                                                                                                                                                                                        3. 为了处理常见的网络编程任务，例如连接建立、同步事件解复用和分发、同步和并发架构，必须多次编写相同的“样板”代码。

                                                                                                                                                                                        4. The same "boilerplate" code had to be written numerous times to handle common network programming tasks, such as connection establishment, synchronous event demultiplexing and dispatching, synchronization, and concurrency architectures.

                                                                                                                                                                                        自适应通信环境 (ACE) 的创建旨在解决这两个难题。ACE 的第一个公开版本于 1992 年发布，可在 SunOS 4.x 和 5.x 上运行。它约 10,000 行代码结合了 C++ 特性、高级操作系统机制和模式，提供了一个可扩展且高效的面向对象网络软件开发工具包。

                                                                                                                                                                                        The ADAPTIVE Communication Environment (ACE) was created to resolve these two frustrations. The first publicly available release of ACE in 1992 ran on SunOS 4.x and 5.x. Its roughly 10,000 lines of code combined C++ features, advanced OS mechanisms, and patterns to provide an extensible and efficient object-oriented networking software development toolkit.

                                                                                                                                                                                        如果 Doug 没有采用开源分发模式发布 ACE，那么在他完成博士学位后，ACE 很可能就会销声匿迹。幸运的是，他多年来一直为自由软件社区做出贡献，曾与 Doug Lea 共同编写了 GNU GPERF 完美哈希函数生成器 [ Sch90 ] 和 GNU LIBG++ 库的部分代码 [ Lea88 ]。因此，他深知围绕开源流程和工具构建社区 [ SP01 ] 的益处。开源开发模式的一个关键优势在于其可扩展至庞大用户社区的能力，在这个社区中，应用程序开发人员和最终用户可以共同参与许多质量保证、文档编写和支持活动。

                                                                                                                                                                                        Had Doug not released ACE using an open-source distribution model, it would likely have faded away after he finished his doctorate. Fortunately, he'd been contributing to the free software community for many years, having written the GNU GPERF perfect hash function generator [Sch90] and parts of the GNU LIBG++ library along with Doug Lea [Lea88]. He was therefore familiar with the benefits of building a community [SP01] around open-source processes and tools. A key strength of open-source development models is their ability to scale to large user communities, where application developers and end users can assist with many quality assurance, documentation, and support activities.

                                                                                                                                                                                        B.1.2 转折点

                                                                                                                                                                                        B.1.2 The Turning Point

                                                                                                                                                                                        到 1994 年，ACE 技术已经发展成熟，并被应用于数十个商业项目中，包括爱立信 [ SS94 ] 和铱星 [ Sch00 ] 的网络管理。与此同时，道格成为圣路易斯华盛顿大学的助理教授。这一转变恰逢商业界对使用中间件来提升网络应用软件的可移植性和灵活性产生了浓厚的兴趣。

                                                                                                                                                                                        By 1994, ACE had matured to the point where it was being used in several dozen commercial projects, including network management at Ericsson [SS94] and Iridium [Sch00]. At that point, Doug became an Assistant Professor at Washington University, St. Louis. This transition coincided with a surge of commercial interest in using middleware to help improve networked application software portability and flexibility.

                                                                                                                                                                                        ACE项目凭借其优越的地理位置，成功搭上了中间件早期发展浪潮的顺风车。因此，道格和他在华盛顿大学的研究团队获得了众多富有远见的赞助商的资助，其中包括ATDesk、BBN、波音、思科、DARPA、爱立信、休斯、Icomverse、铱星、柯达、克朗斯、洛克希德·马丁、朗讯、摩托罗拉、诺基亚、北电网络、美国国家科学基金会（NSF）、雷神、SAIC、西门子医疗、西门子SCR、西门子中电、Sprint和Telcordia。这些赞助商意识到，如果他们要独立地重新发现并开发针对其核心网络应用软件挑战的临时解决方案，成本和时间都过于高昂。幸运的是，ACE项目的参与者已经识别、记录并提炼出了应对这些挑战的关键模式和框架，道格的赞助商随后应用这些模式和框架，从而减少了开发和维护其网络应用过程中许多繁琐且成本高昂的环节。

                                                                                                                                                                                        ACE was well positioned to surf the early wave of interest in middleware. As a result, Doug and his research group at Washington University received funding from many visionary sponsors, including ATDesk, BBN, Boeing, Cisco, DARPA, Ericsson, Hughes, Icomverse, Iridium, Kodak, Krones, Lockheed Martin, Lucent, Motorola, Nokia, Nortel, NSF, Raytheon, SAIC, Siemens MED, Siemens SCR, Siemens ZT, Sprint, and Telcordia. These sponsors recognized that it was too costly and time consuming for them to independently rediscover and reinvent ad hoc solutions to their core networked application software challenges. Fortunately, the participants on the ACE project had identified, documented, and reified key patterns and frameworks to address these challenges, which Doug's sponsors then applied to reduce many tedious and expensive aspects of developing and maintaining their networked applications.

                                                                                                                                                                                        在接下来的六年里，约700万美元的赞助资金使道格得以聘请数十名研究生和全职员工。这些人中许多都在圣路易斯华盛顿大学的分布式对象计算（DOC）小组工作多年，现在又回到加州大学尔湾分校，道格本人也以终身副教授的身份在该校电子与计算机工程系任教。DOC小组共同取得了以下成就：

                                                                                                                                                                                        Over the next six years, around U.S.$7 million of sponsor funding enabled Doug to hire dozens of graduate students and full-time staff. Many of these people have worked for years in the Distributed Object Computing (DOC) Groups at Washington University in St. Louis, and now at UCI, where Doug has returned as a tenured Associate Professor in the Electrical and Computer Engineering department. Together, the DOC groups have:

                                                                                                                                                                                        1. 极大地扩展了 ACE 的功能，其规模约为原来的 25 倍，并包含数百个额外的类和框架。

                                                                                                                                                                                        2. Greatly expanded the capabilities of ACE, which is about 25 times its original size and contains hundreds more classes and frameworks.

                                                                                                                                                                                        3. 将 ACE 移植到数十个新的操作系统/编译器平台，这些平台在第 14 页的侧边栏 1中有总结。

                                                                                                                                                                                        4. Ported ACE to dozens of new OS/compiler platforms, which are summarized in Sidebar 1 on page 14.

                                                                                                                                                                                        5. 撰写了大量杂志文章和技术论文，详细描述了ACE工具包中封装外观和框架的模式和性能。这些论文可以从http://www.cs.wustl.edu/~schmidt/publications.html下载，方便全球开发者评估ACE的范围和质量，从而确定它如何才能最好地满足自身需求。

                                                                                                                                                                                        6. Written scores of magazine articles and technical papers that describe the patterns and performance of the wrapper facades and frameworks in the ACE toolkit. The ability to download these papers from http://www.cs.wustl.edu/~schmidt/publications.html enabled worldwide developers to assess the scope and quality of ACE to determine how it could best meet their needs.

                                                                                                                                                                                        DOC Group 的成员和 ACE 用户社区在将 ACE 从一名研究人员的个人爱好发展成为世界上使用最广泛的 C++ 框架之一方面发挥了重要作用，该框架用于在各种硬件和软件平台上进行并发面向对象的网络编程。

                                                                                                                                                                                        The members of the DOC Group and the ACE user community have been instrumental in transitioning ACE from the personal hobby of a single researcher into one of the world's most widely used C++ frameworks for concurrent object-oriented network programming across a wide range of hardware and software platforms.

                                                                                                                                                                                        B.1.3 跨越鸿沟

                                                                                                                                                                                        B.1.3 Crossing the Chasm

                                                                                                                                                                                        1996年，当道格和他在华盛顿大学的团队致力于ACE 3.x版本的开发时，史蒂夫·休斯顿则从事咨询和网络应用开发工作。在一个项目中，他需要一款C++网络软件来满足紧迫的开发进度。通过网络搜索，他找到了ACE。不幸的是，ACE并没有移植到该项目的平台（Unixware）。然而，如果没有ACE提供的功能，该项目注定失败，因此史蒂夫开始着手将其移植到Unixware平台。将ACE移植到新平台、学习足够的ACE知识以完成这项工作，以及开发系统，所花费的时间比史蒂夫从头开始编写所需的网络软件的时间还要少。新系统运行高效，这成为了众多ACE成功案例中的第一个[ Gro ]。

                                                                                                                                                                                        While Doug and his group at Washington University were working on ACE version 3.x in 1996, Steve Huston was doing consulting and networked application development. In one project he needed C++ networking software to meet an aggressive development schedule. A Web search yielded ACE. Unfortunately, ACE wasn't ported to the project's platform (Unixware). The project was doomed without the capabilities ACE provided, however, so Steve began the port to Unixware. The time to port ACE to a new platform, learn enough about ACE to do the job, and then develop the system was less than it would have taken Steve to write the necessary networking software from scratch. The new system performed efficiently and the result was the first of many ACE success stories [Gro].

                                                                                                                                                                                        意识到ACE的巨大潜力，史蒂夫密切关注着DOC Group和ACE邮件列表。尽管ACE不断改进，但其用户仍然主要集中在研究人员和工业研发团队。ACE的实用性太强，不能仅仅局限于研究人员，史蒂夫也意识到，要让ACE跨越鸿沟[ Moo91 ]，惠及主流商业软件开发人员，就必须提供高质量的支持。1996年末，史蒂夫开始着手准备，到1997年中期，他将公司更名为Riverace Corporation（http://www.riverace.com），并专注于提供支持和产品服务，使ACE更易于学习和应用。

                                                                                                                                                                                        Realizing the gains achievable with ACE, Steve kept an eye on the DOC Group and the ACE mailing list. Although ACE improved continually, it was still used mostly by researchers and industrial R&D groups. While ACE was too practical to be left solely in the hands of researchers, Steve recognized that high-quality support was needed in order for ACE to cross the chasm [Moo91] to support mainstream commercial software developers. The wheels started turning late in 1996 and by mid-1997 Steve had renamed his company Riverace Corporation (http://www.riverace.com) and focused it on support and product services that make ACE easier to learn and apply.

                                                                                                                                                                                        如今，Riverace 提供支持和咨询服务，帮助企业在其开发项目中充分利用 ACE。该公司持续提升 ACE 作为开源产品的质量，并提供商业级的支持，助力 ACE 在全球企业软件开发领域得到更广泛的应用。ACE 现在拥有商业软件的外观和体验，并且所有优势均无需支付任何运行时或开发者许可费用。侧边栏 24概述了 ACE 使用的开源许可。

                                                                                                                                                                                        Today, Riverace provides support and consulting services that help companies make the best use of ACE in their development projects. The company continues to improve the quality of ACE as an open-source product, providing a level of commercial support that's helping to expand ACE's use into enterprise software development worldwide. ACE now has the "look and feel" of commercial software, and all of its benefits come without any run-time or developer licensing fees. Sidebar 24 outlines the open-source license used for ACE.

                                                                                                                                                                                        侧边栏 24：ACE 开源许可证

                                                                                                                                                                                        Sidebar 24: The ACE Open-Source License

                                                                                                                                                                                        ACE 开源许可证类似于所谓的BSD UNIX开源许可证。用户可以永久且不可撤销地使用、修改、复制和分发 ACE 源代码和由此生成的目标代码，以及复制和分发此软件的修改版本。尤其需要注意的是，ACE 可用于专有软件，用户没有义务重新分发任何使用 ACE 构建或衍生自 ACE 的源代码。完整的 ACE 版权和许可信息可在 ACE 发行版中的 $ACE_ROOT/COPYING 文件中找到。

                                                                                                                                                                                        The ACE open-source license is similar to the so-called BSD UNIX open-source license. Users are free to use, modify, copy, and distribute, perpetually and irrevocably, the ACE source code and object code produced from the source, as well as copy and distribute modified versions of this software. In particular, ACE can be used in proprietary software and users are under no obligation to redistribute any source code that's built with or derived from ACE. Complete copyright and licensing information for ACE is available in the file $ACE_ROOT/COPYING In the ACE release.

                                                                                                                                                                                        B.1.4 中间件标准

                                                                                                                                                                                        B.1.4 Middleware Standards

                                                                                                                                                                                        到了20世纪90年代后期，信息技术显然正在走向商品化；也就是说，关键的硬件和软件产品正以越来越可预测的速度变得更快、更便宜、更好。过去十年，我们都受益于硬件（例如CPU和存储设备）以及网络元件（例如IP路由器）的商品化。而最近，由于以下标准的成熟，许多软件层和组件也正在走向商品化：

                                                                                                                                                                                        Toward the latter half of the 1990s, information technology was clearly becoming commoditized; that is, key hardware and software artifacts were getting faster, cheaper, and better at an increasingly predictable pace. For the past decade we've all benefited from the commoditization of hardware, such as CPUs and storage devices, and networking elements, such as IP routers. More recently, many software layers and components are becoming commoditized due to the maturation of the following standards:

                                                                                                                                                                                        • 编程语言，例如 Java 和 C++

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Programming languages, such as Java and C++

                                                                                                                                                                                        • 操作系统环境，例如 POSIX 和 Java 虚拟机以及

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Operating environments, such as POSIX and Java virtual machines and

                                                                                                                                                                                        • 中间件，例如 CORBA、企业级 Java Beans 和 .NET Web 服务 [ SS01 ]。

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Middleware, such as CORBA, Enterprise Java Beans, and the .NET Web services [SS01].

                                                                                                                                                                                        这些软件产品商品化的后果是，长期以来受到高准入门槛保护的行业（如电信和航空航天）更容易受到颠覆性技术[ Chr97 ]和全球竞争的影响，这可能导致价格降至边际成本。

                                                                                                                                                                                        A consequence of the commoditization of these software artifacts is that industries long protected by high barriers to entry, such as telecom and aerospace, are more vulnerable to disruptive technologies [Chr97] and global competition, which can drive prices to marginal cost.

                                                                                                                                                                                        由于道格认为软件行业的长期成功取决于实用开放标准的采用，他启动了两个衍生项目，致力于将ACE的研究成果转化为开放的中间件标准。本节将介绍这些衍生项目的成果，最终产生了两个基于标准的中间件工具包——TAO和JAWS，如图B.1所示。TAO和JAWS是利用ACE提供的封装外观和框架开发的，具体内容如下所述。

                                                                                                                                                                                        Since Doug felt that the long-term success of the software industry depends on the adoption of useful open standards, he began two spin-off projects that focused on transitioning the ACE research into open middleware standards. This section describes the results of these spin-off efforts, which yielded the two standards-based middleware toolkits—TAO and JAWS—shown in Figure B.1. TAO and JAWS were developed using the wrapper facades and frameworks provided by ACE, as described below.

                                                                                                                                                                                        图 B.1. 基于 ACE 的标准兼容中间件

                                                                                                                                                                                        ACE ORB（TAO）

                                                                                                                                                                                        TAO 是 CORBA 规范 [ SLM98 ]的高性能实时实现。它包含如图 B.1 (1)所示的网络接口、操作系统、网络协议和 CORBA 中间件功能。TAO 中使用的许多模式在 [ SC00 ] 中有描述。与 ACE 一样，TAO 是开源软件，可从 URL http://ace.ece.uci.edu/TAO免费下载。

                                                                                                                                                                                        TAO is a high-performance, real-time implementation of the CORBA specification [SLM98]. It contains the network interface, OS, networking protocol, and CORBA middleware capabilities shown in Figure B.1 (1). Many of the patterns used in TAO are described in [SC00]. Like ACE, TAO is open-source software, which is freely available for download at the URL http://ace.ece.uci.edu/TAO.

                                                                                                                                                                                        DOC集团在TAO方面的工作在多项标准化工作中发挥了重要作用：

                                                                                                                                                                                        The DOC Group's work on TAO has played an important role in several standardization efforts:

                                                                                                                                                                                        • 它影响了 OMG 的实时 CORBA 规范 [ Obj01 ]，特别是其显式绑定和可移植同步器功能。

                                                                                                                                                                                        • It influenced the OMG's real-time CORBA specification [Obj01], particularly its explicit binding and portable synchronizer features.

                                                                                                                                                                                        • 它已被选为国防信息系统局 (DISA) 联合战术架构 (JTA) 在国防信息系统卓越中心 (DII COE) 中选定的两个作战参考站 (ORB) 之一。

                                                                                                                                                                                        • It has been included as one of two ORBs selected for DISA's Joint Tactical Architecture (JTA) in the DII COE.

                                                                                                                                                                                        • 它已被用作 DMSO HLA/RTI 分布式交互式模拟标准的基础 [ OSLN99 ]。

                                                                                                                                                                                        • It has been used as the basis for the DMSO HLA/RTI distributed interactive simulations standard [OSLN99].

                                                                                                                                                                                        如今，TAO 已在全球数百个研究和商业项目中得到应用，涵盖航空航天、电信、仿真、医疗保健、科学计算和金融服务等领域。它也是首个成功在战斗机上飞行的 CORBA ORB 系统 [ Lac98 ]。TAO 由 OCI（http://www.theaceorb.com）提供支持，采用与 River-ace 类似的开源许可和商业模式。

                                                                                                                                                                                        Today, TAO is used in hundreds of research and commercial projects in the aerospace, telecommunication, simulation, health care, scientific computing, and financial services domains around the world. It has the distinction of being the first CORBA ORB flown successfully in a fighter aircraft [Lac98]. TAO is supported by OCI (http://www.theaceorb.com) using an open-source license and business model that's similar to River-ace's.

                                                                                                                                                                                        JAWS自适应Web服务器（JAWS）

                                                                                                                                                                                        JAWS 是一个高性能、自适应的 Web 服务器 [ HS99 ]，它基于 ACE 框架构建，并实现了 HTTP 1.0 规范。图 B.1 (2) 展示了 JAWS 的主要结构组件和模式。JAWS 采用框架嵌套的框架结构。整个 JAWS 框架包含以下组件和框架：

                                                                                                                                                                                        JAWS is a high-performance, adaptive Web server [HS99] built using the ACE frameworks. It implements the HTTP 1.0 specification. Figure B.1 (2) illustrates the major structural components and patterns in JAWS. JAWS is structured as a framework of frameworks. The overall JAWS framework contains the following components and frameworks:

                                                                                                                                                                                        • 并发策略，即实现诸如每个请求一个线程和线程池之类的并发机制，可以在运行时自适应地选择，也可以在初始化时预先选择；

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Concurrency strategies, which implement concurrency mechanisms such as thread per request and thread pool, that can be selected adaptively at run time or preselected at initialization time;

                                                                                                                                                                                        • I/O 策略，实现各种 I/O 机制，例如异步 I/O、同步 I/O 和反应式 I/O；

                                                                                                                                                                                        • I/O strategies, which implement various I/O mechanisms, such as asynchronous, synchronous, and reactive I/O;

                                                                                                                                                                                        • 事件调度器，用于协调 JAWS 的 I/O 和并发策略之间的事件处理；

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Event dispatcher, which coordinates the handling of events between JAWS's I/O and concurrency strategies;

                                                                                                                                                                                        • 协议处理程序，用于实现 HTTP 请求的解析和处理；

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Protocol handlers, which implement the parsing and handling of HTTP requests;

                                                                                                                                                                                        • 协议管道允许轻松地将过滤操作与协议处理程序正在处理的数据相结合；

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Protocol pipeline, which allows filter operations to be incorporated easily with the data being processed by protocol handlers; and

                                                                                                                                                                                        • 缓存虚拟文件系统通过缓存策略（例如最近最少使用 (LRU)和最不常用 (LFU)）来减少文件系统访问的开销，从而提高 Web 服务器性能。

                                                                                                                                                                                        • Cached virtual filesystem, which improves Web server performance by reducing the overhead of filesystem accesses via caching strategies, such as least recently used (LRU) and least frequently used (LFU).

                                                                                                                                                                                        这些框架均由一组协作对象构成，这些对象通过组合和扩展 ACE 中的组件来实现。JAWS 的构成模式在 [ SSRB00 ] 中有详细描述。与 ACE 和 TAO 一样，JAWS 也被广泛应用于许多商业项目中。它也是开源软件，随 ACE 版本一起分发，位于$ACE_ROOT/apps/目录中。

                                                                                                                                                                                        Each of these frameworks is structured as a set of collaborating objects implemented by combining and extending components in ACE. The patterns constituting JAWS are described in [SSRB00]. Like ACE and TAO, JAWS is used in many commercial projects. It's also open-source software—distributed with the ACE release in the $ACE_ROOT/apps/directory.

                                                                                                                                                                                        ACE 对 TAO 和 JAWS 的成功至关重要。此外，技术发展也具有协同效应。例如，TAO 和 JAWS 的实现和重构过程[ FBB + 99 ]催生了许多新的类，同时也改进和优化了 ACE 中的许多类和框架。

                                                                                                                                                                                        ACE has been fundamental to the success of TAO and JAWS. Moreover, the flow of technology has been synergistic. For example, the process of implementing and refactoring [FBB+99] TAO and JAWS has yielded many new classes, as well as refined and optimized many classes and frameworks in ACE.

                                                                                                                                                                                        B.1.5 开源软件的影响

                                                                                                                                                                                        B.1.5 The Impact of Open Source

                                                                                                                                                                                        ACE开源社区拥有数以千计的开发者和最终用户。如果没有他们的支持，ACE不太可能取得如今的成功，原因如下：

                                                                                                                                                                                        There are thousands of developers and end users in the ACE open-source community. Without their support it's unlikely that ACE would have been as successful as it has for the following reasons:

                                                                                                                                                                                        缺乏足够的资金投入。ACE +TAO 的开发耗费了超过 100 人年的精力。假设传统公司每人年的成本约为 20 万美元的薪资和福利，那么如果采用传统的闭源开发模式，这项工作将需要约 2000 万美元的资金。正如第 261 页所述，DOC 各小组的赞助者仅花费了这笔费用的三分之一就开发出了 ACE+TAO。剩余的大部分资金都来自 ACE+TAO 开源社区的时间和精力贡献。

                                                                                                                                                                                        Lack of sufficient capital investment. Over 100 person-years of effort have been expended to develop ACE+TAO. Assuming that each person-year costs a conventional company around U.S.$200 thousand in salary and benefits, this effort would have required around U.S.$20 million in funding using a conventional closed-source development model. As mentioned on page 261, it cost the DOC groups' sponsors only one-third of this amount to develop ACE+TAO. Much of the difference was made up by contributions of time and effort by the ACE+TAO open-source community.

                                                                                                                                                                                        缺乏短期投资回报。ACE 花了数年时间才成熟到可以用于生产系统的程度。例如，许多 ACE 框架需要多次迭代才能确定合适的 API、模式和关系。很少有公司或风险投资家愿意在一个中间件项目上投入如此长的时间，尤其是在最终成果是免费提供的情况下！

                                                                                                                                                                                        Lack of short-term return on investment. It took several years for ACE to mature to a point where it could be used for production systems. For example, many ACE framework required multiple iterations to determine the appropriate APIs, patterns, and relationships. Few companies or venture capitalists would be willing to invest in a middleware project for this long, particularly when the end result was given away for free!

                                                                                                                                                                                        缺乏时间、兴趣和可用平台。 开发高度可移植的中间件需要投入大量精力处理相对“琐碎”的任务，例如确保软件能够在数十种编译器和操作系统平台上顺利构建和运行。即使核心开发团队拥有足够的时间和兴趣（这在长期资金不足的先进研发环境中不太可能），获取创建和维护所有这些移植版本所需的所有硬件/软件平台也将是一笔极其昂贵的开支。幸运的是，开源模式使得 DOC 团队能够利用网络上丰富的人力和计算资源，从而确保许多琐碎的任务能够及时、经济地完成 [ SP01 ]。

                                                                                                                                                                                        Lack of time, interest, and available platforms. Developing highly portable middleware requires a substantial amount of effort on relatively "mundane" tasks, such as ensuring that the software builds and runs cleanly on dozens of compilers and OS platforms. Even if a core group of developers had sufficient time and interest (which is unlikely in chronically underfunded advanced R&D environments), it would be prohibitively expensive to obtain all the necessary hardware/software platforms necessary to create and maintain all these ports. Fortunately, the open-source model allowed the DOC groups to leverage the vast human and computing resources available on the Web to ensure that many mundane tasks were completed in a timely and economical manner [SP01].

                                                                                                                                                                                        缺乏广泛的技术专长。ACE 的发展得益于世界各地中间件专家的软件贡献和指导。Doug 在 20 世纪 80 年代后期曾参与 GNU C 和 C++ 项目，与 Richard Stallman、Doug Lea 和 Michael Tiemann 等自由软件先驱共事。因此，当他开始开发 ACE 时，他深知建立一个技术专家社区来增强和支持软件工具包功能的重要性。

                                                                                                                                                                                        Lack of broad technical expertise. ACE has benefited greatly from software contributions and guidance from middleware experts throughout the world. Doug had been involved in the GNU C and C++ projects during the latter years of the 1980s along with free software pioneers, such as Richard Stallman, Doug Lea, and Michael Tiemann. When he started developing ACE he therefore understood the value of creating a community of technical experts to augment and support the capabilities of a software toolkit.

                                                                                                                                                                                        1991年，ACE的第一个可用版本完成后，便可通过匿名FTP下载——当时HTTP和我们今天所知的Web都还不存在。这立即催生了一个小型用户社区，他们帮助修复漏洞并将ACE移植到新平台，从而强化了自由软件的价值——“开源”这个词在当时也还不存在！

                                                                                                                                                                                        As soon as the first working build of ACE was complete in 1991 it was available for anonymous ftp—HTTP and the Web as we know it today didn't exist at that point. This immediately spawned a small user community to help fix bugs and port ACE to new platforms, thereby reinforcing the value of free software—the term "open source" did not exist at that point either!

                                                                                                                                                                                          B.2 前路漫漫

                                                                                                                                                                                          B.2 The Road Ahead

                                                                                                                                                                                          我们将在未来的工作重点放在ACE项目上，具体如下：

                                                                                                                                                                                          We're focusing our future efforts on ACE as follows:

                                                                                                                                                                                          改进的文档。ACE 文档的匮乏及其缺乏全面易用性在一定程度上阻碍了其主流应用。目前正在开展一项大规模、多方面的工作来解决这个问题，并且未来仍将重点关注此问题。2000 年，Carlos O'Ryan 和 Darrell Brunsch 在加州大学尔湾分校 (UCI) 牵头开展了一项工作，将 ACE 的参考资料生成方式转换为 Doxygen [ Dim01 ]。Doxygen 能更好地表达 ACE 的用法，生成的参考资料也更易于使用。改进后的参考资料，以及即将出版的《ACE 程序员指南》 [ HJS ] 和《C++ 网络编程，第二卷：使用 ACE 和框架进行系统性重用》 [ SH ]，将帮助更多 C++ 开发人员充分利用 ACE 的强大功能和灵活性。

                                                                                                                                                                                          Improved documentation. ACE's lack of comprehensive and easy-to-use documentation has impeded its mainstream success somewhat. A large, multifaceted effort to remedy this problem is underway and will continue to be a focus in the future. In 2000, Carlos O'Ryan and Darrell Brunsch spearheaded an effort at UCI to convert ACE's reference material generation to Doxygen [Dim01]. Doxygen provides better expression of ACE's usage and the resulting reference material is much easier to use. The improved reference material and the upcoming publication of The ACE Programmer's Guide [HJS] and C++ Network Programming, Volume 2: Systematic Reuse with ACE and Frameworks [SH] will help many more C++ developers make the most of ACE's power and flexibility.

                                                                                                                                                                                          全新及升级平台。 我们将继续改进和扩展 ACE，以支持现有操作系统的新版本。我们将探索新的平台，主要依据 ACE 用户社区和 Riverace 客户的兴趣和需求。ACE 的 C++ 功能使用也将不断扩展。ACE 可与大多数 C++ 编译器兼容，包括一些 Cfront 时代的编译器。随着时间的推移，越来越多的编译器遵循 C++ 标准，ACE 的“编译器支持窗口”将会缩小，而不是扩大。这种演变将使 ACE 能够利用现代 C++ 标准特性，例如原生异常、部分模板特化、模板成员函数和标准 C++ 库。

                                                                                                                                                                                          New and updated platforms. We will continue to improve and extend ACE to support new releases of its existing operating systems. New platforms will be explored, driven primarily by interest and demand from the ACE user community and Riverace customers. ACE's C++ feature usage will also expand. ACE works with most C++ compilers, some from the days of Cfront. As time goes on and more compilers adhere to the C++ standard, ACE's "window of compiler support" will slide, instead of being enlarged. This evolution will allow ACE to leverage modern C++ standard features, such as native exceptions, partial template specialization, template member functions, and the Standard C++ Library.

                                                                                                                                                                                          增强的稳定性。ACE 拥有一套全面的回归测试，每天在数十个平台上持续运行。这些测试能够自动检测编译错误、配置错误、运行时错误和内存错误。您可以随时通过访问http://ace.ece.uci.edu/scoreboard/查看这些回归测试的输出结果，从而了解 ACE 的最新状态。由于 ACE 是一个大型软件，我们将不断扩展其回归测试功能，以确保其质量和稳定性持续提升。

                                                                                                                                                                                          Increased robustness. ACE has an extensive set of regression tests that run on dozens of platforms continuously each day. These tests automatically detect compilation errors, configuration errors, run-time errors, and memory errors. At any point in time, you can keep track of the status of ACE by examining the output of these regression tests at http://ace.ece.uci.edu/scoreboard/. Since ACE is a large piece of software, we'll keep expanding its regression testing capabilities to ensure that its quality and robustness continue to improve.

                                                                                                                                                                                          降低内存占用。 在常见的操作系统平台上，核心 ACE 库的大小在 700KB 到 1.5MB 之间，如果使用完整的调试信息构建，则体积会显著增大。在某些环境中，尤其是在内存受限的嵌入式系统 [ NW01 ] 中，ACE 的内存占用可能会成为瓶颈。因此，我们着手开展一项工作，旨在支持构建 ACE 的子集，使应用程序只需承担所需部分的内存开销，而无需承担其他部分的开销。有关 ACE 子集构建工作的更多信息，请参阅ACE 软件版本中的$ACE_ROOT/docs/ACE-subsets.html 文件。

                                                                                                                                                                                          Reduced memory footprint. The core ACE library's size ranges from 700KB to 1.5MB on common OS platforms, and is significantly larger when built with full debugging information. In some environments, particularly memory-constrained embedded systems [NW01], the memory footprint of ACE can be a hindrance. We have therefore embarked on an effort that enables subsets of ACE to be built so applications only incur the memory overhead for parts they need, without incurring overhead for parts they don't. For more information on the ACE subsetting effort see $ACE_ROOT/docs/ACE-subsets.html in the ACE software release.

                                                                                                                                                                                          如果您有兴趣参与这些项目，请告诉我们！

                                                                                                                                                                                          Let us know if you're interested in getting involved in these projects!

                                                                                                                                                                                            B.3 总结性发言

                                                                                                                                                                                            B.3 Concluding Remarks

                                                                                                                                                                                            过去十年，我们致力于网络应用研发的诸多方面，从基础学术研究到实际产品开发和咨询，无所不包。根据我们的经验，将先进的软件研发技术应用于主流商业软件开发的最有效方法是：

                                                                                                                                                                                            Over the past decade, we've worked on many aspects of networked application R&D, ranging from blue-sky academic research to hands-on product development and consulting. In our experience, the most effective way to bring the power of advanced software R&D techniques to mainstream commercial software developers is to

                                                                                                                                                                                            1. 基于前沿系统研究，开发高质量、可重用的软件。

                                                                                                                                                                                            2. Develop high-quality reusable software based on cutting-edge systems research.

                                                                                                                                                                                            3. 与早期用户合作，将其部署到实际应用中。

                                                                                                                                                                                            4. Work with early adopters to deploy it in real-world applications.

                                                                                                                                                                                            5. 为主流软件开发人员提供商业支持和服务，帮助他们过渡和吸收新技术。

                                                                                                                                                                                            6. Provide commercial support and services to help transition and assimilate the new techniques to mainstream software developers.

                                                                                                                                                                                            只有当研究人员在实际运行系统中证明其技术的优势后，才能真正打入商业市场。然而，将技术与研究完全脱钩，可能会阻碍前沿研发工作，而这些工作对于改进和扩展新技术至关重要。研究团队与商业团队的密切合作有助于推动技术向前发展，并顺利过渡到主流市场。像 Riverace 和 DOC Group 这样的商业/学术合作项目，需要耐心和团队协作才能兼顾两者的优势。这样的成果不仅对团队所有成员意义重大，而且对受益于合作的用户群体也大有裨益。

                                                                                                                                                                                            Significant penetration into commercial markets rarely occurs until researchers demonstrate the benefits of their techniques in real-world operational systems. Completely decoupling technology from research, however, can curb the leading-edge R&D efforts required to improve and extend new technology. Close cooperation between research and commercial groups help maintain forward development and smooth migration into the mainstream. Combined commercial/academic efforts, such as Riverace and the DOC Group, require patience and teamwork to maintain the best of both worlds. The results can be quite rewarding for all parts of the team, as well as for the user community that benefits from their collaborations.

                                                                                                                                                                                              词汇表

                                                                                                                                                                                              Glossary

                                                                                                                                                                                              抽象类
                                                                                                                                                                                              Abstract Class

                                                                                                                                                                                              抽象类是指没有实现其接口中定义的所有方法的类。抽象类为其子类定义了一个公共接口。

                                                                                                                                                                                              A class that does not implement all the methods defined in its interface. An abstract class defines a common interface for its subclasses.





                                                                                                                                                                                              接收器-连接器模式
                                                                                                                                                                                              Acceptor-Connector Pattern

                                                                                                                                                                                              一种设计模式，它将网络系统中协作对等服务的连接和初始化与它们连接和初始化后执行的处理解耦。

                                                                                                                                                                                              A design pattern that decouples the connection and initialization of cooperating peer services in a networked system from the processing they perform once connected and initialized.





                                                                                                                                                                                              偶然的复杂性
                                                                                                                                                                                              Accidental Complexity

                                                                                                                                                                                              在应用领域内，由于工具和技术（例如类型不安全的 API 和过程设计）的局限性而产生的复杂性，会导致软件开发出现问题。

                                                                                                                                                                                              Complexity that arises as a side-effect of limitations with tools and techniques, such as type-unsafe APIs and procedural design, used to develop software within an application domain.





                                                                                                                                                                                              主动连接建立
                                                                                                                                                                                              Active Connection Establishment

                                                                                                                                                                                              对等应用程序所扮演的连接角色，即发起与远程对等方的连接（与被动连接建立进行比较）。

                                                                                                                                                                                              The connection role played by a peer application that initiates a connection to a remote peer (compare with Passive Connection Establishment).





                                                                                                                                                                                              活动对象
                                                                                                                                                                                              Active Object

                                                                                                                                                                                              实现了主动对象模式的对象（与被动对象进行比较）。

                                                                                                                                                                                              An object that implements the Active Object pattern (compare with Passive Object).





                                                                                                                                                                                              活动对象模式
                                                                                                                                                                                              Active Object Pattern

                                                                                                                                                                                              一种设计模式，它将方法执行与方法调用解耦，以增强并发性并简化对驻留在其自身控制线程中的对象的同步访问。

                                                                                                                                                                                              A design pattern that decouples method execution from method invocation in order to enhance concurrency and simplify synchronized access to objects that reside in their own threads of control.





                                                                                                                                                                                              算法分解
                                                                                                                                                                                              Algorithmic Decomposition

                                                                                                                                                                                              一种按功能分解程序的设计范式。

                                                                                                                                                                                              A design paradigm in which programs are decomposed by functionality.





                                                                                                                                                                                              API
                                                                                                                                                                                              API

                                                                                                                                                                                              应用程序编程接口。软件平台（例如操作系统）的外部接口，供构建在其上的系统或应用程序使用。

                                                                                                                                                                                              Application programming interface. The external interface of a software platform, such as an operating system, that is used by systems or applications built on top of it.





                                                                                                                                                                                              方面
                                                                                                                                                                                              Aspects

                                                                                                                                                                                              程序的某些属性，例如内存管理、同步或容错能力，会跨越模块边界。

                                                                                                                                                                                              A property of a program, such as memory management, synchronization, or fault tolerance, that cross-cuts module boundaries.





                                                                                                                                                                                              异步 I/O
                                                                                                                                                                                              Asynchronous I/O

                                                                                                                                                                                              一种用于发送或接收数据的机制，其中启动了 I/O 操作，但调用者不会阻塞等待操作完成。

                                                                                                                                                                                              A mechanism for sending or receiving data in which an I/O operation is initiated but the caller does not block waiting for the operation to complete.





                                                                                                                                                                                              带宽
                                                                                                                                                                                              Bandwidth

                                                                                                                                                                                              通信介质（例如网络或总线）的容量。

                                                                                                                                                                                              The capacity of a communication medium, such as a network or bus.





                                                                                                                                                                                              屏障同步
                                                                                                                                                                                              Barrier Synchronization

                                                                                                                                                                                              线程同步机制允许一组指定的线程在各自达到特定状态（例如完成某个集体操作或任务）时同步执行进度。屏障代表执行路径上的一个特定点。每个到达屏障点的线程都会等待其他线程也到达该点。当集合中的所有线程都到达屏障点时，屏障将被“释放”，所有线程同时继续执行。

                                                                                                                                                                                              A thread synchronization mechanism that allows a designated group of threads to synchronize their progress when each attains a certain state, such as completion of some collective operation or task. A barrier represents a specific point in the execution path. Each thread that reaches the barrier point waits for the other threads to also reach that point. When all threads in the set reach the barrier, the barrier is "dropped" and all threads simultaneously continue execution.





                                                                                                                                                                                              播送
                                                                                                                                                                                              Broadcast

                                                                                                                                                                                              广播是一种特殊的多播形式，它将消息从发送方传输到特定域中的所有接收方。

                                                                                                                                                                                              A broadcast is a special form of multicast, where messages are transmitted from a sender to all receivers in a particular domain.





                                                                                                                                                                                              公共汽车
                                                                                                                                                                                              Bus

                                                                                                                                                                                              连接计算设备（例如 CPU、磁盘和网络接口）的高速通信通道。

                                                                                                                                                                                              A high-speed communication channel that links computing devices, such as CPUs, disks, and network interfaces.





                                                                                                                                                                                              繁忙等待
                                                                                                                                                                                              Busy Wait

                                                                                                                                                                                              线程使用的一种技术是通过执行紧密循环并在每次迭代中轮询锁是否可用来等待锁，这与通过睡眠并允许其他线程运行来等待锁被释放的方式形成对比。

                                                                                                                                                                                              A technique used by a thread to wait for a lock by executing a tight loop and polling to see if the lock is available on each iteration, in contrast to waiting for the lock to be released by sleeping and allowing other threads to run.





                                                                                                                                                                                              打回来
                                                                                                                                                                                              Callback
